Job Description

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 25,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers are amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to make an impact. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Rockwell is looking for a Senior Software Test Engineer to join an agile team. This team is building and validating FactoryTalk Optix, a modern industrial visualization and HMI platform. The platform is used by customers to design, deploy, and maintain applications for manufacturing environments.

Position Summary

The Senior Software Test Engineer will help ensure the quality of FactoryTalk Optix by creating and executing manual and automated tests for new and existing product functionality. This role will work closely with product owners, developers, and other test engineers to understand requirements, validate features, reproduce and document defects, and support regression and release testing activities. The scope of work is focused on developing solid test engineering practices, learning the product and industrial automation domain, and contributing to a high-quality customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Create, maintain, and execute manual and automated tests for FactoryTalk Optix features.
  • Validate design-time and runtime workflows to help ensure a reliable customer experience.
  • Lead test planning, estimation, execution, and defect triage as part of an Agile team.
  • Reproduce, document, and track defects with clear titles, descriptions, steps, and supporting details.
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, and other test engineers to understand requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support regression, release, and exploratory testing activities.
  • Contribute to test documentation, quality procedures, and continuous improvement of test practices.
  • Use tools such as JIRA, QTest, Confluence, GitHub, and Jenkins to support testing and quality tracking.
  • Learn FT Optix product functionality and relevant industrial automation concepts over time.
  • Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams.

The Essentials - You Will Have

  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Legal authorization to work in the US is required.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

  • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of experience in software testing, software development, test automation, or a related technical role.
  • Experience creating, executing, and documenting manual or automated test cases.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated tests using Python, C#, or similar programming or scripting languages.
  • Experience with Squish and Selenium test frameworks
  • Experience creating or updating GitHub Actions
  • Familiarity with Linux
  • Experience with C# scripting
  • Familiarity with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, JIRA, Confluence, or QTest.
  • Exposure to performance, reliability, longevity, or regression testing.
  • Experience with industrial automation, HMI software, PLCs, and protocols such as CIP or OP-CUA

What We Offer

  • Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
  • 401k
  • Paid Time off
  • Parental and Caregiver Leave
  • Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
  • To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans.

If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at +1 (844) 404-7247.

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

Job Description

It’s about putting our best to the test.

Are you described as someone with an inquisitive mind and an innovative personality? Are you never satisfied with good enough? Does solving complex problems and ensuring top-quality applications excite you? If so, being a Quality Automation Engineer III with Frost could be for you.

At Frost, it’s about more than a job. It’s about having a flourishing career where you can thrive, both in and out of work. At Frost, we’re committed to fostering an environment that reflects our values and encourages team members to be the best they can be. In joining our adaptable, integrity-driven team, you’ll become part of Frost’s over 150-year legacy of providing unparalleled banking services.

Who You Are

As a Quality Automation Engineer III, you are our quality control, ensuring every application is stable and built with integrity, caring and excellence. You’ll play an important role in the design, creation, and testing of applications to ensure the quality and stability in every system. You’ll use your strong problem-solving skills to ensure that the applications are performing optimally and meet our high standards. You are not afraid to ask the question why and thrive in a collaborative environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Oversee, design, review, build, and deploy test automation solutions and framework for the most complex, interrelated systems to ensure the quality and stability of software applications
  • Lead the troubleshooting and triage of the most complex escalated system issues with project teams to identify the root causes, resolve issues, and implement process improvements
  • Guide and mentor other Test Automation Engineers to ensure that their test automation solutions and scripts align with Frost’s automation framework and industry standards
  • Collaborate with product management, project management, development teams, and business stakeholders to develop project, product, and testing objectives
  • Write and execute functional test cases as needed
  • Always take action using Integrity, Caring, and Excellence to achieve all-win outcomes

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience
  • 4+ years of test automation experience
  • Technical development experience with multiple programming or scripting languages like JAVA, Python while using Selenium/Playwright as framework
  • Exposure to database technologies and SQL queries
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented programming concepts and design patterns
  • Expertise in independently identifying technical issues including misconfigurations and defects in code
  • Demonstrated experience in developing functional and regression automation solutions across web, mobile and API layers with reusable components
  • Expert knowledge of the role of Test Automation and Software Quality Assurance in the development process including test planning, execution, and production support
  • Demonstrated experience leading testing efforts for complex projects and applications and partnering closely with stakeholders
  • Experience with a distributed version-control management system like GIT, BitBucket

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Experience using automated testing tools like Junit, TestNG, Cucumber, Appium, JMeter, SoapUI, Playwright
  • Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD integration including Jenkins, Maven, Splunk etc.
  • Knowledge of Non-Functional Testing (Performance, Security and Accessibility Testing)
  • Exposure to Insurance applications and functionality preferred

Our Benefits

At Frost, we care about your health, your family, and your future and strive to have our benefits reflect that. This includes:

  • Medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and life insurance
  • 401(k) matching
  • Generous holiday and paid time off schedule
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Extensive health and wellness programs, including our Employee Assistance Program
  • Referral bonus program + more!

Since 1868, Frost has dedicated their expertise to provide exceptional banking, investment, and insurance services to businesses and individuals throughout Texas. Frost is one of the 50 largest U.S. banks by asset size and is a leader in banking customer satisfaction. At Frost, it’s about being part of something bigger. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply and see what’s possible at Frost.

Job Title: Senior Test Engineer

Job Category: Engineering

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Continental US

* * *

The Opportunity

  • Work on various programs dedicated to supporting the war fighter.
  • Contribute to and improve engineering processes
  • Develop and maintain user and administrative documentation to meet customer contract requirements
  • Understand the software life-cycle management and tools
  • Travel onsite to periodically test operational systems and updates

Responsibilities

  • Work directly with software engineers and project leads
  • Analyze requirements and technical documents, and respond to the team with questions and insights
  • Construct test scenarios, test cases, and detailed procedures and verifications, connecting these with requirements and driving more testable code
  • Execute tests and report results
  • Understand, build, and document environments needed for testing
  • Research, design, and build automation to streamline various testing needs
  • Work on small teams in an agile software development life cycle to develop, maintain, and enhance diverse software systems
  • Refine and enhance existing test cases and applications to best meet requirement verification and improve operational performance
  • Apply system level knowledge (software, OS, and hardware) and tools to diagnose and describe issues

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s (or higher) degree in Computer Engineering or Computer Science
  • Minimum 6+ years of relevant work experience in software development

Required Skills

  • Must be a US Citizen and have the ability to acquire Security Clearance
  • Use of AWS, Kubernetes deployments, or other container technology like Docker
  • Use and experience of Linux debugging and diagnostic tools
  • Scripting experience in bash, python, or other relevant language
  • Dedication to Test Engineering methods and techniques

Desired

  • Active TS/SCI Clearance
  • Understanding of software, automation, and tools
  • Familiar with basic concepts of API testing and associated technologies (rest, json, etc.)
  • Understanding of distributed systems and networking
  • Demonstrable experience with source control (git)
  • Familiarity with one or more non-UI test automation frameworks
  • Experience developing automation in an Agile team (scrum, kanban)
  • Demonstrable experience with UI automation frameworks (Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or similar)
  • Competency in one or more OO languages (Python, Java)
  • Understanding of Linux security and auditing
  • Knowledge of compiled languages
  • Familiar with continuous integration tools (GitLab, Jenkins, Bamboo or similar)
  • Familiar with server hardware administration and maintenance (RAID, PCIe, IPMI)
  • Basic competency with relational databases (mysql, postres)

What You Can Expect

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$82,700 - 173,900 USD

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

FTI is seeking a Senior Software Test Engineer / SDET to lead test automation architecture and development across our web application portfolio. You will design, build, and maintain production automation frameworks, write code, and resolve complex testing challenges.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who brings technical ownership and experience delivering software within a large technology company, major defense contractor, or comparable large engineering organization. You should be comfortable working independently, explaining architectural decisions, and helping teams improve software quality.

Strong familiarity with artificial intelligence and machine learning is required, including an understanding of how these technologies support software products, development, or testing. You will also apply AI-assisted development tools and large language models to support engineering work.

Playwright is our preferred automation framework, and JavaScript/TypeScript is our preferred language background. Candidates with Python-based Playwright experience or strong Cypress framework experience will also be considered.

This role is ideally based near one of FTI’s office locations in Chesapeake, VA, Beavercreek, OH, Colorado Springs, CO, or Northern Virginia. Candidates in these markets will receive primary consideration. Exceptional remote candidates within the United States who bring highly relevant experience may also be considered.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end automation frameworks and suites for complex web applications, with Playwright as the preferred framework.
  • Own framework architecture, including reusable libraries, page objects, fixtures, utilities, test data management, and API test harnesses.
  • Write and review production-quality automation code.
  • Connect automated tests to CI/CD pipelines and investigate failures across development and build environments.
  • Develop testing strategies that balance end-to-end, API, integration, and component coverage.
  • Diagnose defects and intermittent test failures through structured root-cause analysis.
  • Improve test reliability by addressing locator stability, asynchronous behavior, timing, shared state, isolation, and race conditions.
  • Apply AI-assisted development tools and large language models to support coding, test development, debugging, and code quality.
  • Partner with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to address testability during software design and development.
  • Mentor engineers, review test code, and communicate technical decisions across teams.
  • Evaluate tools and practices that improve automation maintainability, coverage, and development speed.

Education/Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and be able to obtain a U.S. Department of Defense security clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field.
  • At least ten years of relevant software development, software quality engineering, SDET, or test automation experience.
  • Meaningful engineering experience within a large technology company, major defense contractor, or comparable large company, including less widely recognized organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, or substantially extending production automation frameworks, with ownership of architectural decisions and reusable components.
  • Strong hands-on programming skills and current or recent experience writing and troubleshooting automation code.
  • Production web automation experience using Playwright, Cypress, or a comparable modern framework. Python-based Playwright experience is acceptable.
  • Strong familiarity with AI/ML concepts and their practical application to software products, development, or testing.
  • Experience incorporating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience using Git workflows and participating in code reviews.
  • Strong understanding of web application, API, end-to-end, integration, and component testing, including the trade-offs between approaches.
  • Demonstrated debugging and root-cause analysis skills involving browser behavior, network traffic, asynchronous execution, application state, and race conditions.
  • Experience diagnosing and correcting flaky tests.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

It’s about putting our best to the test.

Are you described as someone with an inquisitive mind and an innovative personality? Are you never satisfied with good enough? Does solving complex problems and ensuring top-quality applications excite you? If so, being a Quality Automation Engineer I with Frost could be for you.

At Frost, it’s about more than a job. It’s about having a flourishing career where you can thrive, both in and out of work. At Frost, we’re committed to fostering an environment that reflects our values and encourages team members to be the best they can be. In joining our adaptable, integrity-driven team, you’ll become part of Frost’s over 150-year legacy of providing unparalleled banking services.

Who You Are

As a Quality Automation Engineer I - Enterprise Payments - Global Trade Systems, you are our quality control, ensuring every application is stable and built with integrity, caring and excellence. You’ll play an important role in the design, creation, and testing of applications to ensure the quality and stability in every system. You’ll use your strong problem-solving skills to ensure that the applications are performing optimally and meet our high standards. You are not afraid to ask the question why and thrive in a collaborative environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and deploy automated test scripts for an assigned system to ensure the quality and stability of software applications
  • Assist with troubleshooting and triaging script and system issues with project teams to identify the root causes and resolve issues
  • Document, track, and escalate issues with application changes or test scripts
  • Communicate with product management, project management and development teams to develop a strong understanding of the project, product, and testing objectives
  • Write and execute functional test cases as needed
  • Always take action using Integrity, Caring, and Excellence to achieve all-win outcomes

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent technical experience
  • Proficiency in Java or scripting languages like Ruby or Python
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented programming concepts
  • Knowledge of SQL queries

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Experience in processing Wires Payments (Domestic, International, FX, Global trade systems), knowing ISO 20022 standards
  • Experience with identifying technical issues including misconfigurations and defects in code
  • Knowledge of developing functional, load, or batch test automation solutions
  • Knowledge of testing methodologies and processes
  • Knowledge of Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, API - Postman/Karate
  • Experience using automated testing tools like Junit, TestNG, Appium, JMeter, XCUITest, and/or Expresso
  • Experience with a distributed version-control system like GIT

Our Benefits

At Frost, we care about your health, your family, and your future and strive to have our benefits reflect that. This includes:

  • Medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and life insurance
  • 401(k) matching
  • Generous holiday and paid time off schedule
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Extensive health and wellness programs, including our Employee Assistance Program
  • Referral bonus program + more!

Since 1868, Frost has dedicated their expertise to provide exceptional banking, investment, and insurance services to businesses and individuals throughout Texas. Frost is one of the 50 largest U.S. banks by asset size and is a leader in banking customer satisfaction. At Frost, it’s about being part of something bigger. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply and see what’s possible at Frost.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced SDET to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for testing, developing java components, and tracking the bugs and ensure the quality and performance of software application.


Additional Information*

The base salary for this position will vary based on geography and other factors.

In accordance with law, the base salary for this role if filled within Charlotte, NC is $80K to $100K/year & benefits (see below).


The Role:

Responsibilities:

  • Proficient in IT industry with proven experience in QA.
  • 7+ Years of experience in implementing QA strategies.
  • Experience in Automation testing.
  • Extensive experience using Cucumber, Selenium, Java
  • Good in coding in Java, Java scripting and component development.
  • Experience with Linux/UNIX environment.
  • Ability to prioritize and multi task is critical.
  • Understanding of SQA processes and methodologies as well as how to implement them throughout the SDLC.
  • Experience using Quality Center and Jira and other tools.
  • Experience testing Java-based three-tier applications deployed.
  • Experience testing high volume financial exchange systems, particularly clearing applications, a plus.
  • Should be having good Banking, finance domain experience.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Good handson Java/Python coding and Selenium, Cucumber automation testing
  • Strong experience writing SQL queries and in ETL.
  • Ideal candidate should be able to resolve automation related issues, there is no help from any other project member.
  • Candidate should be able to implement framework feature if client wants to add it to the existing framework.
  • Candidate should be able to drive the automation tasks himself.
  • Should be in a position to explain what can be the best/optimized solution/code.


Preferred, but not required:

  • Work experience in Java development in prior experience is plus
  • Experience in trading and banking, finance domain.
  • Good exposure various database NOSQL, Hadoop, Big data.

  • A multinational organization with 58 offices in 22 countries and the possibility to work abroad.

  • A comprehensive insurance plan including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and long-/short-term disability (plans vary by region).

  • A higher education certification policy.
  • Commuter benefits (varies by region).

Automation Test Engineer

The Opportunity:

When a user tries new software, they expect it to be intuitive and run smoothly. Functionality, reliability, and user experience are key to successful software development and that means rigorous testing. That’s why we need you, an experienced test engineer who knows how to thoroughly test software and work with developers to make sure our team releases the best software possible.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:

Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision. The AI-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management.

We are seeking a Software Engineer in Test (SET) with 4–6 years of experience to help deliver reliable, high-quality software through test automation and strong engineering practices. This means choosing and building the right frameworks for the company while maintaining reliability for all of our software in the age of AI.

In this role, you will build and maintain automated testing frameworks, develop test strategies, and integrate quality checks into our CI/CD pipelines. You will work closely with software engineers, product managers, and infrastructure teams to identify risks early, improve testability, and increase release confidence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated tests for APIs, services, web applications, and end-to-end workflows.
  • Build and improve reusable test frameworks, utilities, and test data management tools.
  • Translate requirements and technical designs into test plans covering functional behavior, integrations, edge cases, and failure scenarios.
  • Test Agents, LLMs and Prompts.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide timely, actionable feedback.
  • Investigate test failures, reproduce defects, and collaborate with engineers on root cause analysis and resolution.
  • Improve test reliability and execution speed by reducing flaky tests and maintaining dependable test environments.
  • Perform exploratory and targeted manual testing where automation does not provide sufficient coverage.
  • Validate data integrity and application behavior using SQL, API tools, logs, and monitoring systems.
  • Participate in design and code reviews to improve testability and identify quality risks before implementation.
  • Track and communicate quality indicators, including critical workflow coverage, escaped defects, test reliability, and execution time.
  • Contribute to performance and resilience testing and help strengthen testing practices across the team.
  • Develop with AI.


Required Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of professional experience in software testing, quality engineering, or software development, with substantial hands-on test automation experience.
  • Proficiency in at least one of these programming languages (Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript). Multiple is preferred.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated tests using frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, JUnit, or TestNG.
  • Strong experience testing REST APIs, including authentication, authorization, error handling, and response validation.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Experience with Git, code reviews, and CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
  • Understanding of test design, regression testing, integration testing, and the appropriate use of unit, service, and end-to-end tests.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to distinguish application defects from test, data, and environment issues.
  • Ability to independently own testing for a feature or service, prioritize work based on risk, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing cloud-hosted applications and distributed or microservices-based systems.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter, and/or Locust.
  • Familiarity with contract testing, event-driven systems, and asynchronous workflows.
  • Understanding of accessibility testing and secure software development practices.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to shared testing standards.


What Success Looks Like

  • Critical user journeys and service integrations have reliable automated coverage.
  • CI/CD quality checks provide fast, meaningful feedback that supports release decisions.
  • Test failures are investigated promptly, and flaky tests are consistently reduced.
  • Quality risks are identified early and communicated with clear recommendations.
  • Engineering teams can release changes with greater confidence and fewer production defects.


Exiger is named a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management, twice selected as one of Fast Company's 'Brands That Matter,' and recipient of the Third Party Risk Association's Innovator Award, Exiger's technology has been recognized by leading analyst evaluations and 50+ awards. Learn more at Exiger.com and follow Exiger on LinkedIn.

At Exiger, our values define how we work and why we lead. We are mission-inspired, imagination-driven, trust-anchored, and compassion-focused—committed to building technology that makes the world safer, more transparent, and more resilient.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

Exiger’s hybrid work policy is periodically reviewed and adjusted to align with evolving business needs.

Job Description

The Role

Fidelity is seeking a Senior Software Engineer in Test to join the Fidelity Institutional Technology Development team. In this role, you will apply strong software development and test automation expertise to design, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality solutions, with a focus on improving delivery speed, efficiency, and overall product quality.

You will partner closely with Agile team members to lead quality practices across the development lifecycle, including defining and implementing test strategies, building automation frameworks, and developing automated and functional tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end). The role also involves driving quality within CI/CD pipelines, performing quality inspections and audits, coaching developers on quality best practices, and collaborating on test coverage, release velocity, and production health—while continuously leveraging new technologies to improve testing processes and outcomes.

The Expertise And Skills You Bring

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • 5+ years of Quality Engineering experience in automated testing environments
  • 4+ years building strong test automation for web-based applications
  • 4+ years working in Agile environments (SAFe Agile preferred)
  • 2+ years of software development experience (preferred)
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, SDLC, TDD, and BDD principles
  • Experience testing enterprise applications in cloud environments (e.g., AWS)
  • Expertise with automated testing tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Cucumber, Serenity, or Selenium
  • Hands-on experience with REST and SOAP API automation (Rest Assured, ReadyAPI, JUnit)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and build tools (Jenkins, Artifactory, Bitbucket, Terracore)
  • Knowledge of containers and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Multi-stack engineering experience across Java/J2EE, Spring, JavaScript/Angular, and web services
  • Experience creating mock services for microservice-based architectures
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (Java, C#, TypeScript, Angular, HTML, XML, VB.NET)
  • Experience with source control and test management tools (Atlassian suite, XRay)

Senior Quality Automation Engineer

About Authenticx

Authenticx is a fast-growing, venture-backed, enterprise AI company transforming healthcare through conversation intelligence. We help healthcare organizations uncover insights hidden in millions of customer interactions to improve patient, member, and business outcomes.

Role Summary

The Senior Quality Automation Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and integrating automated tests across Authenticx's healthcare conversation intelligence platform. You will translate customer workflows, product requirements, user personas, and healthcare realities into automated coverage that protects the experiences that matter most. You will own automation for critical product areas and prioritize coverage based on customer impact, product risk, release frequency, and business value.

You will partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Implementation, and Customer teams to improve product quality, testability, and release confidence. We are looking for someone who brings strong technical judgment, product sense, curiosity, and ownership to quality engineering in a fast-paced startup environment.

What You'll Do

Build Automation Around Real Customer Use Cases

  • Learn how Authenticx customers use the platform across healthcare quality, coaching, compliance, operations, analytics, and customer experience workflows.
  • Translate workflows, acceptance criteria, production issues, and known risk areas into meaningful automated test scenarios.
  • Determine what should be automated, which testing layer is most appropriate, and the level of coverage needed.
  • Balance UI, API, integration, and data-level testing to create reliable and maintainable coverage.

Build and Maintain Automated Coverage

  • Design, write, maintain, and troubleshoot automated tests for UI workflows, APIs, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, reporting, and AI-powered features.
  • Build and maintain smoke, regression, acceptance, integration, and end-to-end test suites.
  • Use Playwright to automate critical user journeys and product workflows.
  • Use Bruno/Postman to validate APIs, payloads, integrations, authentication, error handling, and backend behavior.
  • Use SQL to validate data accuracy, workflow integrity, processing outcomes, reporting outputs, and customer-facing analytics.
  • Build reusable automation utilities, fixtures, helpers, and test data patterns.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide earlier and more reliable quality signals.
  • Investigate flaky tests, environmental issues, timing problems, and test-data failures, and distinguish them from true product defects.
  • Identify high-risk coverage gaps and build automation to address them.

Partner Cross-Functionally to Improve Quality

  • Work with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Implementation, and Customer teams to understand requirements, risks, and real-world usage.
  • Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, logging, test data setup, and API contracts.
  • Use logs, monitoring tools, database queries, API responses, and product data to investigate failures and validate system behavior.
  • Communicate defects, automation gaps, and release risks clearly.
  • Share automation patterns and testing practices that strengthen the broader quality engineering discipline.

Validate AI-Powered Product Experiences

  • Build automated validation for classifications, model outputs, prompt and configuration changes, structured responses, extraction workflows, and downstream behavior.
  • Develop repeatable test scenarios for deterministic and semi-deterministic AI behaviors.
  • Validate expected outputs, required fields, edge cases, failure conditions, and downstream workflow impacts.
  • Use representative test data and known expected outcomes to detect regressions.
  • Partner with Data Science and Engineering to improve the testability and regression coverage of AI-powered features.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years in test automation, SDET, or software engineering, with hands on ownership of automated suites
  • Production level coding in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, or Python
  • Playwright or equivalent modern UI automation on complex web applications
  • REST API testing (Bruno, Postman, or code based), covering authentication, payload validation, and error handling
  • SQL proficiency to validate data integrity and processing outcomes
  • CI/CD integration, including failure triage, flaky test diagnosis, and test data management
  • Ability to assess product risk and choose the right test layer (UI, API, or data) without having every case defined for you
  • Experience validating asynchronous, multi service workflows

Preferred Qualifications

  • C#/.NET, PostgreSQL, and Azure
  • Experience testing LLM or ML features using representative datasets, expected outcomes, and threshold based regression checks
  • Ingestion pipelines, event driven systems, and third party integrations
  • Healthcare, contact center, or regulated environment experience
  • AI assisted development tools for test creation and debugging

This role will be located in Indianapolis and work hybrid in our office location.

Payactiv is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer who will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing automated testing strategies and frameworks to ensure the quality and reliability of software products. What You Will Do…

  • Contribute the overall test automation strategy across platforms and product lines. Identify and prioritize test cases for automation.
  • Develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and reusable test automation frameworks for web, mobile, and desktop applications.
  • Create, execute, and maintain automated tests for functional, regression, API, performance, and security testing.
  • Integrate automated tests into Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to enable continuous testing.
  • Analyze test results, troubleshoot issues by conducting root cause analysis, and effectively report defects to development teams.
  • Work closely with developers, product managers, and other QA engineers to ensure comprehensive test coverage, define acceptance criteria, and address quality concerns.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior QA engineers on best practices, tools, and automation techniques.
  • Proactively identify areas for improvement in QA processes, tools, and metrics to optimize testing efficiency.
  • Supervise and guide the testing team to ensure adherence to established testing methodologies and quality standards.

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance with a strong focus on test automation.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is often required.
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, Gherkin or Cucumber.

  • Experience with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) frameworks like Cucumber or SpecFlow, Maven, Page Object Model, Page Factory Model and TestNG

  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Must have 2+ years of AI Experience
  • Hands-on experience with industry-standard test automation tools and frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Junit along-with BrowserStack and XCUITest.
  • Familiarity with cloud testing environments and technologies (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Knowledge of performance and security testing tools (e.g., JMeter, OWASP ZAP).
  • Experience in a specific industry, such as finance, or e-commerce.
  • Relevant certifications such as ISTQB.

  • Company Sponsored Health, Dental and Vision insurance
  • 401K, traditional and Roth with employer match
  • Tuition Assistance or Tuition Reimbursement
  • Monthly Gym Reimbursement

Job Description

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Software Quality Automation Engineer to join the Mist Engineering team. This role is ideal for engineers with strong software development and automation skills who are passionate about improving product quality through scalable test frameworks, intelligent automation, and rigorous validation.

While experience in Quality Assurance is valuable, we place greater emphasis on software engineering capabilities, particularly Python development, automation design, and problem-solving skills. Candidates with strong coding and cloud application experience who are interested in quality engineering are encouraged to apply.

U.S. citizenship is required for this role. This is an onsite position based in Cupertino, CA, requiring 5 days per week in the office, along with flexibility to attend meetings outside of standard business hours at least 3 days per week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and tools using Python.
  • Create scalable automation solutions for validating cloud, web UI, and REST API functionality.
  • Develop test infrastructure to improve engineering productivity and product quality.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers to identify, reproduce, troubleshoot, and resolve defects.
  • Analyze system behavior, logs, and telemetry to diagnose complex issues.
  • Build and maintain test environments, automation pipelines, and quality metrics.
  • Participate in feature reviews and provide feedback on testability and automation strategy.
  • Investigate customer-reported issues and reproduce problems in lab environments when required.
  • Continuously improve automation coverage, testing efficiency, and release quality.
  • Document automation solutions, test methodologies, and troubleshooting procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizen.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 2+ years of software engineering, automation engineering, quality engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of Python programming with demonstrated experience developing software or automation solutions.
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining automated testing frameworks.
  • Experience validating REST APIs and web applications.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working independently and driving technical solutions with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Selenium, Playwright, pytest, or similar automation frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud-native applications and distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with Django, RESTful services, and modern web architectures.
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates.
  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS products.

What We Are Looking For

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

  • Strong coding ability and software development fundamentals.
  • Ability to design and build automation, rather than simply execute existing test suites.
  • Analytical thinking and a passion for solving complex technical problems.
  • Self-motivation and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced engineering environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and collaboration skills.
  • Curiosity, continuous learning, and ownership mindset.
  • Must be able to join team meetings three times a week during early or late hours to support international teams and customers.
  • No travel required for this role.

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Job Overview

The Sr. Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET III) plays a critical role in our Software Development Life Cycle by designing, developing, and maintaining robust end-to-end test automation frameworks. This role works with multiple teams on different products to further the test strategy and capability of the QA department, leveraging modern automation tools and AI-powered testing agents. The Senior SDET will be involved from the initial design and grooming, through development and testing, to production promotion and maintenance.

Req ID: 395918

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Front Office Automation Tester to join our team in Charlotte, North Carolina (US-NC), United States (US).

We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer to support Front Office Sales & Trading technology platforms. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated testing solutions to validate the functionality, performance, stability, and accuracy of trading and financial applications. The successful candidate will partner with business stakeholders, developers, business analysts, and quality engineering teams to ensure high-quality software delivery across Fixed Income and Derivatives trading workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test frameworks and test scripts for Front Office trading applications.
  • Create and enhance API, UI, functional, regression, and integration test automation suites.
  • Validate trading workflows, order management processes, market data functionality, and transaction processing capabilities.
  • Collaborate with traders, business analysts, developers, and project teams to understand business requirements and define testing strategies.
  • Analyze test results, identify defects, document findings, and work with development teams to support issue resolution.
  • Develop and maintain test plans, test cases, test data, and testing documentation.
  • Ensure adequate test coverage for business processes, application functionality, and regulatory requirements.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Support continuous integration and continuous testing initiatives within the software development lifecycle.
  • Contribute to the enhancement and optimization of automation frameworks, testing standards, and quality engineering best practices.
  • Perform data validation and database testing activities as required.
  • Support release validation, production readiness testing, and post-deployment verification activities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in software quality assurance, test automation, or quality engineering.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience developing automated tests using Python.
  • Experience with UI automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience testing APIs, web services, and data integrations.
  • Experience working within Agile software development environments.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test design techniques, and defect management processes.
  • Ability to analyze complex business and technical requirements and translate them into automated test solutions.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for U.S.-based positions. The starting pay range for this role is $90,000-115,000 per year. Overview

The Sr. Automation Engineer is responsible for implementing and maintaining automated UI and API testing frameworks and scenarios. This role will work closely with Automation Architects, Sr. Quality Engineers, other QA Engineers and Developers to ensure that all aspects of the applications have proper testing coverage and overall system reliability, performance and quality.

Deliver effective and efficient technical solutions by meeting key project milestones and overall project deliverables on-time and adhering to development and quality standards. Create, review and approve test plans, scenarios, scripts or procedures that contribute to the overall testing framework. Collaborate and interact with other application teams for integration testing efforts.

Responsibilities

  • Accountable for developing and the effective and timely completion of UI and API automation test activities performed on multiple projects, including driving tasks and milestones to complete within the timeframes of a well-defined project plan and/or sprint that includes planning, design, build and execution tasks, while providing guidance to resolve problems as issues arise.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of current test automation process, procedures and best practices to ensure that all QE work is being performed accordingly. Ability to think outside the box and adjust to IT and business needs collaboratively in order to meet project objectives.
  • Adheres to all organizational standards and best practices.
  • Provide Rough Order of Magnitude Estimates (ROMs) and forecast resource needs for automation projects.
  • Establish and maintain metrics which measure resource productivity, test progress and automation effectiveness.
  • Identify potential improvements, best practices and efficiency to test automation process, implement and/or communicate solutions.
  • Demonstrates strong analytical, problem solving and time management skills.
  • Provide QE input into root cause analysis and conduct lessons learned sessions with IT/BA/QA following each release.
  • Provide transparency into automation activities and defect management to project / program leadership.
  • Should be able to perform setting up frameworks on multiple application platforms for building robust, scalable, and high–quality test automation solutions for functional, regression and In-sprint testing.
  • Work with QE team members, software developers and system and database administrators to trouble-shoot test failures in the various test environments. This may include trouble-shooting database issues using SQL queries, reviewing web server and application server logs, etc.
  • Partner with Automation Architect/Sr. Automation Engineer/Lead on all automation activities to ensure alignment with the organizational strategy and approach.

Qualifications

Knowledge and Requirements

  • College Degree preferred in Computer Science, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 8+ years of hands-on Software Testing, Development and/or Test Management experience, including experience in advanced test automation strategies.
  • Experience with BDD and TDD a plus. Experience with Azure DevOps and Azure cloud testing platforms a plus.
  • Experienced with C#, Java, .NET, SQL or other software languages.
  • Experienced with both UI and Rest API automation.
  • Experienced with Object-Oriented Design and Patterns.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and time management skills.
  • Experienced in working with AGILE, DevOps CI/CD process administration methodology.
  • Knowledge of different test methods/tools such as MS Test, TestNG, JUnit/NUnit, GIT, Selenium WebDriver, and so forth. Knowledge of current trends in automation and ability to quickly pick up and learn new technologies and concepts independently, e.g., AI, ML, IoT,.

AI & Advanced QE Capabilities (Must Have)

  • Ability to create and work with AI agents for testing/automation
  • Use AI tools (Copilot etc.) for test generation, script creation, and debugging
  • Validate and test AI-generated code and outputs
  • Understand prompting and AI guardrails

Total Rewards

Selective Insurance offers a total rewards package that includes a competitive base salary, incentive plan eligibility at all levels, and a wide array of benefits designed to help you and your family stay healthy, achieve your financial goals, and balance the demands of your work and personal life. These benefits include comprehensive health care plans, retirement savings plan with company match, discounted Employee Stock Purchase Program, tuition assistance and reimbursement programs, and 20 days of paid time off. Additional details about our total rewards package can be found by visiting our benefits page.

The actual base salary is based on geographic location, and the range is representative of salaries for this role throughout Selective's footprint. Additional considerations include relevant education, qualifications, experience, skills, performance, and business needs.

Pay Range

USD $101,000.00 - USD $137,000.00 /Yr.

Additional Information

Selective is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. That means we respect and value every individual’s unique opinions, beliefs, abilities, and perspectives. We are committed to promoting a welcoming culture that celebrates diverse talent, individual identity, different points of view and experiences – and empowers employees to contribute new ideas that support our continued and growing success. Building a highly engaged team is one of our core strategic imperatives, which we believe is enhanced by diversity, equity, and inclusion. We expect and encourage all employees and all of our business partners to embrace, practice, and monitor the attitudes, values, and goals of acceptance; address biases; and foster diversity of viewpoints and opinions.

For Massachusetts Applicants

The ideal candidate will have strong hands on expertise in UI and API automation, with experience using Selenium WebDriver, Microsoft Playwright, Karate API, Postman, SoapUI, and Oracle Application Testing Suite (OATS).

The candidate will work closely with development, product, business, and DevOps teams to define test strategies, build scalable automation frameworks, integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, and ensure the quality and reliability of mission critical applications.

Experience working in Banking & Financial Services environments is strongly preferred.

  • Develop automated test scripts for web applications, APIs, services, and integration workflows.

  • Develop API and service level automated tests using: Karate API Postman SoapUI
  • Create reusable automation components, utilities, libraries, and test data frameworks.
  • Develop automated regression, functional, integration, smoke, and end to end test suites.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, developers, product owners, and architects to understand requirements and define appropriate test coverage.
  • Analyze functional and technical requirements and develop detailed test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and test cases.
  • Perform API validation, backend validation, database testing, and integration testing.
  • Validate application behavior across multiple systems and interconnected banking platforms.
  • Integrate automated testing into enterprise CI/CD pipelines.
  • Execute automated tests as part of build, deployment, and release pipelines.
  • Analyze automation failures, application defects, environment issues, and test data problems.
  • Track, document, prioritize, and manage defects through resolution.
  • Participate in defect triage sessions and collaborate with development teams on root cause analysis.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, testing efficiency, and overall product quality.
  • Support release validation and production readiness activities.
  • Mentor junior automation engineers and promote test automation standards and engineering best practices.

  • Strong hands-on experience in test automation framework design and development.
  • Extensive experience with Selenium WebDriver.

  • Strong API testing and automation experience using Karate API, Postman, and/or SoapUI.
  • Experience with Oracle Application Testing Suite (OATS) is desirable.
  • Strong programming skills in: Core Java JavaScript
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming concepts and reusable automation design.

  • Experience testing applications running across Windows and Linux environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum software development and testing practices.

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by participating in product architecture discussions, promoting test‑driven development, and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400-$115,000 based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Automation & Testing Execution: Design, write, and maintain robust automated test suites while creating targeted manual test cases for features requiring hands-on validation.
  • Agile Requirements Refinement: Active participation in story grooming and refinement sessions to clarify acceptance criteria, spot edge cases early, and ensure testability.
  • Quality & Integration: Partner directly with cross-functional development teams to execute integration and regression testing, ensuring high performance, security, and end-user reliability before release.
  • Defect Analysis & Troubleshooting: Debug build failures, triage bug reports, and perform root-cause analysis to ensure rapid, effective resolutions in non-production and production environments.
  • Framework & Process Improvement: Maintain quality assurance documentation, adopt industry best practices in the industry, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium, API Testing, Playwright etc).
  • Experience with Windows and Unix Based Systems
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team.

That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health so you can thrive both personally and professionally.

We’re also leading the way in technology modernization, helping financial institutions evolve with speed, security, and flexibility. Our strategy focuses on delivering secure data access, mitigating fraud, and enabling seamless integration. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders.

Culture of Commitment

Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. Our culture empowers us to rise to challenges, seek new opportunities, and support one another through change. It’s this shared commitment that drives our success. We’re proud to foster an environment where inclusion, sustainability, and community impact are more than values, they’re how we operate. Job Description

The Team

We are seeking a Senior Test Automation Engineer to join the Information Technology organization’s Quality Assurance team at American Tower. The team focuses on improving software quality, strengthening automated regression coverage, and supporting reliable delivery across enterprise platforms. Day to day you will design, develop, maintain, and execute scalable automated test solutions using modern automation tools and frameworks while helping advance automation standards, continuous integration and continuous delivery integration, and quality engineering practices. As a Senior Test Automation Engineer, you will collaborate closely with Quality Assurance, development, business analyst, product owner, and application teams to validate critical business processes, identify quality risks, and deliver automation solutions that improve test efficiency, coverage, and release confidence.

Responsibilities

What You Can Offer Us

  • Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts and frameworks for enterprise applications using tools such as Unified Functional Testing (UFT), Tosca, Playwright, and/or similar automation platforms.
  • Partner with Quality Assurance, development, business analyst, and product teams to understand requirements, identify automation opportunities, and validate critical business processes.
  • Lead automation design and implementation for regression, functional, integration, and end-to-end testing across applications such as Salesforce, Oracle E-Business Suite, and other similar platforms.
  • Integrate automated tests with continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, test management tools, and reporting solutions to support repeatable execution, traceability, and release readiness.
  • Review test results, troubleshoot automation failures, identify quality risks, and collaborate with teams to drive timely defect resolution and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor Quality Assurance team members on automation best practices, coding standards, and quality engineering approaches.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications

What You Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, and/or a related field strongly preferred.
  • A minimum of 6 years of software quality assurance experience required.
  • Hands-on experience designing and developing test automation solutions for enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Oracle E-Business Suite, web applications, application programming interfaces, and/or similar business-critical platforms required.
  • Experience creating and maintaining automated test scripts using tools such as Unified Functional Testing, Tosca, Playwright, Selenium, and/or similar platforms required.
  • Working knowledge of scripting languages, test management processes, defect tracking, and integration of test automation into software delivery pipelines required.
  • Fluency in English required; multilingual capabilities preferred.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and suggestions clearly and effectively.
  • Ability to work with different functional groups and levels of employees to effectively and professionally achieve results.
  • Strong organizational skills; ability to accomplish multiple tasks within the established timeframes through effective prioritization of duties and functions in a fast-paced environment.

American Tower is a global digital infrastructure company serving customers through tower sites and other real estate solutions that support connectivity and opportunity, focused on achieving our vision of Building a More Connected World. Our success is rooted in the potential of our people and the power of local teams at our offices and sites across 25 countries.

We are one of the largest global Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) and a publicly traded (NYSE:AMT), Fortune 500 Company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. The next decade will be an exciting time as we evolve our infrastructure to meet tomorrow’s needs and position our people to elevate their impact, their potential, and our shared success. Come grow your career with us!

For more information about how American Tower is building a more connected world, visit americantower.com

  • Python or TypeScript skills, basic knowledge of databases and related scripting/programming.
  • Detail-oriented, quick learner with the ability to multi-task.
  • Demonstrated ability to work as part of an integrated team, as well as independently.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills conducive to team building.
  • Must have good practical testing skills and an understanding of QA and development.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced agile environment.
  • Experience working with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning capabilities.

  • Familiarity with DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Development.

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Sr. Software Development Engineer In Test, ML/AI

At SIE, we believe in making play safer for everyone. Within our Information Security team, we protect our people, platforms, and products with smart, scalable, and thoughtful solutions. Our mission is to provide clear, actionable risk and security insights that guide the business and enable amazing player experiences.

We’re building a team that thrives on collaboration, curiosity, and delivering real value. Come help us make a difference!

Overview

We are hiring a Sr Software Engineer in Test specializing in ML/AI quality, including automation for model evaluation, LLM-assisted test generation, and validation of AI-powered workflows. The role includes guiding quality strategy and developing automation frameworks. You will also manage implementation for complex, cross-functional, machine learning-powered products and services. This role involves more than test development. You will lead quality initiatives from start to finish, ensuring teams stay synchronized, dependencies are managed, and releases are delivered confidently. You will work closely with ML, engineering, product, and infrastructure teams. You will shape how quality is built, monitored, and expanded while leading embedded QE efforts within projects.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and complete quality strategies, test plans, and automation coverage for ML-powered services and platform components.
  • Use LLMs and other AI-assisted techniques to generate, expand, and maintain high-value test cases for ML-powered workflows.
  • Design scenario-based test suites for AI features, including adversarial prompts, edge cases, ambiguous inputs, and underrepresented user scenarios.
  • Lead QE efforts for multi-functional projects, driving risk assessment, dependency management, and release readiness.
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for backend services, APIs, and ML inference systems using Python and/or Java.
  • Build automated validation for ML and LLM outputs, including ranking behavior, score distributions, prompt/response quality, hallucination indicators, and probabilistic model evaluation.
  • Debug test failures, service anomalies, model inconsistencies, and AI behavior regressions to identify root causes and drive resolution.
  • Perform functional, integration, regression, API, end-to-end, performance, and reliability testing for distributed systems.
  • Improve automation reliability, reduce flakiness, and optimize execution efficiency.
  • Partner with engineering and ML teams to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and release workflows.
  • Collaborate across teams to establish scalable quality standards, tooling, and guidelines.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent
  • 5+ years of experience as an SDET or QE engineer focused on backend and distributed systems.
  • Experience using LLMs to generate, transform, and prioritize test cases for AI-powered experiences.
  • Experience with AI evaluation tooling, prompt evaluation frameworks, model monitoring, or human-in-the-loop review workflows.
  • Strong experience testing RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed architectures.
  • Proficiency in Python, Java, JS or similar languages for automation development.
  • Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as pytest, JUnit, Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or Appium.
  • Experience with CI/CD systems and test pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.).
  • Experience with cloud and container technologies (AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Familiarity with databases, monitoring, and observability tools.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and release processes.
  • Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience validating ML outputs using statistical analysis or scenario-based testing approaches.
  • Familiarity with ML infrastructure, data pipelines, or model-serving platforms (Seldon, KServe, Ray Serve, etc.).
  • Prior work in content moderation ML, security, fraud detection, or adversarial ML.
  • Experience testing high-scale, low-latency online services.
  • Experience with Databricks or similar ML platform tooling.
  • Familiarity with Node.js, React, or modern frontend technologies.
  • Experience testing mobile, console, or other non-PC platforms.

What Sets You Apart

  • Strong combination of automation engineering and delivery ownership.
  • Ability to drive quality across complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Practical understanding of how to test non-deterministic AI systems and separate model variance from quality regressions.
  • Proven risk management and dependency coordination skills.
  • Ability to influence engineering teams and promote quality guidelines.
  • Passion for scalable, reliable, and maintainable automation systems.

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

The estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.

$152,500—$228,700 USD

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.
