descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly skilled Automation Software Tester / Quality Assurance Engineer to support the development of Clinical Trials Research Management applications for CTIS, a CMMI Level 3 certified company. This role focuses on designing, executing, and maintaining automated test solutions within an Agile DevOps environment. You will be responsible for thorough test coverage, writing and debugging automated scripts, executing exploratory testing, and validating software functionality across the web and mobile platforms.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS (Job Requirements)


Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


  • Support the design, development, and testing of software products with a focus on quality engineering and automated testing throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain manual and automated test cases, test scripts, and test suites for web, and web service/API applications based on business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications.

  • Maintain a basic understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) concepts and utilize AI-assisted development and code assistant tools, where appropriate, to improve software testing efficiency and automation effectiveness. Experience with such tools is beneficial.

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize scalable automation frameworks using technologies such as Selenium, Java, TestNG, Cucumber, REST Assured (or equivalent API automation frameworks), and support cross-browser, cross-device, parallel, and environment-agnostic test execution.

  • Design and execute automated testing for web services and APIs (REST, and SOAP), including authentication, authorization, request/response validation, contract testing, error handling, performance, and integration testing.

  • Configure and maintain automated test environments using externalized configuration, parameterization, and secure credential management to enable execution across development, test, staging, and production-like environments.

  • Integrate UI and API automation into CI/CD pipelines using Bamboo, Bitbucket, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar technologies to support continuous testing and continuous delivery.

  • Perform cross-browser, cross-device, accessibility, database, and backend validation testing, including SQL query development and execution to verify data integrity and application functionality.

  • Support testing of applications deployed in Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments, including cloud-hosted applications, cloud-native services, integrations, logging, monitoring, and distributed application architectures.

  • Identify, analyze, document, and track software defects, performance bottlenecks, and integration issues using test results, application logs, and cloud monitoring tools, providing clear and actionable recommendations for resolution.

  • Collaborate effectively with software developers, DevOps engineers, cloud engineers, product owners, and QA team members to ensure high-quality software delivery and continuous process improvement.

  • Communicate test strategies, execution status, quality metrics, risks, and defects to project stakeholders and provide technical guidance and QA best practices to strengthen the organization's quality engineering capabilities.

  • May be asked to Facilitate all Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, Backlog Refinement, and Inspect and Adapt sessions.

  • May be asked to Facilitate preparation and readiness for Agile Release Train (ART) ceremonies.

  • May be asked to Coordinate release planning and readiness activities with Product Owners, development, QA, and other stakeholders to ensure successful and timely releases.

  • May be asked track release milestones, dependencies, risks, and impediments, ensuring the team remains aligned with PI objectives and release commitments.

  • May be asked to Facilitate release readiness discussions, communicate delivery status, and coordinate cross-team activities to support successful production deployments.

    •  


    COMPETENCIES


  • SAFe Agile methodologies, Agile testing practices, and Acceptance Test-Driven Development (ATDD).

  • Proficiency in test automation technologies and scripting, including Selenium, Java, TestNG, Cucumber, REST Assured (or equivalent API automation frameworks), Jira, Xray, and related quality engineering tools.

  • Experience designing and implementing scalable, environment-agnostic automation frameworks for web, mobile, and API testing using reusable, configurable, and parameterized test components.

  • Knowledge of API and web service testing, including REST, SOAP, GraphQL, authentication and authorization, contract validation, and API security testing.

  • Knowledge of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices and tools to support automated testing within modern software development lifecycles.

  • Working knowledge of Amazon Web Services (AWS) and cloud-native application testing, including cloud architecture fundamentals, microservices, containerized applications, distributed systems, cloud logging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose application, integration, database, and cloud-related issues using logs, monitoring tools, and test results.

  • Exceptional attention to detail with a strong commitment to software quality, customer requirements, and continuous process improvement.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional Agile, DevOps, and cloud engineering teams while effectively managing priorities and meeting commitments.

    •  


     


    PHYSICAL DEMANDS


    The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.


     


    While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. This is largely a sedentary role; however, some filing is required. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand on a stool as necessary. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms.


     


    POSITION TYPE/EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK 


    This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. 






    REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE


  • 5+ years of software testing experience, including both manual and automated testing.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in automation testing.

  • Proficiency with Selenium, Java, TestNG, Cucumber, Gherkin, Jira, Deque AXE, and Xray.

  • Strong experience with cross-browser and mobile platform testing.

  • Experience setting up, optimizing, and maintaining test automation frameworks.

  • Understanding of Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD).

  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Bamboo and Bitbucket.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently and take initiative in identifying automation opportunities.

  • Experience with Section 508 compliance testing and accessibility tools.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred.

  • Experience developing automated test suites for REST/SOAP/GraphQL web services using REST Assured, Postman/Newman, ReadyAPI, or equivalent API automation frameworks.

  • Working knowledge of AWS cloud services and testing applications deployed in cloud environments.

  • Experience testing microservices-based and cloud-native applications.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized test environments is preferred.

    •  


    PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE


  • Experience running continuous integration build life cycles focused on automation

  • Hands-on experience certifying that software is section 508-compliance

  • Knowledge of clinical trials and their conduct

  • Experience testing hospital management systems and/or electronic medical records

  • Experience working in a CMMI environment

  • Experience serving as a Scrum Master or Agile team facilitator in a SAFe environment, including facilitating Agile/Scrum and ART ceremonies, coordinating release readiness, tracking risks and impediments, and reporting status using Jira; Agile certification (CSM, PSM, or SAFe Scrum Master) is a plus

    •  


    OTHER DUTIES

We are seeking a highly skilled Automation Software Tester / Quality Assurance Engineer to support the development of Clinical Trials Research Management applications for CTIS, a CMMI Level 3 certified company. This role focuses on designing, executing, and maintaining automated test solutions within an Agile DevOps environment. You will be responsible for thorough test coverage, writing and debugging automated scripts, executing exploratory testing, and validating software functionality across the web and mobile platforms.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS (Job Requirements)

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

- Support the design, development, and testing of software products with a focus on quality engineering and automated testing throughout the software development lifecycle.

- Design, develop, execute, and maintain manual and automated test cases, test scripts, and test suites for web, and web service/API applications based on business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications.

- Maintain a basic understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) concepts and utilize AI-assisted development and code assistant tools, where appropriate, to improve software testing efficiency and automation effectiveness. Experience with such tools is beneficial.

- Develop, maintain, and optimize scalable automation frameworks using technologies such as Selenium, Java, TestNG, Cucumber, REST Assured (or equivalent API automation frameworks), and support cross-browser, cross-device, parallel, and environment-agnostic test execution.

- Design and execute automated testing for web services and APIs (REST, and SOAP), including authentication, authorization, request/response validation, contract testing, error handling, performance, and integration testing.

- Configure and maintain automated test environments using externalized configuration, parameterization, and secure credential management to enable execution across development, test, staging, and production-like environments.

- Integrate UI and API automation into CI/CD pipelines using Bamboo, Bitbucket, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar technologies to support continuous testing and continuous delivery.

- Perform cross-browser, cross-device, accessibility, database, and backend validation testing, including SQL query development and execution to verify data integrity and application functionality.

- Support testing of applications deployed in Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments, including cloud-hosted applications, cloud-native services, integrations, logging, monitoring, and distributed application architectures.

- Identify, analyze, document, and track software defects, performance bottlenecks, and integration issues using test results, application logs, and cloud monitoring tools, providing clear and actionable recommendations for resolution.

- Collaborate effectively with software developers, DevOps engineers, cloud engineers, product owners, and QA team members to ensure high-quality software delivery and continuous process improvement.

- Communicate test strategies, execution status, quality metrics, risks, and defects to project stakeholders and provide technical guidance and QA best practices to strengthen the organization's quality engineering capabilities.

- May be asked to Facilitate all Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, Backlog Refinement, and Inspect and Adapt sessions.

- May be asked to Facilitate preparation and readiness for Agile Release Train (ART) ceremonies.

- May be asked to Coordinate release planning and readiness activities with Product Owners, development, QA, and other stakeholders to ensure successful and timely releases.

- May be asked track release milestones, dependencies, risks, and impediments, ensuring the team remains aligned with PI objectives and release commitments.

- May be asked to Facilitate release readiness discussions, communicate delivery status, and coordinate cross-team activities to support successful production deployments.

 

COMPETENCIES

- SAFe Agile methodologies, Agile testing practices, and Acceptance Test-Driven Development (ATDD).

- Proficiency in test automation technologies and scripting, including Selenium, Java, TestNG, Cucumber, REST Assured (or equivalent API automation frameworks), Jira, Xray, and related quality engineering tools.

- Experience designing and implementing scalable, environment-agnostic automation frameworks for web, mobile, and API testing using reusable, configurable, and parameterized test components.

- Knowledge of API and web service testing, including REST, SOAP, GraphQL, authentication and authorization, contract validation, and API security testing.

- Knowledge of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices and tools to support automated testing within modern software development lifecycles.

- Working knowledge of Amazon Web Services (AWS) and cloud-native application testing, including cloud architecture fundamentals, microservices, containerized applications, distributed systems, cloud logging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose application, integration, database, and cloud-related issues using logs, monitoring tools, and test results.

- Exceptional attention to detail with a strong commitment to software quality, customer requirements, and continuous process improvement.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional Agile, DevOps, and cloud engineering teams while effectively managing priorities and meeting commitments.

 

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. This is largely a sedentary role; however, some filing is required. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand on a stool as necessary. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms.

 

POSITION TYPE/EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK 
 

 This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. 


 



REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

- 5+ years of software testing experience, including both manual and automated testing.

- 2+ years of hands-on experience in automation testing.

- Proficiency with Selenium, Java, TestNG, Cucumber, Gherkin, Jira, Deque AXE, and Xray.

- Strong experience with cross-browser and mobile platform testing.

- Experience setting up, optimizing, and maintaining test automation frameworks.

- Understanding of Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD).

- Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Bamboo and Bitbucket.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently and take initiative in identifying automation opportunities.

- Experience with Section 508 compliance testing and accessibility tools.

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred.

- Experience developing automated test suites for REST/SOAP/GraphQL web services using REST Assured, Postman/Newman, ReadyAPI, or equivalent API automation frameworks.

- Working knowledge of AWS cloud services and testing applications deployed in cloud environments.

- Experience testing microservices-based and cloud-native applications.

- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized test environments is preferred.

 

PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

- Experience running continuous integration build life cycles focused on automation

- Hands-on experience certifying that software is section 508-compliance

- Knowledge of clinical trials and their conduct

- Experience testing hospital management systems and/or electronic medical records

- Experience working in a CMMI environment

- Experience serving as a Scrum Master or Agile team facilitator in a SAFe environment, including facilitating Agile/Scrum and ART ceremonies, coordinating release readiness, tracking risks and impediments, and reporting status using Jira; Agile certification (CSM, PSM, or SAFe Scrum Master) is a plus

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by participating in product architecture discussions, promoting test‑driven development, and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400-$115,000 based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium, API Testing, Playwright etc).
  • Experience with Windows and Unix Based Systems
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

Job Description

Position Description:

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows. You will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities

  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with TypeScript, Selenium, and related API-testing tools.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Execute product testing focusing on end-to-end, performance and load testing.
  • Create and report test-cycle metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements that reduce cycle time.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Create reusable automation workflows and prompts that connect product requirements, code changes, Jira or Azure DevOps issues, test results, logs, and documentation into repeatable QA processes.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.
  • Improve automated test coverage, regression readiness, and feedback speed by identifying repeatable QA workflows and reducing manual effort across release cycles.
  • Document how AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, validated, and incorporated into automation assets when those outputs influence test coverage, quality decisions, or product release readiness.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Powershell and/or C#.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Cryptography knowledge including Key Management.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) will be responsible for advancing software quality across the Post Production Automation platform through a combination of manual validation, test automation, performance testing, and quality engineering practices. The role will partner closely with Development, DevOps, Architecture, and operational teams to improve test coverage, shorten feedback loops, and establish repeatable quality practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, integration, performance, and regression tests for the Post Production Automation platform.
  • Develop and maintain reusable test frameworks, fixtures, utilities, test data, and automation standards to support scalable testing.
  • Create and maintain test cases for critical user workflows, including functional, negative, regression, integration, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Partner with Development and DevOps to identify high-value manual validation scenarios and convert appropriate scenarios into repeatable automated tests.
  • Partner with Development early in the delivery lifecycle to review requirements and acceptance criteria for testability, completeness, business risk, adjacent workflow impact, and potential defects.
  • Perform exploratory and manual testing when automation is not appropriate or additional investigation is required.
  • Troubleshoot test failures and application issues to distinguish between software defects, automation defects, test data issues, and environment-related failures.
  • Support root cause analysis for significant defects and production issues and develop regression coverage to help prevent recurrence.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish practical quality gates for software delivery.
  • Develop and maintain test reporting, dashboards, and quality metrics that provide visibility into test results, coverage, defects, and application quality.
  • Ability to provide off-hours operational support, including nightly deployments and incident response.
  • Collaborate with DevOps on release readiness, deployment validation, and production issues requiring additional test coverage or defect reproduction.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve test reliability, execution time, automation coverage, and overall quality engineering practices.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of experience in hybrid QA, SDET, Software Quality Engineering, or similar roles combining manual testing and test automation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience with test management tools such as QMetry, TestRail, or similar platforms.
  • Strong experience designing and maintaining automated UI, API, integration, regression, and performance test suites.
  • Experience with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with REST API and performance testing, including analysis of application behavior under load.
  • Experience creating and maintaining reusable test cases, test data, fixtures, and regression coverage for business-critical workflows.
  • Strong systems-level troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to trace failures across UI, API, application services, test automation, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated critical-thinking skills and the ability to analyze complex problems, identify risk, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis and converting production defects into preventative regression coverage.
  • Experience with source control management, preferably Git.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and software build and deployment processes.
  • Ability to read and understand application code, logs, API responses, and system behavior to support defect investigation.
  • Strong cross-team collaboration skills with experience working across Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and operational teams.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or similar iterative software development environments.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Production Asset Management and Media Asset Management systems.
  • Experience mentoring developers on unit testing, testability, and quality-engineering practices.
  • Experience testing applications deployed across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, or similar infrastructure and deployment technologies.
  • Experience testing complex integrations, asynchronous workflows, file movement, databases, messaging, and distributed application components.
  • Familiarity with observability tools, logging, monitoring, dashboards, and test reporting platforms.
  • Ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
  • Ability to adapt to changing requirements, priorities, release schedules, and production needs.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across technical and operational teams

Additional Requirements:

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $90,000 - $105,000

Good things are happening at Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies —an A+ (Superior) rated, nationwide Property & Casualty insurer backed by Berkshire Hathaway.   • Competitive pay + generous PTO
  • Medical, dental & vision starting day one

Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled and experienced QA Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust automated testing solutions. This role requires a deeper understanding of automation frameworks and the ability to lead testing efforts for complex features and systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement scalable and maintainable automated test frameworks using Tricentis Tosca and other tools.
  • Analyze business and functional requirements related to P&C insurance systems and translate them into effective automated test strategies and plans.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API testing, accessibility testing across web and backend systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, developers, and product owners to ensure test coverage and quality.
  • Execute automated test cases, log defects, and track them to closure using Azure DevOps.
  • Develop automated tests for APIs, UI, and backend systems.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and review their test scripts.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze test results, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
  • Maintain test documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across QA teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in software testing, preferably in the P&C insurance domain
  • 3–5 years of experience in test automation.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools, with a strong emphasis on Tricentis Tosca and Playwright; experience with Selenium, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks is also preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL for backend/database testing.
  • Experience with API testing using tools like Postman or REST Assured.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong understanding of Agile QA methodologies, test planning, and defect management.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Optional Certifications (Preferred But Not Required):

  • ISTQB Certified Tester – Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer
  • Certified Agile Tester (CAT)

PrePass is North America’s most trusted provider of integrated weigh station bypass, electronic toll management, and compliance solutions. Designed to work with a fleet’s existing operations, PrePass leverages GPS and the PrePass Mobile App to help commercial fleets save time, reduce costs, improve safety scores (ISS), and increase driver productivity.

Through strategic oversight and industry alignment, it helps ensure PrePass technologies consistently deliver meaningful value to both fleets and enforcement partners.
descriptionHtml:
About PrePass

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We're transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It's what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That's why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to drive software quality, strengthen test automation, and improve testing practices throughout the software development lifecycle. In this role, you'll take ownership of designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automated testing solutions for web, API, and mobile applications while helping ensure reliable software releases. You'll collaborate closely with developers, product owners, DevOps, and the test lead to identify risks early, improve testability, and promote quality engineering best practices across the team. This position offers the opportunity to influence automation strategy, leverage emerging AI technologies, and contribute to continuous improvement in a hybrid work environment.

Our technology stack is Microsoft-centered, including .NET, MVC, WCF, MS SQL, and Visual Studio, with CI/CD pipelines supported by Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.

Essential Responsibilities

Test Automation & Technical Ownership

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable automated UI and API testing solutions using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman, Karate, or REST Assured
  • Lead the development and improvement of automation frameworks, promoting maintainability, reusability, and consistent testing standards
  • Review application code and automated tests to identify quality risks, improve testability, and recommend enhancements
  • Evaluate and apply generative AI tools, such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, to accelerate test development, generate test data, and improve automation efficiency while validating AI-generated output for accuracy

Test Strategy & Quality Assurance

  • Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and testing approaches for web, API, and backend applications using tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira Xray
  • Lead the planning and execution of smoke, functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing throughout the sprint lifecycle
  • Perform exploratory and risk-based testing to identify complex scenarios, edge cases, and potential gaps in automated test coverage
  • Identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, expand automation coverage, and strengthen overall product quality

Defect Management & Quality Reporting

  • Lead defect identification, documentation, triage, and verification, partnering with development teams to investigate root causes and implement effective solutions
  • Analyze quality metrics, including defect leakage, automation coverage, and test cycle time, to identify trends and recommend improvements
  • Communicate testing results, quality risks, and release readiness to technical teams and stakeholders
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce recurring defects and improve the reliability of software releases

CI/CD Integration & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Integrate, maintain, and optimize automated testing within CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar tools
  • Partner with DevOps and development teams to improve automated test execution, pipeline reliability, and release efficiency
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including standups, sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives, proactively identifying quality and testability concerns
  • Provide technical guidance, share best practices, and support consistent quality engineering standards across the team


Requirements

Qualifications/Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in software Quality Assurance, including at least 3 years of hands-on test automation experience
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Java, Python, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Strong experience developing and maintaining automated tests using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools, with familiarity with testing frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG, Pytest, or Mocha
  • Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, Karate, REST Assured, or comparable tools
  • Proficiency with SQL for test data validation and backend testing using relational databases
  • Hands-on experience integrating and executing automated tests within CI/CD pipelines, including Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms
  • Practical experience using generative AI tools, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar technologies, to support software engineering and testing, with sound judgment in validating AI-generated results
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, the software testing lifecycle, and defect management
  • Authorization to work in the United States

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with agentic workflows or AI-driven testing tools, such as MCP-based solutions, Playwright with AI agents, or AI-assisted test generation
  • Experience with behavior-driven development (BDD) frameworks such as Cucumber or SpecFlow
  • Knowledge of performance and load testing tools, including JMeter or Gatling
  • Experience testing native mobile applications on iOS and Android
  • Familiarity with application security testing concepts, including the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience working with Docker and containerized testing environments


Benefits

How We Will Take Care of You

  • Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire
  • Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays
  • 401(k) plan with employer match
  • Company-funded "lifestyle account" upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships)
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts
  • Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you)
  • Company-sponsored and funded "Culture Team" that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees
  • Community Give-Back initiatives
  • Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives

Overview

Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. Enterprise Mobility and its affiliates offer extensive car rental, carsharing, truck rental, fleet management, retail car sales, as well as travel management and other transportation services, to make travel easier and more convenient for customers.

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles and accounted for nearly $39 billion in revenue through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories.

At the center of it all, our dedicated IT teams innovate, design and develop the technology that is redefining how customers rent, buy and share vehicles from our family of brands. Here, you will be part of a diverse and talented team that creates and delivers powerful technology solutions for our customers and employees across the world with the resources and support to develop in a variety of career paths.

As an Enterprise Mobility team member, we offer an excellent package with market-competitive pay, comprehensive healthcare packages, 401k matching & profit sharing, schedule flexibility, work from home opportunities, paid time off, and organizational growth potential.

This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule, which includes the ability to work from home, while also requiring to be in person as needed at our Lakeside and/or Clayton Corporate HQ campus locations in St. Louis, Missouri.

We are committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. Candidates should expect identity verification, video interviews, technical validation of skills, and verification of employment, education, and work authorization. Falsification of information, proxy interviewing, or misrepresentation of experience or location will result in disqualification.

Responsibilities

The Automated Rental Management System (ARMS) department is seeking an innovative and result-oriented Engineer 2, Test Automation to help with the modernization efforts. ARMS is an application that manages the insurance replacement business by providing an interface for direct interaction between Insurance partners and Enterprise. We are focused on bringing additional value to our insurance partners through technology and innovative solutions. These solutions enhance the customer’s experience, create efficiencies, improve claims outcomes, and reduce loss adjustment expenses. Enterprise continuously strives to modernize our applications to keep pace with the competitive market, and ARMS has upcoming projects to modernize applications. This is an exciting time to be part of the ARMS team.

As an Engineer 2, Test Automation on ARMS Modernization team, you will be responsible for using your technical knowledge and professional experience to test the quality of the services in an automated manner and drive the department forward on its journey to build and mature its test automation suite. You should have experience in creating and maintaining automated and manual test scripts and E2E tests for applications as well as REST APIs. This role will be responsible for executing automated and manual test suites and assessing and evaluating quality assurance test requirements to determine the scope to be covered by the automated testing suite. You will be responsible for developing, designing, executing, and maintaining automated test suites and test cases, as well as manual test suites for those tests that may not qualify for automation. You will also participate in code reviews of automated test code, debug automated test code, provide estimates for assignments, and assist with sprint planning activities.

Typical Responsibilities Will Include

  • Developing professional expertise
  • Focusing on defined strategic and tactical activities.
  • Participating on project teams
  • Working on moderate to complex assignments
  • Establishing and fostering one-on-one relationships within and outside the department
  • Automate functional, regression, and smoke tests using internal and open-source tools
  • Define test specifications for functional and integration testing.
  • Manual testing and coverage for new features that have not yet been automated.
  • Create and maintain test plans as our product grows in functionality.
  • Experience in development using JavaScript (React.js, Node.js, modern JavaScript libraries - ES6 - 2015 and later versions)
  • Experience working with databases and various data formats and related technologies for testing.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Proven track record of working in Agile teams that may be geographically distributed, as well as working independently by self-managing priorities based on the team’s composition
  • Experience working closely with development and test teams to ensure the final code delivery meets product, quality, and performance standards
  • Ability to contribute to overall improvement of quality engineering practices by removing redundancies, sharing knowledge etc.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong time management skills
  • Strong knowledge of various computer systems and technologies with an ability to learn new skills and technology quickly
  • Experience maintaining established service level agreements to meet customer expectations and quality service
  • Ability to be productive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, with changing priorities

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

Qualifications

Required:

  • Must be presently authorized to work in the U.S. without a requirement for work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future
  • Must reside in St. Louis, Missouri, or immediate surrounding area
  • 3+ years hands on experience with developing and integrating automated tests into an existing development and continuous integration processes
  • Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, SOAP, REST, JSON, Unix, Windows, AWS
  • Experience coordinating and/or conducting re-testing after defects are addressed and summarizing and publishing test results for internal customers
  • Experience executing automated test scripts that are already developed, analyzing results, and providing timely and accurate feedback to development teams
  • Experience participating in estimation discussions with the product and engineering teams
  • Must be committed to incorporating security into all decisions and daily job responsibilities

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, or a related field
  • Good working knowledge on essential Cloud services on AWS is a plus.
  • Startup mentality: self-starter, proactive, flexible
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills
  • Design and develop system test automation scripts using Playwright, Jest, Cucumber, Postman, and Karate
  • Support test automation solution planning and estimation
  • 5+ years of experience in test automation including planning, assessments, script development & maintenance preferably in cloud environment; experience in manual functional and regression testing and preparing relevant test cases
  • Experience with the Atlassian suite including Jira, Confluence, BitBucket (Git)
  • Experience working with PostgreSQL and Azure

Overview

Good things are happening at Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies —an A+ (Superior) rated, nationwide Property & Casualty insurer backed by Berkshire Hathaway. With supportive leadership, collaborative teams, and opportunities to grow, GUARD is a place where people build meaningful, long‑term careers.

Good Things You Can Count On.

  • Hybrid schedule: 2 days remote / 3 in‑office
  • Predictable hours (no nights, weekends, or holidays)
  • Competitive pay + generous PTO
  • Medical, dental & vision starting day one
  • 401(k), tuition reimbursement & longevity bonuses

Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled and experienced QA Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust automated testing solutions. This role requires a deeper understanding of automation frameworks and the ability to lead testing efforts for complex features and systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement scalable and maintainable automated test frameworks using Tricentis Tosca and other tools.
  • Analyze business and functional requirements related to P&C insurance systems and translate them into effective automated test strategies and plans.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API testing, accessibility testing across web and backend systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, developers, and product owners to ensure test coverage and quality.
  • Execute automated test cases, log defects, and track them to closure using Azure DevOps.
  • Develop automated tests for APIs, UI, and backend systems.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and review their test scripts.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze test results, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
  • Maintain test documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across QA teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in software testing, preferably in the P&C insurance domain
  • 3–5 years of experience in test automation.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools, with a strong emphasis on Tricentis Tosca and Playwright; experience with Selenium, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks is also preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL for backend/database testing.
  • Experience with API testing using tools like Postman or REST Assured.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong understanding of Agile QA methodologies, test planning, and defect management.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Optional Certifications (Preferred But Not Required):

  • Tricentis Tosca Automation Specialist Level 1 & 2
  • ISTQB Certified Tester – Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer
  • Certified Agile Tester (CAT)
  • Certified Jenkins Engineer (CJE)
  • Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional

Salary Range $56,000.00 - $130,000.00

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, this range represents a good-faith estimate. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, credentials, geographic location, and other considerations permitted by law.

This role may be based out of any of our office locations, including:

Parsippany, NJ; Conshohocken, PA; Wilkes ‑ Barre, PA; Alpharetta, GA; Scottsdale, AZ

Interview Integrity Notice: Berkshire Hathaway GUARD is committed to a fair and consistent hiring process. Candidates are expected to participate independently in interviews. Unauthorized recording, transcription, AI note-taking, or AI interview assistance tools may not be used during interviews without prior approval.

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely.

Entrust's values are a cornerstone of who we are, our future business growth and how our people grow through it. Get to Know Us

Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future.

Position Description

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows. You will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities

  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with TypeScript, Selenium, and related API-testing tools.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Execute product testing focusing on end-to-end, performance and load testing.
  • Create and report test-cycle metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements that reduce cycle time.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Create reusable automation workflows and prompts that connect product requirements, code changes, Jira or Azure DevOps issues, test results, logs, and documentation into repeatable QA processes.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.
  • Improve automated test coverage, regression readiness, and feedback speed by identifying repeatable QA workflows and reducing manual effort across release cycles.
  • Document how AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, validated, and incorporated into automation assets when those outputs influence test coverage, quality decisions, or product release readiness.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Powershell and/or C#.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Cryptography knowledge including Key Management.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.

Our growing company relies on curious, dedicated, and innovative colleagues to anticipate the future and provide solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure world. Entrust technologies and expertise help government agencies, enterprises, and financial institutions in more than 150 countries serve and safeguard citizens, employees and consumers. Each year, our solutions secure billions of transactions — and every day, our technologies issue and manage more than 10 million secure identities. How do we do all of this? Together.

Join us. Together we’ll create solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure life.

For more information, visit www.entrustdatacard.com. Follow us on Twitter, YouTube and LinkedIn.

Entrust Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

NO AGENCIES, NO RELOCATION

At Entrust, We Don’t Just Offer Jobs – We Offer Career Journeys. Here Is What You Can Expect When You Join Our Team

  • Career Growth: Whether you’re a budding developer or a seasoned expert, we’re invested in your professional journey. With learning-forward initiatives and exciting challenges, your growth is our priority.
  • Flexibility: Life is all about balance. Whether you’re remote, hybrid, or on-site, we offer flexible options that fit your lifestyle.
  • Collaboration: Here, your voice matters. Our teams thrive on sharing ideas, brainstorming solutions, and working together to build a better tomorrow.

We believe in securing identities—but it doesn’t stop there. At Entrust, we’re passionate about valuing all identities. Our culture is built on diversity, inclusion, and respect. From unconscious bias training for our leaders to global affinity groups that connect colleagues across the globe, we’re creating a community where everyone is encouraged to be themselves.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you’re excited by the prospect of innovating, growing your career, and collaborating in a dynamic environment, Entrust is the place for you. Join us in making a difference. Let’s build a more secure world—together.

Apply today!

For more information, visit www.entrust.com. Follow us on, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube

In This Role, You Will

  • Design comprehensive test strategies and detailed test plans for complex enterprise applications built with TypeScript and Core Java ensuring thorough validation of functional integration and regression scenarios across hybrid work arrangements.
  • Develop robust automated test suites and maintain reusable test frameworks aligned with Core Java and TypeScript coding standards improving test coverage reducing execution time and supporting reliable continuous integration pipelines.
  • Execute systematic functional integration system and regression testing cycles documenting test outcomes with clear defect descriptions and actionable evidence to support efficient resolution by engineering teams.
  • Collaborate closely with product owners business analysts and software engineers to refine testable requirements clarify business rules and align test scenarios to expected outcomes that enhance customer and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Analyze production incidents and recurring defects to identify patterns propose targeted quality improvements and help teams implement root cause fixes that strengthen overall application stability and maintainability.
  • Provide clear guidance to junior test team members by sharing test design best practices reviewing test cases and promoting disciplined defect management that improves overall team productivity and consistency.
  • Coordinate end to end test execution across multiple environments track progress against test plans and communicate concise status updates and risk assessments to project stakeholders supporting timely release decisions.
  • Drive data preparation activities by defining realistic test data sets validating data integrity and aligning data scenarios to merchandising use cases where applicable ensuring meaningful coverage of business flows.
  • Validate integration points and service interfaces for TypeScript and Core Java components by executing focused interface tests monitoring logs and confirming that end to end transaction behavior meets performance and reliability expectations.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating existing test processes recommending pragmatic enhancements and implementing measurable changes that reduce defect leakage and increase release confidence.
  • Review technical designs and code changes from a testability perspective highlighting potential risk areas suggesting additional test scenarios and ensuring that quality considerations are integrated early in the development lifecycle.
  • Engage in hybrid collaboration ceremonies by participating in planning estimation and defect triage discussions contributing analytical insights that help teams prioritize work and optimize testing efforts.
  • Contribute to the company purpose by safeguarding software reliability for merchandising related solutions enabling smoother retail operations better customer experiences and more efficient decision making that positively impacts society.

Locations: Atlanta,GA

Work model: Hybrid

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Atlanta,GA. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered (Required)

  • Possess extensive experience in Core Java based test automation and service validation demonstrating skill in creating maintainable test suites that integrate seamlessly with enterprise pipelines.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in TypeScript for validating modern web interfaces and front end behavior including structured test case design for complex user journeys and edge conditions.
  • Bring solid background in advanced test design techniques including boundary analysis equivalence partitioning and risk based testing to maximize coverage while optimizing effort.
  • Apply deep understanding of defect management practices and test lifecycle tools to maintain accurate test artefacts traceability records and high quality reporting that supports audit ready documentation.
  • Utilize practical knowledge of merchandising processes such as product assortment pricing and inventory flows where available translating domain insight into more realistic and valuable test scenarios.
  • Show proven capability in working within hybrid delivery models using modern application lifecycle tools maintaining effective communication and collaboration across onsite and remote team members.
  • Exhibit strong analytical and problem solving skills enabling effective investigation of complex defects precise isolation of root causes and clear articulation of findings to technical and business partners.
  • Apply experience gained over ten to fourteen years in structured testing environments to handle large scale test initiatives maintain discipline under tight timelines and meet quality expectations for enterprise releases.

Salary And Other Compensation

Applications will be accepted until 11/20/2026.

The annual salary for this position is from $71k to $112K depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) plan and contributions
  • Long-term/Short-term Disability
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
  • Pension / Retirement benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

Being a part of IT Ent Arch Data & Corp Tech team, The Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.

Your Primary Responsibilities

  • Prepare, maintain and implement test cases based on user stories; present results and track defects to closure.
  • Prepare, maintain and implement automated test scripts.
  • Maintain traceability from business requirements through test cases to automated scripts
  • Review test cases / automation approach with collaborator to ensure comprehensive coverage and acquire feedback.
  • Track test execution milestones, report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines.
  • Construct appropriate end-2-end business scenarios through the application of a broad understanding of business objectives and goals.
  • Responsible for Delivery Pipeline adoption
  • Identify dependencies for environmental and data requirements.
  • Contribute to standard framework of reusable functions.
  • Develop a basic understanding of the product being delivered.
  • Responsible for process compliance & associated documentation
  • Aligns risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to supervise and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately.

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 4+ years of related experience
  • Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience.

Talents Needed For Success

  • 4+ years of QA Testing experience with at least 3 years hands on Test Automation Experience
  • Develop, maintain, and implement functional and automated test scripts using Java and testing frameworks.
  • Hands-on Experience with JIRA, AQM, Bitbucket, Git, Jenkins, TestNG, JUnit, and Selenium
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum methodology through JIRA, Defect Triaging, Defect Status Reporting and Tracking
  • Knowledge of automation standard and best practices including experience with XPath axes and CSS selectors
  • In depth knowledge of common automation design patterns such as the page object model and software development methodologies
  • Sound knowledge of regression testing, Smoke & Sanity testing, compatibility testing, system functional testing, user acceptance testing etc.
  • Strong hands-on experience using Java for test automation, ability to develop, maintain, improve, and implement automated scripts.
  • Experience in API automation API testing (e.g. Rest Assured, Karate, Postman) and database testing (e.g. Oracle/ DB2/ Snowflake).
  • Ability to write simple to medium complexity SQL queries.
  • Ability to interpret technical designs and specifications and design automated solutions accordingly.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Positive relationship and collaboration skills.

The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We are seeking a Senior SDET / QA Automation Engineer (Playwright, Selenium, Java & Cucumber) to join our Quality Engineering team supporting a leading healthcare client. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in test automation, functional testing, and quality assurance practices, with expertise in building and maintaining scalable automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, Java, and Cucumber. This role requires close collaboration with developers, business stakeholders, and DevOps teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality, reliable applications through robust automated testing strategies and continuous quality improvements.

  • Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future*

About The Role

In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks for modern web applications using Playwright, Selenium, Java, and Cucumber. You will be responsible for creating and executing functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end test scenarios while ensuring comprehensive test coverage across multiple applications.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, business analysts, product owners, and DevOps engineers, to identify testing requirements, analyze defects, and drive issue resolution. The role also involves integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines, improving testing efficiency, enhancing automation coverage, and contributing to quality engineering best practices that support faster and more reliable software releases.

As a senior member of the team, you will participate in test planning, requirement reviews, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives, helping deliver exceptional product quality and a seamless user experience.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks using Playwright/Selenium with Java for web application testing.
  • Hands on experience in Cucumber.
  • Design and implement functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing solutions across multiple applications and platforms.
  • Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.) to enable continuous testing and faster releases.
  • Analyze test results, identify defects, and work closely with development teams to ensure timely issue resolution.
  • Create and maintain reusable automation frameworks, test data management strategies, and testing best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Business Analysts, Developers, Product Owners, and DevOps teams to ensure complete test coverage.
  • Participate in test planning, requirement reviews, and risk assessments to improve overall product quality and delivery timelines.
  • Monitor and improve automation coverage, testing efficiency, and quality metrics while driving continuous process improvements.

Work Model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States.   • Java

  • Functional Testing

  • Test Case Design & Execution

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Performance Testing exposure
  • Healthcare domain experience (if applicable)

descriptionHtml:
Job Purpose

The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), a subsidiary of Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) presents an opportunity for a full-time Senior QA Engineer to join one of our Technology teams.

The individual will be responsible for functional testing, designing and developing comprehensive automated test strategies and test cases for the various applications that support our business needs. The candidate should understand modern testing tools and frameworks. We are looking for a methodical tester who is naturally curious, eager to learn new tools and technologies, and quick to pick up new testing methods.

Responsibilities

  • Review project business requirements to properly build, enhance and support related testing frameworks.
  • Design and develop comprehensive automated test strategies and test cases.
  • Automate test cases using exiting frameworks and tools.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work with internal teams to better understand requirements, to provide technical solutions and support user testing.
  • Provide support throughout software delivery process, auditing as well as after-hours support, as necessary.

Knowledge And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering or equivalent academic discipline.
  • 5+ years of relevant Quality Engineering experience involving application development, deployment and testing (Preferably in the financial industry).
  • Proven track record of delivering quality work on time.
  • Knowledge of software development and quality assurance best practices.
  • RDBMS (Oracle, MSSQL or MySQL) and NoSQL (PostgreSQL): 4+ years (Preferred).
  • Linux and Windows: 3+ years (Preferred).
  • Experience with Java and Python.
  • Experience with Maven, Jenkins, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Artifactory, JUnit, and TestNG.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and container-based application environments.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered testing and development tools.
  • Experience testing and supporting web/cloud-based applications.
  • Experience supporting production and CERT environments.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to explain designs and solutions clearly.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to work well independently as well as part of a team.
  • Strong aptitude for picking up new QA tools, technologies and testing methodologies quickly.
  • A methodical, detail-oriented approach to test planning, execution and defect tracking.
  • Genuine eagerness to learn, ask questions and continuously grow as a QA professional.

New York Base Salary Range

The expected base salary for this role, if located in New York, is between $120,000 - 175,000 USD.  The base salary range does not include Intercontinental Exchange’s incentive compensation.  While we provide this range as general guidance, at ICE we compensate employees based on the skillset and experience of the individual. Regular full-time ICE employees are eligible for a suite of competitive employee benefits, including healthcare coverage (medical, dental and vision), a 401(k) plan, life insurance, time off, and paid leave for qualifying circumstances.

Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.
