Job Purpose

The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), a subsidiary of Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) presents an opportunity for a full-time Senior QA Engineer to join one of our Technology teams.

The individual will be responsible for functional testing, designing and developing comprehensive automated test strategies and test cases for the various applications that support our business needs. The candidate should understand modern testing tools and frameworks. We are looking for a methodical tester who is naturally curious, eager to learn new tools and technologies, and quick to pick up new testing methods.

Responsibilities



- Review project business requirements to properly build, enhance and support related testing frameworks.
- Design and develop comprehensive automated test strategies and test cases.
- Automate test cases using exiting frameworks and tools.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills to work with internal teams to better understand requirements, to provide technical solutions and support user testing.
- Provide support throughout software delivery process, auditing as well as after-hours support, as necessary.

Knowledge And Experience



- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering or equivalent academic discipline.
- 5+ years of relevant Quality Engineering experience involving application development, deployment and testing (Preferably in the financial industry).
- Proven track record of delivering quality work on time.
- Knowledge of software development and quality assurance best practices.
- RDBMS (Oracle, MSSQL or MySQL) and NoSQL (PostgreSQL): 4+ years (Preferred).
- Linux and Windows: 3+ years (Preferred).
- Experience with Java and Python.
- Experience with Maven, Jenkins, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Artifactory, JUnit, and TestNG.
- Experience with Kubernetes and container-based application environments.
- Familiarity with AI-powered testing and development tools.
- Experience testing and supporting web/cloud-based applications.
- Experience supporting production and CERT environments.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
- Excellent communication skills with ability to explain designs and solutions clearly.
- Excellent presentation skills.
- Ability to work well independently as well as part of a team.
- Strong aptitude for picking up new QA tools, technologies and testing methodologies quickly.
- A methodical, detail-oriented approach to test planning, execution and defect tracking.
- Genuine eagerness to learn, ask questions and continuously grow as a QA professional.

New York Base Salary Range 

The expected base salary for this role, if located in New York, is between $120,000 - 175,000 USD.  The base salary range does not include Intercontinental Exchange’s incentive compensation.  While we provide this range as general guidance, at ICE we compensate employees based on the skillset and experience of the individual. Regular full-time ICE employees are eligible for a suite of competitive employee benefits, including healthcare coverage (medical, dental and vision), a 401(k) plan, life insurance, time off, and paid leave for qualifying circumstances.

Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.

At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.

Job Description

The Automation Engineer tests, creates, implements and desktop automations. Performs design, scripting, testing, implementing, maintaining and modifying automations of moderate complexity, significance, and risk. Creates comprehensive test plans and test cases; defines automation data needs across systems and creates a plan to coordinate this test data. Creates and executes performance tests to ensure the expected automation performance levels are achieved. Performs, and at times, leads clients and technical staff to investigate, analyze, and resolve technical problems. Writes documentation that describes automation capabilities and operating procedures. Estimates and defines time tables and project tasks; analyzes and estimates cost and time. Conducts analysis of organizational needs for the creation and implementation of automation solutions; participates in feasibility assessments of new automation opportunities and helps determine best approach for automation.

Job Responsibility:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks and solutions to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of enterprise payment and software platforms.
  • Create, execute, and optimize automated API test suites using tools such as Postman, Bruno, ReadyAPI, Groovy scripting, and Citrus or similar automation frameworks.
  • Develop high-quality automation code using Java and apply software engineering best practices to build reusable and maintainable test solutions.
  • Convert manual test cases, business requirements, and API collections into robust automated regression and integration test suites.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, product teams, and quality assurance partners to identify, reproduce, troubleshoot, and resolve application defects.
  • Analyze application logs, troubleshoot test failures, and perform root cause analysis using monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and related DevOps tools to support continuous testing and accelerated software delivery.
  • Participate in code reviews, pull request reviews, and automation design discussions to ensure adherence to quality and development standards.
  • Develop and maintain test data, test environments, and automation assets to support functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing activities.
  • Utilize source control and Agile development tools, including Git, Jira, IDEs, and pull request workflows, throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Enhance and maintain test automation frameworks leveraging technologies such as Citrus, Selenium, Cucumber, TestNG, and other industry-standard tools.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve testing strategies, increase automation coverage, and drive defect prevention initiatives.
  • Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar technologies to improve automation development efficiency and code quality.
  • Apply Generative AI (GenAI), Large Language Models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques to support AI-assisted software development and testing practices.
  • Utilize AI-driven capabilities to generate test cases, create test data, analyze defects, develop automation scripts, and optimize overall test coverage and engineering productivity within an Agile environment.


Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
  • Seven to nine years of relevant work experience with programming concepts, development logic or automating complex API processes


Preferred Skills/Experience:

  • Proficient in working with APIs, including API testing and tools such as Postman or Bruno.
  • Hands-on experience with Citrus or other test automation frameworks (preferred).
  • Strong programming skills in Java.
  • Capable of converting manual test cases or Postman collections into automated test scripts.
  • Experienced in analyzing and debugging logs using Datadog.
  • Able to collaborate effectively with development teams to identify, reproduce, and resolve bugs.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins.
  • Familiarity with Selenium, Cucumber, and TestNG is a plus.
  • Experience in API automation testing using ReadyAPI and Groovy scripting or similar tools.
  • Understanding of software development processes and tools including Git, Jira, IDEs, and Pull Requests.
  • Experience using AI-powered development and testing tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to improve test automation, code quality, and engineering productivity.
  • Familiarity with Generative AI (GenAI), Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI-assisted SDLC and testing practices.
  • Experience leveraging AI for test case generation, test data creation, defect analysis, automation script development, and test coverage optimization.


Location expectations

This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Benefits:

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following:

  • Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
  • Basic term and optional term life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Pregnancy disability and parental leave
  • 401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan
  • Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)
  • Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities
  • Adoption assistance
  • Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law


Review our full benefits available by employment status here.

U.S. Bank is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and other factors protected under applicable law.

E-Verify

U.S. Bank participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program in all facilities located in the United States and certain U.S. territories. The E-Verify program is an Internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. Learn more about the E-Verify program.

In addition to salary, U.S. Bank offers a comprehensive benefits package, including incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase 401(k) contribution and pension (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Pay Range: $98,175.00 - $115,500.00

U.S. Bank will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment. U.S. Bank conducts background checks consistent with applicable local laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act as well as the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Position Description

### Advance Quality Engineering for Mission-Critical Payment Platforms

Are you an experienced **Test Automation Engineer** who enjoys building scalable automation solutions and improving quality across complex, enterprise-scale applications? Do you have experience testing **payment systems and transaction processing**, including ACH, wire transfers, SWIFT, or other electronic payment flows?

CGI is seeking a **Senior Test Automation Engineer – Payments** to join our team supporting a high-profile enterprise client in **Salt Lake City, UT**.

In this role, you will help drive modern quality engineering practices across critical payment applications by designing and enhancing automation frameworks, expanding automated test coverage, and embedding testing throughout the software development lifecycle. You will work closely with product, business, development, and engineering teams to strengthen **shift-left testing, continuous testing, API automation, and CI/CD integration**.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced automation engineer who enjoys combining **hands-on development, payments domain knowledge, API and database testing, cloud technologies, and DevOps practices** to improve software quality and delivery efficiency.

  • Location:** This position is based onsite at a client location in the **Salt Lake City, UT area**.

Your future duties and responsibilities

How you'll make an impact

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable and reusable **test automation frameworks** for complex enterprise applications.
  • Develop and execute automated **functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression test suites** across critical business workflows.
  • Advance **shift-left testing** by incorporating automated quality validation earlier in the software development lifecycle.
  • Partner with Product Management, business stakeholders, developers, architects, and engineering teams to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and critical business processes.
  • Develop automated testing solutions for complex **payment applications and transaction-processing workflows**, including ACH, wire transfers, SWIFT, and related payment capabilities.
  • Design and execute automated **API and integration testing** for REST and SOAP-based services.
  • Create and execute SQL queries to validate application data, payment transactions, integrations, and expected processing outcomes.
  • Integrate automated test suites into **CI/CD pipelines** to support continuous integration, continuous delivery, and continuous testing.
  • Test applications deployed across **public cloud and containerized environments**, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Docker.
  • Analyze automated test results, identify defects and quality risks, troubleshoot automation failures, perform root-cause analysis, and partner with development teams to drive issues through resolution.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, test efficiency, reliability, maintainability, and overall engineering productivity.
  • Evaluate and recommend new testing tools, frameworks, technologies, and automation approaches based on evolving application and delivery needs.
  • Estimate, plan, track, and report automation and testing activities throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Conduct automation code reviews and contribute to coding standards, reusable components, technical documentation, and secure development practices.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in **quality engineering, test automation, cloud-native development, DevOps, and continuous testing**.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

What you'll bring

  • **6+ years of experience** in test automation, quality engineering, software testing, or a related discipline.
  • Hands-on experience testing **payment applications or transaction-processing systems**, including ACH, wire transfers, SWIFT, and/or other electronic payment capabilities.
  • Strong experience designing, developing, executing, and maintaining **enterprise-scale test automation frameworks**.
  • Hands-on automation experience using **Playwright and/or Selenium**.
  • Programming or automation development experience using **Java and/or Python**.
  • Experience testing **REST and SOAP APIs**, including experience with tools such as Postman or comparable technologies.
  • Strong **SQL and relational database** skills, including the ability to query and analyze data for transaction and test validation.
  • Experience testing applications deployed on at least one major public cloud platform, such as **AWS, Azure, or GCP**.
  • Experience testing applications within **containerized environments**, including Docker.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into **CI/CD pipelines** and working within continuous integration, continuous delivery, and continuous testing practices.
  • Experience with development and delivery tools such as **Bamboo, Git, Artifactory, Jira, and Confluence**, or comparable technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience planning, estimating, executing, tracking, and reporting automation and testing activities.
  • Experience working within **Agile and/or Waterfall** software delivery methodologies.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex application and automation issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across business, product, development, and engineering teams.

## Education

  • Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline**.

Other Information:

CGI is required by law in some jurisdictions to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. The determination of this range includes various factors not limited to skill set, level, experience, relevant training, and licensure and certifications. To support the ability to reward for merit based performance, CGI typically does not hire individuals at or near the top of the range for their role. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for this role in the U.S. is $79,600.00 $139,300.00.

CGI's benefits are offered to eligible professionals on their first day of employment to include:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive insurance options
  • Matching contributions through the 401(k) plan and the share purchase plan
  • Paid time off for vacation, holidays, and sick time
  • Paid parental leave
  • Learning opportunities and tuition assistance
  • Wellness and Well being programs

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Flexjet is currently seeking a QA Automation Engineer. The QA Automation Engineer analyzes the functionality of applications and designs automated tests to validate their performance and reliability. Completes development, execution, and documentation of test plans and scripts. Assists non-QA resources in the planning and execution of user acceptance testing.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Maintain, design, and implement test automation frameworks for a continuous integration and execution model.
  • Create and design the testing approach (Unit, Functional, Integration, System, User).
  • Create automation tests by analyzing user stories, acceptance criteria, creating initial test designs, writing scripts, installing the automation testing tools, and reporting results.
  • Develop a repeatable process for designing, developing, and executing scripts.
  • Conduct tests, document, and analyze test results, and present findings to development teams.
  • Preparing reports on all aspects related to software testing.
  • Participating in project meetings including Agile/Scrum grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and daily stand-ups.
  • Collaborate within an agile software development process with software engineers, subject matter experts and stakeholders.

Education & Experience

  • Understanding and knowledge of software engineering concepts and methodologies.
  • Understanding of test cases and negative, positive and regression testing.
  • Understanding of automation testing and experience writing automation tests for REST APIs and UI.
  • Experience with writing automation tests using one or more of the following: Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, ect.
  • Extremely proficient in one or more development languages (i.e. C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc.).
  • Knowledge of industry best practices for manual, automation and performance testing.
  • Experience with deployments and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience gathering, refining, and validating business/technical requirements, interdependencies, cross-functional dependencies & risks/issues.
  • Knowledge of application functions, bug fixing, and testing practices.
  • Experience with system/platform integrations and the ability to work cross-functionally.
  • Shows initiative and is motivated to learn.
  • Strong communication skills (oral and written); ability to communicate technical information to non-technical people.
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration and consultative skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and committed to a high level of accuracy & quality.

descriptionHtml:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We're hiring experienced Software Engineers in Test to work on Site Vault, a rapidly growing SaaS platform product in the Life Sciences industry encompassing the fields of pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical devices.

As part of our Quality Assurance and Release Engineering team, you'll be responsible for functional and automation testing to deliver a top-quality SaaS product. This is a hands-on position playing a vital role in ensuring customer success with each new release.

If you are an experienced Quality Engineering professional ready to make an impact and take your career to the next level, we want to hear from you. In our fast-paced environment, you'll be involved in the product development process, taking pride in building great software. You'll collaborate with like-minded engineers in a high-energy setting and leverage your existing skills to learn and grow with us.

What You'll Do

  • Create testing-related documentation, including test plans, test cases/scripts, and bug reports assessing quality and associated risk
  • Automate features for better regression coverage
  • Triage and/or assist with triaging of automation results
  • Develop deep expertise in the product
  • Conduct QA tests and verify outcomes within schedules/timelines
  • Work with software engineers, product managers, and other quality engineers in an Agile team environment
  • Operate at architecture and code level, driving technical discussions during design/implementation reviews
  • Be the technical quality expert in functional areas and influencing decisions that will help build quality into the product
  • Be comfortable providing technical leadership to junior teammates, enabling them to achieve targeted goals
  • Conduct POCs and make recommendations that would help raise the quality bar
  • Enhance your knowledge of code coverage tools and metrics
  • Work with quality management to come up with new processes and roll them out across the organization
  • Become a technical contributor, a product expert, and a team project manager and support your QA manager as and when you work on the product

Requirements

  • 2+ years relevant work experience, including software development and/or software test automation
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Understanding of Software QA methodologies, tools, and approaches (black box and/or automated testing) in a software company with short release cycles
  • Experience in writing test cases and automating them, covering both sanity and in-depth testing including and not limited to boundary, negative, compatibility, and concurrency tests
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Bachelor's / Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Must be located in the Eastern Time Zone.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in JavaScript, Java, Python, or other object-oriented programming language.
  • Experience with Atlassian products like Jira, Confluence
  • Experience with TestRail or similar test case management software
  • Experience authoring automated tests in standard functional test automation frameworks. e.g., Cucumber/Selenium/TestNg. Playwright is preferred.
  • Knowledge of modern best practices for software development
  • Experience in a SaaS environment that has an agile development process is a huge plus
  • Experience working with remote teams
  • Experience working in the Health Sciences and Life Sciences industry

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    • A conversation with the hiring manager
    • A practical case exercise
    • A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $75,000 - $150,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

With top clients to boast about, Synechron has a global workforce of 17,000, and has 58 offices in 22 countries within key global markets.


Our Challenge


We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer with strong experience testing distributed software systems, APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will design and maintain automated test frameworks, validate complex integrations and data workflows, and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.


Key Responsibilities


  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks and test suites covering functional, integration, API, UI, regression, and performance testing.
  • Develop comprehensive test scenarios, edge cases, and validation strategies from business requirements and technical designs.
  • Test microservices, event-driven systems, REST APIs, WebSocket services, and messaging-based integrations.
  • Validate data movement, transformations, reconciliations, and end-to-end workflows across multiple systems.
  • Create SQL queries to validate relational databases, ETL processes, data integration workloads, data warehouses, and reporting solutions.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to improve release quality.
  • Perform performance, load, and reliability testing to identify bottlenecks and assess system behavior.
  • Investigate complex issues across applications, services, integrations, and data pipelines using logs and observability tools.
  • Manage test cases, report defects, and collaborate with stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
  • Build domain knowledge and communicate testing progress, risks, and findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of professional experience testing distributed software systems, APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise applications.
  • Strong experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks and test suites.
  • Proficiency with automation tools such as Cucumber, Selenium, Playwright, Power Automate, Rest Assured, Postman, or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, and/or Python.
  • Experience testing microservices-based architectures, event-driven systems, and distributed applications.
  • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, WebSocket services, and messaging-based integrations.
  • Experience validating data transformations, reconciliations, and workflows across multiple systems.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience validating data in databases such as PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
  • Experience testing ETL/data integration workloads, data warehouses, and reporting solutions.
  • Experience with messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, or similar technologies.
  • Exposure to HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, or Angular, along with UI test automation.
  • Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Proficiency in SDLC, Agile methodologies, and DevOps practices, including integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as PractiTest, Jira, Xray, or Zephyr.
  • Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk.
  • Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must be a US Citizen or Green Card Holder

This position is hybrid 3 days per week in the following office locations: Cincinnati, OH and Alpharetta, GA (Atlanta)

Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Quality Assurance Analyst Senior (Sr. SDET) to join our ever-evolving Biller Solutions team to help us unleash the potential of every business.

What You’ll Own

  • Responsible for test activities of assigned projects in the Agile development environment
  • Work with Product Owner and Developers to Refine Backlog items with well thought out Acceptance Criteria
  • Collaborate with Team to establish automation testing strategy for the product being tested
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies, pair programming, and peer reviews
  • Develop and maintain the automated UI and APIs Test Frameworks using NUnit and C#
  • Develop and maintain the automated Test Frameworks using Selenium Webdriver
  • Leverage SQL skills for REST APIs Testing
  • Work closely with Product Owners, Architects, and Developers on Product Design and provide thought leadership on test approaches
  • Organize and maintain the test scrip library for assigned area or application(s).

What You Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, computer science or other related discipline, or the equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience.
  • Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in QA practice creating/maintaining test plans, creating test harnesses, scripts; executing scripts and reporting.
  • Experience in Agile development methodology in the .NET development environment required
  • Good understanding of OOP concepts
  • 5+ years knowledge of Automation Testing frameworks for APIs and UI
  • 3+ years of C# and .NET knowledge (Linq, Genics, .NET 6)
  • 3+ years of T-SQL Queries and able to write complex queries
  • Postman knowledge for manual testing
  • Agile and Scrum knowledge, User Stories and Test Case Management
  • AzureDevOPS and git experience
  • Must understand the technical concepts of APIs, Services, Deployments, .NET Architecture concepts, Configuration Files

Added bonus if you have:

  • Azure Pipeline
  • ORM Knowledge (Dapper, Entity Framework, etc …)
  • Automation using SpecFlow is a plus
  • Load Testing knowledge (JMeter, Neoload, Loadrunner)
  • Behavior Driven Syntax for acceptance criteria
  • Domain knowledge/experience of the Payments Industry (practices, players, regulations) is a plus
  • Must be a quick and sharp thinker and be creative enough to react to the dynamic nature of Agile development

Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. Job Title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer

Location: Maple Grove, MN

Reports To: Jeff Guhin

Employment Type: Full Time

Job Requisition ID: 2026-1076

Requisition Begin Date: 11/3/2026

Requisition End Date: 1/3/2027

Role Overview

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape how quality is built into technology at ProAg. As a Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you’ll partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, developers, architects, DevOps, and other quality professionals to understand business outcomes, identify risks, and create maintainable automated testing solutions. You’ll use automation and practical AI capabilities to improve testing efficiency, reliability, and feedback throughout the development lifecycle. Through this work, you’ll help reduce delivery risk, improve customer experiences, and support the technology behind the people who grow America’s food, fuel, and fiber.

In This Exciting Opportunity, You Will

  • Participate throughout the Agile software development lifecycle, helping define acceptance criteria, testability, and quality risks early, and translating business requirements and technical designs into practical test strategies, plans, scenarios, and automated checks.
  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated and manual tests for web applications, APIs, service-oriented architectures, and integrated business workflows using approved technologies such as Playwright or Selenium, C#, NUnit, and related tools to create reliable, reusable, and supportable solutions.
  • Apply AI-assisted tools responsibly to accelerate automated test design, code generation, refactoring, debugging, documentation, and maintenance, while validating outputs for accuracy, security, and quality.
  • Analyze test failures and operational information to isolate root causes, clearly communicate and support defects through resolution and verification, identify coverage gaps and defect trends, and improve product quality, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate with DevOps and engineering teams to provide fast, trustworthy feedback across environments, while participating in peer reviews of test code, test cases, test plans, and defects and contributing to shared engineering standards.
  • Support risk-based testing decisions that balance speed, coverage, maintainability, and business impact, while documenting automation frameworks, testing processes, tools, and workflows and continuously improving ProAg’s quality engineering strategy, frameworks, and skill-based ways of working.

What You Bring

  • Relevant professional experience in software quality assurance, automated testing, software development, or a closely related discipline, along with a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent education and/or experience.
  • Hands-on experience designing automated tests and contributing to test frameworks for modern applications and services, with experience in several of the following highly valued: C#, Python, Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, API testing, SQL, PostgreSQL, AWS, CI/CD, Azure DevOps pipelines, Page Object Model, web applications, and service-oriented architectures.
  • Strong understanding of software testing and development principles, including risk-based testing, test design, defect lifecycle management, quality throughout the SDLC, object-oriented programming, full-stack web applications, and common application integration patterns.
  • Experience testing APIs for functionality, reliability, performance, and security, with strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills to investigate complex failures and clearly explain findings.
  • Ability to estimate, prioritize, plan, and coordinate testing activities in Scrum, Kanban, or similar Agile delivery models, along with the ability to learn and work effectively in a technology stack or business domain that may differ from previous environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, emphasizing clarity, collaboration, confidentiality, tact, and diplomacy, combined with curiosity and a continuous-learning mindset, including an interest in applying AI and emerging technology to improve quality engineering outcomes.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package
  • Strong learning culture with ongoing development opportunities
  • Opportunities for growth and career advancement
  • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, with eligibility beginning on your first day of employment
  • Basic life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan with 6% company match
  • 20 days of PTO, three floating holidays, approximately 10 paid holidays, and volunteer time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Access to our award-winning wellness program, including mental health services, fitness network membership, and a complimentary Headspace subscription
  • Student loan matching program
  • Employee discount program
  • An opportunity to do meaningful work and love what you do

What We Represent

A career with purpose. Our crop insurance professionals work each day to bring peace of mind and protection to American farmers and ranchers. Join a team who truly cares.

  • Part of something bigger: We offer a career with purpose as you support the farmers and ranchers who create food, fuel, and fiber for the world.
  • Personal connections: We are built on strong relationships and appreciation of your individuality.
  • A team who cares: We look out for each other personally and professionally because we care about each other.
  • Innovators by trade: We’re committed to a brighter tomorrow for our team members and agriculture.
  • The best of both worlds: We combine personal connections with powerful resources, thanks to our culture and the backing of Tokio Marine HCC.

The Company

ProAg, a member of the Tokio Marine HCC group of companies, is positioned as a financially strong and well-capitalized insurer with an AM Best rating of A++. With 100 years of service to our agents & insureds, we stand committed to continuing the principles that ProAg was founded on: Integrity, Loyalty, and Customer Service.

Tokio Marine HCC is a leading specialty insurance group with offices in the United States,

the United Kingdom, Europe, and other exciting locations. With the strength and stability

that comes from being a member of the Tokio Marine Group, and more than fifty years of

growth, profitability, and stability, we offer important insurance products that most people

don’t even know exist. Every policy we write is special, enabling our clients to do amazing

things.

Pay Transparency

The pay range for this position is $105,000 - $125,000 which includes geographic adjustments, where applicable. The pay range is the range THMCC, in good faith, believes is the range of compensation for this role at the time of this posting. The hired applicant will be offered pay within the entire range based on the candidate’s geographic location, qualifications, work experience, education, and/or skill level. The Company is fully committed to ensuring equal pay opportunities for equal work regardless of color, race, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, age, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local pay equity laws.

Disclaimer

As an insurance company, we comply with certain federal, state and local laws such as the Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act of 1994 (18 USC

  • 1033(e)), which restricts our ability to employ individuals with certain types of criminal convictions. Where not restricted by law and for criminal history not covered by this law, the Company will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history in compliance with applicable law.

Equal Opportunity Employer

TMHCC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration

for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care

leave, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national

origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity,

religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected

by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.

Position Description

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows. You will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities

  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with TypeScript, Selenium, and related API-testing tools.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Execute product testing focusing on end-to-end, performance and load testing.
  • Create and report test-cycle metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements that reduce cycle time.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Create reusable automation workflows and prompts that connect product requirements, code changes, Jira or Azure DevOps issues, test results, logs, and documentation into repeatable QA processes.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.
  • Improve automated test coverage, regression readiness, and feedback speed by identifying repeatable QA workflows and reducing manual effort across release cycles.
  • Document how AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, validated, and incorporated into automation assets when those outputs influence test coverage, quality decisions, or product release readiness.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Powershell and/or C#.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Cryptography knowledge including Key Management.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.

Where you will be: This is a hybrid role requiring three days per week in our Shakopee, MN headquarters office.

Our growing company relies on curious, dedicated and innovative colleagues to anticipate the future and provide solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure world. Entrust technologies and expertise help government agencies, enterprises and financial institutions in more than 150 countries, serve and safeguard citizens, employees and consumers. Each year, our solutions secure billions of transactions — and every day, our technologies issue and manage more than 10 million secure identities. How do we do all of this? Together.

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer: SDET, you will design and develop test automation solutions and frameworks to ensure high-quality software delivery. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure automation solutions meet business needs and are aligned with industry standards.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design Automation Solutions: Design and develop test automation solutions and frameworks across multiple layers of the application architecture, including UI, API, Services, and Data, to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • Develop Test Scenarios: Understand functional requirements, design optimized test scenarios, identify test cases, and code them to be integrated with application code and DevOps pipeline for automated execution and reporting.
  • Troubleshoot Automation Issues: Troubleshoot and debug automation issues, and optimize automation solutions for performance and scalability to ensure reliable and efficient testing.
  • Maintain Test Environments: Develop and maintain test data and test environments to support automated testing, ensuring accurate and reliable test results.
  • Analyze Test Results: Analyze test results and provide insights to stakeholders to improve software quality and reduce defects, driving business value through data-driven decision-making.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Test Automation Development: Exposure to designing and developing test automation solutions and frameworks across multiple layers of application architecture, including UI, API, Services, and Data.
  • Multi-Technology Automation: Experience working with automation testing across various technologies, such as Mobile, Devices, Browsers, Client-server, Micro-Services, and Containers.
  • Test Scenario Optimization: Exposure to understanding functional requirements, designing optimized test scenarios, identifying test cases, and coding them for automated execution and reporting.
  • Automation Troubleshooting: Experience working with troubleshooting and debugging automation issues, and optimizing automation solutions for performance and scalability.
  • Test Environment Maintenance: Exposure to developing and maintaining test data and test environments to support automated testing.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Multi-Layered Architecture Knowledge: Exposure to designing and developing test automation solutions and frameworks across multiple layers of application architecture, including UI, API, Services, and Data, to deliver high-quality software.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience working with cross-functional teams to ensure automation solutions meet business needs and are aligned with industry standards, driving business value through collaboration.
  • Industry Standards Alignment: Exposure to aligning automation solutions with industry standards, ensuring compliance and best practices in test automation development.
  • Preferred Skills: Test Manager with SDET, Automation Testing with Karate, Cucmber, Selenium, Java, Playwright

Where Ambition Meets Innovation

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you'll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

Job Overview:

LPL Financial is seeking a Senior Engineer, Software Development Test (QE) to design, implement, and execute comprehensive quality engineering strategies across a variety of technology platforms and applications. This role is responsible for developing automated testing solutions, validating software functionality and performance, and partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality software delivery throughout the software development lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks and reusable test assets for enterprise applications.
  • Create and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios to ensure coverage of functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Validate complex integration workflows across multiple enterprise systems and platforms, including cloud-native and hybrid application architectures deployed on AWS.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, product owners, business stakeholders, and technology teams to define testing strategies and quality standards.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects, partnering with development teams to support issue resolution and validation.
  • Perform functional, integration, regression, performance, security, and user acceptance testing activities.
  • Integrate automated testing solutions into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery and release quality.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, and code reviews to promote testability and quality throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Monitor test execution results, quality metrics, and defect trends, providing regular status updates to project stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the improvement of quality engineering tools, processes, standards, and best practices.
  • Mentor junior quality engineers and support the growth of quality-focused engineering practices across the organization.


What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering, Quality Assurance, or Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) roles.
  • Experience designing and implementing automated testing solutions using tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, JUnit, TestNG, NUnit, Postman, JMeter, or similar technologies.
  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language, such as Java, C#, or Python.
  • Hands-on experience developing automation solutions using TypeScript, messaging and event-driven platforms including Kafka, and applications hosted on AWS cloud services.
  • Experience working within Agile software development environments and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.


Core Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes, risks, impacts, and recommend effective solutions.
  • Ability to develop and execute quality engineering strategies across complex technology environments.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement, automation, and engineering excellence.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.


Preferences:

  • Experience performing API testing, database validation using SQL, and non-functional testing activities including performance or security testing.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL/SQL and database testing techniques.
  • Proven experience testing large-scale, enterprise-level applications with complex integrations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience working on mission-critical enterprise platforms with high availability, scalability, and compliance requirements.

$91,400.00 - $152,400.00

Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Responsibilities:



- Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks and reusable test assets for enterprise applications.
- Create and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios to ensure coverage of functional and non-functional requirements.
- Validate complex integration workflows across multiple enterprise systems and platforms, including cloud-native and hybrid application architectures deployed on AWS.

Job Description

Flexjet is currently seeking a QA Automation Engineer. The QA Automation Engineer analyzes the functionality of applications and designs automated tests to validate their performance and reliability. Completes development, execution, and documentation of test plans and scripts. Assists non-QA resources in the planning and execution of user acceptance testing.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Maintain, design, and implement test automation frameworks for a continuous integration and execution model.
  • Create and design the testing approach (Unit, Functional, Integration, System, User).
  • Create automation tests by analyzing user stories, acceptance criteria, creating initial test designs, writing scripts, installing the automation testing tools, and reporting results.

  • Conduct tests, document, and analyze test results, and present findings to development teams.
  • Preparing reports on all aspects related to software testing.
  • Participating in project meetings including Agile/Scrum grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and daily stand-ups.

Education & Experience

  • Understanding and knowledge of software engineering concepts and methodologies.
  • Understanding of test cases and negative, positive and regression testing.
  • Understanding of automation testing and experience writing automation tests for REST APIs and UI.
  • Experience with writing automation tests using one or more of the following: Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, ect.
  • Extremely proficient in one or more development languages (i.e. C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc.).
  • Knowledge of industry best practices for manual, automation and performance testing.
  • Experience with deployments and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience gathering, refining, and validating business/technical requirements, interdependencies, cross-functional dependencies & risks/issues.

  • Experience with system/platform integrations and the ability to work cross-functionally.

  • Strong communication skills (oral and written); ability to communicate technical information to non-technical people.
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration and consultative skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and committed to a high level of accuracy & quality.

Position Description

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows.

This role will have an emphasis on managing performance/load testing within our current K6 environment.

In addition, you will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities

  • Manage, troubleshoot and report on performance/load testing of web sites and components using our K6 environment. It measures the throughput and resilience of thousands of printers hitting a site for the purpose of issuing credit, debit and ID cards.
  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with C# and API-testing tools such as RestSharp and Playwright.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Performance/Load testing
  • Programming experience in C#. JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Powershell.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with K6 performance testing tool
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.

Where you will be: This is a hybrid role requiring three days per week in our Shakopee, MN headquarters office.

Position Description

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows.

This role will have an emphasis on managing performance/load testing within our current K6 environment.

In addition, you will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities



- Manage, troubleshoot and report on performance/load testing of web sites and components using our K6 environment. It measures the throughput and resilience of thousands of printers hitting a site for the purpose of issuing credit, debit and ID cards.
- Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with C# and API-testing tools such as RestSharp and Playwright.
- End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products. 
- Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
- Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
- Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
- Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
- Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.

Basic Qualifications



- 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
- 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
- Performance/Load testing
- Programming experience in C#. JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Powershell.
- Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
- Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
- Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
- Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications



- BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
- Experience with K6 performance testing tool
- Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
- Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
- Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
- Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
- Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.

Join the leader in providing smarter solutions for a safer world.

The property technology space is growing rapidly, and Kastle Systems is leading the way. Kastle Systems is the leader in managed security, with a track record of introducing innovative technologies to serve over 460M square feet of real estate globally. Clients span the commercial and multifamily real estate, education, and construction industries and the customers they serve. Delivering a world class customer experience drives everything we do, and Kastle’s mission is to be our customers’ best service provider and to ensure that their security the most effective, efficient and convenient. Kastle's integrated security solution, including access control, video, and remote video monitoring, significantly reduces costs and improves the critically important 24x7 performance for building owners, developers and tenants.

The QA Engineer (AI/Automation) is a highly technical role dedicated to building scalable, automated testing frameworks for Kastle’s complex product ecosystem. This individual will lead the transition from AI-assisted testing processes to a modern agentic testing process. This role will accelerate the full rollout of Kastle's Agentic Testing project to more product lines. The ideal candidate is an automation specialist who can design frameworks that enable continuous validation and faster release cycles without sacrificing the high-security standards Kastle is known for.

In addition to a great work environment, we provide excellent benefits (Medical/Dental/Vision, 401K, Tuition/Training Assistance, BrightHorizons Lifestyle Assistance, Wellness Program, etc.) and we're proud to be a Certified Great Place to Work! For more information about what it's like to work with us, please visit Kastle Careers.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Automation Framework Development

  • Design, build, and maintain a scalable automation framework for Kastle products, especially the firmware, hardware integration, and internal software applications.
  • Drive the full-scale rollout of Kastle's Agentic Testing project to more product lines
  • Drive the extension of Kastle resilient QA framework OmniGuard to embedded systems and internal applications

CI/CD Integration

  • Integrate automated test suites into the CI/CD pipeline to ensure continuous validation of every build.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and Engineering to automate smoke, regression, and performance tests.

Efficiency & Speed

  • Reduce reliance on manual testing, especially for the firmware, hardware integration, and internal software applications
  • Significantly shortening the time-to-market for new features and firmware updates.
  • Implement automated regression testing to ensure new updates don't break existing hardware/software functionality.

Qualifications

Key Skills & Qualifications

  • Automation Proficiency: Extensive experience with automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Appium, RestAssured, Cucumber, JMeter, etc.).
  • CI/CD Expertise: Hands-on experience integrating tests into Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.
  • Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in languages such as Python, Java, or C# for test script development.
  • Familar with agentic testing or agentic engineering concepts, workflow and platforms.

Experience & Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • 3 - 5 years of experience in QA Automation

Travel Requirements

  • This position has 0% travel requirements

Bonus Qualifications

  • Architectural Thinking: Ability to design frameworks that handle the complexities of IoT/Hardware-software communication.

Rockwell is looking for a Senior Software Test Engineer to join an agile team. This team is building and validating FactoryTalk Optix, a modern industrial visualization and HMI platform. The platform is used by customers to design, deploy, and maintain applications for manufacturing environments.

Position Summary

The Senior Software Test Engineer will help ensure the quality of FactoryTalk Optix by creating and executing manual and automated tests for new and existing product functionality. This role will work closely with product owners, developers, and other test engineers to understand requirements, validate features, reproduce and document defects, and support regression and release testing activities. The scope of work is focused on developing solid test engineering practices, learning the product and industrial automation domain, and contributing to a high-quality customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Create, maintain, and execute manual and automated tests for FactoryTalk Optix features.
  • Validate design-time and runtime workflows to help ensure a reliable customer experience.
  • Lead test planning, estimation, execution, and defect triage as part of an Agile team.
  • Reproduce, document, and track defects with clear titles, descriptions, steps, and supporting details.
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, and other test engineers to understand requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support regression, release, and exploratory testing activities.
  • Contribute to test documentation, quality procedures, and continuous improvement of test practices.
  • Use tools such as JIRA, QTest, Confluence, GitHub, and Jenkins to support testing and quality tracking.
  • Learn FT Optix product functionality and relevant industrial automation concepts over time.
  • Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams.

The Essentials - You Will Have

  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Legal authorization to work in the US is required.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

  • Typically requires a minimum of 2 years of experience in software testing, software development, test automation, or a related technical role.
  • Experience creating, executing, and documenting manual or automated test cases.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated tests using Python, C#, or similar programming or scripting languages.
  • Experience with Squish and Selenium test frameworks
  • Experience creating or updating GitHub Actions
  • Familiarity with Linux
  • Experience with C# scripting
  • Familiarity with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, JIRA, Confluence, or QTest.
  • Exposure to performance, reliability, longevity, or regression testing.
  • Experience with industrial automation, HMI software, PLCs, and protocols such as CIP or OP-CUA

What We Offer

  • Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
  • 401k
  • Paid Time off
  • Parental and Caregiver Leave
  • Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
  • To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies.
