Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking an Automation Test Engineer to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. This position is in Herndon, VA. The qualified applicant will become part of Peraton's Department of State (DOS) Consular Systems Modernization (CSM) Program, for the Diplomatic Technology (DT).

This role requires excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively within a large, diverse program. As part of the Automation Testing Team, you will build and execute automated test scripts, contribute to Agile development efforts and help ensure high-quality software delivery.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Work within an Agile Team to plan and develop automated test scripts to support the integration testing requirements of the teams you support.
  • Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using modern frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools.
  • Generate technical engineering products using appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools.
  • Maintain a Kanban board with tasks and report out the status of your work during scheduled standup meetings.
  • Collaborate with developers and testers to validate APIs, web services, and system integrations.

Work Location: Herndon, VA

#DOSCSM

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree and at least 5 years of experience.
  • Good knowledge of functional, environmental, operational, and performance testing.
  • Problem-solving skills to isolate and document issues and defects.
  • Interest and ability to program in text-based languages and object-oriented languages (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript).
  • Exposure to software engineering principles and basic test automation concepts.
  • Experience in an agile testing environment including Test-Driven Development (TDD).
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Must be able to obtain or have an Active Secret (or higher) clearance. Interim clearances acceptable

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with using AI-assisted development or testing tools.
  • Experience developing automated test scripts using Java or other programming languages.
  • Experience with Selenium WebDriver and Gauge a plus.
  • Experience writing SQL scripts for Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc.

Details

Target Salary Range: $80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

The Senior Test Automation Engineer is responsible for creating and maintaining test scripts ensuring software quality standards are met. This includes coordinating all testing activities with developers and functional analysts to create and manage test plans, test scripts both manual and automated, and testing artifacts in accordance with VA mandated testing documentation standards and templates.

Job Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and collaborate with developers and functional analysts to create test plans and test scripts (Manual and Automated) in accordance with VA mandated testing documentation standards and templates.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Ensure high quality and reliability of software
  • Lead continuous integration, and performance testing events.
  • Manage and track all testing artifacts in GitHub, Jira, and associated repositories.
  • Lead and conduct testing in accordance with Master Test Plan specifications that provide tracking, monitoring and reporting of results.
  • Manage and assist staff test events with appropriate resources.
  • Identify and document defects.
  • Monitor and update defect and bug reports in the Application Life Cycle Management (ALM) tool Jira.
  • Perform code reviews of scripts
  • Execute manual and automated test scripts

  • Must have experience working with developers, end users and organizations to create test plans and test scripts
  • Must have comprehensive technical expertise in IT products, operating systems, software, hardware, systems and networks and specialized environments.

  • Must manage the defect database under the guidance of QA Manager.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, electronics engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in manual and automation testing
  • 8+ years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for education
  • Eligibility limited to U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents (green card holders)
  • Must be able to receive a Security Clearance / Public Trust

  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Must have experience in the coordination and management of test events in accordance with approved test plans, procedures, and scripts.

  • Hands-on experience with QA automation tools (e.g., Selenium, JMeter, TestNG, Cypress, Playwright).
  • Must be able to create test reports.
  • Experience working in a SAFe / Agile environment
  • Application Life Cycle (ALM) tool experience preferred (Jira, etc.)

  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.

  • Highly proficient in Scripting languages (Java, Python, JavaScript, C#, C++, Go, TypeScript, PHP)
  • Experienced in backend testing
  • Ability to perform manual testing
  • Proficient in SQL

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team setting.
  • Stay updated on emerging QA tools, trends, and methodologies, recommending new technologies and best practices
  • Experience working with the Department of Veterans’ Affairs (preferred)
  • Medical claims X.12 Transaction (837, 835, 277, etc.) - (preferred)

  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)

Northrop Grumman’s Space Systems Sector is seeking a Software Automated Test Developer to join our team in Redondo Beach, CA.

The Software Automated Test Developer will develop test automation, conduct verification, and troubleshooting activities for Next Gen Polar application software with emphasis on verification test automation. This role develops and executes automated software test solutions using Robot Framework, supports test architecture and test environment readiness, and works across software code base and two levels of specifications to verify software requirements behavior in representative test environments.

The ideal candidate combines strong test automation skills with domain understanding of ground and space command and control systems and Flight Dynamics, enabling efficient development of reusable test procedures, test input driven verification, and rapid root-cause analysis of integration issues.

What You’ll Get To Do

  • Develop, maintain, and execute automated integration test procedures using a keyword-driven automated testing framework.
  • Design software test approaches that support repeatable, reliable, and pipeline-enabled integration testing.
  • Build and maintain test inputs, scripts, drivers, and stubs required for CSCI level and below verification testing.
  • Analyze software requirements, interfaces to derive automated test coverage.
  • Investigate troubleshooting of failures observed during testing.
  • Review logs, telemetry, and test artifacts to isolate defects and document results.
  • Contribute to CI/CD or automated execution workflows, quality gates, and regression test suites.
  • Support test readiness reviews, anomaly tracking, test reporting, and verification closure evidence.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science degree in a STEM discipline and 5 years of relevant experience in integration, test, systems, software test, or verification; OR Master of Science Degree in a STEM discipline and 3 years of experience in integration, test, systems, software test, or verification; OR a PhD with 1 year of relevant experience in integration, test, systems, software test, or verification
  • Experience with software verification testing in complex software systems.
  • Experience developing and executing automated test scripts/frameworks.
  • Experience with Robot Framework or a comparable automated test framework.
  • Experience with scripting/programming for test automation (for example: Python, shell scripting, or similar).
  • Experience analyzing software interfaces, requirements, and test results to identify defects and support root-cause analysis.
  • Ability to work across multidisciplinary teams including systems, software, and test.
  • Familiarity with configuration-managed test artifacts, defect tracking, and technical documentation.
  • Demonstrated experience using a keyword-driven automated testing framework for automated testing.
  • Working knowledge of Flight Dynamics concepts applicable to test and verification.
  • DOD Secret Level clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting space programs in Ground Software test efforts.
  • Experience automating integration, regression, and end-to-end software test scenarios in Robot Framework.
  • Experience building automated tests that interact with test drivers, simulators, telemetry sources, and databases.
  • Experience with ground and space command and control systems in an operational, integration, or verification context.
  • Experience with Flight Dynamics, including trajectories.
  • Experience in integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enforcing automated quality gates.
  • Experience with software test data management, result parsing, report generation, and regression trending.
  • Experience with distributed systems, message-based architectures, or real-time/near-real-time systems.
  • Experience with requirements verification, formal test procedures, and sell-off evidence packages.
  • Experience with tools such as Jira, Bitbucket, DOORS, or similar engineering/test toolchains.
  • Active TS/SCI security clearance

Job Description

Business Title(s): Sr. Programmer Analyst II (Test Automation Engineer)

Employment Type: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: In-office - Any employee, in any Clearbrook office, can apply for this opportunity and stay in their current location.

Summary

We are seeking an experienced Test Automation Engineer to join our P&C Quality Assurance and Test Automation team. You will report to the Manager of P&C Quality Assurance and Test Automation.

In this role, you will leverage your expertise in automated testing frameworks, software quality assurance, and technical ability to ensure the reliability and performance of our critical P&C policy systems. You will work on complex assignments, collaborating closely with technical and non-technical team members to deliver robust and effective automated testing solutions.

This is a 100% in-office position. Candidates must be able to work on-site at a designated company office during standard business hours.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts primarily for web and API applications.
  • Support the design of effective test cases by engaging with Agile teams to understand systems, workflows and requirements.
  • Execute testing within continuous integration pipelines using industry standard tools like GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
  • Analyze test results, identify defects, and work with development teams to resolve issues.
  • Maintain and improve test environments, existing automated tests, and test data management strategies.
  • Implement and maintain test reporting and dashboards for visibility into test coverage and results.
  • Participate in test automation code reviews and contribute to quality standards and best practices.
  • Prepare detailed documentation for automated testing solutions, including best practices, test case design, data flow, system interfaces, and training materials.
  • Develop estimates for time and cost related to test automation development and ongoing operations.
  • Collaborate with the other Test Automation Engineers to translate strategic automation objectives into actionable testing solutions.
  • Stay current with emerging tools, trends, and technologies.

Qualifications / Experience Required

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Four to six years of experience in software development or test automation, with a minimum of 3 years focused on designing and implementing automated testing frameworks for complex business systems.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in test automation, such as C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
  • Experience in open source and/or proprietary test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Tosca Commander
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to lead and mentor others.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing/maintaining tests using Playwright
  • Experience implementing/maintaining tests using Tricentis Tosca Commander
  • Experience or certifications around P&C Commercial/Ag insurance products
  • Test Automation related certifications such as CTAL-TAE, CSTAS-IIST, etc.

The base salary range provided below is for hires in those geographic areas only and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

  • Albany, NY pay range: $87,740.00 - $110,400.00

Please Note

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas.

If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar state or local law and you wish to discuss potential reasonable accommodations related to applying for employment with us, please contact our Benefits Department at 210-321-8400.

Benefits And Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives, and a comprehensive benefits program—including health, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Core Values

At Clearbrook our Core Values are Integrity, Collaboration, Pursuit of Excellence and Forward Thinking. These values reflect who we are today and who we aspire to be - guiding how we work, how we lead and how we succeed.

descriptionHtml:
About Vimo:

Vimo® started as the “Expedia” of health insurance and has evolved into a leader in transforming government IT infrastructure with its proven SaaS and AI technology. Our innovative approach to health insurance shopping and enrollment has expanded beyond exchanges, and we are now reinventing how states administer safety net programs such as Medicaid, SNAP (food stamps), child care, and unemployment insurance. With our cutting-edge technology, we are helping agencies serve more people, faster, and transforming healthcare service delivery as we know it.


Job Title : QA Automation Engineer (SDET) AI-Enhanced Testing:

We are seeking a highly analytical and technically strong QA Engineer with an SDET background to join our team responsible for validating a complex web-based health insurance marketplace. This role combines hands-on manual testing, test automation development, and the use of AI tools in the SDLC. You will contribute to building reliable test coverage, improving automation, and ensuring overall product quality.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze requirements and workflows to design effective manual and automated test cases, prioritizing automation where appropriate
  • Perform comprehensive manual and automated testing, including exploratory, functional, regression, and end-to-end testing
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks for high-value and repeatable scenarios
  • Contribute to test coverage across UI, API, and integration layers
  • Identify, document, and triage defects with clear reproduction steps and root cause insights
  • Use AI tools to enhance testing, including test case generation, defect analysis, automated test development, and test optimization
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to ensure quality throughout the SDLC
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and faster feedback cycles
  • Continuously evaluate and improve what should be tested manually vs. automated


Required Basic Qualifications:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Proven experience in manual testing of web applications
  • Solid understanding of QA methodologies, processes, and best practices
  • Strong experience with SQL and data validation
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java)
  • Experience testing APIs and data-driven systems
  • Experience working with modern CI/CD pipelines
  • Comfort using AI tools within the software development lifecycle (e.g., AI-assisted test creation, code generation, debugging, or analysis tools)


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience testing complex, data-driven web applications
  • Familiarity with healthcare or health insurance or Medicaid domains
  • Experience with modern automation tools (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar)
  • Exposure to cloud-based environments and microservices architectures
  • Experience with performance or load testing


Compensation and Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation - All In range of ($120,000-$140,000). (Please note that salary and compensation may vary based on factors such as skills, experience, performance and location.)
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including but not limited to:
  • Health, Dental, Life, Disability, and Vision insurance
  • Healthcare spending or reimbursement accounts (HSA/FSA)
  • Retirement benefits (401k)
  • Paid time off
  • Holidays: 13 paid days per year
  • Education assistance or tuition reimbursement
  • Employee discounts for Gym memberships & commuting/travel assistance


Our Vaues:

  • We believe that working hard, when it is imbued with purpose, can and should be fun.
  • You’ll find we are a “can do” place where people work together and roll up their sleeves to get the job done.
  • Everyone has a voice; everyone’s ideas count, and everyone is respected.
  • We have built a company, as well as a community of friends and colleagues, with respect for each other.


Information Security & Data Protection:

  • This role may involve access to sensitive or regulated information. The candidate is expected to handle all data in accordance with company security, privacy, and data protection policies.
  • Compliance with access control, data classification, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements is required.

Job Description:

GDIT is seeking a Software Test Automation Engineer to support a mission-critical software application within the NCE Testing Organization (NTO) in Springfield, Virginia.

This role is an opportunity to help mature the software testing process for an established application. Working alongside developers and an existing tester, you will build an initial automated testing framework, develop and maintain regression tests, create effective test cases, and improve how the team validates software changes.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on test engineer who can move between manual and automated testing, write or modify test scripts, and take initiative in establishing practical, repeatable testing practices. Experience introducing automation into a program with limited existing automation is especially valuable.

This position is primarily focused on software quality and test automation, rather than general DevOps engineering. The selected candidate must be comfortable working on-site five days per week in a classified environment.

Responsibilities

  • Establish and implement an automated testing framework appropriate for the application's architecture and technology stack.
  • Assess existing testing practices and identify opportunities to introduce automation, improve coverage, and reduce repetitive manual testing.
  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated regression tests to validate existing functionality and identify unintended impacts from software changes.
  • Create clear, repeatable test cases based on requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and expected application behavior.
  • Perform functional, integration, end-to-end, and exploratory testing across the application's components.
  • Develop and maintain test scripts using appropriate programming or scripting languages and automation tools.
  • Identify opportunities to incorporate automated tests into existing build, integration, and CI/CD workflows.
  • Work closely with software developers, product stakeholders, and the existing tester to establish effective testing practices throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, contribute to test planning and estimation, and identify testing needs early in the development process.
  • Document test procedures, execution results, defects, and coverage in tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
  • Track defects through resolution, validate fixes, and maintain regression coverage for previously identified issues.
  • Support formal test events, including test planning, test configuration, execution, results analysis, and coordination with the customer testing organization.
  • Evaluate test results, identify quality risks, and communicate findings and recommendations to the team.
  • Conduct performance or load testing when required to support application validation.
  • Assist with test environment configuration, troubleshooting, and upgrades as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with the required polygraph.
  • Five or more years of experience in software testing, quality assurance, test engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Hands-on experience creating, executing, and documenting software test cases.
  • Practical experience developing or implementing automated tests using a programming or scripting language.
  • Experience designing and executing regression tests for software applications.
  • Ability to translate requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria into effective test scenarios.
  • Experience identifying, documenting, tracking, and retesting software defects.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with software developers and other technical team members.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work on-site five days per week in Springfield, Virginia.
  • U.S. citizenship, as required for the position and customer environment.

A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered, subject to contract and customer requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience introducing automated testing into a software program that previously relied primarily on manual testing.
  • Experience building an initial automation framework or establishing a maintainable automated regression suite.
  • Familiarity with one or more test automation frameworks, such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, JUnit, pytest, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience testing applications with a combination of user interfaces, APIs, services, and backend components.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into an existing CI/CD pipeline.
  • Familiarity with Linux, containerized applications, Kubernetes, or OpenShift environments.
  • Experience with integration, end-to-end, performance, or load testing.
  • Familiarity with Agile software development practices and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
  • Experience supporting government software testing organizations or formal customer test events.
  • Relevant industry certifications, such as Security+, when required by the customer.

What Success Looks Like

  • Establishing a practical starting point for automated testing and expanding it as the application and team evolve.
  • Creating a useful, repeatable regression suite that helps identify defects earlier and reduces repetitive manual effort.
  • Improving test case quality, consistency, traceability, and documentation.
  • Collaborating with the existing tester and development team to make testing a more integrated part of software delivery.
  • Providing actionable feedback that improves application quality and confidence in each release.

About Air Apps
At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal, in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.
The Role
As a QA Automation Engineer at Air Apps, you will play a crucial role in building and maintaining automated test frameworks and regression test suites to ensure our applications meet the highest quality standards. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and QA teams to implement automated testing strategies, increase test coverage, and optimize testing efficiency.
Your contributions will directly impact the stability, performance, and reliability of our applications across web and mobile platforms.
Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks for web and mobile applications.
  • Create and execute automated regression, functional, performance, and API tests.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing.
  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure testability of features and early defect detection.
  • Analyze test results, troubleshoot failures, and report issues to development teams.
  • Enhance test coverage by identifying critical scenarios and edge cases.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to define quality standards and best practices.
  • Stay up to date with emerging automation tools, frameworks, and testing methodologies.
Requirements
  • Around 3+ years of experience in test automation development.
  • Proficiency in test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Appium, Playwright).
  • Strong experience in programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience with API testing (Postman, REST Assured, or similar).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
  • Experience with version control systems (Git) and test management tools (TestRail, Zephyr).
  • Strong understanding of software testing principles, SDLC, and agile methodologies.
  • Knowledge of performance and load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling) is a plus.
  • Experience testing mobile applications (iOS & Android) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
What benefits are we offering?
  • Apple hardware ecosystem for work.
  • Annual Bonus.
  • Medical Insurance (including vision & dental).
  • Disability insurance - short and long-term.
  • 401k up to 4% contribution.
  • Air Conference – an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
  • Transportation budget
  • Free meals at the hub
  • Gym membership
Diversity & Inclusion
At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.
Application Disclaimer
At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.

Job Description

QE Automation Engineer

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

We are seeking an experienced Automation Quality Engineer (QE) with strong expertise in test automation using Selenium and Cucumber. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automation frameworks and ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of applications throughout the software development lifecycle.

The role requires strong hands-on automation experience, programming skills, knowledge of modern testing methodologies, and the ability to collaborate effectively with developers, product owners, business analysts, and other QE engineers in an Agile environment.

  • Strong hands-on experience in Quality Engineering, Software Testing, and Test Automation.
  • Strong experience with Selenium WebDriver for web application automation.
  • Strong experience with Cucumber and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language, preferably Java.
  • Strong understanding of Gherkin syntax, feature files, step definitions, hooks, and Cucumber test execution.
  • Experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks using patterns such as Page Object Model (POM).
  • Experience with testing frameworks such as JUnit or TestNG.
  • Experience with build and dependency-management tools such as Maven or Gradle.
  • Experience with REST API testing using tools/frameworks such as REST Assured, Postman, or equivalent.
  • Experience working with Git-based source control and branching strategies.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.
  • Good understanding of SQL and relational databases for backend data validation.
  • Strong understanding of software testing concepts, including functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, smoke, and negative testing.
  • Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and SDLC/STLC processes.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain robust test automation frameworks using Selenium and Cucumber.
  • Develop automated functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end test suites for web-based applications.
  • Create and maintain BDD feature files and scenarios using Gherkin/Cucumber based on business and functional requirements.
  • Develop reusable automation components, utilities, page objects, and test libraries.
  • Execute automated test suites, analyze failures, identify root causes, and communicate defects to development teams.
  • Inte grate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and faster feedback.
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and define appropriate test strategies.
  • Participate in requirement reviews, design discussions, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Identify appropriate candidates for automation and continuously improve automation coverage.
  • Perform API and service-level testing and validate integrations between application components.
  • Develop and maintain test data required for automated and manual testing.
  • Perform database validation using SQL queries where required.
  • Track defects through resolution and perform regression testing to validate fixes.
  • Analyze automation execution results and provide clear quality metrics and test reports.
  • Troubleshoot complex application and automation issues using logs, debugging tools, and other diagnostic techniques.
  • Conduct code reviews for automation scripts and ensure adherence to coding standards and automation best practices.
  • Continuously improve test frameworks, processes, execution efficiency, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to promote shift-left testing and quality engineering practices throughout the SDLC.

Salary Range- $100,000-$120,000 a year

descriptionHtml:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/29/2026

This is a remote position working from anywhere in the USA.

Meet the Team

Isovalent, now part of Cisco, is the company founded by the creators of Cilium and eBPF. Cisco Isovalent is building the next generation of products for securing workloads and AI infrastructure using advanced technologies across Linux and Windows.

Our software agent team builds high-performance, secure, and lightweight software agents that run across Unix, Linux, and Windows environments and multiple architectures, including aarch64, x86_64, s390x, ppc64_le, and SPARC. These agents operate across traditional and modern workloads in on-premises and cloud environments, including virtual machines and major container orchestration platforms.

Our agents collect rich information about workloads, including network traffic and system activities such as processes, users, and file access. They enforce network policies from a central controller, monitor and protect container-based deployments, and provide runtime security capabilities designed to mitigate high-severity vulnerabilities.

You will be an integral member of the software agent team and work closely with software engineers and cross-functional teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from initial design and development through testing and deployment into production environments.

Your Impact

As a Software Development Test Engineer, you will define, design, and develop testing strategies, frameworks, automation, and environments that continuously measure and improve the quality of Cisco Isovalent's software agents.

You will build testing capabilities designed to operate continuously and over extended periods of time, helping identify functional, performance, reliability, and integration issues before they affect production environments. You will develop automated testing approaches for software operating across operating systems, architectures, virtual machines, containers, and cloud environments.

You will work closely with software engineers throughout the development lifecycle to understand new capabilities, define appropriate testing strategies, identify defects, and improve overall product quality. Your work will help ensure the reliability and security of software providing workload visibility, network policy enforcement, container protection, and runtime security at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and develop testing strategies, frameworks, automation, and environments for software agents across Unix, Linux, and Windows platforms.
  • Design automated tests that continuously evaluate software functionality, reliability, performance, and quality over extended periods of time.
  • Build and maintain automated testing infrastructure for virtual machines, containers, and cloud-based environments.
  • Develop testing approaches for software agents that collect workload and network information, enforce network policies, protect containerized environments, and provide runtime security capabilities.
  • Integrate automated testing into the software development and product delivery lifecycle.
  • Analyze test results, identify software defects and reliability issues, and collaborate with engineering teams to troubleshoot and resolve problems.
  • Collaborate with software engineers and cross-functional teams from product conceptualization through production deployment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 3+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience testing complex software products or systems.
  • Experience with Kubernetes
  • Experience developing or implementing automated software testing.
  • Experience working across the software development lifecycle and shipping software products into production.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and developing complex software testing frameworks, strategies, or infrastructure.
  • Experience with OpenShift and Rancher.
  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure automation technologies.
  • Experience testing software across virtual machines, containers, cloud, or distributed environments.
  • Knowledge of runtime security concepts.
  • Knowledge of host-based firewall concepts.
  • Experience programming in Golang.
  • Experience with continuous testing, long-running reliability testing, or automated performance testing.
  • Experience working in agile development environments and collaborating closely with software engineering teams.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The starting salary range posted for this position is $167,700.00 to $245,200.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees
  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco
  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees
  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)
  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next
  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members
  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees On Sales Plans Earn Performance-based Incentive Pay On Top Of Their Base Salary, Which Is Split Between Quota And Non-quota Components, Subject To The Applicable Cisco Plan. For Quota-based Incentive Pay, Cisco Typically Pays As Follows

  • .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;
  • 1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;
  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and
  • Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

$149,100.00 - $250,900.00

  • For quota-based sales roles on Cisco’s sales plan, the ranges provided in this posting include base pay and sales target incentive compensation combined.

Who We Are

Robert Half, one of FORTUNE’s World’s Most Admired Companies and a Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For is hiring for a Quality Assurance Automation Test Engineer Level IV to join the ATI Salesforce Competency Center department.

This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated test solutions that support Salesforce applications, integrations, and enterprise business processes. The ideal candidate is passionate about automation, has deep expertise in Salesforce testing, and has demonstrated innovative use of Artificial Intelligence to improve test development, execution, maintenance, and quality insights.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites for Salesforce applications, APIs, integrations, and end-to-end business processes.
  • Enhance and support the enterprise automation framework to ensure scalability, maintainability, reliability, and ease of adoption.
  • Build reusable automation components, libraries, utilities, and test data strategies.
  • Develop automated tests across multiple layers, including UI, API, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
  • Implement robust automation design patterns such as Page Object Model, data-driven, keyword-driven, and hybrid frameworks.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve automation coverage, effectiveness, and execution efficiency.
  • Validate Salesforce customizations and configurations across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, and integrated enterprise applications.
  • Create and maintain automation solutions for Salesforce Lightning components, workflows, integrations, and APIs.
  • Collaborate with developers to improve application testability and ensure quality is designed into solutions from the start.
  • Participate in requirements reviews and sprint planning to identify automation opportunities early in the development lifecycle.
  • Leverage AI tools and technologies to accelerate automation development, improve code quality, and reduce maintenance costs.
  • Utilize generative AI solutions to:
    • Generate automation scripts and reusable framework components.
    • Create test cases and test data.
    • Analyze APIs and request/response validations.
    • Identify automation gaps and optimize test coverage.
    • Accelerate root cause analysis and defect triage.
  • Evaluate emerging AI-powered testing capabilities and recommend innovative approaches that improve quality engineering outcomes.
  • Partner with teams to establish AI-assisted testing best practices and governance standards.
  • Participate in code reviews and automation design reviews.
  • Drive continuous learning and adoption of innovative testing techniques and technologies.
What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software quality assurance or quality engineering experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on automation development experience.
  • Strong experience testing Salesforce applications and platforms.
  • Experience developing and maintaining enterprise automation frameworks.
  • Proficiency with automation tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, Provar, Playwright, or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, JavaScript, or similar languages.
  • Experience testing REST APIs, integrations, and distributed systems.
  • Experience working within Agile environments.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Experience with source control and CI/CD platforms such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, or GitLab.
  • Knowledge of performance, security, accessibility, and mobile testing practices.

The typical annual salary range for this position is shown below and is negotiable depending upon experience and location. The position is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus.

$109,000.00 - $165,000.00

Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

  • Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
  • Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.
  • Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment & ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality engineering, and the engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity.

Job Summary

The DEEP & Technology team is seeking a Sr. Software Development in Test Engineer to join our Engineering Services team to build test automation and processes to ensure the quality of our advertising systems. When our systems work properly, they are able to reliably deliver relevant ads to all of our viewers; driving higher revenue for our business and helping our customers to discover brands and products that are relevant to their interests. Defects in our ad systems can negatively impact revenue and deliver advertisements that detract from the viewer experience due to irrelevance, repetition and other factors. This is a unique opportunity to join an excellent team and have a meaningful impact on the QE and automation process and culture, as well as the products we release. As a result, those most likely to excel in this role are independent, creative, and able to operate effectively in ambiguous circumstances. If you are interested in a testing role with a heavy emphasis on automated testing where the results of your testing will have significant impact on the business and be highly visible to company leadership, then this might be the right opportunity for you!

Responsibilies Include

  • Work closely with Software Engineers to understand the complex advertising ecosystem in place at DEEP & Technology
  • Develop and maintain reusable automated testing frameworks and comprehensive test suites covering API testing, data pipeline validation, data quality, and end-to-end integration testing using Python
  • Participate in design discussions for our platform to help evolve the platform in a way that enables richer testing scenarios that simplify defect detection and prevention
  • Assist with triage, diagnosis, and resolution of issues discovered across teams.
  • Contribute to end-to-end acceptance tests
  • Where necessary, develop and execute manual test cases to detect issues that cannot be detected through automated means
  • Drive the conversion of manual tests to automated whenever possible

Part of product teams in building architectures which are robust, fault-tolerant, and cloud- native. Builds solutions for problems of sizeable scope and complexity that have been successfully deployed to customers/users. Influences and drives software engineering best practices within the team

Technically lead and deliver multiple projects utilizing an Agile methodology while reviewing team members code. Participates in developing technical and/or business approaches; and new/enhanced technical tools.

Owns the design of software programs or systems within the team, and within the organization. Writes codes that establishes and enhances frameworks. Reviews code for the design, testability and clear usability. Builds solutions that scale and perform. Identifies opportunities to improve the system/product/services with each iteration.

Work Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on software test development experience, including both functional and non-functional test development
  • Passion around driving best practices in the testing space
  • Proficiency with Python or other OO language
  • Knowledge of software engineering practices and agile approaches
  • Strong desire for establishing and improving product quality
  • Experience building or improving test automation frameworks .
  • Proficiency CICD integration and pipeline development in Jenkins, Spinnaker or other similar tools.
  • Proficiency in UI automation ( Selenium, Robot, Watir)
  • Experience in Gherkin ( BDD /TDD )
  • Willingness to take challenges head on while being part of a team

About The Role

Cyber Software Test Engineer

Peraton's Space & Intelligence Sector is looking for an experienced Automated Software Test Engineer to design, implement, and maintain automated testing frameworks that ensure the quality and reliability of our software products. The ideal candidate has a strong background in automated test development, continuous integration workflows, and modern testing tools.

This role will support ongoing development efforts by creating scalable test solutions, improving test coverage, and contributing to overall software quality throughout the SDLC. This position is 100% onsite working in our Herndon SCIF.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance automated test scripts for functional, regression, integration, and performance testing.
  • Design and implement scalable automated test frameworks and harnesses.
  • Collaborate closely with developers to identify testing needs and ensure comprehensive test coverage.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
  • Analyze test results, troubleshoot failures, and document defects with clear and actionable detail.
  • Support manual testing when needed and help define overall QA best practices.
  • Contribute to requirement reviews, design discussions, and sprint planning when necessary.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree with 8 years of relevant experience OR a Master's degree with 6 years of relevant experience; An additional 4 years of experience considered in lieu of a degree requirement
  • Active TS/SCI clearance with poloygraph
  • Extensive experience with automated software testing
  • Experience with automated test tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, JMeter, SoapUI, or Junit.
  • Experience documenting test plans/procedures.
  • Experience maintaining and enhancing existing automated software testing scripts
  • Experience in an Agile software development environment utilizing Python
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Software development experience in a virtual environment like AWS
  • Experience working with developers to ensure test coverage and quality gates.
  • Experience with Jenkins, and Gitlab

descriptionHtml:
Primary Purpose: The Autonomous Vehicle (AV) Test Engineering team at Motional is responsible for validating the safety, functionality, and performance of our self-driving technology and commercial operations platform through rigorous, system-level testing. Motional’s Las Vegas office is located less than 10 miles from the Las Vegas Strip at 730 E Pilot Road and is home to one of the largest fleets of self-driving vehicles. The city’s grid system of roads and status as one of America’s “smart cities” enables extensive research and development testing.

As a Senior QA Automation Test Engineer, you will lead the design, development, and execution of backend and frontend automation frameworks for our fleet operations platform—the operational backbone of our commercial robotaxi service. In this role, you will also lead and mentor a fellow automation engineer, driving best practices and continuous improvement across the team. Your work will establish scalable quality gates within CI/CD pipelines and ensure reliable end-to-end validation across fleet management, dispatching, and monitoring systems.

Essential Duties:

Automation Architecture & Framework Ownership

  • Own the architecture, development, and maintenance of scalable backend and frontend test automation frameworks for the fleet operations platform, with a primary focus on backend API and service-level validation.
  • Design and execute comprehensive automated test suites covering backend services, APIs, and data pipelines, as well as frontend UI workflows within the operations platform.
  • Develop automation solutions primarily in Python and Go for backend testing, and JavaScript for frontend validation, while proactively adopting new tools and frameworks as the platform evolves.

Integration & Platform Validation

  • Lead integration testing efforts for third-party APIs and internal services, ensuring reliable end-to-end data flow across fleet management, dispatching, and monitoring systems.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis on test failures and system defects, driving resolution across backend services and frontend interfaces.

Quality Strategy, CI/CD & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with software engineers and product teams to define test strategies, identify coverage gaps, and establish quality gates within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Contribute to documentation, test plans, and operational frameworks that bring clarity and transparency to the automation testing process for all stakeholders.

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Lead, mentor, and collaborate with one automation test engineer, providing technical guidance, code reviews, and support for professional development.
  • Drive continuous improvement and best practices across the automation testing function.

Strategic Adaptation & Support

  • Continuously adapt automation strategies in response to evolving platform requirements, architectural shifts, and stack changes.
  • Support after-hours validation or release activities as needed by fleet or field operations.
  • Travel domestically on occasion to support on-site testing or operational deployments.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software QA or test automation, with a strong emphasis on backend and API testing.
  • Hands-on proficiency in Python and Go for backend test automation, and JavaScript for frontend automation.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and building automation frameworks from the ground up for complex, distributed systems.
  • Experience with REST/gRPC API testing, service integration validation, and data pipeline verification.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality gates for production-grade software releases.
  • Proven ability to lead technical efforts, operate autonomously, mentor engineers, and drive cross-functional collaboration.
  • Ability and willingness to quickly learn new tools, frameworks, and technologies as the platform and stack evolve.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to drive cross-functional alignment and effectively report technical findings.
  • High level of initiative, ownership, and accountability in a fast-paced engineering environment.
  • Flexible schedule and willingness to support late meetings, night shifts, or urgent validation activities as required.

Preferred:

  • Experience with autonomous vehicle fleet monitoring, dispatching, or fleet management systems.
  • Experience with Uber API or similar ride-hail/transportation platform integration testing.
  • Familiarity with cloud telemetry systems or AV data pipelines.
  • Experience in a cross-site or global engineering organization.
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and at times for long periods; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds.

Working Environment

The work environment characteristics described here represent those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the team member is regularly exposed to outside weather conditions, road conditions, and pedestrian traffic. The team member is regularly exposed to mechanical and computer parts. The team member is occasionally exposed to fumes and airborne particles. The noise level in the environment is low to moderate.

Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.

Our journey is always people first.

We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.

Scale up, not starting up.

Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.

Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

Senior SDET – Robot Framework

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our gamechangers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Senior SDET – Robot Framework

Location: Omaha, NE (Onsite - 5 days a week)

Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Test Engineer to drive quality across complex enterprise applications through thoughtful test strategy, hands-on test execution, and scalable automation. In this role, you will partner closely with developers, product owners, business analysts, and project teams to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions across evolving applications, technologies, and business domains.

This is an opportunity for a quality engineering professional who brings strong technical expertise, clear communication, problem-solving confidence, and the adaptability to succeed in dynamic environments where priorities and teams may shift based on business needs.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, design, and execute comprehensive testing strategies for complex enterprise applications.
  • Perform manual and automated functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
  • Analyze requirements, identify quality risks, and develop risk-based testing approaches that balance speed, coverage, and business impact.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites using frameworks such as Robot Framework, Playwright, and/or Selenium.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to improve release confidence and delivery efficiency.
  • Build reusable automation assets and continuously improve test coverage through automation.
  • Conduct API testing using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or SoapUI.
  • Manage defects through identification, documentation, triage, root cause analysis, and resolution validation.
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts, and cross-functional project teams to clarify requirements and resolve quality concerns.
  • Communicate testing progress, quality risks, defects, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Support multiple applications, products, projects, or business domains as priorities evolve.
  • Quickly learn new technologies, applications, and business processes with minimal ramp-up time.
  • Apply knowledge gained across one project, domain, or technology to solve challenges in another.
  • Contribute to Agile and DevOps testing practices that support continuous delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and a proactive mindset in improving overall quality engineering outcomes.

Qualifications

  • 7–15 years of experience in Quality Assurance with strong hands-on expertise in test automation.
  • Strong experience in quality engineering, test planning, test design, and test execution for complex enterprise applications.
  • Hands-on experience with manual and automated testing across functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end scenarios.
  • Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Experience with one or more automation frameworks, including Robot Framework, Playwright, or Selenium.
  • Experience integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong API testing experience using Postman, REST Assured, SoapUI, or similar tools.
  • Programming or scripting experience in one or more of the following: Java, Python, JavaScript, or SQL.
  • Experience with version control tools such as Git and GitHub.
  • Familiarity with test management tools such as Jira or TestRail.
  • Experience with build and deployment tools such as Maven or Jenkins.
  • Strong understanding of defect management, triage, and root cause analysis.

Job Number: R0251156

Quality Assurance Engineer

The Opportunity:

A Digital Twin is only as valuable as the trust users place in it. As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you'll help ensure that the applications, services, data pipelines, and simulations behind a Digital Twin and Modeling and Simulation (M&S) platform for military test ranges perform reliably, accurately, and securely.

You'll own test strategy and execution across web applications, back-end APIs, 3D and geospatial data pipelines, and real-time 3D visualization environments built on game engines. You'll build automated test suites, integrate them into CI/CD pipelines, and verify that releases meet functional, visual, performance, and security requirements before they reach mission users. You'll also help confirm that simulation outputs and 3D content accurately represent the real-world systems and environments they model. You'll work alongside full-stack developers, M&S engineers, platform engineers, and UX practitioners to catch issues early and help build quality into every stage of delivery.

In this role, you'll help define how quality is measured on a complex, emerging platform. You'll also produce the test evidence that supports releases in regulated DoD environments.

Help us deliver Digital Twin capabilities that mission users can count on.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in software quality assurance or test engineering
  • Experience developing automated tests for web and desktop applications using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or pytest
  • Experience testing REST APIs using tools such as Postman or REST Assured
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins
  • Experience writing test plans, test cases, and defect reports, and tracking them in tools such as Jira or Xray
  • Experience with scripting in Python, C#, or JavaScript
  • Ability to quickly learn engine-specific testing tools
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time
  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience testing real-time 3D, simulation, or XR applications using the Unity Test Framework, Unreal Automation Framework, AltTester, or GameDriver
  • Experience with visual regression or image-comparison testing for rendered 3D content
  • Experience profiling real-time application performance using tools such as Unity Profiler, Unreal Insights, or RenderDoc
  • Experience with performance and load testing tools such as k6, JMeter, or Locust
  • Experience validating 3D and geospatial data, including OpenUSD, point clouds, meshes, or GIS formats
  • Experience with M&S verification, validation, and accreditation (VV&A), including comparing simulation outputs against reference data
  • Experience testing cloud-native applications deployed on AWS, including containerized services on Kubernetes
  • Experience with accessibility testing against Section 508 standards, security testing, or supporting DoD ATO test evidence and compliance requirements
  • Secret clearance
  • ISTQB or equivalent Testing Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

  • Experience using Java, TestNG, Selenium.

  • Strong debugging and triage skills
  • Strong written and oral communication skills

  • Must be able to present work in a clear and understandable manner

The Medpace IT department delivers software solutions that enable and empower both internal and external customers to manage their business processes most effectively and efficiently. Responsibilities

  • Create new and maintain existing test automation code with a high degree of quality;
  • Promote best practices in code health, testability, and maintainability;
  • Work with members of the development and validation teams to determine the best areas of the applicaton to automate;
  • Implement automation regression suites;
  • Perform exploratory testing when needed; and

  • Experience in automation testing and/or software development;
  • Experience with black and white box testing;

We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Purpose-Driven Work

Collaborative Culture

descriptionHtml:
***This is NOT a remote position***


Job Description


Eccalon is seeking a Senior SDET / QA Automation Engineer to build and own the automated testing strategy across our web applications and backend services supporting DoD, Intelligence, and enterprise programs. You will design and maintain robust test frameworks, integrate quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, and ensure the reliability of systems operating in regulated, compliance-driven environments. This is a hands-on senior role with broad visibility across the full engineering stack—working directly with software engineers, DevOps, and product teams to shift quality left and keep mission-critical software shipping with confidence.


Responsibilities

Test Automation & Framework Development

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end UI automation frameworks using Playwright and/or Cypress across multiple web applications (e.g., lynxconnect.io, eccalon.com).
  • Develop and maintain API and backend test suites using Postman collections and REST Assured; validate authentication flows, data integrity, and service contracts.
  • Write clean, maintainable test code in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript; enforce consistent standards through code reviews and shared libraries.
  • Build reusable test utilities, fixtures, and data factories that reduce test setup overhead and improve suite reliability.


CI/CD Integration & Quality Gates

  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD) to enforce quality gates on every pull request and deployment.
  • Configure and maintain synthetic monitoring scripts (e.g., Playwright-based uptime checks) for production applications; triage and resolve false positives.
  • Define and track test coverage metrics, pass rates, and flakiness trends; report quality signals to engineering leadership.


API & Backend Testing

  • Validate REST APIs against specifications; test authentication and authorization flows including OAuth2, SAML, OIDC, and JIT provisioning patterns.
  • Develop data-driven test scenarios against AWS-hosted services (RDS/PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Cognito) and Azure-backed platforms (GCC High).
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to identify testability gaps in service design and recommend interface contracts that support automation.


Cross-functional Collaboration & Quality Strategy

  • Partner with DevOps, software engineering, and IT teams to embed testing earlier in the development lifecycle; contribute to definition-of-done criteria.
  • Serve as the quality subject matter expert on the team—mentoring engineers on test best practices, automation patterns, and tooling selection.
  • Maintain test documentation, test plans, and traceability matrices that satisfy compliance audit and ATO evidence requirements.
  • Evaluate and recommend improvements to the overall QA toolchain and processes as applications and team scale.


Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field—or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in software development engineering in test (SDET), QA automation, or a related discipline.
  • Hands-on proficiency with Playwright and/or Cypress for end-to-end UI test automation.
  • Strong API testing skills using Postman (including collections, environments, and Newman for CI execution) and/or REST Assured.
  • Solid programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Python; ability to write production-quality test code, not just record-and-replay scripts.
  • Experience integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins).
  • Familiarity with AWS services (Cognito, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch) and how they factor into end-to-end test design.
  • Experience testing authentication and authorization flows (OAuth2, SAML, OIDC, MFA).
  • Strong understanding of HTTP, REST, JSON, and web application architecture.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize across multiple projects, and communicate quality risk clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with synthetic monitoring and uptime automation (e.g., Playwright-based health checks, Pingdom scripting).
  • Familiarity with NIST 800-171, CMMC, or FedRAMP testing and traceability requirements.
  • Experience testing applications hosted on Azure GCC High or AWS GovCloud environments.
  • Background in performance or load testing (k6, JMeter, or Locust).
  • Experience with accessibility testing (WCAG 2.1, 508 compliance) and security-focused test cases (OWASP Top 10 validation).
  • ISTQB certification or equivalent QA/testing credential.
