descriptionHtml:
***This is NOT a remote position***


Job Description


Eccalon is seeking a Senior SDET / QA Automation Engineer to build and own the automated testing strategy across our web applications and backend services supporting DoD, Intelligence, and enterprise programs. You will design and maintain robust test frameworks, integrate quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, and ensure the reliability of systems operating in regulated, compliance-driven environments. This is a hands-on senior role with broad visibility across the full engineering stack—working directly with software engineers, DevOps, and product teams to shift quality left and keep mission-critical software shipping with confidence.


Responsibilities

Test Automation & Framework Development

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end UI automation frameworks using Playwright and/or Cypress across multiple web applications (e.g., lynxconnect.io, eccalon.com).
  • Develop and maintain API and backend test suites using Postman collections and REST Assured; validate authentication flows, data integrity, and service contracts.
  • Write clean, maintainable test code in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript; enforce consistent standards through code reviews and shared libraries.
  • Build reusable test utilities, fixtures, and data factories that reduce test setup overhead and improve suite reliability.


CI/CD Integration & Quality Gates

  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD) to enforce quality gates on every pull request and deployment.
  • Configure and maintain synthetic monitoring scripts (e.g., Playwright-based uptime checks) for production applications; triage and resolve false positives.
  • Define and track test coverage metrics, pass rates, and flakiness trends; report quality signals to engineering leadership.


API & Backend Testing

  • Validate REST APIs against specifications; test authentication and authorization flows including OAuth2, SAML, OIDC, and JIT provisioning patterns.
  • Develop data-driven test scenarios against AWS-hosted services (RDS/PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Cognito) and Azure-backed platforms (GCC High).
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to identify testability gaps in service design and recommend interface contracts that support automation.


Cross-functional Collaboration & Quality Strategy

  • Partner with DevOps, software engineering, and IT teams to embed testing earlier in the development lifecycle; contribute to definition-of-done criteria.
  • Serve as the quality subject matter expert on the team—mentoring engineers on test best practices, automation patterns, and tooling selection.
  • Maintain test documentation, test plans, and traceability matrices that satisfy compliance audit and ATO evidence requirements.
  • Evaluate and recommend improvements to the overall QA toolchain and processes as applications and team scale.


Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field—or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in software development engineering in test (SDET), QA automation, or a related discipline.
  • Hands-on proficiency with Playwright and/or Cypress for end-to-end UI test automation.
  • Strong API testing skills using Postman (including collections, environments, and Newman for CI execution) and/or REST Assured.
  • Solid programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Python; ability to write production-quality test code, not just record-and-replay scripts.
  • Experience integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins).
  • Familiarity with AWS services (Cognito, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch) and how they factor into end-to-end test design.
  • Experience testing authentication and authorization flows (OAuth2, SAML, OIDC, MFA).
  • Strong understanding of HTTP, REST, JSON, and web application architecture.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize across multiple projects, and communicate quality risk clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with synthetic monitoring and uptime automation (e.g., Playwright-based health checks, Pingdom scripting).
  • Familiarity with NIST 800-171, CMMC, or FedRAMP testing and traceability requirements.
  • Experience testing applications hosted on Azure GCC High or AWS GovCloud environments.
  • Background in performance or load testing (k6, JMeter, or Locust).
  • Experience with accessibility testing (WCAG 2.1, 508 compliance) and security-focused test cases (OWASP Top 10 validation).
  • ISTQB certification or equivalent QA/testing credential.

CI/CD Integration & Quality Gates

- Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD) to enforce quality gates on every pull request and deployment.
- Configure and maintain synthetic monitoring scripts (e.g., Playwright-based uptime checks) for production applications; triage and resolve false positives.
- Define and track test coverage metrics, pass rates, and flakiness trends; report quality signals to engineering leadership.


API & Backend Testing

- Validate REST APIs against specifications; test authentication and authorization flows including OAuth2, SAML, OIDC, and JIT provisioning patterns.

- Familiarity with AWS services (Cognito, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch) and how they factor into end-to-end test design.

- Strong understanding of HTTP, REST, JSON, and web application architecture.

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience with synthetic monitoring and uptime automation (e.g., Playwright-based health checks, Pingdom scripting).
- Familiarity with NIST 800-171, CMMC, or FedRAMP testing and traceability requirements.
- Experience testing applications hosted on Azure GCC High or AWS GovCloud environments.

Benefits

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. The Workers’ Compensation Insurance Rating Bureau of California (WCIRB) is a private, nonprofit association of insurance companies licensed to transact workers'​ compensation insurance in the state of California. The WCIRB operates under the authority of the California Insurance Code, is licensed by the California Department of Insurance (CDI) and is the Insurance Commissioner’s designated statistical agent for workers comp insurance. 

The WCIRB develops proposed advisory pure premium rates for submission to the California Insurance Commissioner and administers the Commissioner’s workers’ compensation regulations contained in the California Workers’ Compensation Uniform Statistical Reporting Plan—1995, the California Workers’ Compensation Experience Rating Plan—1995 and the Miscellaneous Regulations for the Recording and Reporting of Data. 

WCIRB operating funds are derived solely from membership fees, premium assessments paid by members and revenue generated from fees for services and products. No state money is used to fund its operations.

To learn more about the WCIRB, its core functions and the products and services available to insurers, agents and brokers, and others, see http://www.wcirb.com.

descriptionHtml:
For over a century, the Workers' Compensation Insurance Rating Bureau of California (WCIRB) has been California's trusted, objective provider of actuarially based information and research, advisory pure premium rates and educational services integral to a healthy workers' compensation system. The WCIRB is a California unincorporated, private, nonprofit association comprised of all companies licensed to transact workers' compensation insurance in California. The operations of the WCIRB are funded primarily by membership fees and assessments; no state money is used to fund its operations. The WCIRB is a stable company and a proven leader in the workers’ compensation insurance industry nationwide.


The WCIRB performs a number of functions to accurately measure the cost of providing workers' compensation benefits and ensure a healthy workers’ compensation system. To learn more about our company, please visit About Us | WCIRB California. The WCIRB employs approximately 175 people with the average tenure of over 10 years. We are committed to fostering a healthy, safe and diverse work environment leading to a dedicated, collaborative and innovative workforce. This is a hybrid position where approximately 40% of the work time is spent at the home office in San Francisco, California.


WCIRB seeks a Quality Engineer who is passionate about ensuring the highest standards and committed to delivering innovative automated testing solutions. As a Quality Engineer, you will be pivotal in implementing, maintaining, and executing comprehensive quality strategies. Your contributions will directly impact our software platforms' quality, accuracy, reliability, and performance, ensuring exceptional user experience for our user base.


The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, high-tech, detail-oriented, innovative, self-motivated, and self-reliant. Take advantage of this opportunity to make a meaningful impact on software quality and workers' compensation.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute automated test solutions using modern automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, and Selenium
  • Analyze user stories and requirements to create comprehensive automated functional/system, integration, component, and regression tests
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and design test solutions, resolve defects, and test code changes
  • Collaborate closely with Business and Quality Analysts to better understand coverage, impacts, data, and acceptance criteria
  • Analyze and validate non-functional requirements such as load, performance, and security
  • Assist in the design and implementation of continuous integration and delivery pipelines, including integration of automated tests
  • Generate test reports/dashboards and document software defects and defects trends
  • Work with development, product, and program management teams to ensure software testing requirements are met
  • Continuously improve software testing methodologies and processes


General Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in software quality engineering
  • A minimum 5 years of experience in .NET and C# (required)
  • Hands-on experience in Visual Studio
  • Experience in testing APIs and using tools such as SoapUI, Postman, Fiddler, etc.
  • Experience in .NET technologies, Azure DevOps, and modern automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, and Selenium (required)
  • Experience in unit test frameworks such as NUnit, XUnit, MSTest
  • Knowledge of modern development principles such as SOLID, Occam's Razor, TDD, iterative lifecycle process, etc.
  • Experience in cloud testing, Microservice architectures, CI/CD, and Azure environments
  • Experience in SQL to conduct database testing and data validation
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies
  • Strong analytical skills with a passion for quality and detail


Nice to Have

  • PowerShell scripting
  • Hands-on Non-Functional Testing Experience (i.e. Performance, Reliability, etc.)
  • Knowledge of non-functional testing such as load, performance, and security
  • Production support, analysis, debugging, troubleshooting, overlaps/Splunk tool usage, etc.


Perks & Benefits

Our employees enjoy a state of the art, energy-efficient, open work environment that nurtures collaboration and creativity. At the WCIRB, we go the extra mile to keep our employees happy and healthy. Our perks include:

  • Hybrid work environment (40% onsite 60% remote)
  • Medical, dental and vision benefits
  • Competitive PTO Program
  • 401K and pension plan
  • Annual incentive plan
  • Social activities
  • Community volunteer involvement


Please note: the WCIRB location in San Francisco is steps from Montgomery Street BART entrance.


WCIRB is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.


The successful candidate will reside in California and will work from our headquarters in San Francisco at least 40% of the time. We are NOT able to pay for relocation costs for candidates or to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.


Thank you for your interest in the WCIRB!

The Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) is a software engineering professional specializing in automation, quality engineering, and intelligent system validation. This role designs, develops, deploys, and maintains scalable automated solutions to ensure the reliability, performance, security, accessibility, and resilience of enterprise applications, system integrations, and automated business workflows.

The SDET combines strong programming expertise with modern engineering practices to build automation frameworks, validate APIs and distributed systems, support CI/CD and cloud-native execution models, and test AI-enabled systems and process automation platforms. Working closely with Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product teams, QA Leads, and other stakeholders, the SDET improves system testability, drives shift-left and continuous testing practices, and embeds automation throughout the software delivery lifecycle while maintaining enterprise quality and governance standards.

Job Duties

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated solutions for functional, regression, integration, performance, security, accessibility, and end-to-end testing
  • Build and enhance automation frameworks for APIs, user interfaces, backend services, and enterprise workflows using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Rest Assured, Postman, Tosca, or similar technologies
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable automation code using Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar languages
  • Perform validation across APIs, distributed systems, databases (relational and NoSQL), and system integrations
  • Define and support test data management practices to improve automation reliability and coverage
  • Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines with quality gates, including functional, performance, and security validations
  • Support scalable and containerized test execution across cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Install, configure, and maintain automation tools and supporting infrastructure across Windows and Linux platforms
  • Develop validation approaches for AI-enabled features, distributed systems, and automated business workflows (including RPA where applicable)
  • Contribute to automation standards, governance practices, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Support shift-left and continuous testing practices and contribute to test strategy and risk-based validation
  • Monitor and improve automation effectiveness by tracking key quality metrics and reducing flaky tests
  • Utilize mocking, stubbing, or service virtualization techniques to enable reliable testing of dependent systems
  • Participate in code reviews and advocate for testability in system design and development practices
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate effectively to ensure alignment on quality objectives
  • Apply sound engineering judgment and enterprise standards in automation design and execution
  • Leverage approved Generative AI tools to enhance automation quality, productivity, and intelligent test design
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship appropriate to role level while continuously learning and adopting new technologies


Required Experience

  • Strong knowledge of software engineering and quality engineering principles
  • Experience with UI and/or API automation frameworks
  • Programming experience in Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar languages
  • Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with Git-based version control
  • Experience supporting applications on Windows and/or Linux platforms
  • Working knowledge of Agile methodologies and SDLC practices


Level 2: Requires minimum 2 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements

Senior Level: Requires minimum 5 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements

Lead Level: Requires minimum 8 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) or multi-cloud environments
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or distributed test infrastructure
  • Experience with performance and/or security testing tools
  • Experience with enterprise validation tools (Tosca, NeoLoad, qTest, Invicti, etc.)
  • Experience implementing or supporting ServiceNow ATF automation
  • Experience validating AI-enabled systems or familiarity with AI-assisted testing tools
  • Experience influencing system design for testability, scalability, and resilience
  • Experience supporting DevOps or DevSecOps practices
  • Familiarity with BDD frameworks (e.g., Cucumber, Gherkin)
  • Experience testing event-driven architectures or message queue systems (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ)
  • Familiarity with mobile testing tools and frameworks (e.g., Appium)
  • Familiarity with resilience testing or chaos engineering principles
  • Familiarity with RPA tools and validation of automated business workflows (e.g., UiPath, Power Automate)
  • Familiarity with observability or monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana)


ERCOT is firmly committed to equal employment for all qualified persons without regard to race, sex, medical condition, religion, age, creed, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, ancestry, veteran status, genetic information or any other protected category under federal, state or local law.

Expected Salary Range

$121,000 - $167,000

Build the future of test automation at one of the world's most innovative financial institutions — where your engineering skills directly impact millions of customers.

As a Senior Associate in the Credit Card Technology team, you will design, build, and maintain an in-house Test Automation Framework that powers continuous delivery across critical financial products. You'll collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure quality at every stage of the development lifecycle, helping us ship faster and smarter.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test cases that validate user acceptance criteria for new and existing features
  • Build and expand the end-to-end test automation suite for existing workflows, integrating tests with CI/CD pipelines for continuous validation
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Product Managers, and Technology partners to understand requirements and design effective test plans
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog prioritization, story mapping, story refinement, sprint reviews, and demos
  • Provide effort estimates for user stories using planning poker and similar techniques
  • Proactively develop and implement testing best practices across the project team, driving continuous process improvement
  • Assist in manual testing efforts when automation is not feasible, ensuring comprehensive test coverage
  • Communicate test progress, results, and issues clearly to product teams and stakeholders
  • Train developers and Product Owners on creating and modifying automated test cases
  • Use AI-assisted tools responsibly to accelerate test case generation, automation code scaffolding, log analysis, and defect summarization

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree, in Computer Science or a related field
  • 3 years of experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks using behavior-driven development tools such as Selenium, Cucumber, JUnit, or Fitnesse
  • 3 years of experience with open-source test automation tools
  • 3 years of experience with Continuous Integration and Deployment practices and tools, including Jenkins or equivalent, Maven, and Git
  • 3 years of experience working in Agile teams, including creating test strategies and test scenarios from product backlog refinements

  • Demonstrated ability to build prompt templates and review checklists that produce repeatable, auditable AI-assisted outputs
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to adapt to changing project needs in cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • 4 years of experience in a financial services environment with working knowledge of credit card products
  • 4 years of experience with application testing and monitoring frameworks such as JMeter, AppDynamics, or Geneos

Job Summary

Build a Bigger, Better, Bolder Future:

Imagine working for a company that measures its success based off the growth of its colleagues, a company that invests in its future by investing in you. Little Caesars is a company where our colleagues make an impact.

Your Mission

The Senior QA Automation Engineer is a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable test automation solutions that improve software quality, accelerate delivery, and increase release confidence across Retail Technology applications.

This role partners closely with Product, Engineering, DevOps, and Quality Assurance teams to implement modern automation practices, integrate quality throughout the software development lifecycle, and support continuous testing across web, mobile, API, integration, and performance testing domains.

What You'll Do

Automation Engineering

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise automation frameworks using Playwright, Cypress, Appium, and related automation technologies.
  • Create and maintain automated tests across web, mobile, API, integration, and end-to-end testing domains.
  • Develop reusable automation assets, utilities, libraries, and testing patterns that improve efficiency and maintainability.
  • Implement automation standards and best practices that support reliable and scalable test execution.
  • Develop automation for Little Caesars digital experiences, including web ordering, mobile apps, APIs, payments, store systems, and omnichannel integrations.
  • Support release validation for menu, pricing, promotions, loyalty, commerce, payment, and operational platform capabilities.

Continuous Quality, CI/CD & Performance

  • Integrate automated testing, API validation, and performance testing into Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Implement automated quality gates that improve release readiness and deployment confidence.
  • Improve automation execution reliability, test stability, and reporting capabilities.
  • Develop and execute performance testing solutions using K6 and related performance testing tools.
  • Analyze performance results and collaborate with engineering teams to identify quality and scalability risks.

API, Integration & Quality Engineering

  • Develop and maintain automated API validation, integration, and service-level test suites.
  • Validate service contracts, integrations, and data flows across critical business applications.
  • Support test data creation, management, and validation strategies.
  • Mentor QA Engineers on automation frameworks, tool usage, and engineering best practices.
  • Contribute recommendations for automation improvements, framework enhancements, and quality engineering maturity.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Quality Assurance, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of software quality engineering experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on automation engineering experience.
  • Experience designing and implementing automation frameworks and scalable test suites in enterprise-level delivery environments.
  • Experience mentoring team members and promoting automation adoption across teams.

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience developing automation solutions using Playwright, Cypress, or Appium.
  • Experience building automation solutions using JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
  • Experience automating REST API testing, service validation, and integration testing using automated frameworks and industry-standard tools.
  • Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, DevOps, SDLC practices, test reporting, quality metrics, and automation execution analytics.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience with K6 performance test scripting, execution, and result analysis.
  • Experience integrating automated testing within Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with Git source control, modern branching strategies, SQL, data validation, cloud-hosted applications, and distributed systems.
  • Experience using AI-assisted software development or testing tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI agents, or AI-enabled testing solutions.
  • Experience supporting retail, eCommerce, point-of-sale (POS), payment, loyalty, or omnichannel platforms.
  • Experience with containerized or cloud-native environments.
  • ISTQB certification or equivalent industry certification.
  • Exposure to Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), agent-based workflows, or AI-enabled testing concepts.
  • Experience evaluating emerging test automation and quality engineering technologies.

Where You'll Work

  • Hybrid work environment with collaboration across local and remote technical teams.
  • Occasional travel may be required based on business needs.
  • Ability to work at a computer workstation for extended periods and participate in virtual and in-person meetings.

descriptionHtml:
About Rad AI

At Rad AI, we’re on a mission to transform healthcare with artificial intelligence. Founded by a radiologist, our AI-driven solutions are revolutionizing radiology—saving time, reducing burnout, and improving patient care. With one of the largest proprietary radiology report datasets in the world, our AI has helped uncover hundreds of new cancer diagnoses and reduced error rates in tens of millions of radiology reports by nearly 50%.

Rad AI has secured over $140M in funding, including a recently oversubscribed Series C ($68M round) led by Transformation Capital, bringing our valuation to $528M. Our investors include Khosla Ventures, World Innovation Lab, Gradient Ventures, Cone Health Ventures, and others—all backing our mission to empower physicians with cutting-edge AI.

Our latest advancements in generative AI are used by thousands of radiologists daily, supporting more than one-third of radiology groups and healthcare systems and nearly 50% of all medical imaging in the U.S. at partners including Cone Health, Jefferson Einstein Health, Geisinger, Guthrie Healthcare System, and Henry Ford Health.

Recognized as one of the most promising healthcare AI companies by CB Insights and AuntMinnie, and ranked by Deloitte as the 19th fastest-growing company in North America, we are building AI-powered solutions that make a real impact. Most recently, Rad AI was named to CNBC’s Disruptor 50 list, highlighting the innovation and momentum behind our mission.

If you’re ready to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to have you on our team!

Why We Need You

Radiologists use our products every day to produce the reports that decide what care a patient gets next. A missed regression here isn't an inconvenience; it's a blank report after signing, a missing accession, or a formatting error in a clinical impression. That's not a context where "good enough" ships.

Our quality engineers are embedded in product teams across Reporting, Impressions, Continuity, Speech, and Interop. Some areas already run PR-level checks, developer-written end-to-end tests, AI-assisted test creation, and automated regression triage. We're now building one quality operating model so those practices hold in every product area, and so testing reflects how radiologists actually work.

Our principle: Engineering owns quality; Quality owns the quality system. As a Senior Test Automation Engineer, you'll own test automation strategy for a product domain. You'll design automation that engineers build on, make release risk explicit, and help us move from catching defects to preventing them.

Here's What You'll Be Doing

You'll be the quality and automation expert for your product domain, where you'll:

  • Own test automation strategy for your domain. Decide what to test, at which level, and why, across complex features and the teams that build them. Balance short-term delivery with the long-term health of our test suites.
  • Design automation others build on. Build scalable, maintainable frameworks, fixtures, and utilities that engineers use to write their own tests. Partner with engineers to improve testability, and use AI-assisted test generation where it raises quality and speed.
  • Make release risk explicit. Run pre-release risk assessments, build the test matrix across integrations, environments, and customer workflows, and lead test planning for high-risk releases and hotfixes. Help define the go/no-go signals your domain ships on.
  • Test the way radiologists work. Turn radiologist personas and real workflows into test cases. Bring customer-matched environments into validation, such as Windows and Electron workstations, dictation systems, and PACS/RIS integrations, and use exploratory testing where automation falls short.
  • Keep the test signal trustworthy. Drive down flaky and low-signal tests, triage failures quickly, cut suite execution time, and improve test data and environment stability with our platform teams.
  • Lead non-functional quality in your domain. Lead or co-lead performance and load testing, security checks in pipelines, and accessibility and compliance coverage such as HIPAA-related auditability.
  • Test AI systems responsibly. Design evaluations for non-deterministic outputs, such as speech recognition and generated impressions, that don't hinge on a single result.
  • Turn escaped defects into prevention. Use incident reviews and customer-reported defects to add regression coverage and update risk profiles, so the same failure doesn't reach a radiologist twice.
  • Use data to guide decisions. Track escaped defects, test stability, and time to detect for your domain, and keep suites organized in our test case management system so results are visible and comparable.
  • Raise the bar around you. Mentor TAEs and software engineers across teams, act as a trusted quality partner to Engineering Managers on risk and release readiness, and contribute to hiring, onboarding, and our Quality community.

Who We're Looking For

  • This role requires working from our San Francisco office.
  • 6+ years of software engineering or test automation experience, including 3+ years designing and owning automation frameworks.
  • Strong programming skills in TypeScript and/or Python; experience with an object-oriented language such as C# or Java is a plus.
  • Deep experience with end-to-end frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.
  • API testing experience across REST and GraphQL services (for example ASP.NET Core Minimal API, FastAPI, Postman), including how tests interact with data and downstream dependencies.
  • Experience building tests into CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions or CircleCI, including PR-level gating, parallelization, and reporting.
  • A track record of reducing flakiness and suite runtime, backed by data.
  • Experience with risk-based test strategy for integration-heavy systems that run across many customer configurations.
  • Strong debugging skills across services, data, and environments, with working knowledge of SQL, logs, and observability tools.
  • A shift-left mindset: you've helped developers own their tests rather than owning every test yourself.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools to write, maintain, and triage tests, with the judgment to review what they produce.
  • Detail-oriented, collaborative, and able to influence without authority, with clear communication and experience mentoring engineers.

It Would Be Nice If

  • You've worked in healthcare or another regulated environment (HIPAA, PHI, SOC 2), ideally at a startup.
  • You're familiar with radiology systems: PACS, RIS, dictation platforms such as PowerScribe or Fluency, HL7/FHIR, FHIRcast, or DICOM.
  • You've automated Windows desktop or Electron applications, for example with WinAppDriver or UI Automation.
  • You've tested ML, AI, or speech systems where outputs aren't deterministic.
  • You've owned performance or load testing, or integrated security checks into pipelines.
  • You've worked with AWS or Google Cloud, and provisioned test environments with tools like Docker or Terraform.
  • You've used a test case management system such as Testmo, or built quality dashboards in tools like Grafana.

Join our world-class team as we build and deploy AI solutions that empower physicians and transform patient care—making a meaningful impact on millions of lives. Driven by our mission, we prioritize transparency, inclusion, and close collaboration, bringing together exceptional people to revolutionize healthcare. If you're passionate about driving innovation and delivering impactful healthcare solutions, we'd love to hear from you!

To learn more about what it's like to work at Rad AI, visit https://www.radai.com/life-at-rad-ai and be sure to follow us on LinkedIn to stay up to date!

Description

About Us

Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.

We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.

Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.

TP-Link is seeking a Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Cloud Web Platforms Quality Engineering team. In this role, you will help ensure the quality of TP-Link's global websites, web applications, and AI-powered customer experiences, which reach millions of users across dozens of countries and languages.

You will drive quality throughout the development lifecycle—from reviewing requirements and identifying risks to designing tests, expanding automation coverage, investigating failures, and supporting release decisions. The work ranges from product pages and content-management platforms to AI-powered search and support assistants. You also have the opportunity to contribute to testing the cloud services and APIs behind these experiences. Throughout, you'll work closely with software engineers, product managers, designers, and senior quality engineers.

This role is ideal for a quality engineer who enjoys both breadth and depth: someone comfortable moving between browser-based UI testing, backend API validation, and automation, and who wants to grow expertise across web and cloud technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Develop risk-based test strategies and execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for websites, web applications, content-management systems, APIs, and supporting cloud services.
  • Participate in requirements reviews and design discussions to clarify acceptance criteria, identify risks early, and improve product testability.
  • Build and maintain automated UI and API tests using Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript and frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent tools. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Validate backend APIs, service integrations, database behavior, and data integrity using API tools, code-based test frameworks, and SQL.
  • Investigate failures and isolate root causes using browser developer tools, network traces, application logs, system telemetry, and database queries.
  • Perform release validation across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, including responsive UI, visual regression, functional, and end-to-end testing to ensure seamless product rollouts.
  • Conduct web performance, load, and accessibility testing, monitoring metrics like Core Web Vitals and ensuring compliance with WCAG guidelines.
  • Produce clear test reports, defect analyses, and go/no-go risk assessments to support release decisions.
  • Advocate for QA best practices, test-code quality, and continuous improvement, using AI-assisted tools where appropriate to improve engineering productivity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of experience in software quality engineering, with significant experience testing web applications.
  • Solid understanding of software testing principles, test design techniques, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience testing web applications across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, using browser developer tools to inspect network requests, console errors, and page behavior.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated UI and API tests in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs with tools such as Postman or code-based test frameworks, and validating data using SQL.
  • Working knowledge of how websites are built and delivered, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTTP, redirects, caching, and content-management systems.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Jira or similar defect-tracking tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain quality risks and test results clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience owning quality for a web product, website migration, or CMS platform from planning through release.
  • Experience testing SEO elements, structured data (Schema.org), analytics and tag implementations, or localized content across many locales.
  • Experience testing AI or LLM-powered features such as chatbots, search, or recommendations, including approaches for evaluating non-deterministic output.
  • Experience with web performance and accessibility testing tools such as Lighthouse, WebPageTest, or axe.
  • Experience testing applications deployed on AWS or other public cloud platforms, or backend services built on microservices.
  • Familiarity with visual regression testing tools such as Percy, Applitools, or Chromatic.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted testing solutions to improve testing efficiency and engineering productivity.
  • Experience with networking products, smart home technologies, connected device ecosystems, or e-commerce websites.

Why Join TP-Link

  • Shape the quality of TP-Link’s global websites and web experiences, used by customers in over 170 countries.
  • Work across web and cloud technologies, from browser-based applications to the APIs and services behind them.
  • Help define how the team tests emerging AI-powered features such as conversational assistants and intelligent search.
  • Build scalable automation using modern frameworks and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Collaborate with talented engineering, product, and design teams across global locations.
  • Grow your career with broad ownership and visible impact on TP-Link’s next generation of web and cloud experiences.

TP-Link is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive.

Benefits

Salary Range:

$100,000 - 130,000

Benefits:

  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial coverage for dependents)
  • Contributions to 401k funds
  • Over four weeks of PTO per year
  • Bi-annual pay increases
  • Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership
  • Quarterly team-building events

At TP-Link Systems Inc., we are continually searching for ambitious individuals who are passionate about their work. We believe that diversity fuels innovation, collaboration, and drives our entrepreneurial spirit. As a global company, we highly value diverse perspectives and are committed to cultivating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Beyond compliance, we strive to create a supportive and growth-oriented workplace for everyone. If you share our passion and connection to this mission, we welcome you to apply and join us in building a vibrant and inclusive team at TP-Link Systems Inc.

Please, no third-party agency inquiries, and we are unable to offer visa sponsorships at this time.

descriptionHtml:
Company

Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

The Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis is seeking an experienced Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer to design, develop, and implement automated testing solutions for a cutting-edge, cloud-based big data analytics platform. You will report to a Manager and be a part of an agile product team responsible for testing cloud-native big data processing capabilities to help reduce improper payments as part of an AWS-based application. You also will work with engineers, data scientists, write database queries, perform end to end testing, and analyze data. Relocation incentives are available. This position will work onsite in the 8th District and work out of our St. Louis, MO office. There is the potential to work from the Kansas City, Cleveland, Dallas, or Richmond Federal Reserve Bank office.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain test automation frameworks and test scripts for cloud-based applications using industry standard experience, and troubleshoot complex data, using capabilities such as python, lambda, Glue, Redshift, EMR, SageMaker and related AWS data processing visualization services.
  • Create comprehensive test plans and strategies to validate cloud infrastructure, services, complex data, and applications across multiple environments.
  • Monitor and analyze test results to identify patterns and areas for improvement in both product and testing methodologies.
  • Create reusable test data, test artifacts, and participate in scrum ceremonies for planning and estimation.
  • Develop and execute requirement validation, integration, regression, API, performance and usability testing. Perform load, performance, and scalability testing of cloud applications for baseline and to identify enhancements based on results.
  • Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot issues, validate fixes, and ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Provide technical thought leadership and collaborate with quality assurance team members, developers, data engineers, architects, operations, and data scientists on multiple projects to ensure quality of applications and services.
  • Perform other team contributions, such as peer test script reviews, defect remediation, and status tracking to ensure features meet requirements.
  • Leverage skills to identify and enhance testing processes. Mentor quality assurance peers for continuous improvement of testing processes and cloud native test capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree with a major or specialized courses in Information Technology or commensurate experience.
  • 5+ years proven experience with a combination of the following:
    • Write/analyze complex data queries and automation scripts for testing
    • Relational SQL databases, especially Redshift
    • Proficient experience with Java, Selenium, Python, Jupyter Lab, and respective tools and technology, such as Jira and Xray
    • Experience independently creating large sets of test data in various file and data formats
    • AWS cloud services: EC2, S3, RDS, Redshift, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, SageMaker, Config, Security Hub, Inspector
    • Proficient with performance testing and API testing tools like Postman and Gatling
    • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools
    • Knowledge of security testing methodologies for cloud environments is preferred
  • Candidates with less experience may be considered at a lower job grade or salary.
  • Position requires US Citizen

Total Rewards

Bring your passion and expertise, and we'll provide the opportunities to challenge you and propel your growth—along with multiple benefits and perks that support your health, wealth, and life.

Salary: 110,000 – 145,000

In addition to competitive compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package all brought together in a flexible work environment where you can find balance:

  • Medical (4 options), Prescription, Dental (3 options), and Vision Insurance with no waiting period
  • 401k/Thrift Plan with generous employer match
  • Employer-funded Pension Plan
  • Paid Vacation/Sick Time and Holidays
  • Flexible Spending Accounts and Healthcare Spending Accounts
  • Life Insurance and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Tuition Reimbursement (undergraduate and graduate)
  • Parental Leave
  • Free onsite 24/7 Fitness Center including training classes, and locker room / shower facilities
  • Onsite Coffee Shop
  • Additional Convenience Benefits, Discounts and More…

At the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, we are committed to a strong and resilient economy for all. We prioritize inclusion and strive to be a workplace where all employees can thrive. Learn more about Bank's culture.

descriptionHtml:
Join us at Sparksoft, where we're not just another tech company—we're a catalyst for change. Our mission isn't just to offer IT solutions; it's to revolutionize the way you work. Here, passion isn't just a buzzword; it's the fuel behind groundbreaking ideas and transformative technologies. We serve a wide range of government clients, delivering impact that's felt across the nation.

Our true strength lies in our people. They're the problem-solvers and innovators consistently delivering extraordinary outcomes. With Sparksoft, you're not stepping into a routine job; you're joining a team committed to innovation and excellence. Our innovation extends beyond just delivering projects. Through our specialized Innovation Centers, we continuously refine our methods, ensuring we remain industry leaders.

We are Sparksoft!

Leads the design, development, and continuous improvement of scalable test-automation frameworks for complex backend applications, APIs, transactional databases, and data integrations. Defines automation standards and quality gates, develops risk-based test strategies, reviews automation code, analyzes quality metrics, leads complex defect investigations, and provides technical direction and mentoring to SDETs and delivery teams.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the design and evolution of enterprise test-automation frameworks.
  • Define automation architecture, coding standards, reusable components, and quality gates.
  • Design, develop, code, test, and debug automated software testing systems and harnesses.
  • Develop and maintain automated test suites targeting SQL programmability (stored procedures, functions, triggers) and backend/transactional database systems.
  • Integrate and execute automated test suites within Azure DevOps (or TFS) CI/CD pipelines.
  • Perform engineering evaluation, ad-hoc and structured software testing, statistical analysis/modeling, data warehousing, and analytics as needed.
  • Work with users and stakeholders to define system scope, objectives, and test requirements.
  • Provide analytical support and technical advice during conceptualization, development, and implementation phases.
  • Plan and schedule testing/automation project tasks with users, systems software, and operations personnel, including objectives, time frames, costs, and manpower requirements.
  • Identify and document software/system hazards using established analysis tools and techniques.
  • Review and evaluate systems and software for adherence to government and commercial directives, standards, guidelines, and criteria concerning software and systems safety.
  • Confirm design mitigations are captured in design documentation and verify their implementation.
  • Maintain configuration management procedures for test assets and automation harnesses.
  • Coordinate testing across development, data, DevSecOps, security, and business teams.
  • Mentor junior personnel and lead root-cause analysis of complex defects.
  • May serve as project lead, instructing, assigning, directing, and monitoring the performance of assigned systems developers/analysts.
  • Experience developing automated tests using programming or scripting languages such as Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript and tools or frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, REST Assured, Postman/Newman, pytest, JUnit, NUnit, or equivalent.
  • Support corporate initiatives, knowledge-sharing activities, continuous improvement efforts, and business-growth opportunities beyond assigned project responsibilities

REQUIRED EXPEREINCE:

  • U.S. Citizenship is required for this position to meet federal government contractual requirements.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience supporting software quality assurance, quality engineering, software testing, or test automation.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience developing and maintaining automated test frameworks.
  • Expert level experience with SQL using relational databases such as SQL Server
  • Experience testing cloud-based applications and data platforms.
  • Experience with API, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing.
  • Experience validating complex data transformations and data integration pipelines.
  • Experience working within Agile development environments.
  • Experience with defect management and requirements traceability tools.
  • Experience supporting CI/CD and automated testing processes.
  • Experience developing automated tests using programming or scripting languages such as Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript and tools or frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, REST Assured, Postman/Newman, pytest, JUnit, NUnit, or equivalent.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Must have lived in the United States 3 out of the past 5 years.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience supporting CMS, HHS, or other federal healthcare programs.
  • Experience analyzing complex relational and dimensional data models.
  • Experience testing ETL/ELT processes, data migrations, and large-scale data integrations.
  • Experience optimizing automated test suites, execution time, coverage, and maintainability.
  • Experience with Section 508/accessibility, performance, security, or resilience testing.
  • Familiarity with federal security, privacy, and system-authorization requirements.
  • Relevant certifications in software testing, Agile, cloud, or DevSecOps technologies.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; an associate degree with two additional years of relevant experience; or a high school diploma/GED with four additional years of relevant experience.

WHAT WE OFFER:

At Sparksoft, we know that people do their best work when they feel supported, inspired, and connected. That’s why we’ve built a workplace that balances comprehensive benefits with a culture of collaboration and innovation. From flexible time off to professional growth opportunities, we’re committed to helping you thrive both inside and outside of work. When you join Sparksoft, you’ll enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation and a 401(k) with employer contributions to help you plan for the future
  • Flexible paid time off and hybrid ways of working that support true work-life balance
  • Comprehensive health coverage—including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • A curated in-office experience designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back through Sparksoft Cares, including annual company-wide fundraising events
  • Training and development programs that build new skills and prepare you for leadership roles
  • A collaborative, transparent, and fun culture—recognized as a Great Place to Work®

Accessibility and Accommodations: Sparksoft Corporation is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at Sparksoft.Accommodations@sparksoftcorp.com or call 410-424-7700. Requests are reviewed and fulfilled on a case-by-case basis.

Security Notice: Your privacy and data security are important to us. Sparksoft Corporation will never request sensitive personal information via email. If you receive any suspicious communication claiming to be from Sparksoft, please report it immediately to our security team at abuse@sparksoftcorp.com.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) Policy: While Sparksoft values the appropriate use of artificial intelligence in the workplace, candidates must complete interviews and independent assessments using their own knowledge and abilities. Unless expressly permitted by Sparksoft, the use of AI during interviews and assessments is strictly prohibited. Violations may result in disqualification. Please contact your recruiter regarding accommodation needs.

Sr Software Development Engineer in Test, ML

Locations: Madison, WI and Waterloo, Ontario Canada

PlayStation is seeking a Sr Software Development Engineer in Test, ML to join our Madison team and lead quality efforts for machine learning-powered products and services. You will partner closely with ML engineers, software engineers, product managers, and data partners to build scalable test automation and validation approaches for systems serving PlayStation at global scale. This role is focused on building confidence in model reliability, production readiness, and behavioral consistency. Unlike traditional software backend testing, success here requires validating probabilistic systems through score distributions, cohort-level behavior, thresholds, and statistical signals, not just deterministic pass/fail assertions.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive architecture-level automation solutions and scalable quality engineering practices across multiple teams and product areas.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks, test scripts for ML inference services and related ML platform components using python/Java
  • Build and automate realistic, representative test account creations and datasets to evaluate model behavior across different scenarios
  • Validate score distributions, ranking behavior, output quality, and other model signals for incoming ML models prior to release
  • Perform different types of testing, including functional, integration, regression and API testing working with RESTful APIs, microservices and databases, and non-functional performance and load testing to verify inference service scalability, latency requirements and reliability under production like conditions
  • Work closely with ML engineers and ops teams to ensure that all features and bug fixes come with automated test coverage, ensuring continuous integration and deployment
  • Debug and analyze test failures, model anomalies and report defects
  • Drive high standards of quality for both engineering decisions and customer-facing features with optimal test and automation strategy
  • Develop and implement best practices for test automation that is highly scalable and maintainable
  • Monitor test execution and optimize performance in test environments
  • Come up with innovative solutions to organizational problems

Required Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as an SDET, with strong experience testing backend systems.
  • Proficiency in Python/Java/Scala/go for test automation.
  • Hands-on experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman or similar) for distributed systems
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and test execution in Jenkins or similar environments such as jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, etc
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks (e.g., pytest, JUnit, TestNG, etc.)Experience in working with databases for backend validation.
  • Experience with cloud and container technologies (AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, etc.)
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, etc.) for validating service health
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and excellent communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience testing machine learning systems, such as recommendation systems, search ranking systems, or other probabilistic ML application systems.
  • Experience creating synthetic or seeded test data to simulate realistic customer/account behaviors.
  • Experience evaluating model outputs using statistical techniques, distribution analysis, or scenario-based validation, rather than deterministic assertions.
  • Knowledge of data pipelines, feature stores, inference systems or model-serving infrastructure (Seldon, KServe, Ray Serve, etc.) is a plus.
  • Experience with performance and load testing tools
  • Experience with Databricks or similar ML platform tooling
  • Experience architecting and optimizing CI/CD pipelines, quality gates, and release validation systems using Jenkins or similar platforms.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

descriptionHtml:
Key Responsibilities - Test Automation & Quality

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test coverage for ActiveScale object storage features across S3, data-path, durability, and data-movement functionality.
  • Develop component, integration, system, regression, and failure-injection tests that validate correctness and reliability at scale.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI pipelines and improve test reliability, execution time, diagnostics, and reporting.
  • Own the team's automated test strategy and work with developers to define coverage and acceptance criteria early in the development cycle.
  • Investigate failures, reproduce complex issues, and help isolate defects across distributed system components.

Object Storage & Resilience Testing

  • Validate S3 API behavior, compatibility, error handling, and data integrity using AWS S3 SDKs, tools, and automated test frameworks.
  • Develop automated coverage for failure scenarios such as node loss, disk faults, partial writes, network disruption, and recovery.
  • Test data placement, erasure coding, tiering, and movement of data across NVMe, HDD, and tape where applicable.
  • Contribute to performance, scalability, and long-running reliability testing of the I/O pipeline.

Engineering

  • Write clean, maintainable automation code and build reusable test infrastructure that supports functional, resilience, and failure testing.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, defect triage, and release readiness activities.
  • Partner closely with developers and the Software Engineering Manager / Product Owner to identify quality risks and ensure appropriate coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software quality engineering, test automation, or software development experience, with strong programming or scripting skills in Python, Go, C/C++, or similar languages.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining automated tests for complex software systems.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools to create, extend, debug, or maintain test automation, with the ability to critically review generated code and test results.
  • Solid Linux fundamentals, including debugging, log analysis, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience testing APIs and distributed or networked systems.
  • Understanding of concurrency, failure handling, and data integrity concepts.
  • Experience with CI systems and source control.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work effectively with developers and remote colleagues.
  • This is a hybrid role, with in-office work at our Centennial, CO office Tuesday through Thursday.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with object storage and the Amazon S3 API, SDKs, and tools.
  • Experience testing storage systems or storage media such as HDD, SSD, NVMe, or tape.
  • Experience with failure injection, resiliency testing, performance testing, or large-scale system testing.
  • Knowledge of erasure coding principles.

Quantum offers a company-matched 401(k) plan to help employees save for retirement in a tax-advantaged way. We also have an Employee Stock Purchase Program for purchasing Quantum stock at a discounted rate.

Anticipated Salary Range: $110,000 to $150,000 for qualified applicants.

The above pay range represents Quantum's good faith and reasonable estimate of possible compensation at the time of posting. Pay within the range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, relevant experience, knowledge/education, skills/abilities, internal equity, and budgetary considerations.

descriptionHtml:
About Prudentia Sciences

Prudentia Sciences is an AI-powered technology platform transforming how biopharma, biotech, and life sciences investors approach portfolio management, due diligence, and value/risk simulation. Our platform accelerates investment in breakthrough therapies by:

  • Empowering biopharma to accelerate drug pipelines, maximize ROI, and achieve clinical and commercial success for greater patient impact
  • Enabling strategic positioning of asset value during portfolio planning and dealmaking
  • Equipping investors with data-driven insights to optimize capital allocation in drug asset transactions

Backed by GV (Google Ventures), McKesson, Signal Fire, Iaso Ventures, and Virtue, we're on a mission to unlock the full potential of pharmaceutical R&D by empowering decision-makers with real-time, data-driven insights.

The Opportunity

We’re hiring our first dedicated QA Engineer: a hands-on engineer who writes code, builds quality into our platform from the ground up, and cares as much about performance and reliability as about correctness.

This is a rare opportunity to join a high-impact technology company in a major growth stage, where you’ll partner closely with engineering, product, and ML teams to safeguard the trust our pharma and biopharma customers place in our platform. Our platform is quickly seeing exceptional demand in its sector, and is backed by top-tier life science investors who have an informed perspective on where AI can have a profound impact in the industry.

What You’ll Do

  • Test Automation: Design, build, and maintain automated test suites across UI, API, and data pipelines, with most coverage at the API and data layers, so the team can ship fast and with confidence as the platform scales.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Use AI coding tools (like Claude Code) daily to build and maintain tests, and know when to question their output. You understand why the code works, not just that it runs, and you keep sensitive data out of AI tools.
  • Quality Gates in CI/CD: Own the automated quality gates in our CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), deciding what blocks a release and what doesn’t. Be ruthless about eliminating flaky or long-running tests.
  • API & Contract Testing: Test at the API layer by default, and catch breaking changes between services before they reach production.
  • Performance & Reliability Testing: Own load, performance, and reliability testing so the platform meets the availability and responsiveness expectations of deal teams working with large volumes of sensitive, time-sensitive data.
  • Bug Tracking & Triage: Identify, document, and triage defects with clear reproduction steps, work with engineers to prioritize fixes, and make clear go/no-go release calls.
  • Data & Output Validation: Validate the accuracy and consistency of ML-driven outputs (risk analyses, valuations, scientific assessments) as they move from the orchestration layer into user-facing views.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Help verify secure handling of sensitive scientific and deal data, including keeping each customer’s data separate
  • Collaboration & Process: Work cross-functionally with engineers, product leads, and domain experts to translate scientific and business requirements into clear, testable acceptance criteria.
  • Continuous Improvement: Champion a quality-first culture: advocate for testability in design reviews, improve test coverage over time, and stay current on modern QA tooling and practices.

Who You Are

Core Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • QA Experience: Proven experience testing modern web applications and designing and building automated test suites, ideally as the person who owned them.
  • Test Automation Tools: Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and API testing tools (e.g., pytest, REST-assured, pactflow).
  • CI/CD Integration: Experience owning automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), including setting up quality gates and managing flaky tests.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in your daily work, with a habit of verifying what they produce.
  • Performance Testing: Experience designing load or performance tests and finding real bottlenecks.
  • Technical Fluency: Comfort reading code and working directly with engineers to understand system architecture, APIs, and data flows well enough to design meaningful tests.
  • Data-Driven Applications: Experience testing applications with complex, data-driven workflows.
  • Bug Tracking & Communication: Skilled at writing clear, reproducible bug reports and explaining quality risks and release readiness to the team.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Familiarity with best practices for secure data handling and testing in regulated or sensitive-data environments
  • Collaboration & Product Mindset: Strong communication and collaboration skills; ability to work closely with engineers, product managers, and scientific domain experts to deliver a high-quality user experience.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Your work directly enables breakthrough therapies to reach patients faster
  • Ownership: Build and lead the platform as a foundational engineering leader
  • Growth: Shape our product experience during a critical scaling phase
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and equity
  • Team: Collaborative, mission-driven colleagues passionate about transforming biopharma

Location

We are prioritizing candidates who can be flexibly hybrid twice per week (Tues/Thurs) from our Boston, NYC, or San Francisco office. If we find truly exceptional talent, we may consider fully remote in the United States.

Compensation Range: $120K - $145K

The Sr. Automation Engineer is responsible for implementing and maintaining automated UI and API testing frameworks and scenarios. This role will work closely with Automation Architects, Sr. Quality Engineers, other QA Engineers and Developers to ensure that all aspects of the applications have proper testing coverage and overall system reliability, performance and quality.

Deliver effective and efficient technical solutions by meeting key project milestones and overall project deliverables on-time and adhering to development and quality standards. Create, review and approve test plans, scenarios, scripts or procedures that contribute to the overall testing framework. Collaborate and interact with other application teams for integration testing efforts.

  • Accountable for developing and the effective and timely completion of UI and API automation test activities performed on multiple projects, including driving tasks and milestones to complete within the timeframes of a well-defined project plan and/or sprint that includes planning, design, build and execution tasks, while providing guidance to resolve problems as issues arise.

  • Experienced with C#, Java, .NET, SQL or other software languages.
  • Experienced with both UI and Rest API automation.
  • Experienced with Object-Oriented Design and Patterns.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and time management skills.
  • Experienced in working with AGILE, DevOps CI/CD process administration methodology.

AI & Advanced QE Capabilities (Must Have)

  • Ability to create and work with AI agents for testing/automation
  • Use AI tools (Copilot etc.) for test generation, script creation, and debugging
  • Validate and test AI-generated code and outputs
  • Understand prompting and AI guardrails

Selective Insurance offers a total rewards package that includes a competitive base salary, incentive plan eligibility at all levels, and a wide array of benefits designed to help you and your family stay healthy, achieve your financial goals, and balance the demands of your work and personal life. These benefits include comprehensive health care plans, retirement savings plan with company match, discounted Employee Stock Purchase Program, tuition assistance and reimbursement programs, and 20 days of paid time off. Additional details about our total rewards package can be found by visiting our benefits page.

The actual base salary is based on geographic location, and the range is representative of salaries for this role throughout Selective's footprint. Additional considerations include relevant education, qualifications, experience, skills, performance, and business needs.

Pay Range

USD $101,000.00 - USD $137,000.00 /Yr.

Additional Information

Selective is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. That means we respect and value every individual’s unique opinions, beliefs, abilities, and perspectives. We are committed to promoting a welcoming culture that celebrates diverse talent, individual identity, different points of view and experiences – and empowers employees to contribute new ideas that support our continued and growing success. Building a highly engaged team is one of our core strategic imperatives, which we believe is enhanced by diversity, equity, and inclusion. We expect and encourage all employees and all of our business partners to embrace, practice, and monitor the attitudes, values, and goals of acceptance; address biases; and foster diversity of viewpoints and opinions.

For Massachusetts Applicants

About The Role

Total Wine & More is seeking a Senior QA Engineer, to join our Tecnology team in our Bethesda, MD office to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our digital platforms. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain automated tests across web, mobile, and API layers to support scalable, high-quality software delivery. You will collaborate closely with engineers, fellow QA team members, and platform engineering teams to integrate automation early in the development lifecycle, enhance CI/CD pipelines, and continuously improve test coverage. The ideal candidate brings strong test automation skills, a solid understanding of modern development practices, and a commitment to driving quality throughout the engineering process. You will report to the Sr. Director, Engineering.

You will

  • Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and product managers to understand features, acceptance criteria, and test scope.
  • Write and maintain test plans, test cases, and test scripts for manual and automated testing.
  • Develop and execute automated tests using modern frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for web applications and Postman / REST Assured for API testing.
  • Participate in code reviews for test scripts and automation frameworks to ensure maintainability and consistency.
  • Contribute to CI/CD integration by automating smoke, regression, and functional tests within pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps).
  • Log, track, and verify defects using tools such as Jira, Zephyr, or TestRail; work with developers to validate fixes.
  • Contribute to test data setup and mocking/stubbing as needed for reliable automation.
  • Support non-functional testing such as performance, accessibility (a11y), or security in collaboration with senior engineers.

You will come with

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field required or equivalent years of experience.
  • 3-6 years experience in software testing or test automation.
  • Hands-on experience building and running automated UI and API tests using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Postman.
  • Working knowledge of at least one modern programming language (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or Java).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) for automation execution and reporting.
  • Good understanding of QA fundamentals, including functional, regression, and integration testing.
  • Exposure to BDD frameworks such as Cucumber, SpecFlow, or Gauge is a plus.
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs, JSON structures, and basic API validation principles.
  • Experience using Git for version control and collaboration.
  • Ability to debug issues across environments and communicate findings clearly.
  • Strong attention to detail, ownership, and curiosity to learn new automation techniques.
  • Familiarity with microservices testing, mock servers, or contract testing.
  • Awareness of performance testing tools (k6, JMeter) or accessibility testing (axe-core, Lighthouse).
  • Interest in AI-assisted testing or intelligent test optimization tools.

We offer

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Generous store discounts
  • Health care plans (medical, prescription, dental, vision)
  • 401(k), HSA, FSA, Pre-tax commuter benefits
  • Disability & life insurance coverage
  • Paid parental leave
  • Pet insurance
  • Critical illness and accident insurance
  • Discounted home and auto insurance
  • College tuition assistance
  • Career development & product training
  • Consumer classes
  • & More!

Crafted for you

We recognize our team members are our biggest asset, and we value the critical role each play in contributing to the company’s success. It is our commitment to support and provide access to the resources needed to take care of their health and wellbeing. That is why we offer a variety of benefits, tools, and resources to support through our Total Rewards program. To view our full career page, click here: https://careers.totalwine.com/!

Total Wine & More considers several factors when establishing compensation. Compensation may vary based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, market location, job-related knowledge, skills and/or experience. The actual hourly rate will equal or exceed the required minimum wage applicable to the job location. Estimated salaries determined by third parties have not been validated by Total Wine & More.

Total Wine & More is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Total Wine & More makes reasonable accommodations during all aspects of the employment process, including during the interview process. Total Wine & More is a Drug Free Workplace.

The information provided above indicates the general nature and level of work required of the position and is not a comprehensive list of all responsibilities or qualifications. Benefits list is only a highlight of some of the benefits offered to team members; eligibility for certain benefits apply. The anticipated close date of this posting is 120 days from the posted date indicated above.
