descriptionHtml:
Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking a Senior Quality Automation Specialist, AVP, with 8+ years of intensive, hands-on automation engineering experience and a proven track record of designing, building, scaling, and maintaining enterprise-grade automation solutions. This is a specialist engineering role focused exclusively on automation delivery along with coordination activities.

The candidate must demonstrate deep expertise across Selenium, Tricentis Tosca, API and service automation, SoapUI/RestAssured, CI/CD-integrated execution, Service Virtualization, AWS, and AI-assisted automation engineering. Strong Banking and Payments domain experience is mandatory, including the ability to convert complex transaction workflows and operational controls into resilient automated validation solutions.

The role requires substantial on-ground automation development in addition to coordinating automation/functional work delivered by the India team. The successful candidate will work closely with the SQA team and the lead located in India while aligning automation backlogs, dependencies, technical standards, execution progress, and delivery outcomes.

Why this role is important to us

Automation is critical to improving release speed, repeatability, platform resilience, and engineering productivity across business-critical Banking and Payments applications. This role will strengthen scalable UI, API, service, data, and intelligent automation capabilities while reducing repetitive validation effort through reusable frameworks, CI/CD execution, and AI-enabled engineering practices.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Intensive Automation Engineering

  • Design, develop, debug, and maintain scalable enterprise automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, API, Service Virtualization and Tricentis Tosca.
  • Build robust, reusable automated solutions for complex web, service, API, data, and end-to-end Banking and Payments workflows.
  • Write high-quality automation code and reusable libraries using Java and/or Python, applying object-oriented design, clean-code principles, exception handling, logging, and configuration management.
  • Develop page-object, data-driven, keyword-driven, modular, and hybrid framework components appropriate to application architecture and delivery needs.
  • Engineer stable automated suites with effective waits, synchronization, reusable locators, recovery logic, parallel execution, cross-browser execution, and environment-independent configuration.
  • Diagnose flaky automation, execution failures, framework bottlenecks, and test-data dependencies, and implement permanent engineering solutions.
  • Maintain automation assets through application and service changes while continuously improving execution speed, stability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • 90% responsible for performing hands-on automation scripting, code review participation, technical troubleshooting, test-data setup, execution analysis, and evidence generation on a regular basis.


API and Service Automation

  • Design and implement comprehensive REST and SOAP API automation using SoapUI, ReadyAPI, REST Assured, Postman, Newman, Karate, and equivalent enterprise-approved tools.
  • Create automated coverage for request and response payloads, schemas, headers, authentication, authorization, status codes, error handling, business rules, and service-level data integrity.
  • Automate API workflows using OAuth 2.0, JWT, API keys, certificates, session tokens, and other applicable enterprise authentication mechanisms.
  • Develop reusable API clients, service-object layers, payload builders, assertion libraries, environment configurations, and automated data setup and cleanup utilities.
  • Implement contract and schema validation using OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, JSON Schema, XML Schema, and consumer-driven contract approaches such as Pact where applicable.
  • Automate chained and stateful service workflows, asynchronous processing, callbacks, queues, batch interfaces, file-based services, and upstream/downstream dependencies.
  • Use service virtualization and mocking tools such as WireMock or equivalent solutions to automate testing when dependent services are unavailable or constrained.
  • Develop automated API performance and reliability checks using JMeter or equivalent tools where appropriate to the engineering scope.
  • Integrate API suites with Maven or Gradle builds, source control, reporting solutions, and CI/CD pipelines for unattended and parallel execution.


Tricentis Tosca Automation

  • Design and maintain Tosca modules, reusable test-step blocks, templates, test data, execution lists, recovery scenarios, and distributed execution configurations.
  • Apply Tosca model-based automation practices to complex web, API, and enterprise Banking workflows.
  • Optimize Tosca workspaces, reusable assets, synchronization, test-data management, and execution performance to support maintainable enterprise-scale automation.
  • Integrate Tosca automated execution with CI/CD pipelines and enterprise reporting mechanisms.


Selenium Automation

  • Develop and enhance Selenium automation frameworks using Java or Python with TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, Maven, or Gradle as applicable.
  • Implement reusable page objects, component libraries, utility layers, data providers, reporting, screenshot capture, retry controls, and parallel execution capabilities.
  • Integrate Selenium suites with Selenium Grid, cloud or enterprise browser infrastructure, source control, pipeline execution, and reporting tools.
  • Apply resilient locator strategies and synchronization techniques to modern dynamic web applications.


AI-Assisted Automation Engineering

  • Use approved AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, and enterprise AI assistants to accelerate automation code generation, refactoring, documentation, test-data creation, and maintenance.
  • Apply prompt-engineering and iterative-validation techniques to generate effective automation assets while ensuring all AI-generated content is technically reviewed, secure, explainable, and maintainable.
  • Use AI-assisted approaches to identify automation candidates, improve scenario coverage, analyze failures, detect flaky patterns, optimize scripts, and accelerate root-cause analysis.
  • Evaluate emerging AI-enabled automation capabilities and implement practical improvements that measurably increase automation productivity, coverage, stability, or execution speed.


CI/CD and Automation Operations

  • Integrate UI, API, service, and Tosca automation suites into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent enterprise platforms.
  • Configure scheduled, event-driven, pipeline-gated, parallel, and distributed automated execution across environments.
  • Implement automated reporting, logs, dashboards, failure classification, evidence capture, and quality gates for rapid and traceable execution analysis.
  • Manage automation configuration, secrets, dependencies, test data, environment parameters, and version-controlled assets in compliance with enterprise engineering standards.


Banking and Payments Automation

  • Apply deep Banking and Payments knowledge to automate account servicing, payment initiation, validation, authorization, transaction processing, approvals, entitlements, posting, settlement, reconciliation, returns, exceptions, and status-tracking workflows.
  • Translate complex Banking business rules, transaction lifecycles, operational controls, cut-off considerations, and data dependencies into reusable automated validation solutions.
  • Build automation for high-volume, high-risk, and business-critical payment scenarios, including positive, negative, boundary, error-path, and recovery conditions.
  • Validate automated outcomes across UI, API, service, message, file, and database layers without creating separate manual testing responsibilities.


India Automation Delivery Coordination

  • Coordinate the automation backlog, work allocation inputs, technical dependencies, execution schedules, and delivery tracking with the India-based SQA team and SQA Lead.
  • Facilitate technical alignment across automation engineers on common frameworks, coding standards, reusable components, tool usage, and CI/CD integration.
  • Consolidate automation progress, execution results, blockers, risks, and dependency updates for relevant stakeholders.
  • Support effective handoffs and collaboration across time zones while remaining directly accountable for substantial hands-on automation engineering deliverables.
  • This coordination is on ground hands on delivery-focused


What We Value

Mandatory Technical Expertise

  • 8+ years of intensive hands-on test automation engineering experience, supported by a proven track record of delivering and maintaining enterprise automation solutions.
  • Advanced hands-on expertise in Selenium WebDriver and strong experience building Java based automation frameworks along with Service Virtualization skills.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Tricentis Tosca, including model-based automation, reusable modules, test-data management, recovery scenarios, and distributed execution.
  • Advanced API and service automation experience using multiple tools and frameworks, including SoapUI, ReadyAPI, REST Assured, Postman, Newman, Karate, and equivalent technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of REST, SOAP, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, XML, OpenAPI/Swagger, schemas, authentication, service virtualization, mocking, and database validation.
  • Strong experience with automation-oriented tools and libraries such as TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, Maven, Gradle, Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Selenium Grid, WireMock, Pact, JMeter, and reporting frameworks.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and operating unattended, parallel, scheduled, and distributed execution.
  • Demonstrated use of AI-assisted engineering tools to create, enhance, refactor, debug, and maintain automated solutions.
  • Strong SQL knowledge for automated data setup, validation, reconciliation, and cleanup.
  • Strong debugging, coding, framework-design, execution-analysis, and problem-solving capabilities.


Mandatory Banking and Payments Expertise

  • Deep practical knowledge and experience in Banking and Payments is mandatory.
  • Strong understanding of payment and transaction lifecycles, account servicing, entitlements, approvals, posting, settlement, reconciliation, returns, exceptions, and operational controls.
  • Proven ability to convert complex Banking and Payments requirements into executable automation architecture, reusable scenarios, and reliable validations.


Professional Competencies

  • Automation-first, engineering-focused mindset with strong ownership of hands-on technical deliverables.
  • Ability to independently design solutions, write automation code, troubleshoot complex failures, and complete deliverables with minimal supervision.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills for working closely with the India-based SQA team, SQA Lead, developers, product partners, and globally distributed stakeholders.
  • Strong focus on measurable automation outcomes, including coverage, reliability, maintainability, execution speed, and reduction of repetitive effort.


Education And Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
  • 8+ years of relevant automation engineering experience in enterprise application environments.
  • Proven delivery experience across Selenium, Tricentis Tosca, API/service automation, SoapUI/ReadyAPI, CI/CD, and AI-assisted automation.
  • Strong Banking and Payments domain experience is mandatory; experience in regulated financial-services environments is preferred.
  • Relevant Tricentis Tosca, Selenium, API automation, cloud, DevOps, or AI certifications are advantageous.


What Success Looks Like

  • Deliver stable, scalable, and maintainable automation solutions across UI, API, service, data, and Banking and Payments workflows.
  • Expand automation coverage and reduce execution time and repetitive effort through reusable frameworks and CI/CD-integrated automation.
  • Improve automation reliability by reducing flaky execution, strengthening failure diagnostics, and resolving framework or environment bottlenecks.
  • Demonstrate measurable productivity gains through responsible adoption of AI-assisted automation engineering.
  • Ensure effective coordination and predictable delivery of India-based automation work while maintaining strong personal hands-on contribution.


Additional Requirements

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document automation architecture, execution results, technical issues, and delivery status.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with the India-based SQA organization and globally distributed technology partners.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage concurrent automation priorities, dependencies, and technical deliverables.
  • Comfortable working in a release-driven, high-visibility environment with a strong focus on automation outcomes.
  • Self-starter mindset with the ability to ramp up quickly and contribute through hands-on automation development with minimal supervision.


Work Requirement

  • 4 days in office, Hybrid
  • Core collaboration hours align with U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Occasional flexibility may be required to support globally distributed teams.

$90,000 - $157,500 Annual

Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking a Senior Quality Automation Specialist, AVP, with 8+ years of intensive, hands-on automation engineering experience and a proven track record of designing, building, scaling, and maintaining enterprise-grade automation solutions. This is a specialist engineering role focused exclusively on automation delivery along with coordination activities.

The candidate must demonstrate deep expertise across Selenium, Tricentis Tosca, API and service automation, SoapUI/RestAssured, CI/CD-integrated execution, Service Virtualization, AWS, and AI-assisted automation engineering. Strong Banking and Payments domain experience is mandatory, including the ability to convert complex transaction workflows and operational controls into resilient automated validation solutions.

The role requires substantial on-ground automation development in addition to coordinating automation/functional work delivered by the India team. The successful candidate will work closely with the SQA team and the lead located in India while aligning automation backlogs, dependencies, technical standards, execution progress, and delivery outcomes.

Why this role is important to us

Automation is critical to improving release speed, repeatability, platform resilience, and engineering productivity across business-critical Banking and Payments applications. This role will strengthen scalable UI, API, service, data, and intelligent automation capabilities while reducing repetitive validation effort through reusable frameworks, CI/CD execution, and AI-enabled engineering practices.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Intensive Automation Engineering



- Design, develop, debug, and maintain scalable enterprise automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, API, Service Virtualization and Tricentis Tosca.
- Build robust, reusable automated solutions for complex web, service, API, data, and end-to-end Banking and Payments workflows.
- Write high-quality automation code and reusable libraries using Java and/or Python, applying object-oriented design, clean-code principles, exception handling, logging, and configuration management.
- Develop page-object, data-driven, keyword-driven, modular, and hybrid framework components appropriate to application architecture and delivery needs.
- Engineer stable automated suites with effective waits, synchronization, reusable locators, recovery logic, parallel execution, cross-browser execution, and environment-independent configuration.
- Diagnose flaky automation, execution failures, framework bottlenecks, and test-data dependencies, and implement permanent engineering solutions.
- Maintain automation assets through application and service changes while continuously improving execution speed, stability, scalability, and maintainability.
- 90% responsible for performing hands-on automation scripting, code review participation, technical troubleshooting, test-data setup, execution analysis, and evidence generation on a regular basis.


API and Service Automation



- Design and implement comprehensive REST and SOAP API automation using SoapUI, ReadyAPI, REST Assured, Postman, Newman, Karate, and equivalent enterprise-approved tools.
- Create automated coverage for request and response payloads, schemas, headers, authentication, authorization, status codes, error handling, business rules, and service-level data integrity.
- Automate API workflows using OAuth 2.0, JWT, API keys, certificates, session tokens, and other applicable enterprise authentication mechanisms.
- Develop reusable API clients, service-object layers, payload builders, assertion libraries, environment configurations, and automated data setup and cleanup utilities.
- Implement contract and schema validation using OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, JSON Schema, XML Schema, and consumer-driven contract approaches such as Pact where applicable.
- Automate chained and stateful service workflows, asynchronous processing, callbacks, queues, batch interfaces, file-based services, and upstream/downstream dependencies.
- Use service virtualization and mocking tools such as WireMock or equivalent solutions to automate testing when dependent services are unavailable or constrained.
- Develop automated API performance and reliability checks using JMeter or equivalent tools where appropriate to the engineering scope.
- Integrate API suites with Maven or Gradle builds, source control, reporting solutions, and CI/CD pipelines for unattended and parallel execution.


Tricentis Tosca Automation



- Design and maintain Tosca modules, reusable test-step blocks, templates, test data, execution lists, recovery scenarios, and distributed execution configurations.
- Apply Tosca model-based automation practices to complex web, API, and enterprise Banking workflows.
- Optimize Tosca workspaces, reusable assets, synchronization, test-data management, and execution performance to support maintainable enterprise-scale automation.
- Integrate Tosca automated execution with CI/CD pipelines and enterprise reporting mechanisms.


Selenium Automation



- Develop and enhance Selenium automation frameworks using Java or Python with TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, Maven, or Gradle as applicable.
- Implement reusable page objects, component libraries, utility layers, data providers, reporting, screenshot capture, retry controls, and parallel execution capabilities.
- Integrate Selenium suites with Selenium Grid, cloud or enterprise browser infrastructure, source control, pipeline execution, and reporting tools.
- Apply resilient locator strategies and synchronization techniques to modern dynamic web applications.


AI-Assisted Automation Engineering



- Use approved AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, and enterprise AI assistants to accelerate automation code generation, refactoring, documentation, test-data creation, and maintenance.
- Apply prompt-engineering and iterative-validation techniques to generate effective automation assets while ensuring all AI-generated content is technically reviewed, secure, explainable, and maintainable.
- Use AI-assisted approaches to identify automation candidates, improve scenario coverage, analyze failures, detect flaky patterns, optimize scripts, and accelerate root-cause analysis.
- Evaluate emerging AI-enabled automation capabilities and implement practical improvements that measurably increase automation productivity, coverage, stability, or execution speed.


CI/CD and Automation Operations



- Integrate UI, API, service, and Tosca automation suites into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent enterprise platforms.
- Configure scheduled, event-driven, pipeline-gated, parallel, and distributed automated execution across environments.
- Implement automated reporting, logs, dashboards, failure classification, evidence capture, and quality gates for rapid and traceable execution analysis.
- Manage automation configuration, secrets, dependencies, test data, environment parameters, and version-controlled assets in compliance with enterprise engineering standards.


Banking and Payments Automation



- Apply deep Banking and Payments knowledge to automate account servicing, payment initiation, validation, authorization, transaction processing, approvals, entitlements, posting, settlement, reconciliation, returns, exceptions, and status-tracking workflows.
- Translate complex Banking business rules, transaction lifecycles, operational controls, cut-off considerations, and data dependencies into reusable automated validation solutions.
- Build automation for high-volume, high-risk, and business-critical payment scenarios, including positive, negative, boundary, error-path, and recovery conditions.
- Validate automated outcomes across UI, API, service, message, file, and database layers without creating separate manual testing responsibilities.


India Automation Delivery Coordination



- Coordinate the automation backlog, work allocation inputs, technical dependencies, execution schedules, and delivery tracking with the India-based SQA team and SQA Lead.
- Facilitate technical alignment across automation engineers on common frameworks, coding standards, reusable components, tool usage, and CI/CD integration.
- Consolidate automation progress, execution results, blockers, risks, and dependency updates for relevant stakeholders.
- Support effective handoffs and collaboration across time zones while remaining directly accountable for substantial hands-on automation engineering deliverables.
- This coordination is on ground hands on delivery-focused


What We Value

Mandatory Technical Expertise



- 8+ years of intensive hands-on test automation engineering experience, supported by a proven track record of delivering and maintaining enterprise automation solutions.
- Advanced hands-on expertise in Selenium WebDriver and strong experience building Java based automation frameworks along with Service Virtualization skills.
- Strong hands-on expertise in Tricentis Tosca, including model-based automation, reusable modules, test-data management, recovery scenarios, and distributed execution.
- Advanced API and service automation experience using multiple tools and frameworks, including SoapUI, ReadyAPI, REST Assured, Postman, Newman, Karate, and equivalent technologies.
- Strong knowledge of REST, SOAP, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, XML, OpenAPI/Swagger, schemas, authentication, service virtualization, mocking, and database validation.
- Strong experience with automation-oriented tools and libraries such as TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, Maven, Gradle, Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Selenium Grid, WireMock, Pact, JMeter, and reporting frameworks.
- Demonstrated experience integrating automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and operating unattended, parallel, scheduled, and distributed execution.
- Demonstrated use of AI-assisted engineering tools to create, enhance, refactor, debug, and maintain automated solutions.
- Strong SQL knowledge for automated data setup, validation, reconciliation, and cleanup.
- Strong debugging, coding, framework-design, execution-analysis, and problem-solving capabilities.


Mandatory Banking and Payments Expertise



- Deep practical knowledge and experience in Banking and Payments is mandatory.
- Strong understanding of payment and transaction lifecycles, account servicing, entitlements, approvals, posting, settlement, reconciliation, returns, exceptions, and operational controls.
- Proven ability to convert complex Banking and Payments requirements into executable automation architecture, reusable scenarios, and reliable validations.


Professional Competencies



- Automation-first, engineering-focused mindset with strong ownership of hands-on technical deliverables.
- Ability to independently design solutions, write automation code, troubleshoot complex failures, and complete deliverables with minimal supervision.
- Strong communication and coordination skills for working closely with the India-based SQA team, SQA Lead, developers, product partners, and globally distributed stakeholders.
- Strong focus on measurable automation outcomes, including coverage, reliability, maintainability, execution speed, and reduction of repetitive effort.


Education And Preferred Qualifications



- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
- 8+ years of relevant automation engineering experience in enterprise application environments.
- Proven delivery experience across Selenium, Tricentis Tosca, API/service automation, SoapUI/ReadyAPI, CI/CD, and AI-assisted automation.
- Strong Banking and Payments domain experience is mandatory; experience in regulated financial-services environments is preferred.
- Relevant Tricentis Tosca, Selenium, API automation, cloud, DevOps, or AI certifications are advantageous.


What Success Looks Like



- Deliver stable, scalable, and maintainable automation solutions across UI, API, service, data, and Banking and Payments workflows.
- Expand automation coverage and reduce execution time and repetitive effort through reusable frameworks and CI/CD-integrated automation.
- Improve automation reliability by reducing flaky execution, strengthening failure diagnostics, and resolving framework or environment bottlenecks.
- Demonstrate measurable productivity gains through responsible adoption of AI-assisted automation engineering.
- Ensure effective coordination and predictable delivery of India-based automation work while maintaining strong personal hands-on contribution.


Additional Requirements



- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document automation architecture, execution results, technical issues, and delivery status.
- Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with the India-based SQA organization and globally distributed technology partners.
- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage concurrent automation priorities, dependencies, and technical deliverables.
- Comfortable working in a release-driven, high-visibility environment with a strong focus on automation outcomes.
- Self-starter mindset with the ability to ramp up quickly and contribute through hands-on automation development with minimal supervision.


Work Requirement



- 4 days in office, Hybrid
- Core collaboration hours align with U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Occasional flexibility may be required to support globally distributed teams.


Salary Range

$90,000 - $157,500 Annual

Become a part of something IMPACT-ful! Ground Missile Defense (GMD) is the heart of the Missile Defense System and a key element of our nation’s defense against ballistic missile attacks.

Lockheed Martin is a global aerospace, defense, and security company dedicated to advancing scientific discovery and harnessing innovation to make the world a safer place. Our RMS business in Huntsville, AL is a hub of talented engineers, scientists, and professionals committed to shaping the future of defense technology. Job Description

ECS is seeking a QA Automation Engineer to work remotely.

We are seeking a QA Automation Engineer with experience in end-to-end testing, test automation, performance testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to join the Professional Services team. This role will be responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive testing strategy across functional, integration, automation, performance, security, regression, and user acceptance testing activities.

The ideal candidate will have experience validating complex web applications, APIs, data platforms, and third-party integrations. This individual will work closely with engineering teams, technical leadership, and customer stakeholders to ensure solutions meet functional requirements, performance expectations, security controls, and release readiness criteria.

Candidates should have hands-on experience with automation frameworks and testing tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Python-based testing solutions, Jira, Confluence, and performance testing tools such as Locust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans covering functional, integration, end-to-end, performance, regression, and user acceptance testing.
  • Define test strategies, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and release readiness metrics in collaboration with project stakeholders.
  • Design, develop, and execute automated test suites for web applications, APIs, and integrated workflows.
  • Perform end-to-end testing across frontend applications, APIs, Databricks environments, and third-party platform integrations.
  • Validate integrations spanning web applications, backend services, data platforms, and external systems.
  • Execute functional testing across multiple user personas and business workflows.
  • Coordinate and facilitate multiple rounds of User Acceptance Testing (UAT), document findings, validate remediation efforts, and support final release approvals.
  • Design and execute performance and load testing using tools such as Locust, validating system behavior under concurrent user activity and identifying performance bottlenecks.
  • Perform regression testing to ensure software quality and system stability prior to production releases.
  • Validate role-based access controls, security requirements, governance controls, and data access restrictions.
  • Identify, document, classify, and track software defects through resolution.
  • Collaborate with engineers, TPMs, product owners, and customer stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Produce testing reports, quality metrics, defect summaries, and release recommendations.
  • Utilize Jira and Confluence to manage testing activities, document results, and track defects and remediation efforts.

Salary Range: $140,000-$165,000

General Description Of Benefits

Required Skills

  • Active Secret Clearance
  • Experience with UAT (User Acceptance Testing)
  • Strong background in Software Quality Assurance (SW QA)
  • Ability to translate business requirements into effective test cases
  • Experience identifying and documenting defects clearly and concisely
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Effective communication skills for cross‑team collaboration

Desired Skills

  • Active Secret Clearance.
  • Experience with end-to-end testing, software quality assurance, and test automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Selenium and/or Playwright for automated web application testing.
  • Experience developing automated test frameworks and automated regression test suites.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining automated testing pipelines.
  • Experience using Python-based testing tools, including performance and load testing solutions such as Locust.
  • Experience testing web applications, REST APIs, and distributed system integrations.
  • Experience testing applications deployed within secure cloud environments, including AWS GovCloud and IL5 environments.
  • Familiarity with Databricks, data engineering workflows, ETL pipelines, Delta Lake, and AI/ML-enabled platforms.
  • Experience validating integrations with external platforms and services, including data, analytics, and AI-related systems.
  • Experience testing React or other modern web application frameworks.
  • Familiarity with RBAC, data governance controls, compliance requirements, and secure application workflows.
  • Experience conducting performance, load, regression, functional, integration, and UAT testing.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments using Jira and Confluence.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience supporting production releases and formal release readiness activities.

  • 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  • Experience in event-driven microservices and REST API’s
  • Experience with network protocols, network programming, and distributed application debugging and analysis
  • Excellence in technical communication with peers and non-technical cohorts

Responsibilities

Job Description Hoplite Solutions is seeking Test Engineers at all levels to support our growing program. As a Test Engineer you will have the opportunity to design, develop, and execute automated tests to ensure the quality and eliability of software applications and services in a Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery Pipeline within a commercial cloud environment. You will play a crucial role in the software development lifecycle, aiming to streamline testing processes, reduce defects, and accelerate software releases. Hiring Multiple Levels for this position Primary Responsibilities:

  • Participate in program Agile software development initiatives (standup, planning, increment planning) to support innovation and enhancement of custom applications through iteration/functionality testing within a commercial cloud environment.
  • Participate and collaborate with team members to assess StoryPoint/complexity efforts (using best practices) to ensure proper testing and delivery of functionality per User Story Acceptance Criteria
  • Collaborate with team members (Scrum Master, Product Owner, Software Developers) to develop test approaches with emphasis on automation of recurring/regression test cases through selected toolsets
  • Develop automated test cases using knowledge of custom Applications through designated GUI/COTS products (ex: Selenium and Katalon Studio)
  • Leverage DevOps practices to ensure repeatability and Configuration Management of test cases/scripts are maintained and continuously improved
  • Develop and document end-to-end functionality test case narratives using task management system (JIRA/Confluence) and support performance testing/evaluation activities using tools such as Jmeter Required Skills Basic Qualifications:
  • Experience in software quality assurance with a significant focus on automation testing.
  • Experience with creation, authoring, execution and documentation of test cases/result sets for software products in an agile cadence
  • Hands-on experience in designing and implementing robust automation frameworks using tools like Selenium or Katalon Studio
  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Java or Python enabling the ability to write efficient and scalable test scripts.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub) and their integration with automated tests.
  • Direct experience with software performance testing practices
  • Experience working/testing within Commercial Cloud Platforms (ex: AWS) and DevOps tools, and working in a SAFe Agile and DevOps development environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work within collaborative environment to execute test cases complimentary to development efforts
  • BS degree with and 4-8 years of prior relevant experience or Master's 2-6 years of prior relevant experience. Will consider experience in lieu of a degree
  • Candidate must have an active TS/SCI with Polygraph Desired Skills Preferred Qualifications:
  • Hands-on experience with Katalon Studio and Katalon Runtime Engine
  • Direct experience with AWS environments

About Digital Harbor

Digital Harbor is a technology company developing innovative software products that transform how people communicate, collaborate, and create.


Our Business Media portfolio includes four products: Byte, Dot, Matee, and Yoodle. Each is designed to solve different challenges in modern communication and productivity.

We operate in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where engineers are encouraged to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and contribute directly to the quality and success of the products they help build.


About the Opportunity

Digital Harbor is seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to help ensure the reliability, performance, and usability of our growing Business Media product portfolio.


We're looking for a hands-on engineer who combines strong manual testing skills with practical test automation experience. This individual will work closely with software engineers, product leaders, and designers to identify defects, improve testing processes, and help deliver high-quality software.


The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, technically curious, and comfortable taking ownership of testing activities throughout the development lifecycle.


As our products continue to expand across web, desktop, and mobile platforms, this position will play an important role in establishing repeatable testing practices and improving release confidence.


Our Products: Business Media

Byte: Video Communication Without Another Meeting

Byte enables asynchronous video communication through browser-based screen and camera recordings.

  • Record and share video messages instantly.
  • Provide feedback through time-specific comments, reactions, and annotations.
  • Catch up quickly with transcripts, AI-generated chapters, and summaries.
  • Continue conversations through video replies and Dot integration.

Value Proposition: Reduce unnecessary meetings while making communication more personal, efficient, and accessible.


Dot: Collaborative Content and Conversations

Dot makes files, screenshots, and everyday content interactive and collaborative.

  • Capture, annotate, and discuss content together.
  • Collaborate using reactions, stickers, Magic Markers, and feeds.
  • Organize communication through threads, mentions, and private conversations.
  • Stay informed through Catch-Me-Up and notifications.

Value Proposition: Make collaboration feel natural by connecting conversations directly to the content people work with.


Matee: Intelligent Writing Technology

Matee is an embeddable rich-text platform designed to make writing and communication smarter.

  • Enhance written communication using natural language understanding and generation.
  • Transform text into clearer, more actionable information.
  • Integrate intelligent writing capabilities into existing applications.
  • Deliver a consistent writing experience across multiple platforms.

TransCore (TRN), a subsidiary of ST Engineering, is seeking a talented Sr. Software Test Engineer, Mobile Automation to join our shared Software QA Automation team in Round Rock, Texas, Atlanta, Georgia, Plano, Texas, Harrisburg, Pennsylvania.


*Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.*


Summary

The Sr. Mobile Test Automation Engineer will focus on automation coverage for the Smart Mobility platform. This role will primarily own native iOS and Android mobile test automation, including framework development, mobile regression coverage, device-cloud execution, CI/CD integration, and mobile quality reporting. The engineer will validate key Smart Mobility workflows across mobile applications, backend services, cloud services, and downstream transaction systems.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for native Android and iOS applications.
  • Build reusable automation components, utilities, reporting, test data handling, and execution standards.
  • Automate sanity, functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end mobile test scenarios.
  • Perform testing across real devices, emulators/simulators, OS versions, and cloud device platforms.
  • Analyze automation failures, troubleshoot flaky tests, and continuously improve framework reliability.
  • Ensure mobile apps meet expectations for functionality, usability, reliability, security, and performance.
  • Coordinate with DevOps engineers to integrate mobile smoke, regression, and end-to-end automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, requirements reviews, and design discussions to identify mobile quality risks early.
  • Support shift-left testing, automation-first delivery, and Test-Driven Development practices.
  • Create dashboards, automation execution reports, and mobile quality metrics for release readiness.
  • Track mobile automation coverage, pass/fail trends, flaky tests, defect leakage, and release risks.
  • Support defect triage, bug fix validation, targeted regression testing, and release sign-off activities.

Requirements And Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or related field required.
  • 8-12 years of QA experience, with strong automation engineering background.
  • 5+ years of hands-on mobile testing experience across iOS and Android.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining mobile automation frameworks from scratch.
  • Hands-on experience with mobile automation tools such as Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Maestro, or similar tools.
  • Experience testing native, hybrid, and mobile web applications.
  • Experience with device cloud platforms such as BrowserStack, SauceLabs, LambdaTest, or similar.
  • Programming experience in Java, Kotlin, Swift, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or C#.
  • Strong knowledge of Git, CI/CD, Agile/Scrum practices, debugging, troubleshooting, and automation best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Playwright test automation for Web UI and API testing.
  • Experience testing tolling, transportation, SaaS, payment, or transaction-based systems.
  • Experience with performance tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, or similar.
  • Exposure to observability, logs, metrics, tracing, crash analytics, mobile performance monitoring, security, and application resiliency.
  • Experience using approved AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for test acceleration, troubleshooting, and automation productivity.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.*

Physical Demands/Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

  • TransCore complies with federal and state disability laws and provides reasonable accommodation for employees with disabilities.

We are seeking a QA/DevOps Engineer to join Discord's Business Systems team. In this role, you will own automated test suite development and maintenance across Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) and Salesforce, with a focus on Tosca-based regression and progression testing. You will embed automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and partner closely with ERP Functional, Technical, and DevOps teams to ensure every release is tested consistently and defects are caught early.

What you'll be doing

  • Run Oracle ERP Cloud and Salesforce QA automation suites for all quarterly patch upgrades end-to-end.
  • Review new Oracle and SFDC release features and recommend improvements to existing testing processes.
  • Build and improve regression and progression test automation in the Tosca environment for Oracle Fusion and Salesforce.
  • Create, maintain, and update Tosca scripts to reflect system and process changes across GL, AP, AR, and FAH modules.
  • Lead feature enhancement reviews as part of quarterly patch assessment cycles and new enhancement projects.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines; trigger regression suites automatically on every release candidate build.
  • Maintain test infrastructure and environments in collaboration with DevOps and ERP Technical teams.
  • Document test coverage, defect trends, and release readiness in Jira and shared reporting dashboards.

Automation Use Cases

  • FAH Process Automation: Auto-test Financial Accounting Hub on each new sales item addition to eliminate manual unit testing.
  • AR Regression Suite: Automated flows for invoicing, receipts, and customer setup across every release.
  • AP Regression Suite: Payment runs, supplier invoices, holds, and approvals tested automatically on each patch cycle.
  • Salesforce Tosca Automation: Develop, maintain, and expand automated SFDC test suites in Tosca, integrated with release pipelines.

What you should have

  • 3-5+ years of QA automation experience.
  • Hands-on Tosca experience for regression and progression test suite development and maintenance.
  • Experience executing and maintaining automated test cycles for quarterly Oracle patch upgrades.
  • Familiarity with Oracle ERP Cloud and SFDC release feature review and technical impact assessment.
  • Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with pipeline configuration: triggering regression runs on pull requests and release candidate builds.
  • Working knowledge of version control (Git / GitHub or GitLab): branching, pull requests, and code review workflows.
  • Basic scripting capability in Python, Shell, or PowerShell for test utility automation and pipeline support.
  • Understanding of containerized test environments (Docker); experience running tests in ephemeral containers is a plus.
  • Jira for defect tracking, test coverage reporting, and sprint participation.
  • Experience writing and maintaining test documentation: test plans, test cases, regression logs, and release readiness summaries.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with ERP Functional Analysts, ERP Technical Developers, and DevOps engineers.
  • Familiarity with SOX compliance, ITGC controls, and ERP change management practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Oracle Fusion certification or formal training in Oracle ERP Cloud modules.
  • Experience with SaaS QA automation in a high-growth technology company environment.
  • Exposure to OIC (Oracle Integration Cloud) or MuleSoft integration testing.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce test automation frameworks beyond Tosca (Selenium, Provar, or equivalent).
  • Prior experience working with AMS or managed services vendors in an ERP context.
  • Knowledge of Oracle quarterly release cycles and technical impact assessments.
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code or environment provisioning concepts (Terraform, Ansible).

This position is US-based and can be remote but if you live in the Bay Area, you're welcome to work from our beautiful SF office.

The base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan; life and disability insurance; paid time off; and paid parental leave. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Applications for this role are accepted on an ongoing basis.

$156,000—$175,500 USD

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Automation QA Engineer on the Resupply team, you will play a key role in defining, implementing, and evolving our quality assurance and test automation strategy. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you'll partner closely with Engineering Managers, Software Engineers, Product Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure quality is built into every stage of the software development lifecycle.

You will drive the adoption of scalable automation frameworks, establish testing best practices, and provide technical guidance across teams. In addition to developing automated test solutions, you'll be expected to perform manual testing when needed, helping the team maintain high-quality releases while balancing speed and reliability.

This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about modern test automation, enjoys influencing engineering practices, and is comfortable operating both strategically and tactically.

What You'll Do

  • Define and help execute the overall test automation strategy for the SNAP platform.
  • Partner with Engineering Managers and development teams to establish quality goals, testing standards, and automation best practices.
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable end-to-end, integration, API, and UI automation frameworks using Playwright.
  • Identify opportunities to increase automation coverage and improve testing efficiency across multiple applications and services.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and ensure quality gates are implemented throughout the release process.
  • Collaborate with developers to improve testability, observability, and overall product quality.
  • Participate in architecture and design discussions to ensure quality considerations are incorporated early in the development process.
  • Analyze testing metrics and provide recommendations to improve release confidence and reduce defects.
  • Lead root cause analysis efforts for quality issues and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Execute manual testing and exploratory testing activities when automation is not practical or during critical release periods.
  • Mentor other QA engineers and developers on automation techniques, testing strategies, and quality engineering practices.
  • Work closely with Product, Support, and Customer-facing teams to understand business requirements and customer workflows.


What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in software quality assurance and test automation.
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing automation frameworks using Playwright.
  • Programming experience with C#/.NET.
  • Experience testing modern web applications, REST APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and quality engineering principles.
  • Experience developing and executing automation strategies across multiple teams or products.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and influence engineering teams without direct authority.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and driving adoption of quality best practices.


Nice to have

  • Experience with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code testing practices.
  • Experience validating infrastructure deployments and DevOps pipelines.
  • Experience with test data management and environment management strategies.
  • Knowledge of performance testing, security testing, and observability platforms.
  • Experience working in highly regulated healthcare or SaaS environments.
  • Previous experience serving as a Test Automation Lead, QA Lead, or Quality Engineering Lead.


What Success Looks Like

  • Establishes and drives a scalable automation strategy across multiple engineering teams.
  • Significantly increases automated test coverage while reducing manual regression effort.
  • Improves release quality and confidence through effective quality engineering practices.
  • Acts as a trusted advisor to engineering leadership on testing and quality strategy.
  • Creates a culture where quality is a shared responsibility across the organization.


Why Join Resmed


At Resmed, our mission is to help people breathe better and live healthier, longer lives. By bringing together technology, innovation, and deep customer understanding, we create solutions that make a meaningful difference. As part of the Brightree team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to products that support customers while working alongside talented colleagues in a collaborative and purpose-driven environment.

Location: Atlanta, Georgia (Hybrid)

This is a hybrid position and is not a remote role. Team members are expected to be based in the Atlanta area and available to work on-site regularly to support collaboration, planning, and innovation.

At Resmed, your work has a direct impact on people's lives. We develop technology that helps millions of people around the world sleep better, breathe better, and live healthier lives. You'll join a collaborative team where learning is encouraged, innovation is valued, and your contributions matter. This is an opportunity to build your career alongside talented colleagues while helping shape the next generation of digital health experiences.

We are shaping the future at Resmed, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world’s best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. Employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week are eligible for benefits. This position qualifies for the following benefits package: comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance, sleep care management, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), commuter benefits, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and tuition assistance. Employees receive Flexible Time Off (FTO), 11 paid holidays plus 3 floating days and are eligible for 14 weeks of primary caregiver or two weeks of secondary caregiver leave when welcoming new family members.

Individual pay decisions are based on a variety of factors, such as the candidate’s geographic work location, relevant qualifications, work experience, and skills.

Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds. We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home.

Join our team as a Senior Software Quality Engineer!

This is a HYBRID role - onsite Tuesday-Thursday in Maple Plain, MN.

We are seeking a Senior Software Quality Engineer to help our agile engineering team deliver reliable enterprise web applications and APIs. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who combines strong test-automation skills with a practical, risk-based approach to quality. A primary focus of this role is building dependable automated testing into CI/CD pipelines so the team receives fast feedback and can release with confidence.

You will work closely with software engineers, product managers, business analysts, and architects throughout the development lifecycle. Rather than acting as a final quality gate, you will help the team build quality into design, implementation, delivery, and production operations. You will influence testability, develop maintainable automation primarily in C#/.NET and Python, own the continuous-testing approach within CI/CD, and provide clear evidence about product and release risk.

What You Will Do

  • Define risk-based test strategies for new features, integrations, and critical business workflows
  • Design and maintain reliable automated tests and frameworks using C#/.NET, Python, and appropriate testing tools
  • Own the team’s CI/CD test-automation strategy, including test stages, quality gates, reporting, and failure diagnostics
  • Build effective API, integration, system, and end-to-end coverage while balancing execution speed, reliability, and maintainability
  • Partner with engineers throughout development to improve testability, prevent defects, and strengthen shared ownership of quality
  • Validate API reliability and performance, supplemented by targeted exploratory and functional testing where appropriate
  • Investigate defects, flaky tests, and production issues; lead root-cause analysis and durable corrective actions
  • Assess release risk using test results, defect trends, and production signals, and mentor teammates in quality-engineering practices
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well documented code following established development standards
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of development practices
  • Collaborate effectively with engineers, analysts, QA, and operations teams
  • Communicate progress, risks, and dependencies clearly to team members and stakeholder
  • Explore and apply AI based tools or techniques to improve development efficiency and automation (where appropriate)

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of experience in Software Testing, Software Quality Engineering or Quality Assurance 
  • Experience in software quality engineering, software development in test, or a related engineering role
  • Proven ability to design maintainable test frameworks and automated coverage for enterprise web applications and APIs
  • Strong programming and debugging skills in C#/.NET or Python, with the ability to contribute in both environments
  • Experience designing CI/CD test automation, including test stages, quality gates, reporting, and failure investigation
  • Strong knowledge of API testing, integration testing, and defect investigation
  • Experience with Git-based workflows and agile, cross-functional product development
  • Ability to communicate quality risks, influence engineering practices, and mentor teammates

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience with performance, load, or resilience testing for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with browser and API automation tools such as Playwright, Selenium, or Postman/Newman.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD platforms.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, observability, and production telemetry.
  • Familiarity with security and accessibility testing; relevant quality, cloud, or automation certifications are a plus.

What's In It For You

  • We offer a competitive salary and total rewards package
  • We offer amazing benefits including but not limited to:
    • Health Insurance: Traditional OR High Deductible plan
    • Flexible Spending Accounts
    • Health Savings Account (including employer contributions)
    • Dental and Vision

Job Description

Your expertise in Test automation will be vital in ensuring the superior quality of our software and promptly resolving any issues.

Job Responsibilities

  • Executes test automation software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or break down technical problems.
  • Creates secure and high-quality test automation code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems.
  • Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity (e.g., code. generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards.
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
  • Produces test automation architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring quality software code development.
  • Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops test data solutions in support of test automation and global quality coverage from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems.
  • Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in code quality and data via test automation solutions to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture.
  • Contributes to software engineering test automation communities of practice and events that explore new and emerging technologies.
  • Collaborate closely with technology teams for BDD implementation.
  • Conduct automation feasibility studies and derive ROI.
  • Apply practical experience in test automation with JAVA, Selenium, BDD Cucumber, API testing, and database knowledge, with familiarity in one or more automation tools.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 2+ years applied experience (must keep this)
  • Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, testing, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs.
  • Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations.
  • Experience across the whole Software Development Life Cycle
  • Exposure to agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, Version Control (Bitbucket, GIT) and Security.
  • Must have expertise in Test Automation, Functional Testing, Performance Testing, Regression Testing, etc.
  • Proficient in SQL/ Test data management using SQLs.
  • Hands-on practical experience in one of test automation tool like Selenium, Cucumber Playwright, etc.
  • Knowledge of Java.
  • Must have expertise in BDD / TDD – Behavior Driven Development/ Test Driven Development
  • Oracle HCM testing or configuration experience.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Experience designing and developing scalable test automation frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, Cucumber (BDD), JUnit/TestNG, or similar automation technologies.
  • Proficiency in Java, Python, or other object-oriented programming languages with a strong focus on test automation and software quality engineering.
  • Experience implementing automated testing within CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of API, web services, and microservices testing using tools and frameworks such as REST Assured, Postman, Karate, or equivalent solutions.
  • Experience with performance, reliability, and resiliency testing using tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, or comparable performance testing technologies.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based application testing, container technologies, and test automation practices in AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, or similar environments.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, DevOps, and Quality Assurance teams to drive quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

Job Description:

This job is responsible for testing and delivering complex software requirements to accomplish business outcomes, ensuring the testing strategy and processes are well-defined and continuously improved. Key responsibilities include establishing a test and automation strategy, creating common test frameworks, defining and managing test processes including test data generation, defect management and reporting. Job expectations include understanding and implementing internal/external mandate, ensuring compliance requirements are met on all levels of test environments, and manages traceability.

LOB Position Summary:

  • Seeking an automation-focused software engineer with experience in ETL/Data Engineering, Mainframe, and real-time data replication environments.
  • Serve as the technical bridge between Development Engineers and Quality Engineers, aligning ETL solution development, automated validation frameworks, testability, and shift-left quality practices.
  • Advance software engineering practices within Quality Engineering by embedding automation, data validation, observability, and testability throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Support Unit, Feature and Integrated automation testing for mission-critical data services, with ownership of data integrity, transformation accuracy, replication reliability, and automated validation across high-volume integration and streaming platforms.

Responsibilities:

  • Creates and optimizes test processes including defect management and reporting
  • Creates and optimizes test automation frameworks and use of test automation tools
  • Leads test planning for complex features that span across the platform or multiple teams
  • Creates a test automation strategy across the application stack (UI, API, and Backend, etc.)
  • Ensures alignment and sign off for test cases from business and other stakeholders
  • Manages test execution and resolves, communicates or escalates any issues that may result in test plan variance
  • Designs test data and ensure data compliance requirements are met on all levels of test environments

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of applicable software engineering, test automation, data engineering, or quality engineering experience.
  • Experience developing and supporting ETL/DataStage solutions, real-time data replication platforms, and large-scale data integration processes, with a strong focus on automation and quality engineering.
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks or suites for Unit, Feature, Integrated, regression and data validation testing.
  • Ability to own automated source-to-target validation, transformation accuracy, data integrity, reconciliation, and consistency across high-volume replication and streaming platforms.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD practices and the integration of automated tests, quality gates, and results reporting into delivery pipelines.
  • Hands-on engineering expertise across Mainframe, DataStage, IIDR/CDC, and Kafka-based data pipelines, including development, troubleshooting, automated testing, and validation.
  • Strong analytical, coding, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • ETL, Kafka, Mainframe, IIDR, Raft, Java, Co-Pilot, Octane, Litmus

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience building reusable automation frameworks for data-intensive, high-volume, and business-critical environments.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery teams and influencing automation strategy across application, infrastructure, data, and quality engineering partners.
  • Ability to communicate quality risks, automation coverage, dependencies, and business outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • DataStage, Python, AI Agents, SQL, UFT, Para Soft, GitHub, Bit-Bucket

Job Title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)

Job Category: Engineering

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

Anticipated Posting End: 3/29/2027

The Opportunity

CACI is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to develop and test innovative applications and technologies, which will enable a multidisciplinary engineering team to meet the requirements of a mission critical force protection system. The chosen engineer is responsible for designing and developing automated testing for software architectures in a cloud-based RF environment. This role involves adhering to technical standards, engineering for quality and ensuring the seamless integration of software and components with complex RF solutions. The Software Engineer will work closely with RF hardware engineers, system designers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-performance, reliable RF system simulation system. The Software Engineer will communicate risks and opportunities with the program executive leadership.

Responsibilities

You will be responsible for helping ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our system. In this role, you will design and develop applications, create interfaces, create and execute test plans, identify defects, collaborate closely with other developers, and develop a continuous improvement plan for our testing processes. You will work across manual and automated testing, balance thoroughness with delivery timelines, and help raise the overall quality bar.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Must be a US citizen and have an active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience is required and Bachelor's Degree or higher in computer engineering or in a field related to the computer engineering or computer science disciplines.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks such as Bruno, Postman.
  • Exposure to API testing and related tools.
  • Comfortable working in a Linux environment.
  • Experience with Java, JavaScript, Linux.
  • Experience with acceptance testing, functional testing, and API testing.
  • Strong documentation skills: manual test cases, test procedures, requirements verification traceability matrices (RVTM), and test plans.
  • Proficient in GitLab, Jenkins or similar CI/CD workflow processes.
  • Familiarity with JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and collaboration.

Desired

  • Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts aligned with requirements and specifications.
  • Experience with Selenium, Cypress or similar.
  • Execute both manual and automated tests, including acceptance, functional, regression, and API.
  • Identify, document, track, verify defects, provide clear reproduction steps, expected versus actual results, and severity assessments.
  • Analyze test outcomes, report findings, and deliver actionable feedback to developers and stakeholders.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Contribute to the development and enhancement of applications, test automation frameworks, increasing.
  • Experience with the Python, Docker, Kubernetes/Helm, ArgoCD
  • Prioritize development and testing activities to balance quality assurance with project timelines and deliverables.
  • Maintain thorough documentation of test artifacts, results, and quality metrics.

What You Can Expect

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$98,500-$206,800

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Software Automation Engineer to own and drive Quality Strategy for enterprise products.

As a Senior Software Test Automation Engineer, you will take on more advanced testing responsibilities and contribute significantly to our quality assurance efforts. Your expertise will help create robust test automation solutions, ensuring software reliability and performance. You will play a crucial role in mentoring junior team members and driving continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and implement end-to-end Quality Strategy across UI, API, and non-functional layers.
  • Establish automation roadmap and quality KPIs.
  • Establish and enforce a Test Pyramid model, ensuring optimal balance across unit, API, integration, and UI automation.
  • Drive shift-left practices and increase automation coverage at lower layers.
  • Define and track QA KPIs (automation coverage, defect leakage, regression stability).
  • Drive release readiness reviews and risk assessments.
  • Influence engineering teams to adopt quality best practices.
  • Architect and implement/modify scalable automation frameworks using C# (.NET) or Advanced Java.
  • Good hands-on knowledge of integrating automation tests in CI/CD pipelines.
  • Implement / Knowledge of contract testing using OpenAPI/Swagger.
  • Mentor and review automation engineers’ code.
  • Provide technical guidance and framework standards.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and DevOps stakeholders.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools (e.g., Copilot) to enhance development efficiency.
  • Hands-on knowledge of prompting techniques to improve automation productivity.


Required Skills

  • Strong proficiency in C# (.NET) OR Advanced Java
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright or Selenium
  • REST API automation using RestSharp / HttpClient
  • Strong understanding of JSON, HTTP protocols, and status codes
  • SQL/database validation
  • Hands-on knowledge of CI/CD integration (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins)
  • Experience tracking QA KPIs and quality dashboards (e.g., Grafana)
  • Agile/Scrum experience
