Description

Software Test Engineer

Omaha, NE

No clearance required to start – Must be clearable to Secret

Ready for your next career step? Leidos has an immediate opportunity for a Software Test Engineer to help with automated testing of our state-of-the-art software solutions delivered to our government customers. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with an outstanding software engineering team and will support the team’s software deployed into our customers' classified networks. Our engineers are at the forefront of defining and building solutions to address the challenges faced by our end users, applying a go-fast, agile approach driven by small teams that rely on and value each team member's contributions.

As a Software Test Engineer, you’ll participate in planning, designing and executing end-to-end automated testing in support of the Continuous Integration (CI)/Continuous Deployment (CD) of our products to customers worldwide. You’ll identify opportunities to increase the level of automated testing of our customer products and solutions, plan and execute strategies to achieve test automation objectives, continuously measure and improve the effectiveness of that testing based on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and evaluate and integrate new testing tools, technologies, and procedures to achieve the organization’s technical objectives.

In this capacity, you’ll collaborate with engineering and product team members, architects, and other IT resources to create and execute test strategies, detailed test plans, and scenarios. You’ll always respect others' opinions, accept constructive criticism, share your views with a passion for improving the team’s performance, and collaborate openly and positively with your teammates.

Most of the work will be on site in Leidos' facility in Omaha, Nebraska. Some level of remote/work from home is possible.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain test methodology documentation for traceability and repeatability.
  • Identify regression test candidates for automation, plan automation activities across the team and automate test cases.
  • Execute test cases/scripts including functional, regression, exploratory, performance, load and smoke tests for both web applications and database.
  • Report issues in work management tool (e.g., Jira) along with steps required to re-create the issue.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including daily standups, sprint planning meetings, sprint reviews and sprint retrospectives.
  • Participate in all phases of risk management assessments and software development with emphasis on analysis of user requirements, test design and test tools selection.
  • Support metrics program by creating, collecting and tracking test related metrics.
  • Inform innovative solutions for more efficient testing strategy.

Basic Qualifications

  • US Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree and 4+ years of prior relevant experience or a Master’s degree with 2+ years of experience. Additional years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Experience with software development (Java, NodeJS/JS, C++, Rust).
  • Experience with writing and/or developing test procedures and automated test scripts (e.g., Test Complete, Selenium, Playwright, Puppeteer, Cucumber, QFTest or Cypress).

Preferred Qualifications

  • US Citizen with an active Secret security clearance or higher.
  • Experience with Agile development principles and methodologies.
  • Experience with automating unit, functional, integration and performance testing of web applications using industry-standard tools such as Playwright, JUnit, SoapUI, Cucumber, Selenium, and JMeter.
  • Working knowledge of continuous integration and delivery methodologies and tools.
  • Familiarity with software design patterns.
  • Solid understanding of software development process fundamentals.
  • Experience managing projects within the Atlassian suite of tools (Confluence, JIRA, Bitbucket).
  • Familiarity with component-based web frameworks & libraries (React, Vue, Angular).
  • Knowledge of a version control system (e.g., Git).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD processes and tools (Gitlab).
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with USSTRATCOM Nuclear Planning process.

Description

Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

As a member of the SMGS Planning Tools team, you will shape the AWS business's direction as a whole. You will build greenfield solutions from the ground up while using native AWS services and frameworks. The right candidate will have a robust system delivery background, well-rounded technical knowledge, and demonstrated experience working on large scale projects. The candidate must be customer-obsessed, have strong analytical and communication skills, and passionate about learning new technologies.

You will work with software development engineers to understand features and technical implementation. You will also work with groups such as product management, UX designers to understand customer usage models and develop test plans and suites that approximate real-world environments and regression tests driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. You will develop automated tests to help fasten testing cycles and release faster to our customers. In this role, you will be responsible to deliver manual/automated solutions to test customer facing features.

This position may be based in Seattle (WA), Dallas (TX), or Herndon (VA). Relocation offered for US residents only.

Key job responsibilities

Test Planning and Strategy: Developing comprehensive test plans and strategies based on project requirements, ensuring all aspects of the application are covered.

Test Case Development: Designing, writing, and maintaining detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test cases.

Test Execution: Executing test cases (both manual and automated) and ensuring software quality across various stages of the software development lifecycle.

Defect Identification and Reporting: Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects using bug tracking tools, and working closely with the development team to resolve them.

Automation Development: Writing and maintaining automated test scripts using appropriate tools and frameworks to increase test coverage and efficiency.

Continuous Improvement: Continuously identifying and implementing process improvements to enhance the testing process and improve product quality.

Collaboration and Communication: Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, to ensure quality standards are met.

Performance and Load Testing: Conducting performance, scalability, and load testing to ensure the application can handle the expected load.

Test Environment Management: Setting up, maintaining, and managing test environments to ensure they reflect production environments as closely as possible.

Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Assessing risks associated with releases and working on strategies to mitigate them, ensuring minimal impact on production environments.

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is the technology partner of choice for industry-leading organizations worldwide. Since its inception in 1968, TCS has upheld the highest standards of innovation, engineering excellence, and customer service.

It has set an aspiration to become the world's largest AI-led technology services company and is enabling its clients to transform themselves across the full AI stack, from infrastructure to intelligence.

Rooted in the heritage of the Tata Group, TCS is focused on creating long term value for its clients, its investors, its employees, and the community at large. With a highly skilled workforce spread across 56 countries and 194 service delivery centers across the world, the company has been recognized as a top employer in six continents. With the ability to rapidly apply and scale new technologies, the company has built long-term partnerships with its clients. Many of these relationships have endured into decades and navigated every technology cycle, from mainframes in the 1970s to artificial intelligence today.

TCS sponsors 14 of the world’s most prestigious marathons and endurance events, including the TCS New York City Marathon, TCS London Marathon, Tata Mumbai Marathon, and TCS Sydney Marathon with a focus on promoting health, sustainability, and community empowerment.

Position Description:

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows. You will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities:

  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with TypeScript, Selenium, and related API-testing tools.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Execute product testing focusing on end-to-end, performance and load testing.
  • Create and report test-cycle metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements that reduce cycle time.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Create reusable automation workflows and prompts that connect product requirements, code changes, Jira or Azure DevOps issues, test results, logs, and documentation into repeatable QA processes.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.
  • Improve automated test coverage, regression readiness, and feedback speed by identifying repeatable QA workflows and reducing manual effort across release cycles.
  • Document how AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, validated, and incorporated into automation assets when those outputs influence test coverage, quality decisions, or product release readiness.


Basic Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Powershell and/or C#.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Cryptography knowledge including Key Management.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.


About Entrust

Our growing company relies on curious, dedicated, and innovative colleagues to anticipate the future and provide solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure world. Entrust technologies and expertise help government agencies, enterprises, and financial institutions in more than 150 countries serve and safeguard citizens, employees and consumers. Each year, our solutions secure billions of transactions — and every day, our technologies issue and manage more than 10 million secure identities. How do we do all of this? Together.

Join us. Together we’ll create solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure life.


For more information, visit www.entrustdatacard.com. Follow us on Twitter, YouTube and LinkedIn.


Entrust Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.


NO AGENCIES, NO RELOCATION

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by participating in product architecture discussions, promoting test‑driven development, and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400-$115,000 based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Automation & Testing Execution: Design, write, and maintain robust automated test suites while creating targeted manual test cases for features requiring hands-on validation.
  • Agile Requirements Refinement: Active participation in story grooming and refinement sessions to clarify acceptance criteria, spot edge cases early, and ensure testability.
  • Quality & Integration: Partner directly with cross-functional development teams to execute integration and regression testing, ensuring high performance, security, and end-user reliability before release.
  • Defect Analysis & Troubleshooting: Debug build failures, triage bug reports, and perform root-cause analysis to ensure rapid, effective resolutions in non-production and production environments.
  • Framework & Process Improvement: Maintain quality assurance documentation, adopt industry best practices in the industry, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

  • Develop Automation Solutions: Design and develop automation solutions that can be used by functional testers for automated testing, utilizing programming skills and various automation tools across the entire application architecture.
  • Implement Test Frameworks: Build and implement test automation frameworks, integrating automated tests into the DevOps pipeline for seamless execution and reporting.
  • Optimize Test Scenarios: Ensure optimized test scenarios, test modeling concepts, and efficient test case identification and coding for functional testers to utilize in automated testing.
  • Collaborate on Automation: Collaborate with teams to identify areas for automation and implement automation solutions that meet business needs.
  • Integrate Automated Tests: Integrate automated tests into the DevOps pipeline, ensuring seamless execution and reporting.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Programming Skills: Experience with programming languages to design and develop automation solutions for test automation frameworks.
  • Automation Tools: Experience with various automation tools to build and implement test automation frameworks across the entire application architecture.
  • Test Automation Frameworks: Experience with developing and implementing test automation frameworks that can be integrated into the DevOps pipeline.
  • Application Architecture: Experience with various technologies such as web, desktop, mobile, devices, browsers, client-server, micro-services, and containers that make up the application architecture.
  • DevOps Pipeline Integration: Experience with integrating automated tests into the DevOps pipeline for seamless execution and reporting.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • FullStack Development Knowledge: Exposure to designing and developing full-stack applications, including UI, API, services, performance, and data layers, is beneficial for this role.

  • Micro-Services Architecture: Exposure to micro-services architecture is helpful for designing and developing automation solutions across the entire application architecture.
  • Preferred Skills: SDET, Automation Testing with Karate, Cucmber frameworks, Selenium, Java, Playwright

About The Role

As a QA Automation Engineer – Playwright, Selenium & Java, you will make an impact by designing and maintaining scalable automated testing solutions for web applications. You will collaborate with developers, business analysts, product owners, and DevOps teams to strengthen test coverage, accelerate releases, and improve overall product quality.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks using Playwright and/or Selenium with Java.
  • Implement functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing solutions across multiple applications and platforms.
  • Develop and maintain Cucumber-based test scenarios to support behavior-driven development and reusable automation.
  • Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
  • Analyze test results, document defects, and partner with development teams to support timely issue resolution.
  • Create reusable automation components, test data management strategies, and testing best practices.
  • Participate in requirement reviews, test planning, and risk assessments to strengthen product quality and delivery timelines.
  • Monitor automation coverage, testing efficiency, and quality metrics while driving continuous process improvements.

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a Remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

  • 7+ years of strong hands-on experience designing and developing web application test automation using Playwright and/or Selenium.
  • Strong Java programming skills for building, enhancing, and maintaining automated test frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with Cucumber and behavior-driven development testing practices.
  • Experience designing and executing functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end tests.
  • Strong understanding of test case design, test execution, defect identification, and defect lifecycle management.
  • Ability to create reusable automation components and maintain scalable test frameworks.
  • Experience collaborating with development, product, business analysis, and DevOps teams in a cross-functional environment.

These will help you stand out

  • Experience integrating automated tests with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar CI/CD platforms.
  • Experience with API testing and related automation tools.
  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum delivery environments.
  • Exposure to performance testing approaches and tools.
  • Experience supporting applications within the healthcare domain.

We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Salary And Other Compensation

The annual salary for this position is between $81,500 to $92,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) plan and contributions
  • Long-term/Short-term Disability
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Position Description:

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows.


This role will have an emphasis on managing performance/load testing within our current K6 environment.


In addition, you will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage, troubleshoot and report on performance/load testing of web sites and components using our K6 environment. It measures the throughput and resilience of thousands of printers hitting a site for the purpose of issuing credit, debit and ID cards.
  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with C# and API-testing tools such as RestSharp and Playwright.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.



Basic Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Performance/Load testing
  • Programming experience in C#. JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Powershell.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with K6 performance testing tool
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.


Where you will be: This is a hybrid role requiring three days per week in our Shakopee, MN headquarters office.


About Entrust


Our growing company relies on curious, dedicated and innovative colleagues to anticipate the future and provide solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure world. Entrust technologies and expertise help government agencies, enterprises and financial institutions in more than 150 countries, serve and safeguard citizens, employees and consumers. Each year, our solutions secure billions of transactions — and every day, our technologies issue and manage more than 10 million secure identities. How do we do all of this? Together.

At Entrust, we don’t just offer jobs – we offer career journeys. Here is what you can expect when you join our team:

  • Career Growth: Whether you’re a budding developer or a seasoned expert, we’re invested in your professional journey. With learning-forward initiatives and exciting challenges, your growth is our priority.
  • Collaboration: Here, your voice matters. Our teams thrive on sharing ideas, brainstorming solutions, and working together to build a better tomorrow.
  • Inclusion: Our culture is built on diversity, inclusion, and respect.


For more information, visit www.entrust.com. Follow us on, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube

Entrust Corporation is an EOE/AA/Veteran/People with Disabilities employer.


NO AGENCIES, NO RELOCATION

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer: Automation, you specialize in creating and maintaining automated testing solutions for IT systems and applications. You possess in-depth knowledge of various test automation tools and technologies to optimize testing processes.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Develop Automation Solutions: Design and implement automated testing solutions to ensure efficient and reliable software delivery, utilizing expertise in test automation tools and technologies.
  • Build Optimized Test Scenarios: Create optimized test scenarios to streamline testing processes, aligning with contemporary trends like Agile, DevOps, and Containers.
  • Manage Test Data and Environment: Develop and maintain automation for managing test data and environment-related automation to support seamless testing processes.
  • Integrate Testing Automation: Collaborate to integrate testing automation into overall delivery automation, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and methodologies.
  • Execute Tests: Apply expertise in automation to execute tests, ensuring high-quality software delivery and identifying areas for process improvement.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Test Automation Tools Expertise: Exposure to various test automation tools and technologies, with the ability to design and implement automated testing solutions for IT systems and applications.
  • Automated Testing Solution Development: Experience working with test automation tools to build optimized test scenarios, ensuring efficient and reliable software delivery.
  • Test Data Management: Exposure to automation for managing test data and environment-related automation, supporting seamless testing processes.
  • Delivery Automation Integration: Experience working with integrating testing automation into overall delivery automation, aligning with contemporary trends like Agile, DevOps, and Containers.
  • Automated Test Execution: Exposure to applying expertise in automation to execute tests, ensuring high-quality software delivery and identifying areas for process improvement.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Contemporary Trends Knowledge: Exposure to contemporary trends like Agile, DevOps, and Containers, with the ability to align testing automation with these methodologies.
  • Test Automation Optimization: Experience working with various test automation tools and technologies to optimize testing processes and ensure efficient software delivery.
  • Delivery Automation Understanding: Exposure to integrating testing automation into overall delivery automation, with the ability to collaborate and ensure alignment with organizational goals and methodologies.
  • Preferred Skills: Telco OSS: Development Lead, Order Management, Telco Integration\.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Good things are happening at Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies —an A+ (Superior) rated, nationwide Property & Casualty insurer backed by Berkshire Hathaway. With supportive leadership, collaborative teams, and opportunities to grow, GUARD is a place where people build meaningful, long‑term careers.

Good Things You Can Count On.

  • Hybrid schedule: 2 days remote / 3 in‑office
  • Predictable hours (no nights, weekends, or holidays)
  • Competitive pay + generous PTO
  • Medical, dental & vision starting day one
  • 401(k), tuition reimbursement & longevity bonuses

Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled and experienced QA Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust automated testing solutions. This role requires a deeper understanding of automation frameworks and the ability to lead testing efforts for complex features and systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement scalable and maintainable automated test frameworks using Tricentis Tosca and other tools.
  • Analyze business and functional requirements related to P&C insurance systems and translate them into effective automated test strategies and plans.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API testing, accessibility testing across web and backend systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, developers, and product owners to ensure test coverage and quality.
  • Execute automated test cases, log defects, and track them to closure using Azure DevOps.
  • Develop automated tests for APIs, UI, and backend systems.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and review their test scripts.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze test results, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
  • Maintain test documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across QA teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in software testing, preferably in the P&C insurance domain
  • 3–5 years of experience in test automation.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools, with a strong emphasis on Tricentis Tosca and Playwright; experience with Selenium, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks is also preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL for backend/database testing.
  • Experience with API testing using tools like Postman or REST Assured.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong understanding of Agile QA methodologies, test planning, and defect management.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Optional Certifications (Preferred But Not Required):

  • Tricentis Tosca Automation Specialist Level 1 & 2
  • ISTQB Certified Tester – Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer
  • Certified Agile Tester (CAT)
  • Certified Jenkins Engineer (CJE)
  • Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional

Salary Range $56,000.00 - $130,000.00

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, this range represents a good-faith estimate. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, credentials, geographic location, and other considerations permitted by law.

This role may be based out of any of our office locations, including:

Parsippany, NJ; Conshohocken, PA; Wilkes ‑ Barre, PA; Alpharetta, GA; Scottsdale, AZ

Interview Integrity Notice: Berkshire Hathaway GUARD is committed to a fair and consistent hiring process. Candidates are expected to participate independently in interviews. Unauthorized recording, transcription, AI note-taking, or AI interview assistance tools may not be used during interviews without prior approval.

descriptionHtml:
About The Role

As a QA Automation Lead, you will make an impact by developing and maintaining automated testing solutions for user interfaces, APIs, integrations, and data. You will collaborate with engineering and delivery teams to strengthen product quality, investigate defects, and integrate automated testing into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.

In this role, you will

  • Develop, maintain, and execute UI and API automation test suites using Java, Selenium WebDriver, and REST Assured.
  • Create comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, and test cases based on business and technical requirements.
  • Validate application functionality, system integrations, APIs, and data across multiple testing stages.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing practices.
  • Investigate defects, analyze test results, and collaborate with engineering teams to drive issues through resolution.

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a Remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in quality assurance, software testing, and test automation.
  • Proficiency in Java, Selenium WebDriver, and REST Assured.
  • Experience testing REST APIs, including working with HTTP methods and JSON payloads.
  • Experience with database testing using SQL or other database-testing tools.
  • Working knowledge of a Java testing framework such as JUnit or TestNG.
  • Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Git and version-control practices.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments.

These will help you stand out

  • Ability to validate complex system integrations and data flows.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.

We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Salary And Other Compensation

The annual salary for this position is between $71,100 to $112,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) plan and contributions
  • Long-term/Short-term Disability
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

At Jack Henry, we’re more than a technology company, we’re a force for good in financial services. We’re redefining how community banks and credit unions connect with the people they serve. Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by participating in product architecture discussions, promoting test‑driven development, and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400-$115,000 based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Automation & Testing Execution: Design, write, and maintain robust automated test suites while creating targeted manual test cases for features requiring hands-on validation.
  • Agile Requirements Refinement: Active participation in story grooming and refinement sessions to clarify acceptance criteria, spot edge cases early, and ensure testability.
  • Quality & Integration: Partner directly with cross-functional development teams to execute integration and regression testing, ensuring high performance, security, and end-user reliability before release.
  • Defect Analysis & Troubleshooting: Debug build failures, triage bug reports, and perform root-cause analysis to ensure rapid, effective resolutions in non-production and production environments.
  • Framework & Process Improvement: Maintain quality assurance documentation, adopt industry best practices in the industry, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium, API Testing, Playwright etc).
  • Experience with Windows and Unix Based Systems
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team.

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer with FullStack expertise, you specialize in building and implementing test automation solutions and frameworks across the entire application architecture. You design and develop automation solutions for functional testers to utilize in automated testing, ensuring optimized test scenarios and efficient test case identification and coding.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Develop Automation Solutions: Design and develop automation solutions that can be used by functional testers for automated testing, utilizing programming skills and various automation tools across the entire application architecture.
  • Implement Test Frameworks: Build and implement test automation frameworks, integrating automated tests into the DevOps pipeline for seamless execution and reporting.
  • Optimize Test Scenarios: Ensure optimized test scenarios, test modeling concepts, and efficient test case identification and coding for functional testers to utilize in automated testing.
  • Collaborate on Automation: Collaborate with teams to identify areas for automation and implement automation solutions that meet business needs.
  • Integrate Automated Tests: Integrate automated tests into the DevOps pipeline, ensuring seamless execution and reporting.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Programming Skills: Experience with programming languages to design and develop automation solutions for test automation frameworks.
  • Automation Tools: Experience with various automation tools to build and implement test automation frameworks across the entire application architecture.
  • Test Automation Frameworks: Experience with developing and implementing test automation frameworks that can be integrated into the DevOps pipeline.
  • Application Architecture: Experience with various technologies such as web, desktop, mobile, devices, browsers, client-server, micro-services, and containers that make up the application architecture.
  • DevOps Pipeline Integration: Experience with integrating automated tests into the DevOps pipeline for seamless execution and reporting.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • FullStack Development Knowledge: Exposure to designing and developing full-stack applications, including UI, API, services, performance, and data layers, is beneficial for this role.
  • Containerization Experience: Familiarity with containerization technologies, such as containers, is advantageous for integrating automated tests into the DevOps pipeline.
  • Micro-Services Architecture: Exposure to micro-services architecture is helpful for designing and developing automation solutions across the entire application architecture.
  • Preferred Skills: Full‑stack test automation, API (REST Assured/Postman/Newman), UI (Playwright/Cypress/Selenium)

At Jack Henry, we’re more than a technology company, we’re a force for good in financial services. We’re redefining how community banks and credit unions connect with the people they serve. Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. We deliver cutting-edge solutions that are paving the way for the next generation of digital banking and payments, but our true impact begins with our associates. If you're ready to help transform an industry and grow with a company that values purpose, collaboration, and excellence then we’d love to meet you.

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by participating in product architecture discussions, promoting test‑driven development, and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400-$115,000 based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Automation & Testing Execution: Design, write, and maintain robust automated test suites while creating targeted manual test cases for features requiring hands-on validation.
  • Agile Requirements Refinement: Active participation in story grooming and refinement sessions to clarify acceptance criteria, spot edge cases early, and ensure testability.
  • Quality & Integration: Partner directly with cross-functional development teams to execute integration and regression testing, ensuring high performance, security, and end-user reliability before release.
  • Defect Analysis & Troubleshooting: Debug build failures, triage bug reports, and perform root-cause analysis to ensure rapid, effective resolutions in non-production and production environments.
  • Framework & Process Improvement: Maintain quality assurance documentation, adopt industry best practices in the industry, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium, API Testing, Playwright etc).
  • Experience with Windows and Unix Based Systems
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team.

Why Jack Henry?

At Jack Henry, we live by the motto: “Do the right thing, do whatever it takes, and have fun.” It’s more than a tagline, it’s the foundation of our culture. We recognize that our associates are the key to our success, and we’re deeply committed to their wellbeing. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health so you can thrive both personally and professionally.

We’re also leading the way in technology modernization, helping financial institutions evolve with speed, security, and flexibility. Our strategy focuses on delivering secure data access, mitigating fraud, and enabling seamless integration. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders.

Culture of Commitment

Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. Our culture empowers us to rise to challenges, seek new opportunities, and support one another through change. It’s this shared commitment that drives our success. We’re proud to foster an environment where inclusion, sustainability, and community impact are more than values, they’re how we operate. Visit our Corporate Sustainability site to learn more about our culture and commitment to our people, customers, community, environment, and shareholders.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Jack Henry, we know we are better together. We value, respect, and protect the uniqueness each of us brings. Innovation flourishes by including all voices and makes our business - and our society - stronger. Jack Henry is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing equal opportunity in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, performance management, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, education, training, social, and recreational activities to all persons regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, genetic information, pregnancy, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, and military and veteran status, or any other protected status protected by local, state or federal law.

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by participating in product architecture discussions, promoting test‑driven development, and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400-$115,000 based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

  • Defect Analysis & Troubleshooting: Debug build failures, triage bug reports, and perform root-cause analysis to ensure rapid, effective resolutions in non-production and production environments.
  • Framework & Process Improvement: Maintain quality assurance documentation, adopt industry best practices in the industry, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium, API Testing, Playwright etc).
  • Experience with Windows and Unix Based Systems
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Bachelor’s degree.

  • Exposure to AI.

Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders.

Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. descriptionHtml:
Cognizant is seeking a Senior Test Automation Analyst to support quality engineering initiatives for a leading financial services client. This role is ideal for an experienced testing professional with deep expertise in Playwright automation, TypeScript, API testing, and modern DevOps practices. The successful candidate will also help advance the use of Generative AI within testing and quality assurance.

You will lead automation activities, collaborate directly with client stakeholders, coordinate onsite and offshore teams, and mentor team members while delivering reliable, scalable test solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, write, enhance, and execute automated test scripts using Playwright.
  • Develop and maintain automation solutions using TypeScript and the REST Assured framework.
  • Support the migration of test automation from Selenium to Playwright.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and DevOps practices.
  • Use Jira, Confluence, GitHub, and GitHub Copilot to manage testing activities and improve delivery efficiency.
  • Incorporate Generative AI tools into testing processes and quality engineering workflows.
  • Test Generative AI solutions built with large language models such as OpenAI, Claude, and Amazon Bedrock.
  • Perform prompt validation, model evaluation, and end-to-end testing of AI-enabled applications and AWS-based solutions.
  • Communicate with client stakeholders and coordinate delivery across onsite and offshore teams.
  • Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentoring to team members.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in software testing, quality assurance, or test automation.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Playwright automation and TypeScript.
  • Experience with REST Assured for API testing.
  • Practical experience migrating automation frameworks from Selenium to Playwright.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, and DevOps practices.
  • Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, GitHub, and GitHub Copilot.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including direct client communication.
  • Experience leading teams, mentoring colleagues, and coordinating onsite and offshore delivery.

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience testing Generative AI applications that use OpenAI, Claude, Amazon Bedrock, or comparable large language models.
  • Experience validating prompts, evaluating model outputs, and testing AI applications hosted on AWS.
  • Background supporting financial services clients or complex enterprise environments.

Why Join Cognizant?

Join a collaborative team working with modern automation frameworks, cloud technologies, and emerging Generative AI capabilities. This opportunity offers the chance to influence quality engineering practices, lead technical delivery, and contribute to innovative testing solutions in an enterprise environment.

Location Disclaimer: This position is based on site in San Diego, California. Candidates must be able to commute to the designated work location or be willing to relocate.

Compensation

The anticipated annual salary range for this position is approximately $81,500–$92,500. The final compensation offered may vary based on factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, location, and other business and organizational considerations. This range is subject to change and does not include any applicable benefits, bonuses, or other forms of compensation.

Apply Now

If you are an experienced test automation professional with strong Playwright expertise and an interest in AI-enabled quality engineering, we encourage you to apply.

Cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment and considering qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics.

Overview

Good things are happening at Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies —an A+ (Superior) rated, nationwide Property & Casualty insurer backed by Berkshire Hathaway. With supportive leadership, collaborative teams, and opportunities to grow, GUARD is a place where people build meaningful, long‑term careers.

Good Things You Can Count On.

  • Hybrid schedule: 2 days remote / 3 in‑office
  • Predictable hours (no nights, weekends, or holidays)
  • Competitive pay + generous PTO
  • Medical, dental & vision starting day one
  • 401(k), tuition reimbursement & longevity bonuses

Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled and experienced QA Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust automated testing solutions. This role requires a deeper understanding of automation frameworks and the ability to lead testing efforts for complex features and systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement scalable and maintainable automated test frameworks using Tricentis Tosca and other tools.
  • Analyze business and functional requirements related to P&C insurance systems and translate them into effective automated test strategies and plans.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API testing, accessibility testing across web and backend systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, developers, and product owners to ensure test coverage and quality.
  • Execute automated test cases, log defects, and track them to closure using Azure DevOps.
  • Develop automated tests for APIs, UI, and backend systems.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and review their test scripts.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze test results, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
  • Maintain test documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across QA teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in software testing, preferably in the P&C insurance domain
  • 3–5 years of experience in test automation.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools, with a strong emphasis on Tricentis Tosca and Playwright; experience with Selenium, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks is also preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL for backend/database testing.
  • Experience with API testing using tools like Postman or REST Assured.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong understanding of Agile QA methodologies, test planning, and defect management.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Optional Certifications (Preferred But Not Required):

  • Tricentis Tosca Automation Specialist Level 1 & 2
  • ISTQB Certified Tester – Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer
  • Certified Agile Tester (CAT)
  • Certified Jenkins Engineer (CJE)
  • Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional

Salary Range $56,000.00 - $130,000.00

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, this range represents a good-faith estimate. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, credentials, geographic location, and other considerations permitted by law.

This role may be based out of any of our office locations, including:

Parsippany, NJ; Conshohocken, PA; Wilkes ‑ Barre, PA; Alpharetta, GA; Scottsdale, AZ

Interview Integrity Notice: Berkshire Hathaway GUARD is committed to a fair and consistent hiring process. Candidates are expected to participate independently in interviews. Unauthorized recording, transcription, AI note-taking, or AI interview assistance tools may not be used during interviews without prior approval.

Job Description

It’s about putting our best to the test.

Are you described as someone with an inquisitive mind and an innovative personality? Are you never satisfied with good enough? Does solving complex problems and ensuring top-quality applications excite you? If so, being a Quality Automation Engineer I with Frost could be for you.

At Frost, it’s about more than a job. It’s about having a flourishing career where you can thrive, both in and out of work. At Frost, we’re committed to fostering an environment that reflects our values and encourages team members to be the best they can be. In joining our adaptable, integrity-driven team, you’ll become part of Frost’s over 150-year legacy of providing unparalleled banking services.

Who You Are

As a Quality Automation Engineer I, you are our quality control, ensuring every application is stable and built with integrity, caring and excellence. You’ll play an important role in the design, creation, and testing of applications to ensure the quality and stability in every system. You’ll use your strong problem-solving skills to ensure that the applications are performing optimally and meet our high standards. You are not afraid to ask the question why and thrive in a collaborative environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and deploy automated test scripts for an assigned system to ensure the quality and stability of software applications
  • Assist with troubleshooting and triaging script and system issues with project teams to identify the root causes and resolve issues
  • Document, track, and escalate issues with application changes or test scripts
  • Communicate with product management, project management and development teams to develop a strong understanding of the project, product, and testing objectives
  • Write and execute functional test cases as needed
  • Always take action using Integrity, Caring, and Excellence to achieve all-win outcomes

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent technical experience
  • Proficiency in Java or scripting languages like Ruby or Python
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented programming concepts
  • Knowledge of SQL queries

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Experience with identifying technical issues including misconfigurations and defects in code
  • Knowledge of developing functional, load, or batch test automation solutions
  • Knowledge of testing methodologies and processes
  • Knowledge of Selenium WebDriver
  • Experience using automated testing tools like Junit, TestNG, Appium, JMeter, XCUITest, and/or Expresso
  • Experience with a distributed version-control system like GIT
  • Knowledge of Playwright automation framework

Our Benefits

At Frost, we care about your health, your family, and your future and strive to have our benefits reflect that. This includes:

  • Medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and life insurance
  • 401(k) matching
  • Generous holiday and paid time off schedule
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Extensive health and wellness programs, including our Employee Assistance Program
  • Referral bonus program + more!

Since 1868, Frost has dedicated their expertise to provide exceptional banking, investment, and insurance services to businesses and individuals throughout Texas. Frost is one of the 50 largest U.S. banks by asset size and is a leader in banking customer satisfaction. At Frost, it’s about being part of something bigger. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply and see what’s possible at Frost.

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer: Automation, you specialize in creating and maintaining automated testing solutions for IT systems and applications. You possess in-depth knowledge of various test automation tools and technologies to optimize testing processes.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Develop Automation Solutions: Design and build optimized test scenarios, develop automation for executing tests, and manage test data and environment-related automation to ensure efficient and reliable software delivery.
  • Integrate Testing Automation: Align testing automation with overall delivery automation, incorporating contemporary trends like Agile, DevOps, and Containers to streamline testing processes.
  • Manage Test Environments: Oversee test data and environment-related automation to ensure seamless testing and delivery processes.
  • Optimize Testing Processes: Use expertise in test automation tools and technologies to identify areas for improvement and implement optimized testing solutions.
  • Ensure Reliable Delivery: Collaborate with teams to ensure that automated testing solutions meet the required standards and contribute to efficient and reliable software delivery.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Test Automation Tools: Experience with various test automation tools and technologies to design and build optimized test scenarios, develop automation for executing tests, and manage test data and environment-related automation.
  • Automation Integration: Experience in integrating testing automation into overall delivery automation, incorporating contemporary trends like Agile, DevOps, and Containers to streamline testing processes.
  • Test Environment Management: Experience in overseeing test data and environment-related automation to ensure seamless testing and delivery processes.
  • Test Process Optimization: Experience with identifying areas for improvement and implementing optimized testing solutions using expertise in test automation tools and technologies.
  • Delivery Automation: Experience in collaborating with teams to ensure that automated testing solutions meet the required standards and contribute to efficient and reliable software delivery.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Agile Methodologies Knowledge: Experience with Agile development methodologies, allowing for effective collaboration with cross-functional teams and integration of testing automation into overall delivery automation.
  • DevOps Practices Familiarity: Familiarity with DevOps practices, enabling the alignment of testing automation with contemporary trends and ensuring seamless testing and delivery processes.
  • Containerization Technologies Understanding: Understanding of containerization technologies, facilitating the incorporation of contemporary trends into testing automation and delivery processes.
  • Preferred Skills: Test Automation Architect | ALM, Jenkins | SAFe 5 | TOSCA certified

At Jack Henry, we’re more than a technology company, we’re a force for good in financial services. We’re redefining how community banks and credit unions connect with the people they serve. Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. We deliver cutting-edge solutions that are paving the way for the next generation of digital banking and payments, but our true impact begins with our associates.
