The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The position also requires strong knowledge of Quality Assurance principles and QA methodologies, with hands-on involvement in designing test plans and detailed test cases in addition to automation. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect existing functionality, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by promoting test‑driven development and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400 - $115,000, based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Performs and may lead programming activities which may require research and timely, effective, and quality delivery of software into production.
  • Performs, and may lead, technical/engineering support for new and existing applications from code delivery until the retirement of the application.
  • Tests and reviews applications based on business requirements and industry best practices.
  • Uses best practices and standard guidance to create and modify code.
  • Considers how code changes will affect internal teams. May review code created by less experienced team members.
  • Collaborates with QA team to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products.
  • Participates in and may lead team in cross-functional meetings and discussions.
  • Creates required technical documentation.
  • Stays updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • Adheres to documented departmental and corporate standards. Participates in the definition and documentation of standards.
  • May lead integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • Designs and contributes to comprehensive test plans and test cases using established Quality Assurance methodologies, in addition to developing automated tests.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium).
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Must have knowledge of Quality Assurance principles and QA methodologies, including experience designing test plans and test cases
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

At Jack Henry, we live by the motto: “Do the right thing, do whatever it takes, and have fun.” It’s more than a tagline, it’s the foundation of our culture. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

FTI is seeking a Senior Software Test Engineer / SDET to lead test automation architecture and development across our web application portfolio. You will design, build, and maintain production automation frameworks, write code, and resolve complex testing challenges.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who brings technical ownership and experience delivering software within a large technology company, major defense contractor, or comparable large engineering organization. You should be comfortable working independently, explaining architectural decisions, and helping teams improve software quality.

Strong familiarity with artificial intelligence and machine learning is required, including an understanding of how these technologies support software products, development, or testing. You will also apply AI-assisted development tools and large language models to support engineering work.

Playwright is our preferred automation framework, and JavaScript/TypeScript is our preferred language background. Candidates with Python-based Playwright experience or strong Cypress framework experience will also be considered.

This role is ideally based near one of FTI’s office locations in Chesapeake, VA, Beavercreek, OH, Colorado Springs, CO, or Northern Virginia. Candidates in these markets will receive primary consideration. Exceptional remote candidates within the United States who bring highly relevant experience may also be considered.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end automation frameworks and suites for complex web applications, with Playwright as the preferred framework.
  • Own framework architecture, including reusable libraries, page objects, fixtures, utilities, test data management, and API test harnesses.
  • Write and review production-quality automation code.
  • Connect automated tests to CI/CD pipelines and investigate failures across development and build environments.
  • Develop testing strategies that balance end-to-end, API, integration, and component coverage.
  • Diagnose defects and intermittent test failures through structured root-cause analysis.
  • Improve test reliability by addressing locator stability, asynchronous behavior, timing, shared state, isolation, and race conditions.
  • Apply AI-assisted development tools and large language models to support coding, test development, debugging, and code quality.
  • Partner with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to address testability during software design and development.
  • Mentor engineers, review test code, and communicate technical decisions across teams.
  • Evaluate tools and practices that improve automation maintainability, coverage, and development speed.

Education/Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and be able to obtain a U.S. Department of Defense security clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field.
  • At least ten years of relevant software development, software quality engineering, SDET, or test automation experience.
  • Meaningful engineering experience within a large technology company, major defense contractor, or comparable large company, including less widely recognized organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, or substantially extending production automation frameworks, with ownership of architectural decisions and reusable components.
  • Strong hands-on programming skills and current or recent experience writing and troubleshooting automation code.
  • Production web automation experience using Playwright, Cypress, or a comparable modern framework. Python-based Playwright experience is acceptable.
  • Strong familiarity with AI/ML concepts and their practical application to software products, development, or testing.
  • Experience incorporating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience using Git workflows and participating in code reviews.
  • Strong understanding of web application, API, end-to-end, integration, and component testing, including the trade-offs between approaches.
  • Demonstrated debugging and root-cause analysis skills involving browser behavior, network traffic, asynchronous execution, application state, and race conditions.
  • Experience diagnosing and correcting flaky tests.
  • Clear technical communication and the ability to explain individual contributions, architectural decisions, and troubleshooting approaches.
  • Ability to own technical work independently while collaborating across engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active DoD Clearance.
  • Significant experience delivering software and automation within a large technology company or comparable engineering organization.
  • Production experience architecting and building Playwright automation frameworks.
  • Strong professional JavaScript/TypeScript development experience.
  • Experience scaling shared automation frameworks across multiple engineering teams.
  • Practical experience applying AI-assisted coding tools and large language models to engineering workflows.
  • Experience with contract testing or performance/load testing.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with containers and infrastructure-as-code.

descriptionHtml:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Automation Engineer to join our QA Engineering team and maintain scalable automated test frameworks using industry best practices. A QA Automation Engineer applies engineering principles to the design, development, and execution of software tests, with the primary goal of automating testing to identify defects before software reaches end users and to ensure product quality and reliability. This role develops and executes test cases, creates test plans, documents and tracks defects with clear reproduction steps, collaborates with developers and cross-functional teams to verify fixes, and supports bug remediation, system maintenance-including releases, patches, and upgrades-and software deployment. Success in this position requires hands-on automation experience, strong attention to detail, effective communication skills, a commitment to continuous learning, and comfort working in a SAFe Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the software quality assurance lifecycle within an Agile process, actively participating in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and other ceremonies.
  • Design, develop, maintain, and execute scalable automated test frameworks and scripts for new and existing features using Selenium, Appium, TypeScript, Gherkin/BDD, and the Page Object Model.
  • Apply appropriate software development and design methodologies, industry best practices, and reusable automation components to continuously improve test efficiency, coverage, performance, and framework stability.
  • Establish test strategies and create test plans, test cases, scripts, and supporting documentation based on product and design requirements.
  • Perform functional, regression, and integration testing; review software components for adherence to design requirements; analyze results; and document outcomes.
  • Identify, report, and track defects in systems such as Jira, provide clear reproduction steps, and collaborate with developers, product managers, and QA and cross-functional teams to define test requirements and verify fixes.
  • Troubleshoot automation issues and update scripts and frameworks as application functionality and technical requirements evolve.
  • Enhance and maintain automated CI/CD workflows by integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

Qualifications

4 years with BS/BA; 8 years with HS degree; 6 years with AS Degree.

Skills And Qualifications

  • Web and browser test automation: Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver, Selenium Grid, LambdaTest, and Sauce Labs.
  • Mobile test automation: Appium, Espresso for Android, XCTest for iOS, LambdaTest Real Device Mobile Cloud, Sauce Labs Government Cloud, and Kobiton.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript and behavior-driven development frameworks and specifications, including Cucumber and Gherkin.
  • Solid understanding of the Page Object Model design pattern and reusable test automation architecture.
  • Experience with Git or other version control systems; GitLab experience is a plus.
  • Experience with defect tracking tools such as Jira and API testing tools such as Postman.
  • Experience working in Agile and Scrum environments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools and workflows, including Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps.

Requirements

  • 4+ years progressive experience in quality assurance job roles
  • BA/BS (4 year) degree in and IT or math related field/ or equivalent years of experience
  • Primary work locations in Tacoma, WA, Aurora, CO, San Antonio, TX, and Falls Church, VA. (Remote or hybrid work may be considered in special cases when approved by the customer.)
  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Public Trust Clearance/ or ability to obtain one

Experience working within Military Health environments is a plus

Details

Target Salary Range: $51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

Our challenge

We are looking for a meticulous SDET to contribute to and review the creation of designs for production software. The SDET's responsibilities include both software development and testing tasks and focuses on the testability, robustness, and performance of production software. As such, an SDET is a test professional with advanced programming skills who can create automation testing tools and frameworks to assist the manual testing process.


The Role

Responsibilities:

  • Understanding the flow of code and how it interacts with different components.
  • Understanding project documents, customer demands, and product objectives to create and execute test cases.
  • Setting up, maintaining, and performing test automation frameworks on multiple application platforms, such as Mobile, Desktop, and Web, and building test scenarios and acceptance tests.
  • Investigating customer problems referred to you by the technical support team, testing bugs, and creating and managing bug reports.
  • Handling technical communications and understanding the customers' systems.
  • Working with deployments teams, resolving level issues for systems, coordinating on product design, and offering inputs on the testability of functional elements and product designs.
  • Noting all testing actions you have performed in daily and weekly reports.
  • Analyzing and disintegrating software systems and coordinating with other teams to enhance the overall design.


Required Skills:

  1. Programming Languages: It is required to have proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, Python, JavaScript, C#, etc.
  2. Test Automation: Must have strong expertise in designing, developing, and maintaining automation test suites using frameworks like Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Appium, etc.
  3. Database Skills: Must be familiar with database management systems such as MySQL, and PostgreSQL and must have a basic knowledge of SQL for querying databases and verifying data integrity during testing.
  4. Web Technologies: Must be familiar with web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  5. CI/ CD Tools: Must have experience and capability to integrate automated tests into CI/ CD pipelines and must have experience with deployment tools such as Jenkins, Travis CI, etc.


Nice to Have:

Experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI) or custom LLM orchestration.

descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

How would you like to influence the most successful gaming platform of all time by validating the very technology our developers use to build extraordinary games?

Role Summary:

Sony Interactive Entertainment (PlayStation) is seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to provide hands-on engineering excellence across our SDK ecosystem. This role focuses on building tools and infrastructure for analyzing the quality of the PlayStation SDK and related technology. While this is the primary domain, there are opportunities to expand into 3D graphics, spatial audio, artificial intelligence, and the fully integrated PlayStation game development environment.

We are looking for someone who wants to directly impact PlayStation technology by developing tools and automated systems that deeply analyze SDK components and platform capabilities. You will help strengthen and evolve our testing infrastructure, raise the technical bar for quality engineering, and drive confidence in every release. If you’re passionate about solving complex system-level challenges and influencing technology used by people around the world, we want to hear from you, come help us power the future of PlayStation!

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Crafting and improving automated test cases, sample applications, testing tools and frameworks for SDK libraries and low level software (C++)
  • Build and improve test infrastructure using Python and Groovy to simplify building, testing, and demonstrating PlayStation® sample applications.
  • Monitor test infrastructure, analyze automation failures, improve reliability, and optimize runtime performance.
  • Partner closely with software production and offshore teams to compose robust test plans, validation strategies, and documentation.
  • Define scalable, maintainable automation and infrastructure patterns that support long-term platform growth.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions for test systems spanning C++, embedded firmware (C), and Python-based infrastructure.
  • Identify technical risks early and drive mitigation strategies to protect release confidence.

What We're Looking For:

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including presenting technical direction to both engineers and executives.
  • Strong programming proficiency in Python & C++, as well as PyTest and GTest frameworks.
  • Self-directed, committed to producing strong results, and passionate about high-quality automation.
  • Experience building, running, and debugging software in both Windows & Linux environments.
  • Deep understanding of automation trade-offs and architectural design decisions.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Exposure to Android platform, including SDK, tooling and architecture
  • Prior experience with PlayStation SDK development is helpful.
  • Familiarity with Unity, Unreal Engine or other game engine technology.
  • Containerization technology such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Proven experience leading complex debugging efforts.

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The position also requires strong knowledge of Quality Assurance principles and QA methodologies, with hands-on involvement in designing test plans and detailed test cases in addition to automation. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect existing functionality, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by promoting test‑driven development and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400 - $115,000, based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Performs and may lead programming activities which may require research and timely, effective, and quality delivery of software into production.
  • Performs, and may lead, technical/engineering support for new and existing applications from code delivery until the retirement of the application.
  • Tests and reviews applications based on business requirements and industry best practices.
  • Uses best practices and standard guidance to create and modify code.
  • Considers how code changes will affect internal teams. May review code created by less experienced team members.
  • Collaborates with QA team to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products.
  • Participates in and may lead team in cross-functional meetings and discussions.
  • Creates required technical documentation.
  • Stays updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • Adheres to documented departmental and corporate standards. Participates in the definition and documentation of standards.
  • May lead integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • Designs and contributes to comprehensive test plans and test cases using established Quality Assurance methodologies, in addition to developing automated tests.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium).
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Must have knowledge of Quality Assurance principles and QA methodologies, including experience designing test plans and test cases
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team.

Why Jack Henry?

At Jack Henry, we live by the motto: “Do the right thing, do whatever it takes, and have fun.” It’s more than a tagline, it’s the foundation of our culture. We recognize that our associates are the key to our success, and we’re deeply committed to their wellbeing. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health so you can thrive both personally and professionally.

We’re also leading the way in technology modernization, helping financial institutions evolve with speed, security, and flexibility. Our strategy focuses on delivering secure data access, mitigating fraud, and enabling seamless integration. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders.

Culture of Commitment

Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. Our culture empowers us to rise to challenges, seek new opportunities, and support one another through change. It’s this shared commitment that drives our success. We’re proud to foster an environment where inclusion, sustainability, and community impact are more than values, they’re how we operate. Visit our Corporate Sustainability site to learn more about our culture and commitment to our people, customers, community, environment, and shareholders.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Jack Henry, we know we are better together. We value, respect, and protect the uniqueness each of us brings. Innovation flourishes by including all voices and makes our business - and our society - stronger. Jack Henry is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing equal opportunity in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, performance management, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, education, training, social, and recreational activities to all persons regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, genetic information, pregnancy, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, and military and veteran status, or any other protected status protected by local, state or federal law.

No one will be subject to, and Jack Henry prohibits, any form of discipline, reprisal, intimidation, or retaliation for good faith reports or complaints of discrimination of any kind, pursuing any discrimination claim, or cooperating in related investigations.

Requests for full corporate job descriptions may be requested through the interview process at any time.

descriptionHtml:
About Prudentia Sciences

Prudentia Sciences is an AI-powered technology platform transforming how biopharma, biotech, and life sciences investors approach portfolio management, due diligence, and value/risk simulation. Our platform accelerates investment in breakthrough therapies by:

  • Empowering biopharma to accelerate drug pipelines, maximize ROI, and achieve clinical and commercial success for greater patient impact
  • Enabling strategic positioning of asset value during portfolio planning and dealmaking
  • Equipping investors with data-driven insights to optimize capital allocation in drug asset transactions

Backed by GV (Google Ventures), McKesson, Signal Fire, Iaso Ventures, and Virtue, we're on a mission to unlock the full potential of pharmaceutical R&D by empowering decision-makers with real-time, data-driven insights.

The Opportunity

We’re hiring our first dedicated QA Engineer: a hands-on engineer who writes code, builds quality into our platform from the ground up, and cares as much about performance and reliability as about correctness.

This is a rare opportunity to join a high-impact technology company in a major growth stage, where you’ll partner closely with engineering, product, and ML teams to safeguard the trust our pharma and biopharma customers place in our platform. Our platform is quickly seeing exceptional demand in its sector, and is backed by top-tier life science investors who have an informed perspective on where AI can have a profound impact in the industry.

What You’ll Do

  • Test Automation: Design, build, and maintain automated test suites across UI, API, and data pipelines, with most coverage at the API and data layers, so the team can ship fast and with confidence as the platform scales.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Use AI coding tools (like Claude Code) daily to build and maintain tests, and know when to question their output. You understand why the code works, not just that it runs, and you keep sensitive data out of AI tools.
  • Quality Gates in CI/CD: Own the automated quality gates in our CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), deciding what blocks a release and what doesn’t. Be ruthless about eliminating flaky or long-running tests.
  • API & Contract Testing: Test at the API layer by default, and catch breaking changes between services before they reach production.
  • Performance & Reliability Testing: Own load, performance, and reliability testing so the platform meets the availability and responsiveness expectations of deal teams working with large volumes of sensitive, time-sensitive data.
  • Bug Tracking & Triage: Identify, document, and triage defects with clear reproduction steps, work with engineers to prioritize fixes, and make clear go/no-go release calls.
  • Data & Output Validation: Validate the accuracy and consistency of ML-driven outputs (risk analyses, valuations, scientific assessments) as they move from the orchestration layer into user-facing views.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Help verify secure handling of sensitive scientific and deal data, including keeping each customer’s data separate
  • Collaboration & Process: Work cross-functionally with engineers, product leads, and domain experts to translate scientific and business requirements into clear, testable acceptance criteria.
  • Continuous Improvement: Champion a quality-first culture: advocate for testability in design reviews, improve test coverage over time, and stay current on modern QA tooling and practices.

Who You Are

Core Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • QA Experience: Proven experience testing modern web applications and designing and building automated test suites, ideally as the person who owned them.
  • Test Automation Tools: Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and API testing tools (e.g., pytest, REST-assured, pactflow).
  • CI/CD Integration: Experience owning automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), including setting up quality gates and managing flaky tests.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in your daily work, with a habit of verifying what they produce.
  • Performance Testing: Experience designing load or performance tests and finding real bottlenecks.
  • Technical Fluency: Comfort reading code and working directly with engineers to understand system architecture, APIs, and data flows well enough to design meaningful tests.
  • Data-Driven Applications: Experience testing applications with complex, data-driven workflows.
  • Bug Tracking & Communication: Skilled at writing clear, reproducible bug reports and explaining quality risks and release readiness to the team.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Familiarity with best practices for secure data handling and testing in regulated or sensitive-data environments
  • Collaboration & Product Mindset: Strong communication and collaboration skills; ability to work closely with engineers, product managers, and scientific domain experts to deliver a high-quality user experience.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Your work directly enables breakthrough therapies to reach patients faster
  • Ownership: Build and lead the platform as a foundational engineering leader
  • Growth: Shape our product experience during a critical scaling phase
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and equity
  • Team: Collaborative, mission-driven colleagues passionate about transforming biopharma

Location

We are prioritizing candidates who can be flexibly hybrid twice per week (Tues/Thurs) from our Boston, NYC, or San Francisco office. If we find truly exceptional talent, we may consider fully remote in the United States.

Compensation Range: $120K - $145K

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The position also requires strong knowledge of Quality Assurance principles and QA methodologies, with hands-on involvement in designing test plans and detailed test cases in addition to automation. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect existing functionality, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by promoting test‑driven development and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400 - $115,000, based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

  • Uses best practices and standard guidance to create and modify code.
  • Considers how code changes will affect internal teams. May review code created by less experienced team members.
  • Collaborates with QA team to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products.
  • Participates in and may lead team in cross-functional meetings and discussions.
  • Creates required technical documentation.
  • Stays updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • Adheres to documented departmental and corporate standards. Participates in the definition and documentation of standards.
  • May lead integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • Designs and contributes to comprehensive test plans and test cases using established Quality Assurance methodologies, in addition to developing automated tests.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium).
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Must have knowledge of Quality Assurance principles and QA methodologies, including experience designing test plans and test cases
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer: Automation, you specialize in creating and maintaining automated testing solutions for IT systems and applications. You possess in-depth knowledge of various test automation tools and technologies to optimize testing processes.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Develop Automation Solutions: Design and implement automated testing solutions to ensure efficient and reliable software delivery, utilizing expertise in test automation tools and technologies.
  • Build Optimized Test Scenarios: Create optimized test scenarios to streamline testing processes, aligning with contemporary trends like Agile, DevOps, and Containers.
  • Manage Test Data and Environment: Develop and maintain automation for managing test data and environment-related automation to support seamless testing processes.
  • Integrate Testing Automation: Collaborate to integrate testing automation into overall delivery automation, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and methodologies.
  • Execute Tests: Apply expertise in automation to execute tests, ensuring high-quality software delivery and identifying areas for process improvement.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Test Automation Tools Expertise: Exposure to various test automation tools and technologies, with the ability to design and implement automated testing solutions for IT systems and applications.
  • Automated Testing Solution Development: Experience working with test automation tools to build optimized test scenarios, ensuring efficient and reliable software delivery.
  • Test Data Management: Exposure to automation for managing test data and environment-related automation, supporting seamless testing processes.
  • Delivery Automation Integration: Experience working with integrating testing automation into overall delivery automation, aligning with contemporary trends like Agile, DevOps, and Containers.
  • Automated Test Execution: Exposure to applying expertise in automation to execute tests, ensuring high-quality software delivery and identifying areas for process improvement.
  • Preferred Skills: Test Mgmt, Mainframes, Java, Pega, Kafka, Cloud, Devin AI, Salesforce, US Healthcare, Perf. Testing.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Contemporary Trends Knowledge: Exposure to contemporary trends like Agile, DevOps, and Containers, with the ability to align testing automation with these methodologies.
  • Test Automation Optimization: Experience working with various test automation tools and technologies to optimize testing processes and ensure efficient software delivery.
  • Delivery Automation Understanding: Exposure to integrating testing automation into overall delivery automation, with the ability to collaborate and ensure alignment with organizational goals and methodologies.

descriptionHtml:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to invent, disrupt and redefine what entertainment means for fans, creators, and communities all around the globe?

As part of the Prime Video team, you’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. Also, you’ll get to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented creatives, technologists, marketing professionals and so much more, you can decide where a career with Prime Video takes you!

Join Amazon's Prime Video Ads QA team, where we ensure seamless ad delivery across millions of customers worldwide and deliver high-quality advertising experiences at scale.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for Prime Video Ads platform, ensuring high coverage across functional, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Participate in org-level quality initiatives and define QA strategy & test plans across multiple concurrent projects, collaborating with engineering, product, and data science teams.
  • Leverage AI in test automation to generate test cases, predict risk areas, detect anomalies, and accelerate defect resolution.
  • Drive shift-left testing practices by embedding quality early in the software development lifecycle, including requirements review and design validation.
  • Track quality metrics and KPIs, providing data-driven insights to stakeholders on release readiness.
  • Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively drive improvements to reduce customer-impacting defects.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, ensuring automated tests are integrated and executed efficiently across build and deployment workflows.

A day in the life

As a QAE on the Prime Video Ads team, your day involves collaborating with engineers, program and product managers to review requirements, identify risks early, and define test strategies. You'll write and review automation scripts, triage failures in CI/CD pipelines, and leverage AI tools to improve test coverage. You will optimize QA processes using AI adoption. You'll participate in sprint ceremonies, contribute to design reviews, and mentor junior QA engineers. You'll also partner with development teams to validate ad delivery and measurement accuracy, and present quality metrics to stakeholders to drive release readiness decisions.

About The Team

The Prime Video Ads QA team is at the forefront of ensuring seamless and high-quality advertising experiences for millions of customers worldwide. We are a passionate group of quality engineers who thrive on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Our team works closely with engineering, product, and data science teams to deliver reliable and impactful advertising solutions at scale. We embrace a culture of ownership, where every team member is empowered to drive quality initiatives and make a meaningful impact. We are committed to leveraging AI tools and automation to stay ahead in a fast-paced, ever-evolving landscape.

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience in manual testing
  • Experience in automation testing
  • Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in API & Mobile testing
  • Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

Job Description

Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a SDET Analyst II to join our ever evolving Software Engineering team and help shape the future of global commerce.

Performs and participates in application development and testing to apply continuous quality and testability of code throughout the software development lifecycle. Builds quality within the software development process with automated testing suites providing a comprehensive view from code quality to functionality. Uses quality paradigms to provide real time quality with use of automation and frequent regression testing. Designs / develops and maintains automation frameworks and automation test suites and scripts with continuous integration, testing, deployment and delivery. Conducts performance, load, security and service virtualization testing.

What you’ll own:

  • Participates in all steps of the software development life cycle and is accountable for producing quality code. Participates within a collaborative software development approach to identify and recommend practices for quality assurance at the source using automation. Conducts basic impact analysis, evaluates and identifies affects to regression test suites, testability of code, and application performance to reduce negative influences on continuous testing. Performs quality checks along with updating of automation scripts. Identifies and designs basic testing suites for test driven development (TDD) and behavior driven development (BDD) to allow early and frequent testing as the software is developed.
  • Writes and executes moderately complex application tests at the source code level to prevent hidden errors (i.e., white box testing) within unit and component testing. Identifies and suggests moderate improvements for code quality to improve deficiencies from functionality through structure of code for performance and maintainability. Builds, maintains and reviews mid-level unit and component test suites and conducts automated white box tests. Identifies basic improper coding and code quality issues. Integrates white box test suites with continuous integration (CI) tools. Programs and creates basic to mid-level test cases using unit and component testing tools for code level testing.
  • Develops standard software tools, frameworks and utilities for validation / verification activities and end-to-end functional testing of software. Identifies and recommends tools and frameworks for testing and creates automated tools for generic use and maintainability. Writes standard code that uses / exercises non-user interface (UI) components like application program interface's (API's), representational state transfer API (RESTful API), and web services similar to the end user to develop frameworks for testing. Integrates automated suites with continuous integration (CI) tools for frequent execution.
  • Installs and uses basic to moderately complex CI frameworks in continuous testing and continuous deployment / delivery. Builds, customizes, and deploys basic to moderately complex test environments and test automation frameworks. Performs basic to moderately complex scripting, data generation, and other methods to maintain automation infrastructure throughout the development. Integrates CI tools with other testing infrastructure and develops basic to moderately complex reporting / metrics on CI.
  • Uses performance, load, security, and service virtualization testing tools to conduct basic testing, analysis and results interpretation. Builds, scripts, and generates data used in testing. Analyzes moderately complex system performance and responses during loads. Applies a basic knowledge of procedures, methodology and/or application standards to include payment card industry and security related compliance to testing activities using automation. Applies knowledge of service virtualization concepts and its applicability for application testing.
  • Works with stakeholders, business, developers and other analysts to develop test plans, conditions and cases (set of inputs, execution preconditions, and expected outcomes developed for a particular objective, such as to exercise a particular program path or to verify compliance with a specific requirement) to be used in testing, and learns to perform test data conditioning and execution of test sets. Begins to build a base knowledge of using multiple environments to validate test conditions and reviews data values while learning the various components of the systems and the applications. Reports, tracks defects and defect resolutions, closure and participates in root cause analysis.
  • Acts as a single point of contact for assigned small, less complex client projects with regard to test activities. Coordinates the test activities assigned to the test team to include, reviewing of client test plans cases and scripts, prioritizing test execution when necessary and providing feedback to internal and external clients.

What you'll bring:

  • Bachelor's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree; additional experience in lieu of degree will be considered
  • Typically Minimum 2 Years Relevant Exp - Professional experience with software testing, coding, designing, and developing

It’s a bonus if you have:

  • Master's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree
  • Typically Minimum 4 Years Relevant Exp - Experience developing automated testing strategies in a variety of environments and frameworks
  • Proven ability to translate functional stories and use-cases into working test plans using Behavior Driven Development (BDD) methodologies
  • Experience with automated testing tools including Selenium, Gherkin, Cucumber, Cypress, Behave, Locust, or similar is required
  • A Python or JAVA background is required
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and AWS Cloud is strongly preferred
  • Comfortable working in an Agile Scrum development environment
  • Demonstrated skill in adhering to coding best practices and being an active participant in code reviews
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills is a must
  • Experience with accounts payable, accounting, or invoice processing is a plus

Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

What makes a Globalpayer?

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team.

We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do. Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

Our perks - what we’ll bring for you

We know it’s bigger than just your career. It’s your life, and your world. That’s why we offer global benefits and programs to support you at every stage. Here’s a taste of what you can expect.

  • A competitive salary and benefits package that recognizes your contribution
  • Opportunities to grow your skills and build your career within a global business
  • Access to learning, development and on-the-job experiences that expand your expertise
  • A supportive, inclusive team environment where your ideas and input matter
  • Time to give back through community and charity initiatives
  • A global employee assistance programme to support your wellbeing
  • Recognition through a global platform that celebrates your achievements

Overview

Good things are happening at Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies —an A+ (Superior) rated, nationwide Property & Casualty insurer backed by Berkshire Hathaway. With supportive leadership, collaborative teams, and opportunities to grow, GUARD is a place where people build meaningful, long‑term careers.

Good Things You Can Count On.

  • Hybrid schedule: 2 days remote / 3 in‑office
  • Predictable hours (no nights, weekends, or holidays)
  • Competitive pay + generous PTO
  • Medical, dental & vision starting day one
  • 401(k), tuition reimbursement & longevity bonuses

Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled and experienced QA Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust automated testing solutions. This role requires a deeper understanding of automation frameworks and the ability to lead testing efforts for complex features and systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement scalable and maintainable automated test frameworks using Tricentis Tosca and other tools.
  • Analyze business and functional requirements related to P&C insurance systems and translate them into effective automated test strategies and plans.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API testing, accessibility testing across web and backend systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, developers, and product owners to ensure test coverage and quality.
  • Execute automated test cases, log defects, and track them to closure using Azure DevOps.
  • Develop automated tests for APIs, UI, and backend systems.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and review their test scripts.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze test results, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
  • Maintain test documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across QA teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in software testing, preferably in the P&C insurance domain
  • 3–5 years of experience in test automation.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools, with a strong emphasis on Tricentis Tosca and Playwright; experience with Selenium, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks is also preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL for backend/database testing.
  • Experience with API testing using tools like Postman or REST Assured.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong understanding of Agile QA methodologies, test planning, and defect management.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Optional Certifications (Preferred But Not Required):

  • Tricentis Tosca Automation Specialist Level 1 & 2
  • ISTQB Certified Tester – Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer
  • Certified Agile Tester (CAT)
  • Certified Jenkins Engineer (CJE)
  • Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional

Salary Range $56,000.00 - $130,000.00

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, this range represents a good-faith estimate. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, credentials, geographic location, and other considerations permitted by law.

This role may be based out of any of our office locations, including:

Parsippany, NJ; Conshohocken, PA; Wilkes ‑ Barre, PA; Alpharetta, GA; Scottsdale, AZ

Interview Integrity Notice: Berkshire Hathaway GUARD is committed to a fair and consistent hiring process. Candidates are expected to participate independently in interviews. Unauthorized recording, transcription, AI note-taking, or AI interview assistance tools may not be used during interviews without prior approval.

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

As a Quality Engineer: Automation, you specialize in creating and maintaining automated testing solutions for IT systems and applications. You possess in-depth knowledge of various test automation tools and technologies to optimize testing processes.

  • Develop Automation Solutions: Design and build optimized test scenarios, develop automation for executing tests, and manage test data and environment-related automation to ensure efficient and reliable software delivery.

  • Test Environment Management: Experience in overseeing test data and environment-related automation to ensure seamless testing and delivery processes.

  • Delivery Automation: Experience in collaborating with teams to ensure that automated testing solutions meet the required standards and contribute to efficient and reliable software delivery.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by participating in product architecture discussions, promoting test‑driven development, and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400 - $115,000, based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Performs and may lead system analysis and programming activities which may require research and timely, effective, and quality delivery of software into production.
  • Performs, and may lead, technical/engineering support for new and existing applications from code delivery until the retirement of the application.
  • Develops, tests and reviews applications based on business requirements and industry best practices.
  • Uses best practices and standard guidance to create and modify code. Considers how code changes will affect end users and internal teams. May review code created by less experienced team members.
  • Collaborates with QA team to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products.
  • Performs, and may lead, work with cross-team as projects dictate.
  • Works on, and may lead, critical tasks and deliverables with no assistance, and sets and updates expectations on size, scope, and timelines.
  • Participates in and may lead team in cross-functional meetings and discussions.
  • Creates required technical documentation.
  • Stays updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • Adheres to documented departmental and corporate standards. Participates in the definition and documentation of standards.
  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium).
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0252018

Are you looking for an opportunity to leverage your software engineering expertise in a high-impact role? You should have a background in software engineering and be able to learn new languages and technologies. You should have expertise in software engineering and quality assurance of complex web applications. You should be able to design technical solutions, make recommendations, and collaborate with testing and development teams.

Join us as we launch next-generation cybersecurity products.

The world can’t wait.

  • 2+ years of experience on web application development teams fielding production systems
  • 2+ years of experience with programming, including Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, or .NET
  • 2+ years of experience with Agile development tools, including Git, Jira, or Wikis
  • Experience with test frameworks, including Selenium or Playwright
  • Experience with web-based user interfaces, REST APIs, and databases
  • Experience with test automation in CI/CD, including Jenkins or Github Actions
  • Knowledge of complex web-based application functions, modules, integrations, or data
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with SQL, Windows Server, IIS, Containers, and Linux
  • Experience with DevSecOps and GitOps
  • Experience with security tools, including Github CodeQL or Static Code Analysis
  • Master's degree

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.

Applications accepted until further notice.

Meet The Team

The Cisco Wireless team ensures the quality, reliability, and performance of next-generation wireless products. We work closely with development, platform, and system teams to validate features, automate test coverage, and reproduce real-world customer scenarios at scale. Our work directly impacts the experience of millions of users relying on Cisco wireless infrastructure.

Your Impact

Role

As a QA / Automation Engineer, you will contribute to validating Cisco’s wireless platforms by writing test plans, developing automation, and analyzing system behavior. You will gain hands-on experience with real networking environments, lab setups, and modern AI-assisted development tools. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy breaking systems, understanding how they work, and ensuring high-quality product delivery. In This Role, You Will:

  • Write and execute test plans and test cases for wireless features and systems
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts using Python or similar languages
  • Analyze test results and identify issues, inconsistencies, or performance gaps
  • Reproduce customer and system issues in controlled lab environments
  • Assist in setting up and maintaining testbeds and lab environments (routers, switches, access points)
  • Collaborate with development and platform teams to debug and resolve issues
  • Learn and apply AI-assisted tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to improve testing efficiency and automation

Minimum Qualification

  • Meet one of the following (completed within the past 3 years or expected to be completed within the next 12 months):
  • A Master's degree with 0 years of work experience; or
  • A Bachelor's degree with 2 years of work experience.
  • Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Network Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong programming fundamentals, preferably in Python or a similar scripting language, with a basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, and routing.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented approach to troubleshooting system behavior.
  • Curious and interested in AI-enabled engineering practices, including using AI tools to improve productivity.

Preferred Qualification

  • Exposure to networking devices (routers, switches, access points) through coursework, labs, or internships
  • Familiarity with setting up small network environments
  • Basic understanding of wireless technologies (Wi-Fi / 802.11)
  • Certifications such as CCNA (or working toward it)

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees
  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco
  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees
  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)
  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next
  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members
  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees On Sales Plans Earn Performance-based Incentive Pay On Top Of Their Base Salary, Which Is Split Between Quota And Non-quota Components, Subject To The Applicable Cisco Plan. For Quota-based Incentive Pay, Cisco Typically Pays As Follows

  • .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;
  • 1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;
  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and
  • Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by participating in product architecture discussions, promoting test‑driven development, and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400 - $115,000, based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Performs and may lead system analysis and programming activities which may require research and timely, effective, and quality delivery of software into production.
  • Performs, and may lead, technical/engineering support for new and existing applications from code delivery until the retirement of the application.
  • Develops, tests and reviews applications based on business requirements and industry best practices.
  • Uses best practices and standard guidance to create and modify code. Considers how code changes will affect end users and internal teams. May review code created by less experienced team members.
  • Collaborates with QA team to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products.
  • Performs, and may lead, work with cross-team as projects dictate.
  • Works on, and may lead, critical tasks and deliverables with no assistance, and sets and updates expectations on size, scope, and timelines.
  • Participates in and may lead team in cross-functional meetings and discussions.
  • Creates required technical documentation.
  • Stays updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • Adheres to documented departmental and corporate standards. Participates in the definition and documentation of standards.
  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium).
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.
