descriptionHtml:
Job Description

It’s about putting our best to the test.

Are you described as someone with an inquisitive mind and an innovative personality? Are you never satisfied with good enough? Does solving complex problems and ensuring top-quality applications excite you? If so, being a Quality Automation Engineer III with Frost could be for you.

At Frost, it’s about more than a job. It’s about having a flourishing career where you can thrive, both in and out of work. At Frost, we’re committed to fostering an environment that reflects our values and encourages team members to be the best they can be. In joining our adaptable, integrity-driven team, you’ll become part of Frost’s over 150-year legacy of providing unparalleled banking services.

Who You Are

As a Quality Automation Engineer III, you are our quality control, ensuring every application is stable and built with integrity, caring and excellence. You’ll play an important role in the design, creation, and testing of applications to ensure the quality and stability in every system. You’ll use your strong problem-solving skills to ensure that the applications are performing optimally and meet our high standards. You are not afraid to ask the question why and thrive in a collaborative environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Oversee, design, review, build, and deploy test automation solutions and framework for the most complex, interrelated systems to ensure the quality and stability of software applications
  • Lead the troubleshooting and triage of the most complex escalated system issues with project teams to identify the root causes, resolve issues, and implement process improvements
  • Guide and mentor other Test Automation Engineers to ensure that their test automation solutions and scripts align with Frost’s automation framework and industry standards
  • Collaborate with product management, project management, development teams, and business stakeholders to develop project, product, and testing objectives
  • Write and execute functional test cases as needed
  • Always take action using Integrity, Caring, and Excellence to achieve all-win outcomes

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience
  • 4+ years of test automation experience
  • Technical development experience with multiple programming or scripting languages while using Selenium as framework
  • Expertise with JAVA and SQL queries
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented programming concepts
  • Expertise in independently identifying technical issues including misconfigurations and defects in code
  • Demonstrated experience in developing functional, load, and batch test automation solutions
  • Expert knowledge of the role of Test Automation and Software Quality Assurance in the development process
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and design patterns
  • Experience with a distributed version-control management system like GIT

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Selenium WebDriver
  • Experience using automated testing tools like Junit, TestNG, Cucumber, Appium, JMeter, SoapUI
  • Knowledge of DevOps including Jenkins, Maven etc.
  • Knowledge of Non-Functional Testing (Performance, Security and Accessibility Testing)

Our Benefits

At Frost, we care about your health, your family, and your future and strive to have our benefits reflect that. This includes:

  • Medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and life insurance
  • 401(k) matching
  • Generous holiday and paid time off schedule
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Extensive health and wellness programs, including our Employee Assistance Program
  • Referral bonus program + more!

Since 1868, Frost has dedicated their expertise to provide exceptional banking, investment, and insurance services to businesses and individuals throughout Texas. Frost is one of the 50 largest U.S. banks by asset size and is a leader in banking customer satisfaction. At Frost, it’s about being part of something bigger. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply and see what’s possible at Frost.

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an SDET / Senior QA Engineer to accelerate functional testing through AI-augmented tools and intelligent automation. You will leverage Claude AI, Playwright, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) to design and execute comprehensive functional tests to reduce manual effort while maintaining rigorous quality standards.

As the last line of defense before production releases, you will ensure our Trading Platforms and related products function according to requirements by using AI to intelligently generate tests, analyze defects, and optimize test execution. You are passionate about quality but impatient with manual, repetitive testing, you use AI and smart tooling to amplify human expertise.

Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze system specifications
  • Collaborate with team members to develop effective strategies and test plans
  • Use Claude AI to automatically generate test cases, test scenarios from requirements and user stories
  • Leverage Claude for intelligent test locator generation (Playwright selectors) to handle complex financial application UIs
  • Write and execute Playwright-based functional tests that cover critical user scenarios and Order & Trading workflows
  • Use AI to analyze test failures, suggest root causes, and recommend fixes
  • Apply MCP to connect Claude with requirements systems, defect trackers, and test execution logs for full-context analysis
  • Conduct post-release/ post-implementation testing
  • Troubleshoot system issues within QA, development and product management
  • Work with cross-functional teams (dev, product, business) to validate quality throughout SDLC

Knowledge And Experience

  • BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
  • 5+ years in Quality Assurance or software testing roles
  • Proven ability to design comprehensive test cases and test plans
  • Strong experience in functional, regression, and integration testing
  • Hands-on experience with SQL for database validation and test data queries
  • Experience in project management and QA methodology
  • Working knowledge of test management software (e.g. Jira and ALM)
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Analytical mind and problem-solving aptitude
  • Strong organizational skills

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Fixed Income and/or Derivative Trading Platforms, a big plus
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks and regression testing is a plus

descriptionHtml:
Standard Job Description

What We're Doing

Become a part of something IMPACT-ful! Ground Missile Defense (GMD) is the heart of the Missile Defense System and a key element of our nation’s defense against ballistic missile attacks.

The GMD Weapon System (GWS) processes data from multiple sensors to identify and characterize the inbound ballistic missile threat, plans the best defensive solution, and launches the intercepting missiles to negate the threat.

Who We Are

Lockheed Martin is a global aerospace, defense, and security company dedicated to advancing scientific discovery and harnessing innovation to make the world a safer place. Our RMS business in Huntsville, AL is a hub of talented engineers, scientists, and professionals committed to shaping the future of defense technology. We value collaboration, excellence, and integrity in everything we do. As a part of our team, you will work alongside like-minded individuals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

Why Join Us

  • Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life
  • Our flexible schedules, competitive pay and comprehensive benefits enable you to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work.

The Work

The selected Principal Test Engineer responsibilities will include the support of the GWS-GSS IPT. You be responsible for scheduling the tests for execution and then will monitor, measure, control and report on the test progress, the product quality status and the test results, adapting the test plan and compensating as needed to adjust for evolving conditions.

Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline preferred from an accredited university and 5 years of related experience, or a Master's Degree and 3 years of related experience, or 1 years of experience with a PhD.

  • Design, develop, implement, and execute test plans, integration plans, and procedures to complete system-level integration testing.
  • Ability to understand and interpret requirements and test guidance to complete system-level integration testing.
  • Experience developing testing criteria to successfully satisfy requirements.
  • Experience in C++ development
  • Experience using Python and other scripting languages
  • Experience using Eggplant or other GUI based toolset
  • Experience with Gitlab or Bitbucket
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% to support business needs.

Applicants must have a current active in-scope U.S. Government DoD issued Secret security clearance at the time of application, which is required to start.

Desired Skills

  • Security+ certification
  • GMD/MDA Experience
  • Java experience/understanding
  • Experience using Cameo

Active, in-scope U.S. Government DoD Top Secret clearance

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $98100.00 - $182100.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

descriptionHtml:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.

Applications accepted until further notice.

Meet The Team

The Cisco Wireless team ensures the quality, reliability, and performance of next-generation wireless products. We work closely with development, platform, and system teams to validate features, automate test coverage, and reproduce real-world customer scenarios at scale. Our work directly impacts the experience of millions of users relying on Cisco wireless infrastructure.

Your Impact

Role

As a QA / Automation Engineer, you will contribute to validating Cisco’s wireless platforms by writing test plans, developing automation, and analyzing system behavior. You will gain hands-on experience with real networking environments, lab setups, and modern AI-assisted development tools. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy breaking systems, understanding how they work, and ensuring high-quality product delivery. In This Role, You Will:

  • Write and execute test plans and test cases for wireless features and systems
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts using Python or similar languages
  • Analyze test results and identify issues, inconsistencies, or performance gaps
  • Reproduce customer and system issues in controlled lab environments
  • Assist in setting up and maintaining testbeds and lab environments (routers, switches, access points)
  • Collaborate with development and platform teams to debug and resolve issues
  • Learn and apply AI-assisted tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to improve testing efficiency and automation

Minimum Qualification

  • Meet one of the following (completed within the past 3 years or expected to be completed within the next 12 months):
  • A Master's degree with 0 years of work experience; or
  • A Bachelor's degree with 2 years of work experience.
  • Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Network Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong programming fundamentals, preferably in Python or a similar scripting language, with a basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, and routing.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented approach to troubleshooting system behavior.
  • Curious and interested in AI-enabled engineering practices, including using AI tools to improve productivity.

Preferred Qualification

  • Exposure to networking devices (routers, switches, access points) through coursework, labs, or internships
  • Familiarity with setting up small network environments
  • Basic understanding of wireless technologies (Wi-Fi / 802.11)
  • Certifications such as CCNA (or working toward it)

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next
  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

Job Description

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.

As a Software Engineer II at JPMorganChase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

Job Responsibilities

  • Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or break down technical problems
  • Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
  • Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
  • Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
  • Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
  • Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture
  • Contributes to software engineering communities of practice and events that explore new and emerging technologies
  • Adds to team culture of diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 2+ years applied experience
  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Hands-on experience in QA automation / SDET / test engineering.
  • Fluent programming skills in at least one of: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Java (able to design/maintain frameworks and debug effectively).
  • Hands-on experience with UI automation and backend/API automation (tooling is flexible; engineering quality and maintainability are essential).
  • Knowledge of testing practices (functional, regression, negative testing, test design) and strong QA fundamentals.
  • Working knowledge of databases and SQL for test data validation and verification.
  • Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
  • Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
  • Exposure to agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Strong experience with Playwright (preferred) and/or Selenium.
  • Performance testing exposure (e.g., JMeter or similar).
  • Cloud experience (e.g., AWS) and scaling test execution (parallelization, containers).
  • Track record of improving pipeline reliability (flake reduction, better test data strategy, observability/metrics).

10+ years of professional hands on experience in Selenium Automation with Java Development.

Must have Banking experience and good to have Payments processing experience.

Hands-on in design and developing automated testing systems and frameworks.

Proven work experience as a QA Architect or similar role in software development.

Experience with automated testing tools and methodologies Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes.

Excellent problem-solving skills.

Ability to document and troubleshoot errors

Working knowledge of agile frameworks and regression testing

Architect and implement scalable automation frameworks using Java, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, and Cucumber (BDD).

Drive UI, API strategies across web platforms

Lead test planning, framework enhancement, and integration of automation into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps).

Validate Kafka-based event-driven systems with real-time message verification techniques.

Perform ETL testing and data validation using advanced SQL queries on Oracle and SQL Server.

Lead test efforts for Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud, including workflows, case management, and data validation.

Execute mobile automation testing using Appium and real devices/emulators in varying network conditions.

Mentor and lead QA teams, perform code reviews, and align testing goals with Agile sprint cycles.

Engage in defect triage, maintain traceability matrices, and report on automation ROI and quality metrics.

Salary Range- $100,000-$120,000 a year

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by participating in product architecture discussions, promoting test‑driven development, and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400 - $115,000, based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Performs and may lead system analysis and programming activities which may require research and timely, effective, and quality delivery of software into production.
  • Performs, and may lead, technical/engineering support for new and existing applications from code delivery until the retirement of the application.
  • Develops, tests and reviews applications based on business requirements and industry best practices.
  • Uses best practices and standard guidance to create and modify code. Considers how code changes will affect end users and internal teams. May review code created by less experienced team members.
  • Collaborates with QA team to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products.
  • Performs, and may lead, work with cross-team as projects dictate.
  • Works on, and may lead, critical tasks and deliverables with no assistance, and sets and updates expectations on size, scope, and timelines.
  • Participates in and may lead team in cross-functional meetings and discussions.
  • Creates required technical documentation.
  • Stays updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • Adheres to documented departmental and corporate standards. Participates in the definition and documentation of standards.
  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium).
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

We recognize that our associates are the key to our success, and we’re deeply committed to their wellbeing. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health so you can thrive both personally and professionally.

We’re also leading the way in technology modernization, helping financial institutions evolve with speed, security, and flexibility. Our strategy focuses on delivering secure data access, mitigating fraud, and enabling seamless integration. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders.

Culture of Commitment

Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. Our culture empowers us to rise to challenges, seek new opportunities, and support one another through change. It’s this shared commitment that drives our success. We’re proud to foster an environment where inclusion, sustainability, and community impact are more than values, they’re how we operate. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect existing functionality, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by promoting test‑driven development and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

descriptionHtml:
Join a National Top Workplace

Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals who are ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture. As a partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are leaders in loyalty, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.

Join Us from Anywhere

While our headquarters are nestled in sunny St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie embraces a flexible work environment, offering teammates the freedom to work remotely. We understand the importance of work-life balance and support our team with:

  • Flexible Time Off to recharge when needed
  • Nine Company-Wide Holidays
  • A diverse suite of benefits prioritizing your growth, development, and personal well-being

Benefits

Discover more about our perks and benefits here.

Kobie is a values-led organization where we believe that everyone is a leader, regardless of their position or role.

Travel Requirements:

As a remote-first organization headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie values meaningful in-person connection and collaboration that strengthens our teams, supports our clients, and enhances our culture. While travel requirements vary by role, periodic travel may be required to support business objectives, team collaboration, customer engagements, training, and company events. Candidates should be able and willing to travel as needed to fulfill the responsibilities of the role.

About The Team And What We'll Build Together

We are a team of software developers building the next-generation customer loyalty platform. Our software delivers surprise and delight every day for millions of customers for some of the best-loved brands in the world. As part of this team you’ll help us deliver software more predictably, more reliably, and with higher quality than we ever have before.

How You Will Make An Impact

  • This is both an enablement and an execution role. You’ll enable teams by providing them with the environment and knowledge to run a robust quality program. You’ll execute by performing tests where appropriate. You are a software engineer first, a quality practitioner second
  • You’ll change the way we develop and ship reliable software by “shifting left” on quality, automating our tests, and moving the needle on our key quality metrics
  • You’ll guide our world-class software engineering team on our continuous improvement journey
  • You’ll enable our engineering teams to thoroughly test their own code through tooling, piloting, advocacy, and education
  • Over time you’ll show continual, meaningful software quality progress, leading to high confidence among business stakeholders, partners, and clients.

What You Need To Be Successful

  • 0-3 years experience as a software developer, Software Developer in Test, or a similar role.
  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent, or analogous work experience.
  • Fluency in software testing methodologies: white box, black box, unit, integration, functional, performance, etc.)
  • Bias toward automation over manual testing. Proven track record automating complex software testing in real-world enterprise environments.
  • Expertise in proven testing frameworks, mocking frameworks, and curiosity to explore state of the art.
  • Production software coding experience is a must.
  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Java, Python, C#, or JavaScript.
  • Experience with test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, Cypress, Playwright, Cucumber, Karate).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps).
  • Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner), a plus.
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), a plus.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, OCI), a plus.
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture, a plus.
  • ISTQB or other relevant certifications, a plus.
  • Experience with compliance (SOC, HITRUST, etc.) a plus.

Who we are As a trusted partner, Kobie delivers market-leading, end-to-end loyalty solutions designed to enable customer experiences for the world's most successful brands. We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level. We believe that our team's passion and expertise are the driving forces behind our success and are proud to be named a Top Workplaces in the USA, where the best and brightest in loyalty drive our mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty.

A place for all We celebrate and embrace diversity at Kobie!

Employment at Kobie is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to professional competence. We do not discriminate against any teammate or applicant because of race,color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are fiercely committed to fostering a workplace where teammates can bring their authentic selves to work every day. Our DEI initiatives, including various committees, ensure that principles of equity, diversity, and inclusion are deeply ingrained throughout Kobie. While our leadership team fully supports our policy of nondiscrimination and equal opportunity, it is the responsibility of all teammates to uphold these values.

Ready to join us? If you’re ready to make an impact and grow in a supportive, innovative environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and join the best and brightest in loyalty!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Job Description

The Team

We are seeking a Senior Test Automation Engineer to join the Information Technology organization’s Quality Assurance team at American Tower. The team focuses on improving software quality, strengthening automated regression coverage, and supporting reliable delivery across enterprise platforms. Day to day you will design, develop, maintain, and execute scalable automated test solutions using modern automation tools and frameworks while helping advance automation standards, continuous integration and continuous delivery integration, and quality engineering practices. As a Senior Test Automation Engineer, you will collaborate closely with Quality Assurance, development, business analyst, product owner, and application teams to validate critical business processes, identify quality risks, and deliver automation solutions that improve test efficiency, coverage, and release confidence.

Responsibilities

What You Can Offer Us

  • Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts and frameworks for enterprise applications using tools such as Unified Functional Testing (UFT), Tosca, Playwright, and/or similar automation platforms.
  • Partner with Quality Assurance, development, business analyst, and product teams to understand requirements, identify automation opportunities, and validate critical business processes.
  • Lead automation design and implementation for regression, functional, integration, and end-to-end testing across applications such as Salesforce, Oracle E-Business Suite, and other similar platforms.
  • Integrate automated tests with continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, test management tools, and reporting solutions to support repeatable execution, traceability, and release readiness.
  • Review test results, troubleshoot automation failures, identify quality risks, and collaborate with teams to drive timely defect resolution and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor Quality Assurance team members on automation best practices, coding standards, and quality engineering approaches.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications

What You Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, and/or a related field strongly preferred.
  • A minimum of 6 years of software quality assurance experience required.
  • Hands-on experience designing and developing test automation solutions for enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Oracle E-Business Suite, web applications, application programming interfaces, and/or similar business-critical platforms required.
  • Experience creating and maintaining automated test scripts using tools such as Unified Functional Testing, Tosca, Playwright, Selenium, and/or similar platforms required.
  • Working knowledge of scripting languages, test management processes, defect tracking, and integration of test automation into software delivery pipelines required.
  • Fluency in English required; multilingual capabilities preferred.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and suggestions clearly and effectively.
  • Ability to work with different functional groups and levels of employees to effectively and professionally achieve results.
  • Strong organizational skills; ability to accomplish multiple tasks within the established timeframes through effective prioritization of duties and functions in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and suggestions clearly and effectively.
- Ability to work with different functional groups and levels of employees to effectively and professionally achieve results.
- Strong organizational skills; ability to accomplish multiple tasks within the established timeframes through effective prioritization of duties and functions in a fast-paced environment.

Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life

While our headquarters are nestled in sunny St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie embraces a flexible work environment, offering teammates the freedom to work remotely. We understand the importance of work-life balance and support our team with:

  • Flexible Time Off to recharge when needed
  • Nine Company-Wide Holidays
  • A diverse suite of benefits prioritizing your growth, development, and personal well-being

Benefits

Discover more about our perks and benefits here.

Kobie is a values-led organization where we believe that everyone is a leader, regardless of their position or role.

Travel Requirements:

As a remote-first organization headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie values meaningful in-person connection and collaboration that strengthens our teams, supports our clients, and enhances our culture. While travel requirements vary by role, periodic travel may be required to support business objectives, team collaboration, customer engagements, training, and company events. Candidates should be able and willing to travel as needed to fulfill the responsibilities of the role.

About The Team And What We'll Build Together

We are a team of software developers building the next-generation customer loyalty platform. Our software delivers surprise and delight every day for millions of customers for some of the best-loved brands in the world. As part of this team you’ll help us deliver software more predictably, more reliably, and with higher quality than we ever have before.

How You Will Make An Impact

  • This is both an enablement and an execution role. You’ll enable teams by providing them with the environment and knowledge to run a robust quality program. You’ll execute by performing tests where appropriate. You are a software engineer first, a quality practitioner second
  • You’ll change the way we develop and ship reliable software by “shifting left” on quality, automating our tests, and moving the needle on our key quality metrics
  • You’ll guide our world-class software engineering team on our continuous improvement journey
  • You’ll enable our engineering teams to thoroughly test their own code through tooling, piloting, advocacy, and education
  • Over time you’ll show continual, meaningful software quality progress, leading to high confidence among business stakeholders, partners, and clients.

What You Need To Be Successful

  • 0-3 years experience as a software developer, Software Developer in Test, or a similar role.
  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent, or analogous work experience.
  • Fluency in software testing methodologies: white box, black box, unit, integration, functional, performance, etc.)
  • Bias toward automation over manual testing. Proven track record automating complex software testing in real-world enterprise environments.
  • Expertise in proven testing frameworks, mocking frameworks, and curiosity to explore state of the art.
  • Production software coding experience is a must.
  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Java, Python, C#, or JavaScript.
  • Experience with test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, Cypress, Playwright, Cucumber, Karate).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps).
  • Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner), a plus.
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), a plus.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, OCI), a plus.
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture, a plus.
  • ISTQB or other relevant certifications, a plus.
  • Experience with compliance (SOC, HITRUST, etc.) a plus.

Who we are As a trusted partner, Kobie delivers market-leading, end-to-end loyalty solutions designed to enable customer experiences for the world's most successful brands. We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level. We believe that our team's passion and expertise are the driving forces behind our success and are proud to be named a Top Workplaces in the USA, where the best and brightest in loyalty drive our mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty.

A place for all We celebrate and embrace diversity at Kobie!

Employment at Kobie is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to professional competence. We do not discriminate against any teammate or applicant because of race,color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are fiercely committed to fostering a workplace where teammates can bring their authentic selves to work every day. Our DEI initiatives, including various committees, ensure that principles of equity, diversity, and inclusion are deeply ingrained throughout Kobie. While our leadership team fully supports our policy of nondiscrimination and equal opportunity, it is the responsibility of all teammates to uphold these values.

Ready to join us? If you’re ready to make an impact and grow in a supportive, innovative environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and join the best and brightest in loyalty!

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

As a member of the SMGS Planning Tools team, you will shape the AWS business's direction as a whole. You will build greenfield solutions from the ground up while using native AWS services and frameworks. The right candidate will have a robust system delivery background, well-rounded technical knowledge, and demonstrated experience working on large scale projects. The candidate must be customer-obsessed, have strong analytical and communication skills, and passionate about learning new technologies.

You will work with software development engineers to understand features and technical implementation. You will also work with groups such as product management, UX designers to understand customer usage models and develop test plans and suites that approximate real-world environments and regression tests driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. About the Role: QA Automation Engineer

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical QA Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain automated testing frameworks for web, mobile, and API applications. In this role, you will bridge the gap between software development, product management, and DevOps to ensure software quality, system reliability, and seamless continuous delivery across release cycles.

Core Responsibilities

  • Test Automation Framework Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test scripts and frameworks for UI, API, and regression testing to maximize test coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
  • Test Planning & Execution: Translate product requirements and user stories into comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automated test suites. Execute functional, integration, performance, and end-to-end tests.
  • Defect Tracking & Root Cause Analysis: Identify, log, and track software defects using tools like Jira. Perform root cause analysis on test failures and collaborate with developers to verify bug fixes.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Integration: Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to enable continuous testing and rapid feedback on code deployments.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Software Developers, Product Managers, DevOps Engineers, and Manual QA teams during Agile/Scrum ceremonies to enforce quality standards throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field (Required).
  • Experience: 0–5 years of experience in QA automation, software testing, SDET roles, or software quality engineering.
  • Required Skills:
  • Strong programming and scripting skills in languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, or TestNG/JUnit).
  • Experience with API testing and automation tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured).
  • Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and defect management tools (e.g., Jira).
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and written/verbal communication skills.
  • Preferred Skills:
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker) and version control systems (Git).
  • Familiarity with performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6) and SQL for backend database validation.
  • Knowledge of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) frameworks (e.g., Cucumber).

What We Offer

  • Targeted Placement: Direct marketing to our network of hiring managers across top Tech, SaaS, FinTech, and Enterprise IT companies.
  • Technical Resume Rebuild: Optimization of your profile to highlight automation frameworks, test coverage metrics, CI/CD integration, and technical stack expertise.
  • Interview Coaching: Guidance on live coding challenges, automation framework architecture questions, and technical QA/SDET interviews.

Ready to Take the Next Step?

Email your updated resume to: yashwanth.phani@maximatek.com

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are…

Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. Verra Mobility Commercial Services creates smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for more than 8.5 million vehicles. Verra Mobility is a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year through connectivity with more than 50 individual tolling authorities and more than 400 issuing authorities. Arizona-based Verra Mobility Corp. currently operates in 15 countries and in 22 languages.

The company is constantly looking toward the future, ensuring it creates relevant solutions today that will work tomorrow. Seeking to understand new customers, regions, and businesses that will shape tomorrow’s smart mobility experiences, Verra Mobility strives to ensure more people around the world reach their destination safely and easily. Keeping its core principles front and center, Verra Mobility is fueled by relationships, driven by impact, guided by what’s right, and energized by what’s next.

Culture

Verra Mobility Corporation is a rapidly growing, entrepreneurial company that operates with a people-first philosophy and approach. The company lives by its core values—Do What’s Right, Lead with Grace, Win Together, and Own It—in everything it does for its customers and team members. The company seeks to grow aggressively, both organically and through acquisition, to continue to be the undisputed market leader with these five core competencies: bias for action, customer focus, teamwork, drive for results, and commitment to excellence.

Position Overview

Verra Mobility is seeking an experienced Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to ensure end-to-end quality of modern cloud-based and legacy enterprise applications through a combination of test design, manual testing, exploratory testing, and automated testing. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Playwright, Selenium, TypeScript, C#, API testing, microservices testing, and micro frontends testing. This role requires the ability to analyze requirements, design comprehensive test scenarios and test cases, determine what should be automated versus manually tested, execute hands-on testing when appropriate, leverage AI-assisted testing/code-generation tools, and mentor other testers.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Analyze business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical designs, and system integrations to identify test scenarios, risks, dependencies, and coverage needs.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, test data, traceability, and regression test suites covering positive, negative, boundary, exception, integration, and end-to-end business scenarios.
  • Perform hands-on functional, exploratory, integration, regression, end-to-end, and production-validation testing where manual testing provides appropriate value.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Tech Leads, Developers, Architects, and QA team members early in the SDLC to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, architecture, integrations, risks, and testability.
  • Determine the appropriate testing approach for each capability, including what should be automated, what should remain manual, and the appropriate testing layer.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, integration, and end-to-end tests using Playwright, Selenium, TypeScript, and related technologies.
  • Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable automation frameworks, components, fixtures, utilities, and test-data capabilities using sound software engineering principles.
  • Test modern applications built with React, micro frontends, C#/.NET APIs, microservices, and cloud technologies, as well as legacy applications built with .NET Framework and ASP.NET.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and establish appropriate quality gates and automated feedback during development and deployment.
  • Design automation that supports parallel execution, cross-browser testing, test-data management, environment configuration, retries where appropriate, and reliable unattended execution.
  • Analyze escaped production defects and recurring issues to identify requirements gaps, test coverage gaps, automation opportunities, and preventive improvements.
  • Effectively use generative AI/code-generation tools for requirement analysis, test scenario/test-case generation, automation development, test-data generation, debugging, defect analysis, documentation, and automation code review, while validating AI-generated outputs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years of software testing/quality engineering experience, including significant hands-on automation experience.
  • Proven ability to independently analyze requirements and create comprehensive, high-quality test scenarios and test cases.
  • Strong hands-on experience performing both manual/exploratory testing and automated testing.
  • Experience testing modern applications involving React, APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud technologies.
  • Excellent communication (written & verbal), knowledge sharing, analytical, debugging, problem-solving, collaboration, and ownership skills.
  • Experience within team environments and Agile project methodologies is a must.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, TypeScript/JavaScript, reusable automation frameworks, test fixtures, assertions, test-data management, parallel execution, and cross-browser testing.
  • Strong ability to analyze requirements and independently create and execute functional, exploratory, regression, integration, negative, boundary, exception, and end-to-end test scenarios and test cases.
  • Strong experience testing REST APIs, JSON/HTTP services, microservices, backend integrations, databases, and asynchronous/event-driven workflows.
  • Working knowledge of C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET Core, React, microservices, micro frontends, REST APIs, and legacy .NET Framework/ASP.NET applications.
  • Strong SQL/SQL Server skills for test-data preparation, backend validation, reconciliation, and defect investigation.
  • Ability to develop maintainable automation using SOLID principles, object-oriented concepts, separation of concerns, reusable components, clean code, and appropriate design patterns.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure, and CI/CD technologies such as Azure DevOps, including automated execution, pipelines, environments, reporting, logging, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong knowledge of risk-based testing, test pyramid, shift-left testing, regression strategy, defect management, root-cause analysis, traceability, test coverage, release readiness, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Strong ability to leverage generative AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, test design, automation development, test-data generation, debugging, code review, and documentation without compromising engineering judgment or quality.

Aligned With Verra Mobility Values

  • Do What’s Right – We’re committed to doing the right thing for each other and for our customers – integrity is our DNA.
  • Lead With Grace – We embrace the importance of our colleagues and customers and always treat them with kindness and grace.
  • Own It – We foster a culture of accountability and excellence, where going the extra mile is standard practice.
  • Win Together – We are ambitious and like to win, but we know we win more when we include others and work together.

Verra Mobility Values

An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

  • Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
  • Do What’s Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
  • Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease.
  • Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.

In no event will we retain such data more than two (2) years following the closure of the recruitment process relating to the role for which you applied or in the event other related job opportunities arise within the company. - 8+ years of software testing/quality engineering experience, including significant hands-on automation experience.
- Proven ability to independently analyze requirements and create comprehensive, high-quality test scenarios and test cases.
- Strong hands-on experience performing both manual/exploratory testing and automated testing.
- Experience testing modern applications involving React, APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud technologies.
- Excellent communication (written & verbal), knowledge sharing, analytical, debugging, problem-solving, collaboration, and ownership skills.
- Experience within team environments and Agile project methodologies is a must.

- Strong hands-on expertise with Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, TypeScript/JavaScript, reusable automation frameworks, test fixtures, assertions, test-data management, parallel execution, and cross-browser testing.
- Strong ability to analyze requirements and independently create and execute functional, exploratory, regression, integration, negative, boundary, exception, and end-to-end test scenarios and test cases.
- Strong experience testing REST APIs, JSON/HTTP services, microservices, backend integrations, databases, and asynchronous/event-driven workflows.
- Working knowledge of C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET Core, React, microservices, micro frontends, REST APIs, and legacy .NET Framework/ASP.NET applications.
- Strong SQL/SQL Server skills for test-data preparation, backend validation, reconciliation, and defect investigation.
- Ability to develop maintainable automation using SOLID principles, object-oriented concepts, separation of concerns, reusable components, clean code, and appropriate design patterns.

Job Description

Job Title: QA Senior Test Engineer

Location: Corporate

Department: Information Technology

Job Summary: The QA Senior Test Engineer is responsible for developing, executing, and maintaining automated and manual tests for web, API, and mobile applications. This role supports quality engineering practices across Digital, Mobile, and IT teams by contributing to test automation, validating application functionality, documenting defects, and helping improve overall software quality. This role is expected to actively participate in agile ceremonies, support CI/CD testing activities, and help ensure that features meet defined acceptance criteria and quality standards. Contribute to test planning, test case design, automated test development, defect validation, and continuous improvement of testing practices.

Principal Duties

  • Collaborate with software development engineers and QA team members to understand feature requirements, technical design, and test coverage needs.
  • Participate in and contribute to code reviews and design discussions to provide input on testability and automation considerations.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute automated functional, integration, API, and end-to-end tests for Digital, Mobile, and IT initiatives.
  • Assist with defining test cases, test data needs, and acceptance criteria in partnership with product and engineering teams.
  • Contribute to improvements to quality assurance practices by identifying opportunities to increase automation, reliability, and repeatability.
  • Find, isolate, document, regress, and track defects through resolution.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of manual and automated test execution across assigned products and features to ensure features meet defined acceptance criteria and quality standards.
  • Assist with end-to-end configuration, environment validation, and test data setup for digital, mobile, and other IT projects.
  • Track and report testing progress, automation results, and defect trends to help teams assess quality and readiness.

Essential Functions

  • Ability to work well individually and in a team environment
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks with appropriate guidance and escalation
  • Detail oriented with strong organizational and time management skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and communicate risks or blockers in a timely manner
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly with technical and non-technical peers
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and willingness to learn
  • Ability to follow established engineering and QA practices while contributing ideas for improvement
  • Enjoys working with partners, colleagues, and teams to solve software quality challenges
  • Passionate about QA, test automation, and continuous learning

Basic Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree preferred or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience writing test cases, executing software tests, documenting defects, and supporting test automation
  • 5+ years of experience with automated testing tools or frameworks
  • Familiarity with software development processes including Agile/Lean methodologies and DevOps concepts, particularly in a CI/CD environment
  • QA professional certifications preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver assigned work with quality and consistency
  • Experience using automation to support repeatable software testing
  • Experience creating and executing test cases for assigned features or applications
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as WebdriverIO, SmartBear, or similar platforms
  • Programming or scripting experience using TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar languages
  • Working knowledge of software development life cycle practices, including coding standards, code reviews, source control, build and release processes, CI/CD, and test suite maintenance

LOB Position Summary:

  • Serve as the technical bridge between Development Engineers and Quality Engineers, aligning ETL solution development, automated validation frameworks, testability, and shift-left quality practices.

  • Support Unit, Feature and Integrated automation testing for mission-critical data services, with ownership of data integrity, transformation accuracy, replication reliability, and automated validation across high-volume integration and streaming platforms.

Responsibilities:

  • Creates and optimizes test processes including defect management and reporting
  • Creates and optimizes test automation frameworks and use of test automation tools
  • Leads test planning for complex features that span across the platform or multiple teams
  • Creates a test automation strategy across the application stack (UI, API, and Backend, etc.)
  • Ensures alignment and sign off for test cases from business and other stakeholders
  • Manages test execution and resolves, communicates or escalates any issues that may result in test plan variance
  • Designs test data and ensure data compliance requirements are met on all levels of test environments

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of applicable software engineering, test automation, data engineering, or quality engineering experience.
  • Experience developing and supporting ETL/DataStage solutions, real-time data replication platforms, and large-scale data integration processes, with a strong focus on automation and quality engineering.
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks or suites for Unit, Feature, Integrated, regression and data validation testing.
  • Ability to own automated source-to-target validation, transformation accuracy, data integrity, reconciliation, and consistency across high-volume replication and streaming platforms.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD practices and the integration of automated tests, quality gates, and results reporting into delivery pipelines.
  • Hands-on engineering expertise across Mainframe, DataStage, IIDR/CDC, and Kafka-based data pipelines, including development, troubleshooting, automated testing, and validation.
  • Strong analytical, coding, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • ETL, Kafka, Mainframe, IIDR, Raft, Java, Co-Pilot, Octane, Litmus

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience building reusable automation frameworks for data-intensive, high-volume, and business-critical environments.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery teams and influencing automation strategy across application, infrastructure, data, and quality engineering partners.
  • Ability to communicate quality risks, automation coverage, dependencies, and business outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • DataStage, Python, AI Agents, SQL, UFT, Para Soft, GitHub, Bit-Bucket

Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING

The Aircraft Media Gateway program enables the P-8A aircraft to deliver advanced maritime and littoral Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities, equipping the United States Navy to effectively counter existing, evolving, and emerging threats.

THE WORK

Integration & Test Engineers collaborate with the Software Engineering and Systems Engineering teams to design and execute automated software testing strategies. The ideal candidate will possess, or be willing to develop, expertise in testing integrated hardware systems. Working in an Agile environment as part of a cross-functional product team, the candidate will be responsible for performing tasks that require strong collaboration and communication skills. Success in this role requires the ability to effectively interact with and present to various stakeholders, including internal leadership, external customers, and cross-functional teams. Team-oriented engineers who are comfortable communicating technical capabilities to both internal and external audiences are encouraged to apply.

Who You Are

The Ideal candidate will have a bachelor's degree from an accredited university and over 5 years of related experience or a master's degree with 3 years of related professional experience.

Who We Are

You will be joining Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems. Learn more about Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems

Our Program team is an Integrated Engineering team that cares about each other and the mission. We embody the Lockheed Martin core values. Learn more about our Culture

WHY JOIN US

Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life Our flexible schedules, competitive pay and comprehensive benefits enable you to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work. Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s competitive and comprehensive benefits

Plans, implements, tests, documents, and maintains solutions for the integration and testing of in-house developed and COTS/GOTS components, elements, subsystems and/or systems. Synthesizes customer contractual needs and requirements into system test solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule and cost constraints. Establishes functional and technical specifications and standards, solves hardware/software interface problems, defines input/output parameters, and ensures integration of the entire system or subsystem. Reviews, evaluates and derives requirements for testability, develops and directs preparation and execution of comprehensive test plans, procedures and schedules for complete systems and/or subsystems. Coordinates subsystem and/or system testing activities with programs and other organizations. Performs analysis of test results and prepares comprehensive subsystem and/or system level evaluation reports which verify and validate system performance. Writes discrepancy reports and performs integration regression testing to verify/validate incorporated fixes to software, components, subsystems and systems.

Basic Qualifications

  • Excellent written/verbal communication skills
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Experience with Python and Linux
  • Experience with Automated Testing
  • While no clearance is required to start, candidate must be willing to obtain a Secret clearance

Desired Skills

Understanding/Experience with:

  • PostgreSQL
  • Robot Framework
  • Test Case Planning/Development
  • Requirement Writing/Reading

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $95900.00 - $178100.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

descriptionHtml:
As a Senior QA Engineer at Plus One Robotics, you will ensure that our robotic systems, including the software and hardware that make them up, are dependable and of the highest quality. 


You will deploy and test software on Linux-based industrial PCs (IPCs), build and maintain automated test suites, analyze logs and stack traces to pinpoint failures, and verify that products work end to end in a physical robot cell. You will work closely with developers to find and verify fixes, with product owners to confirm the product does what they intended, and with customers to understand how it is used in the field. 


This is a senior level position; we are not considering entry-level candidates for this role. 


Essential Functions 

Software Testing and Automation 

  • Define and implement testing strategies for new and existing products, covering functional, regression, integration, performance, and stability testing 
  • Create detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans, test cases, and documentation from requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria 
  • Develop and maintain automated test suites to validate functionality, performance, and stability. Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines so builds are validated before release. Perform manual tests when automation isn't feasible
  • Build internal tools and scripts to optimize and automate QA workflows, test data collection, and log analysis 

Deployment, Debugging, and Defect Management 

  • Install, deploy, and configure software builds and deploy packages on Linux-based industrial PCs (IPCs) and test systems 
  • Read stack traces, application logs, and system output to isolate where and why a failure occurred, and deliver actionable findings to developers 
  • Identify, thoroughly document, and track bugs in GitLab throughout the development cycle, with clear steps to reproduce and supporting logs or screenshots. Work with developers to verify fixes and confirm no regressions
  • Use git and GitLab daily to check out branches and tags under test, review merge requests and pipelines to understand what changed, and manage issues and epics 

Hardware and System Testing 

  • Perform hands-on testing of POR robotic systems, including InductOne, verifying that software, electrical, and mechanical sub-systems work together end to end 
  • Troubleshoot at the system level to determine whether a fault originates in software, electrical, or mechanical sub-systems 

Collaboration and Leadership 

  • Be an advocate for our customers and end users by holding a high standard for quality and usability 
  • Work with product owners to confirm features meet requirements and intended customer use, and participate in acceptance and release sign-off 
  • Present QA data, test results, and analyses to stakeholders, including customers, leadership, and cross-functional teams, in a clear, accessible manner tailored to the audience  
  • Mentor interns and junior-level teammates by sharing QA best practices, providing technical guidance, reviewing their work, and supporting their professional development 


Qualifications 

Required 

  • Strong software QA fundamentals: test strategy, test plan development, test case design, bug reporting, regression testing, fix verification, and acceptance testing 
  • Proficient in Python, TypeScript, or a similar language used in test automation 
  • Working proficiency with the Linux command line, including file system navigation, permissions, SSH, managing services, and reading logs 
  • Experience installing and deploying software builds or deploy packages to test or production systems 
  • Experience with git and GitLab (or GitHub): branches, tags, merge requests, and issue tracking 
  • Experience testing hardware or physical systems, or a demonstrated aptitude and willingness to learn hands-on hardware testing 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English 
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a dynamic environment 

Preferred 

  • Experience with testing frameworks such as Pytest, Puppeteer, Playwright, or similar. Familiarity with C++
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, ideally GitLab CI 
  • Experience with Docker or other containerized deployments 


Required Education and Experience 

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience 
  • 5+ years of experience in QA or test engineering, with the majority in software testing 
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience developing software test automation 
  • Experience testing products that combine software and hardware, such as robotics, automation, or embedded systems 


Work Environment & Travel 

  • This position operates in a professional office setting with occasional exposure to robotic systems and moving mechanical parts. The noise level in the work environment and job sites may at times be loud. 
  • There is some travel expected for the purposes of customer support and deployments. 

 

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work/Locatio

Full time, 40 hours/week between M-F, 9:00am-6:00pm, In office at our San Antonio based HQ.


Salary Information

The range for this role starts at $112,000 per year. Starting salary is based on years of experience.


We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The position also requires strong knowledge of Quality Assurance principles and QA methodologies, with hands-on involvement in designing test plans and detailed test cases in addition to automation. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect existing functionality, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by promoting test‑driven development and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400 - $115,000, based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.
