  • Tests and reviews applications based on business requirements and industry best practices.
  • Uses best practices and standard guidance to create and modify code.
  • Considers how code changes will affect internal teams. May review code created by less experienced team members.
  • Collaborates with QA team to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products.
  • Participates in and may lead team in cross-functional meetings and discussions.
  • Creates required technical documentation.
  • Stays updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • Adheres to documented departmental and corporate standards. Participates in the definition and documentation of standards.
  • May lead integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • Designs and contributes to comprehensive test plans and test cases using established Quality Assurance methodologies, in addition to developing automated tests.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium).
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Must have knowledge of Quality Assurance principles and QA methodologies, including experience designing test plans and test cases
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

It’s about putting our best to the test.

Are you described as someone with an inquisitive mind and an innovative personality? Are you never satisfied with good enough? Does solving complex problems and ensuring top-quality applications excite you? If so, being a Quality Automation Engineer II with Frost could be for you.

At Frost, it’s about more than a job. It’s about having a flourishing career where you can thrive, both in and out of work. At Frost, we’re committed to fostering an environment that reflects our values and encourages team members to be the best they can be. In joining our adaptable, integrity-driven team, you’ll become part of Frost’s over 150-year legacy of providing unparalleled banking services.

Who You Are

As a Quality Automation Engineer II, you are our quality control, ensuring every application is stable and built with integrity, caring and excellence. You’ll play an important role in the design, creation, and testing of applications to ensure the quality and stability in every system. You’ll use your strong problem-solving skills to ensure that the applications are performing optimally and meet our high standards. You are not afraid to ask the question why and thrive in a collaborative environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and deploy test automation solutions for interrelated systems to ensure the quality and stability of software applications
  • Troubleshoot and triage script and system issues with project teams to identify the root causes and resolve issues
  • Document, track, and escalate issues with application changes or test scripts
  • Collaborate with product management, project management and development teams to develop a strong understanding of the project, product, and testing objectives
  • Focus on improving automation percentage for projects developed in all technologies
  • Write and execute functional test cases as needed
  • Always take action using Integrity, Caring, and Excellence to achieve all-win outcomes

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience
  • 2+ years of test automation experience
  • Demonstrated experience in Java or scripting languages like Ruby or Python, using Selenium as a framework in independently identifying technical issues in code
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented programming concepts
  • Demonstrated experience developing functional, load, or batch test automation solutions
  • Proficiency with SQL queries

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of Selenium WebDriver, Jenkins, Maven
  • Experience using automated testing tools like Junit, TestNG, Appium, JMeter, XCUITest, and/or Expresso
  • Experience with a distributed version-control management system like GIT

Our Benefits

At Frost, we care about your health, your family, and your future and strive to have our benefits reflect that. This includes:

  • Medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and life insurance
  • 401(k) matching
  • Generous holiday and paid time off schedule
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Extensive health and wellness programs, including our Employee Assistance Program
  • Referral bonus program + more!

Since 1868, Frost has dedicated their expertise to provide exceptional banking, investment, and insurance services to businesses and individuals throughout Texas. Frost is one of the 50 largest U.S. banks by asset size and is a leader in banking customer satisfaction. At Frost, it’s about being part of something bigger. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply and see what’s possible at Frost.

Role: AI Testing – Automation QA Engineer (Selenium)

Location: Charlotte, NC


We are

At Synechron, we believe in the power of digital to transform businesses for the better. Our global consulting firm combines creativity and innovative technology to deliver industry-leading digital solutions. Synechron’s progressive technologies and optimization strategies span end-to-end Artificial Intelligence, Consulting, Digital, Cloud & DevOps, Data, and Software Engineering, servicing an array of noteworthy financial services and technology firms. Through research and development initiatives in our FinLabs we develop solutions for modernization, from Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain to Data Science models, Digital Underwriting, mobile-first applications and more. Over the last 20+ years, our company has been honored with multiple employer awards, recognizing our commitment to our talented teams. With top clients to boast about, Synechron has a global workforce of 14,500+, and has 58 offices in 21 countries within key global markets.


Our challenge

We are looking for an AI Testing – QA Engineer responsible for testing AI applications, RAG systems, APIs, and data platforms. The role involves validating model behavior, ensuring accuracy and reliability, and supporting governance, reporting, and documentation activities.


Additional Information*

The base salary for this position will vary based on geography and other factors. In accordance with law, the base salary for this role if filled within Charlotte, NC is $90000-$100000/year & benefits (see below)..


The Role

Responsibilities:

  • Own testing governance and reporting for AI applications, RAG systems, APIs, and data platforms.
  • Design and execute functional, regression, integration, and performance test cases.
  • Validate model outputs for accuracy, relevance, consistency, bias, and hallucinations.
  • Test AI workflows, data pipelines, APIs, and model integrations.
  • Develop and maintain automation frameworks using Selenium.
  • Document test results, defects, evidence, metrics, and dashboards.
  • Collaborate with development, data science, and product teams to resolve issues.
  • Support AI testing governance and continuous improvement initiatives.


Requirements:

  • Strong experience in AI testing and QA governance.
  • The role combines strong hands-on skill in Java, Selenium, Playwright, API automation, SQL, automation frameworks and CI/CD with practical use of Generative AI and LLM-based tools
  • Proficiency in test automation using Selenium and Playwright.
  • Hands-on experience testing AI applications, RAG systems, APIs, and data platforms.
  • Experience with model testing, prompt testing, and evidence-based validation.
  • Experience with defect tracking and exception management.
  • Knowledge of regression testing, functional testing, integration testing, and API testing.
  • Strong documentation, reporting, and analytical skills.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Python and test automation frameworks.
  • Familiarity with PyTest.
  • Experience with tools such as LangSmith, Galileo, or similar AI testing platforms.
  • Knowledge of performance/load testing and security testing.
  • Experience with Azure and Java is a plus.



We offer:


  • A highly competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A multinational organization with 60 offices in 20 countries and the possibility to work abroad.
  • 10 days of paid annual leave (plus sick leave and national holidays).
  • Maternity & paternity leave plans.
  • A comprehensive insurance plan including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and long-/short-term disability (plans vary by region).
  • Retirement savings plans.
  • A higher education certification policy.
  • Commuter benefits (varies by region).
  • Extensive training opportunities, focused on skills, substantive knowledge, and personal development.
  • On-demand Udemy for Business for all Synechron employees with free access to more than 5000 curated courses.
  • Coaching opportunities with experienced colleagues from our Financial Innovation Labs (FinLabs) and Center of Excellences (CoE) groups.
  • Cutting edge projects at the world’s leading tier-one banks, financial institutions and insurance firms.
  • A flat and approachable organization.
  • A truly diverse, fun-loving, and global work culture


SYNECHRON’S DIVERSITY & INCLUSION STATEMENT


Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more.


All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
We are Skyward.

That is, a love for people, for improvement, for human advancement through information technology. We are a people-centered business with a desire to serve others. We are diverse and unified; creative and collaborative; a collection of complementary, not competing talents. And though on the surface we remain relaxed, beneath, a torrent of energy links us to our civic tech mission.

We stand by our values, and we won’t compromise on any of them.

Integrity: We’re conscientious, intentional, and empathetic. Our words and actions align. That’s our character. Please don’t ask us to play another part, we’re poor actors.

Compassionate: If we may borrow a quote from Theodore Roosevelt: “No one cares how much you know until they know how much you care.” Because our team is thoughtful and supportive, caring deeply for each other, our clients, and our work, this comes naturally.

Inquisitive: We remain students by failing openly and turning lessons into solutions.

Unconventional: For us, life isn’t what happens outside of work. Work happens inside of life and our culture erases the line often dividing the two.

Authentic: Made possible only because we embody the values listed above. We’re relaxed and fun yet intensely curious and driven. Team members are placed with thought, care, and precision to ensure that Trust, Truth, and Transparency continue to represent our brand.

Because of that, we continue Onward, Upward, and Skyward.

We need an Automation Test Engineer.

Are you the kind of person who can’t look at a machine learning model without wanting to test it six different ways (and then automate all six)? Do your friends sigh when you bring up responsible AI? Maybe they’ve stopped asking what you do for work because the last time you went on a 20-minute tangent about bias in training data and flaky CI pipelines for neural nets.

If that sounds familiar, you might be exactly who we’re looking for.

Come join us if you're motivated to learn from others, to learn from mistakes, to be part of a future-looking and growth-oriented team.

Let's go Skyward together.

What you’ll do:

  • Be part of a team supporting the development of an AI/ML platform that will leverage generative AI to relieve user burden across the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).
  • Design and maintain robust, scalable automated test frameworks for web apps, APIs, and AI-driven features
  • Develop automated pipelines for model validation, bias detection, and drift monitoring in ML-based systems
  • Define and execute test plans that include functional, regression, performance, and AI-specific testing strategies
  • Partner with AI/ML engineers to create test datasets and simulate real-world user behavior and edge cases
  • Implement CI/CD-integrated quality gates to ensure AI releases meet defined reliability and fairness metrics
  • Mentor junior engineers and help establish best practices in intelligent automation and AI testing
  • Advocate for ethical AI standards and contribute to cross-functional discussions about responsible AI


What we'd like you to have:

  • 5+ years of experience in software QA/automation engineering, with at least 1 year focused on AI/ML product testing
  • Strong proficiency in at least one automation framework (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and scripting language (Python preferred)
  • Hands-on experience with testing AI models, including validation metrics, dataset versioning, and model explainability
  • Familiarity with tools like MLflow, TensorBoard, or similar for AI observability
  • Understanding of model bias, fairness audits, and compliance considerations in government or regulated environments
  • Experience working in Agile DevSecOps environments with modern CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, etc.)
  • Strong collaboration skills with a knack for clear communication across engineering, data science, and product teams


What would blow us away:

  • You’ve previously supported the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)


Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. At Skyward, we’re focused on hiring individuals with the right skills and passion to grow, not just checking off every box.

And now the important part. What we offer you:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 15 days of paid leave
  • 7 days of sick leave
  • 2 days bereavement leave
  • 11 paid Federal holidays
  • Up to 40 hours for jury duty
  • 401K with 4% employer contribution (and no vesting period)
  • Up to 4 weeks of paid paternity and maternity leave
  • Company provided laptop
  • $5,000 per year for professional development
  • $600 per year for technical supplies and equipment
  • $2,000 referral bonus
  • Life and disability insurance
  • HSA and FSA
  • Legal Shield and ID Shield Voluntary Benefits
  • Opportunity to work in a collaborative, motivated team focused on modernizing government services with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions. Who says government work can't be exciting!


At Skyward, we support flexible working hours and remote opportunities to help maintain a healthy work-life balance for all employees.

Offers of employment with Skyward are contingent upon acceptable results of a background investigation.

Applicants must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance due to the nature of our work as a government contractor.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.   • Contribute to architectural reviews and provide input on scalability and reliability considerations during design phases.

Education

To be successful in this role you will need:

Experience

  • 5+ relevant financial services industry experience.
  • 5+ years of experiences in Tricentis NeoLoad, APM tools, CI/CD integration.

  • Strong analytical skills and detailed orientation
  • High level understanding of system architecture
  • Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile methodologies and QA lifecycle.

descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities
The USDS Core Business Quality Team owns end-to-end quality across TikTok's core products and services in the US. We are looking for a forward-thinking Quality Engineer who takes deep ownership of product quality and engineering efficiency. In this role, you will partner closely with cross-functional teams to identify quality risks, drive continuous improvements, build scalable quality solutions, and leverage AI-driven technologies to enhance product quality and engineering practices.

Responsibilities
- Have a deep understanding of business logic, and product functionality.
- Champion end-to-end quality practices and management across project testing, regression suites, and app validation. Drive production issue triage, defect pattern and root-cause analysis to proactively mitigate risk and continuously improve release stability
- Develop scalable automation tests, CI/CD validation pipelines, and internal engineering tools to increase test coverage, and elevate product reliability
- Apply LLMs and AI agents to real-world engineering challenges, such as automated test generation, self-healing scripts, root-cause analysis, and triaging to transform quality engineering practices

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- BS in Computer Science or related fields
- Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Java, etc.).
- Experience with web and mobile tests
- Proven experience building scalable test automation, or productivity tools.
- Experience with AI tools, with an understanding of practical use to improve testing efficiency
- Strong problem solving skills and self-driven mindset with effective collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications
- Strong grasp of complex business logic and workflows, with the ability to design precise and comprehensive test strategies and use cases
- Experience with integrating AI agents into testing workflow or engineering pipelines
- Background in benchmarking and evaluating AI agents for effectiveness, reliability, and output quality
- Experience with building AI testing frameworks, autonomous testing agents or intelligent automation solutions
- Working knowledge of large-scale distributed systems architecture

About USDS
TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​


USDS Reasonable Accommodation
USDS is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/USDS-RA​

Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.​
Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. 1. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues;​
2. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and​
3. Exercising sound judgment.​

descriptionHtml:
The application window is expected to close on: 12/21/2026

Meet the Team

Our team is part of the Cisco AI and Automation portfolio, responsible for the "Circuit" platform—the central AI engine that powers productivity and process automation for all of Cisco. We are a rapidly expanding, high-impact group dedicated to building the vehicle for AI-driven business transformation. We operate at the intersection of applied research and production, ensuring our technology is not only cutting-edge but also optimized for performance, reliability, and functional quality for our 80,000+ monthly users.

As an Automation QA Engineer, you are the guardian of that functional quality—owning the automated testing ecosystem that keeps Circuit reliable, scalable, and production-ready across every release. This is a hybrid position.

Your Impact

As an Automation QA Engineer, you will drive the transformation of our regression testing ecosystem, moving beyond manual processes to build AI-driven, fully automated test suites for both new and legacy features. You will design and own end-to-end (E2E), API, and performance test automation that ensures the Circuit platform continues to meet Cisco's high standards for functional quality and performance.

You will build and maintain scalable test frameworks, integrate them into CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality feedback, and leverage AI-assisted coding tools (such as Cursor, Copilot, or Claude Code) to generate and maintain tests—while rigorously validating that AI-generated artifacts are stable, correct, and compliant with security standards. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to automate functional quality and reduce technical debt directly ensures Circuit remains a reliable vehicle for process automation across Cisco.

Responsibilities

Automated Regression & E2E Testing: Architect, build, and maintain comprehensive automated regression and end-to-end test suites for the entire Circuit platform using Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript), Python/Pytest, and Selenium, replacing manual QA with scalable automation.

API Testing: Design and automate REST and GraphQL API test suites covering functional correctness, contract validation, error handling, and performance—including validation of AI/model-serving endpoints under concurrent load.

Performance & Load Testing: Plan and execute load, stress, and soak tests using k6 or JMeter, ; track response-time percentiles (p95/p99), throughput, error rates, and AI-specific metrics such as Time to First Token (TTFT) and inter-token latency.

AI-Driven Test Automation: Use AI agents and AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code) to generate and maintain regression suites for new and legacy features; read and judge the stability of auto-generated code and ensure it does not violate security standards before it is merged.

AI Application & Agent Validation: Develop testing approaches for AI/LLM features—validating model response quality, behavior consistency (stability testing), and end-to-end AI agent workflows across both the reasoning and action layers.

CI/CD Integration & Reporting: Integrate all automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent) for continuous validation; build dashboards and reports (Grafana, Allure) and communicate quality metrics, risk assessments, and defect trends to engineering leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as a "Team Captain" for automation initiatives—defining standards, mentoring peers, and collaborating with development, product, and UX teams to embed automation-first testing into the core development lifecycle.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree with 4+ years, Master's degree with 3+ years, or PhD with 1+ year of related experience in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related technical field.
  • Experience in test automation and regression framework development, with a deep understanding of functional quality assurance.
  • Experience with Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) for E2E/UI automation and/or Python with Pytest/Robot Framework; familiarity with Selenium.
  • Experience with REST API testing (and familiarity with API contract testing); GraphQL testing a plus.
  • Solid conceptual and practical knowledge of software development lifecycles, including CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar) and automated testing best practices.
  • Experience in AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code), critical thinking, and Agile/Git workflows to ensure high-quality, scalable test automation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing AI/ML-powered web applications, including LLM-based features, chatbots, or AI agent workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with performance/load testing (k6, JMeter) and AI/LLM performance metrics (TTFT, inter-token latency, token throughput).

descriptionHtml:
As a quality automation tester, you will make an impact by validating the quality and reliability of card processing and payments systems through hands-on functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing. You will be a valued member of the Software Engineering team and work collaboratively with developers, business analysts, testing teams, offshore team members, and Test leads.

In this role, you will

  • Design the test strategy and test plan, estimate and track testing efforts, and develop, review, and execute detailed test scenarios and test cases based on functional requirements and banking business workflows.
  • Coordinate defect triage with developers, business analysts, and testing teams to investigate, prioritize, and resolve defects, and perform defect retesting, regression validation, and root cause investigation.
  • Support test data preparation, test environment validation, and troubleshooting of testing dependencies.
  • Coordinate day-to-day testing activities across offshore team members, ensuring timely completion of assigned deliverables.
  • Work closely with the Test Lead to communicate testing progress, defects, blockers, and quality risks, and provide test execution status, defect metrics, and regression results to support release readiness, along with test closure and status reports.

Work model

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Alpharetta, GA. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

  • Strong knowledge of card processing, payments, and customer servicing systems, including TS2, card lifecycle management, account servicing, card issuance and replacements, authorization processing, settlement, transaction research, fraud blocks, back-office operations, and customer service workflows.
  • Strong understanding of ISO 8583 message formats and payment interchange protocols, including validating financial transaction card-originated messages such as MTIs, bitmaps, and data elements, plus packet and protocol testing to ensure data integrity during transmission.
  • Strong hands-on experience in REST/SOAP API testing using tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or Thunder Client, along with web UI functional and integration testing.
  • Strong experience in defect identification, defect triage, defect lifecycle management, and retesting, with Jira or similar defect and test management tools.
  • Good understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, and STLC, with strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently on complex testing scenarios while supporting offshore team coordination.

These will help you stand out

  • Experience executing, developing, and maintaining automation scripts using frameworks such as BDD/Cucumber, Selenium, Playwright, REST Assured, or Robot.
  • Experience with data synchronization, source-to-target validation, and data lake/data-processing validation.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins and Git.
  • Knowledge of Kafka or other event-driven messaging platforms.
  • Basic understanding of microservices architecture, API integrations, and cloud-hosted applications, with experience using application monitoring and log analysis tools such as Splunk.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Applications will be accepted until November 20th, 2026.

The annual salary for this position is from $53k to $92.500K depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) plan and contributions
  • Long-term/Short-term Disability
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

descriptionHtml:
Points North is looking for a Software Engineer in Test who is excited about doing meaningful, high-impact work on a product that people already depend on and making it better. You will be joining a small, fast-moving Agile team with the specific mission of modernizing the quality practices around a mature production application. You will be working with systems that real people use every day to do their job, and you are excited to make things measurably better than you found them.

If you are the kind of Engineer who gets energized by bringing structure and confidence to a complex codebase, who sees a legacy system as an opportunity rather than a liability, and who wants to build the testing foundation that carries a product into its next era we want to talk to you.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Enable the QA modernization journey. Partner with software engineers, other quality engineers, and product managers to assess where the application stands today and chart a practical path toward modern, sustainable quality practices without over-engineering the solution.
  • Balance manual and automated testing. Apply targeted manual testing where it delivers the most insight while systematically expanding automated coverage over time. Know when each approach is the right tool for the job.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for our SaaS products using Playwright, C# and TypeScript, including end-to-end (E2E), integration, and API tests.
  • Build test tools, frameworks, and utilities that improve coverage, accelerate execution, and make the whole team more effective.
  • Leverage AI tools as a force multiplier, not a shortcut. Use AI thoughtfully to expand test coverage, accelerate test creation and maintenance, and surface insights.
  • Participate in code reviews, pair programming, and agile events as a core member of the team.
  • Help define and evolve testing strategies and best practices across the team as the codebase and product mature.
  • Follow DevSecOps best practices for CI/CD and contribute to deployment automation.
  • Continuously learn and grow technically, collaboratively, and in how you think about quality.


What We Are Looking For:

  • A hands-on QA engineer with a developer mindset who is genuinely excited about legacy modernization. We are looking for someone who sees complexity as a puzzle worth solving.
  • A practical thinker who balances automated coverage with targeted manual testing, and knows that the goal is confidence, not coverage numbers.
  • Someone who is enthusiastic about AI as an enabler. Someone who is eager to experiment with AI-assisted tooling to move faster and reach further, while understanding that AI augments good engineering judgment rather than replacing it.
  • A collaborator who communicates openly, takes pride in their work and their team's work, and leaves codebases and processes better than they found them.
  • A builder who wants to see their work ship, make an impact, and solve real world problems.


Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in professional software development or software quality engineering.
  • Proven, professional experience building and utilizing test automation tools and frameworks.
  • Proficiency with languages such as C# and/or TypeScript.
  • Experience testing REST APIs and using tools like Postman or equivalent automation frameworks.
  • Experience with source control and modern CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions).
  • Comfortable working with relational databases such as SQL Server.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work as a core member of an Agile software development team.
  • Solid understanding of modern software engineering principles and best practices.
  • Experience working in a SaaS company or small, fast-paced development team.
  • Familiarity with cloud services (Azure App Services, Azure SQL, Azure Functions).
  • Experience bringing QA practices to legacy or established codebases.


At Points North, we believe that taking care of our team is the foundation of our success. That’s why we’ve created a benefits package designed to support you both personally and professionally:

  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans are available to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Retirement Savings: Invest in your future with employer-matching contributions to a SIMPLE Traditional and/or ROTH IRA plan.
  • Time Off: Generous PTO, paid holidays, and Volunteer Time Off (VTO) are offered so that you can take time to recharge and give back to what matters to you.
  • Growth Opportunities: Professional development is encouraged whether it be in training, certifications, or other opportunities to boost your career.
  • Flexibility: Depending on the role, remote or hybrid arrangements may be made available to fit your lifestyle and business needs.


For this position the base salary range is $110,000 - $125,000 per year, plus annual bonus eligibility. Final compensation determinations will reflect your unique experience, skills, and the responsibilities of the role.

At Points North, you’ll find an energizing, ambitious and supportive workplace where your contributions make a real impact. Ready to join our team? Apply today to take the next step in your career!

  • Cypress (modern UI automation)

  • Experience testing RESTful APIs in distributed systems environments
  • Hands-on experience with performance testing tools (JMeter, BlazeMeter)
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution

  • Familiarity with test design patterns (Page Object Model, abstraction layers, BDD best practices)
  • Experience supporting high-scale, mission-critical systems with strict SLAs
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum delivery models
  • Exposure to containerized or cloud-based testing environments
  • Familiarity with test management tools (e.g., Jira, ALM)

descriptionHtml:
Performance Drone Works (PDW) is building the next generation of tactical robotic systems used across defense, national security, and public safety missions. We are building a new center of engineering excellence to design our new category of tactical robotic systems and the industrial capacity to deliver them, bringing decisive airpower into the hands of every operator. We are not here to make promises; we are here to deliver real systems with real capabilities for real missions. 

You will join a team of operators, engineers, and builders who solve hard problems with humility and focus. We design and produce multi-mission aerial systems that operators trust to perform in real-world conditions, reliably, repeatedly, and at scale. Our approach is grounded in operator-centered design, rapid iteration from field use, and U.S.-based manufacturing. We operate by a clear set of values: Mission First, Aim Farther, Own It, Win Together. This is how we build advantage and how we help protect our service members, our communities, and our country. 

Now, we’re entering a new phase of growth and are looking for a/an Senior Software Quality Engineer – QGC & Tool Automation to establish and expand test automation for QGroundControl (QGC), controller software, and supporting ground-side tools across Linux and Android environments. You will develop maintainable frameworks, automate repeatable validation, and reduce dependence on manual testing as automated coverage becomes reliable and sufficient. You will own the automation architecture and technical roadmap for this workstream, with priorities established in partnership with SQA leadership and the responsible engineering teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Establish and execute the automation roadmap for QGC, controller software, and supporting ground-side tools, prioritizing work with SQA leadership based on product risk, release needs, manual effort, and opportunities for reuse.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and regression suites for Qt/QML applications and associated workflows across Linux and Android environments.
  • Automate validation of platform utilities, radio configuration, and controller setup workflows, including error handling, recovery, and verification of the resulting system state
  • Validate complete ground-side workflows across application interfaces, command-line tools, APIs, vehicle communications, and connected hardware as applicable.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD workflows, including environment setup, configuration control, results reporting, and collection of logs and other diagnostic artifacts.
  • Partner with developers to define acceptance criteria, identify quality risks, and improve application testability and diagnostic capabilities.
  • Investigate failures using application logs, telemetry, system parameters, and communication traces; reproduce defects and support root cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Maintain test plans, test cases, validation procedures, and traceability between requirements, tests, and results. Communicate coverage gaps, defects, residual risks, and release-readiness recommendations.
  • Provide technical guidance, review automation code, and mentor engineers in test design, software development practices, and effective use of shared frameworks.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in software quality engineering, test automation, software development, or embedded/robotic system validation, including independent ownership of complex automation initiatives.
  • Strong Python software development skills, including modular design, automated testing, dependency management, code review, and maintenance of shared tools or frameworks.
  • Experience testing Qt/QML applications and developing automated validation of user interfaces and application behavior using Squish or comparable tools.
  • Experience validating applications and system workflows in Linux and Android environments, including software installation, configuration, execution, and diagnostic log collection.
  • Experience automating application, command-line, API, or device-connected workflows using frameworks appropriate to the application, such as pytest, Qt testing tools, or similar technologies.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD workflows, including unattended execution, environment configuration, diagnostic artifact collection, and actionable results reporting.
  • Experience diagnosing failures through application logs, telemetry, system parameters, or communication traces.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to explain quality risks, recommend priorities, document technical decisions, and drive issues through resolution across teams.
  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with UAV systems, PX4, QGroundControl, or other ground control applications.
  • Familiarity with C++ and the ability to review application code when investigating defects or improving testability.
  • Experience validating software and firmware packages, installation and update processes, and compatibility among components on embedded or Android-based controllers.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Ability to sit, stand, bend, reach, climb, and move about regularly throughout the day and lift / carry up to 40 pounds. Must have manual dexterity to operate standard office equipment as well as various UAS and payloads. Must be physically capable of picking up, moving and configuring UAS and payloads.

Work Environment

This position typically operates in a standard office setting and manufacturing environment. This role requires use of standard office equipment and may require occasional travel to other PDW offices, customer sites, and field locations. This position may have exposure to outdoor weather conditions, noise, and non-climate-controlled environments. May require the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) depending on the environment. This is a fast-paced work environment and requires cross departmental collaboration with independent and team-based responsibilities. Standard works hours for this position are Monday through Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm with occasional overtime as operational needs demand.

Benefits

PDW values our team, and we offer a compensation package reflective of your experience and capabilities. Benefits include:

  • Comprehensive BCBS medical, dental, and vision coverage; 80% sponsored by the company.
  • Safe Harbor 401(K) with company match.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • A work environment that encourages teamwork and innovation.
  • On-site gym at our Huntsville, AL and Denver, CO locations.
  • Employer provided life insurance.
  • Robust Employee Assistant Program (EAP).
  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off (PTO), and flexible leave options.

EEO Statement

PDW is an equal opportunity employer that upholds all federal and state non-discrimination laws. We ensure a fair and unbiased evaluation for employment for all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, medical condition, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

This position will have an annual salary and benefits. The salary range provided is a guideline rather than a fixed limit. Individual pay is determined by factors including geography, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

The Pay Range For This Role Is

150,000 - 188,000 USD per year(Denver, CO)

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled QA Automation Engineer with strong experience in Playwright to design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks for web applications. Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts using Selenium.

descriptionHtml:
Intapp is looking for an enthusiastic individual for the position of QA Automation Engineer. This person will make a real impact on the business by helping grow our test automation team and processes. The ideal candidate will have a passion for high quality software and engineering principles with strong analytic, problem solving and programming skills. This person brings a software engineer mindset to this role by using best practices and appropriate design patterns to build solutions for our test automation tools, frameworks, and automated tests.

About Intapp:

Intapp, based in Silicon Valley, is a leader in Vertical AI SaaS solutions, collaborating with the world’s top firms globally across accounting, consulting, investment banking, legal, private capital, and real assets. With 20+ years of industry expertise, Intapp's "Intelligence Applied" approach is transforming how businesses operate and leverages a strategic partnership with Microsoft in delivering industry cloud solutions. The company culture promotes accountability, responsibility, and growth in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment. Since going public in 2021 and trading on the NASDAQ, Intapp has expanded to over 1,200 employees globally with development centers in Palo Alto, Charlotte, Belfast, Berlin and Lisbon.

What you will do:


  • Collaborate across functions with product managers, software architects, and developers, contributing to release planning and software design.

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites for web applications.

  • Create comprehensive test strategies, including both manual and automated test scenarios.

  • Execute manual testing where appropriate, including exploratory, functional, regression, and user acceptance testing.

  • Build and maintain automation tooling using Playwright primarily.

  • Build and run automated tests as part of continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

  • Create dashboards and reporting metrics to drive release quality and continuous improvements.


What you will need:


  • Proven experience in software testing, including test planning, test case creation, execution, defect reporting, and issue tracking (typically 5+ years), with a strong focus on test automation.

  • Hands-on experience with Playwright for e2e test automation.

  • Solid understanding of software development principles and Agile methodologies, with hands-on experience in React(preferred), and familiarity with web technologies such as HTML and CSS.

  • Expert knowledge of software testing methodologies and tools, covering both manual and automated testing approaches.

  • Experience in configuring and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to support automated testing workflows, along with proficiency in version control systems (e.g., Git).

  • Strong organizational and time management skills to work across projects, proactively managing competing priorities.

  • Excellent communication skills to work in a collaborative environment and participate in stakeholder meetings.

  • Familiarity with load, stress, or performance testing tools and methodologies is a plus.

  • An understanding of Microsoft Azure & Amazon Web Services is a plus.

At Intapp, you’ll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You’ll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that’s connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities. We’ll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork.

Here, you will have the opportunity to:


  • Expand Your Skills: Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.

  • Enjoy Where You Work: Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.

  • Support What Matters Most: Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.


Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Make your mark on the future of ArcGIS by joining the ArcGIS Enterprise portal team as a Sr. Product Test Engineer. We’re looking for a collaborative individual who deeply understands user needs and can help shape the vision for quality in our software. In this foundational role, you’ll design and evolve a resilient automated test framework that reflects real-world use cases. With each new feature, you’ll strengthen automated coverage, so our test infrastructure grows alongside our releases. Your insights will guide thoughtful interpretation of test results throughout the development process. When issues arise, you’ll support the team in understanding where, why and how they occurred. Through your dedication and influence, you’ll contribute directly to delivering dependable software to users across the globe.

Responsibilities

  • Set the scope, vision, and priorities of the test automation team by understanding team and stakeholder software quality needs
  • Collaborate with product engineers and software developers to set the vision and scope of automated tests for ArcGIS Enterprise
  • Work with feature teams to gather, design, and scope automated test cases and then have them implemented by software development engineers in test
  • Monitor and analyze test results; collaborate across teams to ensure software quality and release readiness
  • Document and communicate software issues found during automated and manual testing, asserting that the issues are tracked, triaged and addressed
  • Reproduce customer-reported bugs and work closely with Software Development Engineers to resolve these issues
  • Advocate for software quality, test automation and accurate reporting for Enterprise team

Requirements

  • 5+ years of software testing experience and execution of automated tests (such as Selenium or related tools)
  • Experience using an application development language, such as Java, C# or Python
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Pro, and ArcGIS platform technologies
  • Self-motivated team player with an interest in continuous learning and building software products
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Knowledge of manual and automated testing practices for functional, regression, and performance scenarios
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, geography, GIS, mathematics, or related field

Recommended Qualifications

  • Testing experience with large-scale GIS systems or desktop, web, or mobile applications
  • Familiarity with JSON, REST, Fiddler, and browser debugging tools
  • Experience with manual testing frameworks such as TestRail and strong understanding of end-user workflows
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (such as Jenkins) for automated deployments and test execution
  • Familiarity with the Agile software development life cycle

Total RewardsEsri’s competitive total rewards strategy includes industry-leading health and welfare benefits: medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance for employees (and their families), 401(k) and profit-sharing programs, minimum accrual of 80 hours of vacation leave, twelve paid holidays throughout the calendar year, and opportunities for personal and professional growth. Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. Compensation decisions and the base range for this role take into account many factors including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

The application window is expected to close on: 12/17/2026

Meet the team

Cisco Networking’s Wireless Engineering System Integration Test team validates end-to-end enterprise Wi-Fi solutions, spanning access points, controllers, switches, and cloud platforms. We ensure high-performing, secure connectivity in complex, customer-representative environments. You will partner with cross-functional engineering teams, employing advanced automation and emerging AI tools to accelerate validation, improve failure analysis, and drive product excellence.

Your impact

As a Wi-Fi QA Engineer, you will own assigned test areas from requirements review through release. You will design and implement integration plans covering functionality, interoperability, performance, scale, and security. You will build and maintain Python-based automation integrated into our CI/CD pipelines to ensure rigorous, repeatable testing. When issues arise, you will perform deep-dive root cause analysis using packet captures, telemetry, RF data, and system diagnostics. You will spearhead the use of AI agents for test generation, log analysis, and defect triage, applying RAG and structured workflows to improve test coverage and investigation efficiency. Success in this role means identifying critical system-level defects early, optimizing lab productivity, and serving as a trusted quality partner who champions technical excellence across the team.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelors in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field+ 5 years of experience, or Masters + 3 years of related experience.
  • Experience in software quality engineering, system integration testing, network engineering, or a related field, including testing sophisticated networked or distributed systems, and knowledge of enterprise Wi-Fi and IEEE 802.11.
  • Experience with TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, switching, routing, multicast, QoS, and network authentication; strong troubleshooting skills with packet captures, logs, telemetry, and command-line tools.
  • Expertise in Python or a comparable programming language, with experience developing and maintaining automated tests.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing enterprise access points, wireless LAN controllers, and cloud-managed networking; knowledge of Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 6E, or Wi-Fi 7, including roaming, RF behavior, spectrum use, and client interoperability.
  • Expertise with WPA2/WPA3, 802.1X, RADIUS, EAP, identity services, and wireless security.
  • Experience with high availability, redundancy, software upgrades, large-scale deployments, or system performance; familiarity with Wireshark, iPerf, traffic generators, spectrum analyzers, RF tools, or wireless packet capture.
  • Experience with REST APIs, Git, containers, test frameworks, and CI/CD platforms.
  • Experience using generative AI or AI agents for test creation, log analysis, troubleshooting, or defect management; familiarity with agent evaluation, retrieval, tool security, guardrails, and human review. Cisco Enterprise Switching or Wireless certifications such as CCNP Enterprise, CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure, or CCIE Enterprise Wireless are a plus.
  • Experience with complex failures, and collaborate across engineering teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work independently.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The starting salary range posted for this position is $128,600.00 to $184,900.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees
  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco
  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees
  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)
  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next
  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members
  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees On Sales Plans Earn Performance-based Incentive Pay On Top Of Their Base Salary, Which Is Split Between Quota And Non-quota Components, Subject To The Applicable Cisco Plan. For Quota-based Incentive Pay, Cisco Typically Pays As Follows

  • .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;
  • 1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;
  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and
  • Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

New York City Metro Area

$155,000.00 - $256,000.00

Non-Metro New York State & Washington State

$138,100.00 - $227,900.00

  • For quota-based sales roles on Cisco’s sales plan, the ranges provided in this posting include base pay and sales target incentive compensation combined.

I'm looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Quality Engineering to join a large enterprise's Global Information Security – Identity and Access Management (IAM) team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on Quality Engineer who enjoys building automated testing solutions, improving software reliability, and working with complex enterprise applications.

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks for enterprise applications.

  • Develop comprehensive testing strategies, including functional, integration, exploratory, and risk-based testing.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, and technical teams to identify defects and improve application quality.
  • Validate intelligent and adaptive systems, including AI-driven applications and non-deterministic behaviors.

AI Test Engineer II


Department: Software Engineering

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Location: Remote


Introduction

SG2 Recruiting has partnered with Trend Health Partners to spearhead the search for a visionary AI Test Engineer II. This is a pivotal opportunity to join a dynamic team and directly influence the company’s next phase of growth. If you are a strategic thinker ready to make a tangible impact, we want to hear from you.


Company Overview

At Trend Health Partners, we are transforming healthcare reimbursement through a tech-enabled payment integrity platform that aligns the common objectives of payers and providers. Our mission is to eliminate friction and administrative waste, fostering true collaboration that ultimately expands patient access to high-quality care. By cultivating an innovative, agile, and transparent culture, we empower our engineering teams to build high-impact technology solutions that solve healthcare's most complex challenges.


Your Role

As an AI Test Engineer II, you validate and elevate the quality, reliability, and safety of AI-powered systems across the Trend Health Partners platform. In this mid-level role, you will build and maintain automated testing suites, integrate AI-assisted engineering tools into your daily workflows, and safeguard data integrity across distributed cloud systems. Working alongside senior engineers, QA peers, and product managers, you will help ensure our payment integrity products run seamlessly, securely, and at high performance.


What You Will Be Doing

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test suites spanning API, UI, regression, and integration testing layers.
  • Develop resilient end-to-end tests using Playwright (or modern equivalent frameworks), focusing on maintainability and minimizing test flakiness.
  • Leverage AI-assisted coding and testing tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and related tools) to accelerate test creation, refactor code, and optimize testing workflows.
  • Author and execute API tests for REST and GraphQL services, validating data contracts, schema integrity, and edge-case error handling.
  • Perform security and performance checks as part of regular release cycles, testing basic OWASP hygiene, access controls, and system responsiveness under load.
  • Validate data integrity across integrations and backend data pipelines using solid SQL queries and automated data validation scripts.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally within an Agile development team, taking an active role in sprint ceremonies, release validations, and root-cause analysis for reported defects.


What You Will Need


Must-Haves

  • Core Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience), with 2–4+ years of dedicated experience in QA automation or software test engineering.
  • Test Automation Tooling: Hands-on proficiency building automated tests with modern web frameworks (Playwright strongly preferred; Cypress or Selenium acceptable) and API validation tools.
  • Data & Cloud Fundamentals: Solid SQL skills to verify database transactions and data pipelines, plus experience testing services in cloud environments (AWS preferred).
  • CI/CD & Agile Workflows: Working knowledge of integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines within standard Agile/Scrum development sprints.


Nice-to-Haves

  • AI/ML Curiosity & Validation: Hands-on exposure to validating AI/ML-generated outputs, prompt-based workflows, or using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot) in real testing workflows.
  • Specialized Testing Tools: Exposure to performance or load testing tools (e.g., k6, JMeter) and security scanning utilities (e.g., OWASP ZAP).
  • Regulated Healthcare Environments: Background working with healthcare technologies, HIPAA-compliant systems, or protected health data.


Logistics

  • Salary Range: $130,000 – $150,000 per year (commensurate with experience)
  • Work Location: 100% Remote (United States)
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan with employer match; paid parental leave; and competitive paid time off (PTO).


Mental and Physical Demands

  • Work Environment: Sedentary role performed primarily in an indoor/home office environment using computer hardware and standard office equipment.
  • Physical Demands: Repetitive motion from continuous computer keyboarding, mouse use, and sustained screen viewing throughout the workday.
  • Mental Demands: High level of sustained focus and analytical reasoning, complex problem solving, technical documentation review, and frequent written and verbal communication across distributed remote teams.


Related Duties as Assigned

  • This job description documents the general nature and level of work expected for this position; it is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities or tasks. You may be asked to perform additional related duties as operational and business needs dictate.
  • Candidates and employees may be required to fulfill compliance requirements mandated by our business partners, including background checks, credential verification, and adherence to strict protocols for protected health information (PHI) and personally identifiable information (PII). All processes adhere to Title VII of the Civil Rights Act and the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

We make all employment decisions based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We are looking for an experienced Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer to support complex, client-facing technology initiatives spanning AI/ML, data platforms, cloud applications, and modern software solutions. This role is ideal for a senior QA professional who combines hands-on automation expertise with the ability to establish quality standards, influence engineering practices, and communicate effectively with both technical teams and client stakeholders.


You will work closely with software engineering, data science, product, and delivery teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. You will help ensure solutions are reliable, secure, scalable, and ready for deployment in highly regulated and government environments.


The right candidate brings a strong understanding of modern QA engineering, automated testing, CI/CD, API and data validation, and cloud-deployed applications. Experience testing AI/ML solutions and working within government or other compliance-driven environments is particularly valuable.


WHAT YOU’LL DO:


Reporting to our Delivery Operations Manager, as a Full-Time Specialist on our team, you will work hybrid onsite in Vienna, VA, and you will own and execute comprehensive quality engineering strategies across application, data, and AI/ML solutions. In this client-facing consulting role, you will partner directly with engineering teams and program stakeholders to identify risks early, improve test coverage, automate repeatable testing, and establish clear release-readiness criteria.


QUALIFICATIONS:


  • 6–10 years of software quality assurance or quality engineering experience, including at least 3 years operating at a senior or lead level.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable test automation frameworks.
  • Strong hands-on experience with modern automated testing tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, PyTest, JUnit, Postman, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience developing automated functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing.
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows using platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Experience testing AI/ML, data-intensive, or analytics applications, including validating model outputs and underlying data.
  • Understanding of AI/ML testing considerations such as model accuracy, bias, drift, data quality, edge cases, and unexpected model behavior.
  • Experience testing REST APIs, distributed applications, data integrations, and backend services.
  • Experience testing applications deployed in cloud and containerized environments using technologies such as AWS, Azure, Docker, or Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile/Scrum delivery, test strategy, defect management, and release management.
  • Strong ability to identify, document, reproduce, prioritize, and communicate defects and quality risks.
  • Experience operating in government, public-sector, regulated, or compliance-driven environments requiring formal documentation, traceability, and audit readiness.
  • Ability to communicate technical quality risks and recommendations clearly to engineering teams, program leadership, clients, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a client-facing consulting environment involving multiple stakeholders, priorities, and delivery deadlines.
  • Experience with AI/ML model pipelines, data validation, model accuracy testing, bias evaluation, or model performance monitoring is highly valuable.
  • Experience with healthcare, Medicaid, program-integrity, or similar government applications is valuable.
  • Knowledge of security testing concepts, vulnerability scanning, and coordination of penetration testing.
  • Experience performing accessibility testing for government-facing applications, including familiarity with Section 508 and WCAG requirements.
  • ISTQB certification or a comparable professional software testing/quality assurance credential is a plus.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test strategies, test plans, test cases, and automated testing frameworks across AI, data, and application solutions.
  • Lead quality engineering activities across the full technology stack, including frontend applications, APIs, backend services, databases, integrations, data pipelines, and AI/ML components.
  • Build and maintain automated test suites that increase regression coverage and integrate effectively with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Determine the appropriate balance of unit, integration, API, UI, regression, system, and end-to-end testing based on technical architecture and delivery risk.
  • Partner with data science and engineering teams to develop validation strategies for AI/ML solutions, including model accuracy, data quality, bias, drift, edge conditions, and unexpected outputs.
  • Develop and execute API and integration testing strategies to validate functionality, data integrity, system behavior, and interoperability between services.
  • Establish and continuously improve quality standards, testing methodologies, automation practices, defect-management processes, and release-readiness criteria.
  • Identify, reproduce, document, and track defects with precision, working directly with engineers to triage issues, determine severity and priority, validate fixes, and mitigate release risk.
  • Build and maintain test environments, reusable test data, test-data management processes, and supporting QA infrastructure.
  • Support government and contractual compliance requirements by maintaining test documentation, requirements traceability, test results, validation evidence, and audit-ready quality artifacts.
  • Contribute to shift-left quality practices through design and requirements reviews, code review participation, developer test guidance, and early identification of quality risks.
  • Partner with software engineers to improve unit, integration, and automated test coverage and help establish quality ownership across the development lifecycle.
  • Validate releases across cloud and containerized environments and troubleshoot environment-specific quality issues.
  • Support security, performance, accessibility, and other non-functional testing requirements as needed.
  • Define and report meaningful quality metrics, including automated test coverage, execution results, defect trends, escaped defects, regression health, and overall release readiness.
  • Communicate testing status, risks, defects, dependencies, and release recommendations clearly to engineering leadership, program teams, and client stakeholders.
  • Serve as a senior quality engineering resource within the delivery team, helping improve QA practices, automation maturity, and overall product quality across engagements.

Reporting to our Delivery Operations Manager, as a Full-Time Specialist on our team, you will work hybrid onsite in Vienna, VA, and you will own and execute comprehensive quality engineering strategies across application, data, and AI/ML solutions. In this client-facing consulting role, you will partner directly with engineering teams and program stakeholders to identify risks early, improve test coverage, automate repeatable testing, and establish clear release-readiness criteria.


QUALIFICATIONS:



- 6–10 years of software quality assurance or quality engineering experience, including at least 3 years operating at a senior or lead level.
- Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable test automation frameworks.
- Strong hands-on experience with modern automated testing tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, PyTest, JUnit, Postman, or comparable technologies.
- Experience developing automated functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing.
- Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows using platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
- Experience testing AI/ML, data-intensive, or analytics applications, including validating model outputs and underlying data.
- Understanding of AI/ML testing considerations such as model accuracy, bias, drift, data quality, edge cases, and unexpected model behavior.
- Experience testing REST APIs, distributed applications, data integrations, and backend services.
- Experience testing applications deployed in cloud and containerized environments using technologies such as AWS, Azure, Docker, or Kubernetes.
- Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile/Scrum delivery, test strategy, defect management, and release management.
- Strong ability to identify, document, reproduce, prioritize, and communicate defects and quality risks.
- Experience operating in government, public-sector, regulated, or compliance-driven environments requiring formal documentation, traceability, and audit readiness.
- Ability to communicate technical quality risks and recommendations clearly to engineering teams, program leadership, clients, and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to work effectively in a client-facing consulting environment involving multiple stakeholders, priorities, and delivery deadlines.
- Experience with AI/ML model pipelines, data validation, model accuracy testing, bias evaluation, or model performance monitoring is highly valuable.
- Experience with healthcare, Medicaid, program-integrity, or similar government applications is valuable.
- Knowledge of security testing concepts, vulnerability scanning, and coordination of penetration testing.
- Experience performing accessibility testing for government-facing applications, including familiarity with Section 508 and WCAG requirements.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
