- Lead quality engineering activities across the full technology stack, including frontend applications, APIs, backend services, databases, integrations, data pipelines, and AI/ML components.
- Build and maintain automated test suites that increase regression coverage and integrate effectively with CI/CD pipelines.
- Determine the appropriate balance of unit, integration, API, UI, regression, system, and end-to-end testing based on technical architecture and delivery risk.
- Partner with data science and engineering teams to develop validation strategies for AI/ML solutions, including model accuracy, data quality, bias, drift, edge conditions, and unexpected outputs.
- Develop and execute API and integration testing strategies to validate functionality, data integrity, system behavior, and interoperability between services.
- Establish and continuously improve quality standards, testing methodologies, automation practices, defect-management processes, and release-readiness criteria.
- Identify, reproduce, document, and track defects with precision, working directly with engineers to triage issues, determine severity and priority, validate fixes, and mitigate release risk.
- Build and maintain test environments, reusable test data, test-data management processes, and supporting QA infrastructure.
- Support government and contractual compliance requirements by maintaining test documentation, requirements traceability, test results, validation evidence, and audit-ready quality artifacts.
- Contribute to shift-left quality practices through design and requirements reviews, code review participation, developer test guidance, and early identification of quality risks.
- Partner with software engineers to improve unit, integration, and automated test coverage and help establish quality ownership across the development lifecycle.
- Validate releases across cloud and containerized environments and troubleshoot environment-specific quality issues.
- Support security, performance, accessibility, and other non-functional testing requirements as needed.
- Define and report meaningful quality metrics, including automated test coverage, execution results, defect trends, escaped defects, regression health, and overall release readiness.
- Communicate testing status, risks, defects, dependencies, and release recommendations clearly to engineering leadership, program teams, and client stakeholders.
- Serve as a senior quality engineering resource within the delivery team, helping improve QA practices, automation maturity, and overall product quality across engagements.

WHERE DO WE START?
How about Kansas City? That’s our home. That’s where Garmin put a stake in the ground in 1989. We’ve grown substantially over the years, offering diverse products and global reach in 5 diverse markets. But some things won’t ever change: Our entrepreneurial spirit and a culture where everyone’s opinion matters. What we do best is make products that let our customers do what they love. To do that, we focus on practical innovation, never losing sight of the benefits our products bring to our customers. Sure, we love bells and whistles. What leading technology company doesn't? But we make sure ours have purpose. It’s not about the things we make. It’s about the things we make possible.

WE’RE GLOBAL, SERIOUSLY.
Yeah, we’re based in Kansas City, but we are truly a global company. With offices throughout Europe, Asia, Middle East, South America and Australia, our products are sold all over the world. One elevator ride at our headquarters and you’re likely to hear 4 (or more) different languages being spoken. At Garmin, we may act local, but we think global.

DREAM BIG. SLEEP WELL.
At Garmin, we like to encourage dreamers. But at some point it’s nice to wake up and enjoy a fully aware life. So we make it super easy to achieve a good balance between working, dreaming and enjoying life—from workout classes offered throughout the day, breaks to get out and move on our campus, and wellness programs offered throughout the year. It’s almost impossible not to take advantage of Garmin’s work-life balance opportunities.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

Building trusted markets — powered by our people 

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world. 

 

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.  

To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

Location Overview

Cboe HQ is located in the historic Old Post Office district, it’s a landmark that blends classic architecture with modern amenities. The building features expansive spaces with high ceilings and large windows, offering an abundance of natural light and panoramic views of the city skyline and the Chicago River.

With its prime location in the heart of downtown, the OPO Building provides easy access to major transportation hubs, including Union Station and multiple CTA lines, making it convenient for commuters. The building is home to a variety of amenities, including restaurants, a fitness center, and collaborative workspaces, creating a vibrant and dynamic work environment in one of Chicago's most iconic areas.

Role Overview

Cboe Clear U.S. (CCUS) is a regulated clearinghouse. We clear the event contracts and prediction markets listed on Cboe's exchanges, and we are building toward tokenized collateral, 24x7 operation, and the infrastructure that carries traditional finance onto DeFi rails.

CCUS Software Engineering is a high trust environment. Failure leads to inquiry rather than blame. Working across team boundaries is expected rather than tolerated. We solve the problem, then we write the code. Design documents and architecture decision records come first. The engineers we value most close their feedback loop. They write tests, and they instrument what they ship so it fails fast, explains itself in production, leaves an audit trail and rolls back cleanly.

The Senior QA Automation Test Engineer sets the strategy for proving the platform works. The difference from our QA Automation Test Engineer is scope. That role builds coverage for a team, while you architect the frameworks other engineers build on and own test strategy across the platform.

Your responsibilities will be:

  • Helping set quality standards and review practices that are held consistently across teams.
  • Mentoring engineers and raising the standard of practice around you.
  • Defining what release confidence means here, including coverage expectations and escaped defect targets.
  • Setting the test data and environment strategy, so clearing scenarios stay reproducible as the platform grows.
  • Influencing how engineering builds for testability, before code is written.
  • Designing and building automated test frameworks across UI, API and integration layers.
  • Validating end-to-end clearing workflows including trade processing, margin, settlement and reconciliation.
  • Ensuring data accuracy and consistency across distributed systems.
  • Embedding automated testing into delivery pipelines so failures surface early and loudly.
  • Owning test coverage as a measurable outcome and driving escaped defects down over time.
  • Building and maintaining the test data and test environments that make clearing scenarios reproducible.
  • Partnering with engineering teams to define testable solutions before code is written.
  • Documenting test strategy and coverage decisions so they outlast any one release.

Required:

  • Proven leadership and mentorship of junior engineers
  • Driving QA across the full application lifecycle, from test strategies, test plans and test cases through smoke, regression, functional, and integration testing
  • Understanding of relational databases, and comfortable writing queries to validate data across systems
  • Solid grounding in object-oriented and functional programming, software engineering principles, design patterns and data modeling fundamentals
  • A strong analytical mindset, and comfort working across teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Hands-on automated testing with Cucumber, Selenium or Playwright
  • Strong command of Java, with the depth to architect, build, and extend test frameworks for other engineers
  • API testing across REST, using RestAssured, Postman or an equivalent

Preferred:

  • AI-powered testing tools, including test generation and self-healing frameworks
  • The FIX messaging protocol
  • Kafka or another event streaming platform
  • Clearing, trading or other financial systems
  • Managing a testing team or planning testing activities for a team

Nice to have:

  • Python as a second test-authoring language
  • Working knowledge of Docker, Podman or similar container runtimes
  • Exposure to AWS or similar Cloud Platform
  • Test data and environment management at scale, including adapting test flows as live data changes
  • Executing performance, resiliency and failover testing, including business continuity and disaster recovery (BCDR) scenarios

Current technology stack:

Java on Kubernetes. Application code and CI pipelines live in GitHub with GitHub Actions. Container images and build artifacts live in registries such as Harbor and Artifactory, and Helm charts are deployed by ArgoCD from a GitOps repository. PostgreSQL, Kafka and Linux. This is representative rather than exhaustive. On the quality side we work in Cucumber, RestAssured, and Selenium or Playwright, against PostgreSQL with the Atlassian suite for tracking.

You do not need experience with every technology in our environment. We hire for competencies over pedigree, so if you have built similar systems and learn quickly, we encourage you to apply.

Minimum Work Experience: 7+ years in quality assurance with a strong automation focus

Minimum Education: Bachelor's in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

Benefits And Perks Of Working For Cboe Global Markets

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer:

  • Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick days and annual community service days
  • Flexible, hybrid work environment
  • Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services 2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire
  • Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities

Some of our associates’ favorite benefits and perks include:

  • Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office
  • Paid tuition assistance and education opportunities
  • Generous charitable giving company match
  • Paid parental leave and fertility benefits
  • On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers

More About Cboe Global Markets

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people. Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed.

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes.

Learn more about life at Cboe on our website and LinkedIn.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment based on any legally protected characteristic, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or Veteran status. We are committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued and respected.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)

At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $121,550-$157,300, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location.

This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long-term equity programs.

Additional information about Cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: Total Rewards at CBOE.

Any communication from Cboe regarding this position will only come from a Cboe recruiter who has a @cboe.com email or via LinkedIn Recruiter. Cboe does not use any other third party communication tools for recruiting purposes.

Integration & Test Engineers collaborate with the Software Engineering and Systems Engineering teams to design and execute automated software testing strategies. The ideal candidate will possess, or be willing to develop, expertise in testing integrated hardware systems.

Working in an Agile environment as part of a cross-functional product team, the candidate will be responsible for performing tasks that require strong collaboration and communication skills. Team-oriented engineers who are comfortable communicating technical capabilities to both internal and external audiences are encouraged to apply.

Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to lead the design, development, and execution of testing solutions that ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of our software products. This role requires expertise in testing the underlying platform and technologies, a proactive quality mindset, and the ability to collaborate closely with engineering and product teams in an Agile environment.


Roles & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:


Certify applications built on modern tech stacks like Java, spring boot, Tomcat, Kafka, openshift/EKS, oracle, cockroach.

Validate platform changes, ensuring compliance with change control, incident, and problem management processes.

Develop comprehensive test plans and test cases to validate platform architecture and design.

Lead API testing, including functional, integration, and regression testing for platform components and integrations.

Ensure adherence to security, compliance, and infrastructure standards during validation.

Support continuous integration and deployment by automating test scenarios and verifying automated test suite execution as part of CI/CD process.

Ensure optimal test coverage by collaborating with platform engineers to understand implemented changes that need to be tested.

Proficient in testing applications developed on On-prem, Cloud, and Hybrid architectures.

Identify opportunities for improving test processes and tools to enhance validation efficiency.

Serve as a key resource for coordinating dependencies across platform teams and ensuring consistent quality across initiatives.

Report test results, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders and recommend improvements for platform reliability and scalability.

Self-driven and able to demonstrate strong understanding of products, services, business flows, and financial context to validate platform changes effectively.

Required Skills:




15+ years of experience in software quality assurance, platform validation, and testing across complex infrastructure and application environments.

10+ years of hands-on experience in test automation, serving in lead and technical leadership roles.

10+ years of hands-on experience in reviewing requirements and project documentation to understand the application and perform automation feasibility analysis.

8+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, executing, maintaining, and analyzing automated test scripts.

8+ years of hands-on experience executing automation scripts, preparing executions reports and defect logs analyze test failures, log defects, and collaborate with developers to drive them to resolution.

10+ years in Technologies such as Core Java, SQL, Selenium and Cucumber to write test scripts.

6+ years of Data/File/Database and ETL/Data warehouse testing and proficient in testing all conversions – File to file, file to Database, database to file etc.

Experience debugging and troubleshooting automated testcases.

Strong command over SQL. Ability to write complex queries across different systems – preferred Oracle

Strong experience (3+ years) in parsing & generating data/files, bank standards, XML/json payloads and XPath

Hands on with Eclipse or NetBeans Project Management; Version Management, API Testing, Litmus, Jenkins, Selenium, Cucumber, Version control like bitbucket

Strong analytical and troubleshooting, debugging/triaging skills.

Comfortable working with Linux & Windows operating systems including shell scripting

descriptionHtml:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

The work:

Accenture Federal Services is seeking a Quality Assurance Tester to join our team and support our client in Washington, DC. As a Quality Assurance Tester, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability and performance of software applications through both automated and manual testing methods. Your day-to-day activities will involve designing and executing test cases, identifying defects, and collaborating closely with development teams to resolve issues efficiently. You will leverage your expertise in .Net, Python, bash, PowerShell and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to create robust automation scripts, while also applying your knowledge of front-end frameworks to validate user interfaces and workflows. Your attention to detail will be crucial as you verify that all software components meet stringent quality standards before deployment. In this role, you will benefit from hands-on experience with a variety of testing tools and processes, such as automated testing frameworks, bug tracking systems, and continuous integration pipelines. Exposure to front-end technologies and scripting languages will enhance your ability to identify and troubleshoot issues across different layers of the application.

What you’ll do:

  • Design, develop, and execute automated and manual test cases for web applications
  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Identify, document, and track software defects using established processes
  • Test front-end frameworks for functionality, usability, and compatibility
  • Analyze test results and provide actionable feedback to developers
  • Participate in test planning, estimation, and status meetings
  • Maintain and update test documentation as needed

Here's what you need:

  • 2 years of experience in quality assurance/testing (manual & automated)
  • Experience with Atlassian tools such as: JIRA or Confluence
  • Experience with Selenium and Cypress
  • Experience running queries to validate data
  • Experience with Gitlab/Git for source control of code
  • Active Top Secret clearance required

Bonus points if you have:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field and 1 year of experience working within AWS cloud infrastructure
  • Experience in .Net
  • Experience in JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Previous experience with automated testing tools & frameworks
  • Prior experience in a secure environment

As required by local law, Accenture Federal Services provides reasonable ranges of compensation for hired roles based on labor costs in the states of California, Colorado, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, and the District of Columbia. The base pay range for this position in these locations is shown below. Compensation for roles at Accenture Federal Services varies depending on a wide array of factors, including but not limited to office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. Accenture Federal Services offers a wide variety of benefits. You can find more information on benefits here. We accept applications on an on-going basis and there is no fixed deadline to apply.

The pay range for the states of California, Colorado, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, and the District of Columbia is:

$94,000—$178,700 USD

As a company wholly dedicated to serving the US federal government, we bring together the best talent to help reinvent how federal agencies operate and deliver greater value for their mission and the American people. We have an unwavering commitment to creating a culture in which all our people are respected, feel a sense of belonging, and have equal opportunity. As a business imperative, every person at Accenture Federal Services has the responsibility to create and sustain a culture where everyone feels welcomed and included. This is grounded in our core values and our experience that hiring and developing great people who reflect different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds is key to driving innovation and delivering the results that our clients and the country count on.

Requesting An Accommodation

If you are hired by Accenture Federal Services and require accommodation to perform the essential functions of your role, you will be asked to participate in our reasonable accommodation process. Accommodations made to facilitate the recruiting process are not a guarantee of future or continued accommodations once hired.

If you are being considered for employment opportunities with Accenture Federal Services and need an accommodation for a disability or religious observance during the interview process or for the job you are interviewing for, please speak with your recruiter.

Other Employment Statements

Candidates who are currently employed by a client of Accenture Federal Services or an affiliated Accenture business may not be eligible for consideration.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

Job Description

Primary Function of Position:

The Ion™ endoluminal system is Intuitive's robotic platform for minimally invasive biopsy in the peripheral lung, with an initial goal of improving the early diagnosis of lung cancer. The main responsibility of the position is to contribute to the design, development, and advancement of automated testing solutions for the Ion products, playing a key role in shaping test strategies and driving quality initiatives across the organization.

This position requires an individual with strong technical and interpersonal skills, the ability to work effectively and collaboratively with highly technical peers, and the capability to manage work load among multiple priorities. The primary focus of the position is on developing test automation using an established test automation framework for formal verification and validation of Ion software. The role will also include hands on verification/validation, root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and formal design control documentation.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Design and develop automated testing solutions and frameworks for Ion products, including GUI-focused automation.
  • Architect and maintain robust automation frameworks to support product quality and scalability
  • Develop, execute, and maintain robust automated test suites.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, UI/UX designers, and other software test team members, driving continuous improvements in our testing processes and results.
  • Influence and negotiate with software developers to deliver important interfaces between test automation and product software.
  • Develop requirement/specifications and perform validation for test automation tools.
  • Identify, report, and help resolve defects and inconsistencies with the tests/framework.
  • Support formal Verification and Validation activities (perform test execution, write reports, verify JIRA tickets).
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Contribute to code reviews and support automation best practices within the team.
  • Prepare and maintain test documentation, including status reports and metrics on automation efforts.
  • Mentor other team members to build automation expertise within the team

Qualifications

Skill/Job Requirements:

To Qualify For This Position, a Candidate Must Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline and 6+ years’ experience (or Master’s degree with 4+ years’ experience).
  • Proven experience in test automation, software development, or software test.
  • Proficiency in writing code in at least one programming language and ability to ramp up quickly on other languages as needed.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing tools/frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, test planning, test case design, software testing types (unit, integration, functional, regression).
  • Experience with Defect Tracking and Requirements Traceability tools.
  • Excellent communication (verbal and presentation) and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work with limited guidance in a fast paced environment.
  • Possess excellent time management and prioritization skills.
  • Creative mindset to design efficient and comprehensive automated tests.
  • Troubleshooting mindset, an ability to systematically and effectively break down a system or process into subparts to identify failure mechanisms.

Ideally, a Candidate Would Also Have

  • Experience integrating with existing software in a variety of languages (C/C++, Matlab, Python, Go, batch scripting, etc.).
  • Experience with automated GUI testing using Squish (or similar), including scripting and maintaining tests for embedded applications.
  • Experience with Medical Design Control processes.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git, SVN).
  • Experience with Bug Tracking tools.
  • Experience with Requirements Management Tools.
  • Experience with Test Management Tools.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools and processes.

Senior QA Engineer -AI & Engineering

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Work You'll Do

As an SDET III, you will bring considerable technical expertise to deliver effective solutions to clients including the following:

  • Acting as the lead, interfacing between clients and our Deloitte teams.
  • Helping to create testing solutions to meet our clients' business needs.
  • Leading the testing of custom technology solutions.

Required Qualifications And Experience

  • 6+ years' relevant consulting or industry experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.
  • 4+ years hands-on experience defining the testing strategy for large scale programs and ensuring requirements traceability throughout the system development lifecycle. Experience should include leading the testing efforts, including experience with all phases of testing: system integration, user acceptance, and performance testing.
  • Experience with at least two of the following: TCOE, TMO, mobile testing, automation testing, SAP/Oracle testing, data testing in a client-facing or industry role.
  • 4+ years' experience driving the quality assurance processes and gaining delivery and buy-in from executive leadership.
  • 2+ years' experience leading teams - onshore, offshore and nearshore.
  • Experience with Test and Defect Management tools - MicroFocus, ALM, JIRA.
  • 4+ years' experience working in a testing role in different environments including the following: client server, service-oriented architecture, web-based, mainframe-based and three-tier architectures.
  • Experience with the following: MicroFocus UFT, Rational Tooling, and Open Source Automation Tools such as Selenium, Cucumber, OpSoapUI, PostMan, RESTAssured, Mockito.
  • Experience in at least one Scripting language - Shell, VBScript, Perl or Python.
  • Experience with Source Control Systems - SVN or GIT.
  • Experience with Build tools - Maven, CircleCI.
  • Experience with Automated Reporting.
  • Experience with Cloud testing, API testing
  • Experience with CI/CD/CT tools - Jenkins, Bamboo, Quickbuild.
  • Experience applying prompt engineering techniques to generate, refine, or debug automated test scripts and test data.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

  • Experience working in Cloud, Web and Mobile Testing platforms - Saucelabs, Browerstack are preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning models.
  • Experience in Python NLTK or similar natural language processing technology.
  • Experience evaluating or testing AI/LLM-based application features (e.g., chatbots, copilots, RAG-based systems), including prompt-response validation and hallucination/edge-case testing.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted defect triage or root-cause analysis tools that reduce manual investigation time.
  • Exposure to self-healing test automation frameworks (AI-driven locator repair, visual AI testing).
  • Understanding of responsible AI/testing governance principles (bias detection, explainability, model validation) as applied to QE.
  • Experience contributing to or influencing AI-adoption roadmaps within a testing/QE organization.
  • Experience implementing testing best practices specific to the test planning and execution processes and gaining buy-in for changes from executives.
  • A deep understanding of testing planning and associated delivery challenges.
  • A strong understanding of the various approaches used in testing techniques - white-box, black-box, load testing, coverage testing and regression testing.

Sponsorship:

  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Wages + Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Broadridge is hiring! The Senior Software QA Engineer is primarily responsible for building and maintaining automation frameworks for web applications, APIs, and databases using Java, Python, Playwright, Selenium, REST Assured, and related tools. The role will focus on the analyst's ability to understanding testing requirements, test case creation, test execution, and reporting test results for to all partners for assigned projects. You will be an individual contributor who is responsible for the preparation of test data, test planning and execution, reporting on testing status.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain reliable, performant, and testable application features, and troubleshoot defects through log analysis, debugging, and code fixes.
  • Build and maintain automation frameworks for web applications, APIs, and databases using Java, Python, Playwright, Selenium, REST Assured, and related tools.
  • Develop unit, integration, API, and end-to-end tests; validate data integrity and business rules using SQL; and create reusable utilities, test data, mocks, and service simulations.
  • Review requirements and technical designs to identify gaps, edge cases, and testing needs early in the development lifecycle.
  • Architect and maintain production-grade CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Groovy, integrating automated tests to support timely feedback and release decisions.
  • Monitor test results, investigate flaky tests, and improve test execution speed, reliability, and coverage.
  • Develop and test AI agents that support test case generation, automation code generation, test execution, and failure analysis.
  • Partner with application teams to assess functional and automation testing gaps, recommend solutions aligned with Broadridge Platform Quality Engineering (PQE) standards, and guide implementation.
  • Support application teams in adopting PQE frameworks, pipeline templates, and AI plugins through onboarding, documentation, feedback collection, and answer quality checks.
  • Triage and resolve or escalate PQE support requests involving pipelines, execution agents, automation frameworks, and AI plugins, including root cause analysis.
  • Maintain and enhance the test execution platform, including Jenkins agents, Selenium Grid, network and proxy connectivity, and AWS container migration.
  • Contribute framework fixes, enhancements, and dependency and security updates; participate in code reviews; and promote maintainable design and coding standards.
  • Collaborate with developers, SDETs, product owners, and DevOps teams to deliver production-ready software.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • At least 8–10 years of hands-on experience in software development and/or application architecture, including proficiency in Java, Node.js, and Python.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD practices and DevOps methodologies, with experience using tools such as Jenkins, Git, Terraform, and Chef.
  • Hands-on experience with Jenkins agents, Selenium Grid, and AWS; familiarity with Serenity BDD, Cucumber, Maven, and Artifactory.
  • Experience supporting automation users across multiple teams, with strong debugging, log analysis, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience working in Agile environments using Scrum or Kanban.
  • Practical experience with AI coding assistants and an interest in testing AI-powered tools.
  • Demonstrated experience as a team lead, mentor, or technical subject matter expert, with strong communication and cross-team collaboration skills.
  • Commitment to clean, maintainable code and continuous improvement of coding standards and delivery processes.

Position Summary

While the formal title is Senior Test Automation Engineer, this is fundamentally a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) role that requires deep software development expertise and hands-on coding experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, and/or C#, along with strong working knowledge of SQL. The ideal candidate views test automation as a software engineering discipline and has experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable automated testing frameworks for enterprise applications.

The Senior Test Automation Engineer is responsible for establishing and owning the automated quality engineering capabilities that support the long-term success of the SPM Cloud platform. The role will initially focus on gaining knowledge of the testing framework, release processes, validation approaches, and quality controls used during implementation while helping prepare STERIS to assume operational ownership.

As the platform transitions to an internally managed product, this position will become responsible for defining and executing the automated testing strategy, quality governance framework, release assurance processes, test automation architecture, and quality engineering standards that support ongoing software development and product enhancements. The role will serve as a key contributor in ensuring software quality, reliability, scalability, and delivery excellence across future platform initiatives.

  • This position is located in Vernon Hills, IL with the opportunity for a hybrid work schedule. Qualified candidates currently residing within commuting distance of Vernon Hills preferred.

What You'll Do as a Senior Test Automation Engineer

  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, define test strategies, and support project planning and execution.
  • Designs, develops, maintains, and enhances automated testing frameworks and quality engineering solutions aligned to enterprise development standards and best practices.
  • Develops and executes functional, integration, regression, API, and end-to-end automated test suites to ensure software quality and release readiness.
  • Establishes testing standards, automation practices, and quality engineering processes to support long-term product success.
  • Participates in release readiness reviews, deployment validation activities, and continuous improvement initiatives across the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Investigates software defects, performs root cause analysis, and works with engineering teams to implement corrective actions.
  • Collaborates with developers and architects to improve application quality, testability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Ensures traceability between business requirements, acceptance criteria, test cases, and validation results.
  • Creates and maintains testing documentation, quality metrics, test coverage analysis, and operational procedures.
  • Leads the evolution of automated testing capabilities while promoting engineering best practices and quality-focused development.

Required

The Experience, Skills and Abilities Needed

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 8+ years of professional software testing, quality engineering, test automation, or related software engineering experience.
  • Experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks for enterprise software applications.
  • Strong experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent modern test automation frameworks.
  • Experience developing automated tests using TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, or similar programming languages.
  • Experience testing REST APIs, web services, integrations, and distributed applications.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, database validation techniques, and Git-based source control workflows.
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and Agile software delivery environments.
  • Experience supporting production applications through defect triage, troubleshooting, release validation, and root cause analysis activities.

Preferred

  • Experience with Playwright at enterprise scale.
  • Experience testing React-based applications and modern web architectures.
  • Experience testing cloud-native applications hosted in Azure.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or other modern CI/CD platforms.
  • Experience testing event-driven, messaging, or API-first architectures.
  • Knowledge of performance, load, stress, resiliency, accessibility, and WCAG compliance testing practices.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Application Insights, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, or similar solutions.
  • Familiarity with Docker, containerized environments, and modern development workflows.
  • Experience working in healthcare, medical device, regulated, or compliance-driven software environments.
  • Experience establishing quality engineering standards and mentoring engineers within distributed software teams.
  • Knowledge of service virtualization, contract testing, and consumer-driven testing approaches.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted software development and validation practices.

Position Summary

While the formal title is Senior Test Automation Engineer, this is fundamentally a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) role that requires deep software development expertise and hands-on coding experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, and/or C#, along with strong working knowledge of SQL. The ideal candidate views test automation as a software engineering discipline and has experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable automated testing frameworks for enterprise applications.

The Senior Test Automation Engineer is responsible for establishing and owning the automated quality engineering capabilities that support the long-term success of the SPM Cloud platform. The role will initially focus on gaining knowledge of the testing framework, release processes, validation approaches, and quality controls used during implementation while helping prepare STERIS to assume operational ownership.

As the platform transitions to an internally managed product, this position will become responsible for defining and executing the automated testing strategy, quality governance framework, release assurance processes, test automation architecture, and quality engineering standards that support ongoing software development and product enhancements. The role will serve as a key contributor in ensuring software quality, reliability, scalability, and delivery excellence across future platform initiatives.



- This position is located in Vernon Hills, IL with the opportunity for a hybrid work schedule. Qualified candidates currently residing within commuting distance of Vernon Hills preferred.

What You'll Do as a Senior Test Automation Engineer



- Collaborates with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, define test strategies, and support project planning and execution.
- Designs, develops, maintains, and enhances automated testing frameworks and quality engineering solutions aligned to enterprise development standards and best practices.
- Develops and executes functional, integration, regression, API, and end-to-end automated test suites to ensure software quality and release readiness.
- Establishes testing standards, automation practices, and quality engineering processes to support long-term product success.
- Participates in release readiness reviews, deployment validation activities, and continuous improvement initiatives across the software delivery lifecycle.
- Investigates software defects, performs root cause analysis, and works with engineering teams to implement corrective actions.
- Collaborates with developers and architects to improve application quality, testability, reliability, and maintainability.
- Ensures traceability between business requirements, acceptance criteria, test cases, and validation results.
- Creates and maintains testing documentation, quality metrics, test coverage analysis, and operational procedures.
- Leads the evolution of automated testing capabilities while promoting engineering best practices and quality-focused development.

Required

The Experience, Skills and Abilities Needed



- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
- 8+ years of professional software testing, quality engineering, test automation, or related software engineering experience.
- Experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks for enterprise software applications.
- Strong experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent modern test automation frameworks.
- Experience developing automated tests using TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, or similar programming languages.
- Experience testing REST APIs, web services, integrations, and distributed applications.
- Working knowledge of SQL, database validation techniques, and Git-based source control workflows.
- Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and Agile software delivery environments.
- Experience supporting production applications through defect triage, troubleshooting, release validation, and root cause analysis activities.

Preferred



- Experience with Playwright at enterprise scale.
- Experience testing React-based applications and modern web architectures.
- Experience testing cloud-native applications hosted in Azure.
- Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or other modern CI/CD platforms.
- Experience testing event-driven, messaging, or API-first architectures.
- Knowledge of performance, load, stress, resiliency, accessibility, and WCAG compliance testing practices.
- Experience with observability platforms such as Application Insights, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, or similar solutions.
- Familiarity with Docker, containerized environments, and modern development workflows.
- Experience working in healthcare, medical device, regulated, or compliance-driven software environments.
- Experience establishing quality engineering standards and mentoring engineers within distributed software teams.
- Knowledge of service virtualization, contract testing, and consumer-driven testing approaches.
- Exposure to AI-assisted software development and validation practices.

descriptionHtml:
Edgewater Federal Solutions is seeking a Test Engineer to support a major national laboratory.

The successful candidate will support the expertise in R&D across many disciplines including large-scale software engineering, computer science, and system engineering. Our specific capabilities include software development, software testing, and system integration. We leverage these capabilities to innovate high-rigor solutions while supporting existing critical customer needs. Our current responsibility includes support for real-time national security missions.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, recommend, and implement automated test tools and Design, implement, and conduct test and evaluation procedures to ensure system requirements are met.
  • Develop, maintain, and upgrade automated test scripts and architectures for application products.
  • Write, implement, and report status for system test cases for testing.
  • Analyze test cases and provide regular progress reports.
  • Serve as subject matter specialist providing testing know-how for the support of user requirements of complex to highly complex software/hardware applications.
  • Direct and/or participate in all phases of risk management assessments and software/hardware development with emphasis on analysis of user requirements, test design and test tools selection.

Qualifications

  • BS/BA in a relevant Computer Science or related field and two (2) years of directly related experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform the duties of the job or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q Clearance on Start or DOD Top Secret with Reciprocity, and ability to obtain a SCI clearance
  • Must be United States Citizen
  • On-site full time

Required Skills:

  • Experience with design, development, and execution of software testing.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication interpersonal skills.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements.
  • Experience with programming in Python.

Desired Skills:

  • Knowledge of scripting languages such as Bash and UNIX command languages
  • Cloud technologies
  • Continuous Improvement/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipeline
  • Containerization (Docker preferred)
  • Large-scale (1M+ lines of code) systems
  • Experience working with large, established codebases
  • Experience with Agile software development practices

About Us:

Edgewater Federal Solutions is a privately held government contracting firm located in Frederick, MD. The company was founded in 2002 with the vision of being highly recognized and admired for supporting customer missions through employee empowerment, exceptional services and timely delivery. Edgewater Federal Solutions is ISO 9001, 20000-1, 270001 certified, appraised at CMMI Level 3 Maturity for Development and Services, and has been named in the Top Workplaces in the Greater Washington Area Small Companies for 2018 through 2025.

It has been and continues to be the policy of Edgewater Federal Solutions to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, and/or other statuses protected by applicable law.
